### Task 020: Atomic Task Claiming, Deferred-FK Attempt Creation, Lease Expiry Sweeper & Monotonic Sleep-Skew Guard

- **Milestone & Track:** `M0 · Kernel Storage & Database Layer`
- **Depends On:** `Task 001`, `Task 012`, `Task 013`, `Task 017`
- **Git Worktree & Branch:** `task/020-task-claiming-leases-sleep-guard` in `../ef-wt/task-020-task-claiming-leases-sleep-guard` (commit on own branch only; **NEVER merge**)
- **Owned Write Scope (Disjoint Subtree):** `packages/db/src/leases/**`, `packages/db/tests/leases/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-020.md`
- **Mandatory Reference Files:** [database-design.md](database-design.md#five-more-traps), [architecture-review-decisions.md](architecture-review-decisions.md), [investigations-and-sweeps.md](investigations-and-sweeps.md#ownership-and-timing), [stops-undo-and-reentry.md](stops-undo-and-reentry.md), [schema/state.sql](schema/state.sql), [schema/queries.sql](schema/queries.sql), [schema/schema-test.js](schema/schema-test.js)
- **Shared Contracts Consumed / Produced:** Consumes `ProjectStateDb` (`Task 013`); produces `TaskLeaseManager` (`claimTask`, `renewLease`, `sweepExpiredLeases`, `fenceAttempts`, `onPowerResume`, `registerTaskScopes`, `openSweepIntent`, `grantSweepLease`, `releaseSweepLease`) and injectable `DualClock` (`wallMs` + `monotonicMs`)

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Implement atomic `claimTask` + `createAttempt` in one `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` transaction:** Execute `claim_task` from [schema/queries.sql](schema/queries.sql) checking all 6 conditions atomically (claimable state, exact `expected_brief` version, zero `task_holds`, zero unfinished `depends_on` tasks, zero overlapping `path_leases` in `'intent'` or `'granted'` mode, race-safe `UPDATE ... RETURNING epoch`), immediately insert the `attempts` row via `create_attempt` satisfying the deferred FK `holder_attempt`, and return `{ claimed: true, epoch, attemptId }` or exact structured refusal reason (`not_ready | held | dependency_open | brief_stale | sweep_overlap | lost_race`).
- [ ] **Implement `task_scopes` write-scope prefix registration:** Convert task write-scope globs (`src/app/kitchen/**`, `tests/kitchen/print.*`) into normalized literal path prefixes (`src/app/kitchen/`, `tests/kitchen/print.`) persisted in `task_scopes(task, path_prefix)` at task publish so SQL prefix overlap matching in `claim_task` and `grant_sweep_lease` is exact.
- [ ] **Implement Sweep Path-Lease Lifecycle (`openSweepIntent`, `grantSweepLease`, `releaseSweepLease`):** Insert `path_leases` (`mode = 'intent'`) + `path_lease_prefixes` atomically to immediately block new overlapping task claims; poll/trigger `grant_sweep_lease` so `'granted'` activates ONLY once zero overlapping tasks remain in `('LEASED','CODING','STATIC_AUDIT','CLEAN_VERIFY')` ([schema/queries.sql](schema/queries.sql), deep-review Fix #3).
- [ ] **Implement Lease Heartbeat Renewal (`renewLease`):** Extend `lease_expires_at` strictly while `(task, holder_attempt, epoch)` still matches and state is `'LEASED'` or `'CODING'`; return `LeaseFencedError` on 0 changed rows.
- [ ] **Implement Lease Expiry Sweeper & Attempt Fencing (`sweepExpiredLeases`):** Execute `sweep_expired_leases` (which strictly skips `submission_pending = 1`!) followed by `fence_attempts` inside one transaction, bumping `epoch` on every expired task so returning stale workers can never submit or mutate state.
- [ ] **Implement Monotonic Clock & Sleep-Skew Guard (`DualClock` + `SleepSkewGuard`):** Track `(wallMs, monotonicMs)` continuously ([database-design.md](database-design.md#five-more-traps)); on OS power-resume event OR whenever `|(wallNow - wallPrev) - (monoNow - monoPrev)| > 30_000` (laptop sleep or NTP/DST wall-clock jump), **suspend the expiry sweeper immediately** until a process-reconciliation pass checks every active attempt's live OS process, extends leases for truly live attempts, and expires ONLY genuinely dead attempts!
- [ ] **Implement `attempt_checkpoints` persistence:** Provide atomic read/write helpers for `attempt_checkpoints(attempt, step, wip_ref, session_ref, contract_versions, pending_effects, handoff_artifact, updated_at)` so every turn boundary survives restarts and sleep.
- [ ] **Verify deferred FK integrity:** Test that committing a `task_runtime.holder_attempt` without inserting its matching `attempts` row is rejected by SQLite at `COMMIT`.

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **Laptop sleeps for 2 hours while 4 workers are healthy or mid-checkpoint:** Without `SleepSkewGuard`, wall-clock `lease_expires_at < now` would expire and fence all 4 leases simultaneously on wake; verify simulated 1-hour wall-clock jump suspends expiry sweeper, runs `reconcileLiveAttempts`, extends live processes, and expires only dead PIDs.
- **Two workers racing to claim the exact same `READY` task:** Under concurrent calls, exactly ONE gets `claimed: true` with `epoch = old + 1` and the second gets `claimed: false` (`lost_race`) with zero orphan `attempts` rows.
- **Glob-to-prefix edge cases (`src/app/**`, `src/app/foo*.ts`, `src/app`, Windows backslashes `src\app\**`):** Always normalize to POSIX forward slashes, preserve trailing directory boundary awareness (`src/app/` vs `src/app-extra/` must NOT falsely collide unless true prefix!), and handle root wildcard `**` cleanly as empty prefix `''`.
- **Two overlapping sweeps queued simultaneously:** Serialize overlapping `path_leases` so neither can starve or deadlock the other; non-overlapping sweeps (e.g., `packages/a/` vs `packages/b/`) may be granted simultaneously.
- **Worker's `submit_candidate` arriving 1 ms before lease expiry while sweeper runs:** Because `accept_submission` sets `submission_pending = 1`, `sweep_expired_leases` strictly skips it (`AND submission_pending = 0`).
- **Clock jumping backwards by 10 minutes (NTP correction):** Monotonic delta detects negative wall shift `> 30 s` and triggers safe reconciliation without corrupting remaining lease durations.
- **Task dependency in `SUPERSEDED` or `CANCELLED` state:** Verify `task_states.done` semantics (`ACCEPTED` and `MERGED_TO_FEATURE` have `done = 1`; verify how cancelled dependencies are retired/removed from active `depends_on` edges before claiming).

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Single Active Holder Invariant:** At most one active `attempt` may hold `task_runtime.holder_attempt` for any task at any instant, enforced structurally by SQLite's conditional `claim_task` and deferred FK.
- **Monotonic Fencing Epoch Invariant:** Every claim, expiry, or reassignment strictly increments `task_runtime.epoch`; an older epoch can never renew, submit, or advance a ref.
- **Zero Sleep False-Expiry Invariant:** Wall-clock jumps `> 30 s` ALWAYS suspend expiry sweeping until process reconciliation finishes.
- **All-Or-Nothing Sweep Grant Invariant:** A sweep holds zero partial paths while waiting; `'intent'` blocks new claims and `'granted'` requires zero active overlapping tasks.
- **Zero Path-Separator Mismatch Invariant:** `task_scopes` and `path_lease_prefixes` ALWAYS store normalized POSIX paths (`/`), never raw Windows `\`.
- **Atomic Claim-Plus-Attempt Invariant:** `claim_task` and `create_attempt` ALWAYS execute inside the same `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` transaction.

#### Multi-Agent Harmony And Branch Isolation

- **Worktree Setup:** Create branch `task/020-task-claiming-leases-sleep-guard` via `node scripts/agent-worktree.mjs create 020 task-claiming-leases-sleep-guard`.
- **Strict Subtree Boundary:** Touch ONLY `packages/db/src/leases/**`, `packages/db/tests/leases/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-020.md`.
- **Parallel Safe Execution:** Disjoint from `Task 021` (holds & submissions) and `Tasks 022–030`.
- **Handoff For `Task 034` (Sim), `Task 095` (Dispatcher), `Task 131` (Power Monitor), `Task 184` (Sweeps):** Export `TaskLeaseManager`, `DualClock`, `SleepSkewGuard`, `AttemptCheckpointRepo`, and `globToPathPrefix` in `.agent-handoffs/task-020.md`.
- **Commit-Only Discipline:** Commit exclusively on `task/020-task-claiming-leases-sleep-guard`; **NEVER merge** into `main` or `harness/integration`.
- **Canonical Queries Only:** Execute `claim_task`, `create_attempt`, `sweep_expired_leases`, `fence_attempts`, `open_sweep_intent`, and `grant_sweep_lease` directly from [schema/queries.sql](schema/queries.sql).

#### Verification, Testing And Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Run `pnpm --filter @ef-harness/db test -- leases` verifying all 6 `claim_task` rejection conditions (not ready, held, unfinished dep, stale brief, sweep overlap, race loss) and deferred FK enforcement.
- [ ] Verify `SleepSkewGuard` with fake `DualClock`: inject +1 hour sleep jump and -10 min backward clock jump, prove expiry sweeper pauses, live attempt leases extend, and only dead attempts are fenced.
- [ ] Verify sweep lifecycle: `'intent'` blocks overlapping claims while permitting disjoint claims; `'granted'` refuses while overlapping task is `CODING` and succeeds once parked.
- [ ] Verify `attempt_checkpoints` upsert and read round-trip preserves `wip_ref`, `session_ref`, `contract_versions`, and `pending_effects`.
- [ ] Run `pnpm --filter @ef-harness/db typecheck`, `lint`, and `node scripts/verify-harmony.mjs --task 020`.
- **Acceptance:** Atomic task claiming, sweep path leases, deferred-FK attempt creation, checkpoint storage, and sleep-skew-proof lease sweeping pass 100% of tests on `task/020-task-claiming-leases-sleep-guard`.

### Task 021: Task Holds Engine (`task_holds`), Submission Protection (`accept_submission`/`finish_submission`) & Fencing Epochs

- **Milestone & Track:** `M0 · Kernel Storage & Database Layer`
- **Depends On:** `Task 001`, `Task 012`, `Task 013`, `Task 020`
- **Git Worktree & Branch:** `task/021-holds-submissions-fencing` in `../ef-wt/task-021-holds-submissions-fencing` (commit on own branch only; **NEVER merge**)
- **Owned Write Scope (Disjoint Subtree):** `packages/db/src/holds/**`, `packages/db/tests/holds/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-021.md`
- **Mandatory Reference Files:** [database-design.md](database-design.md#additions-from-the-18-november-architecture-review), [architecture-review-decisions.md](architecture-review-decisions.md), [architecture-deep-review.md](architecture-deep-review.md), [build-pipeline.md](build-pipeline.md#state-machines), [routing-design.md](routing-design.md#which-work-to-hold), [schema/state.sql](schema/state.sql), [schema/queries.sql](schema/queries.sql), [schema/schema-test.js](schema/schema-test.js)
- **Shared Contracts Consumed / Produced:** Consumes `ProjectStateDb` (`Task 013`), `HOLD_REASONS`/`TASK_STATES` (`Task 010`); produces `TaskHoldAndSubmissionRepo` (`placeHold`, `releaseHold`, `listActiveHolds`, `isTaskHeld`, `submitAndAcceptCandidate`, `finishSubmission`, `transitionTaskState`, `parkTask`, `resumeParkedTask`)

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Implement Multi-Reason Non-Overwriting Holds (`placeHold`, `releaseHold`, `listActiveHolds`):** Insert/delete individual rows in `task_holds(task, reason, source, created_at)` keyed by `(task, reason, source)` so a `user_pause` from `msg-1`, a `requirement_change` from `CS-88`, a `budget` hold, a `ccr` hold, and a `governor` hold coexist independently without overwriting each other; releasing `('T07', 'requirement_change', 'CS-88')` NEVER clears `('T07', 'user_pause', 'msg-1')`.
- [ ] **Enforce "Held Is A Property, Not A State":** Confirm placing or releasing a hold NEVER overwrites `task_runtime.state` (preserving `'READY'`, `'CODING'`, `'PARKED'`, etc.) and emit durable outbox events (`TaskHoldPlaced`, `TaskHoldReleased`, `TaskUnheld` only when hold count hits 0).
- [ ] **Implement Atomic Candidate Submission + Lease Protection (`submitAndAcceptCandidate`):** In ONE `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` transaction, run `submit_candidate` (which checks `holder_attempt = :attempt AND epoch = :epoch` and enforces `UNIQUE(task, attempt, commit_sha)`) AND `accept_submission` (transitioning `('LEASED'|'CODING') → 'STATIC_AUDIT'` and setting `submission_pending = 1` so slow verification can never lose its lease — deep-review Fix #5!), plus update `attempts.state = 'submitted'`.
- [ ] **Implement Verification Outcome Finalizer (`finishSubmission`):** Execute `finish_submission` from [schema/queries.sql](schema/queries.sql) requiring `epoch = :epoch AND submission_pending = 1`, clearing `submission_pending = 0`, transitioning to `'ACCEPTED'`, `'CODING'` (static findings / hint ladder), `'ESCALATED'` (clearing `holder_attempt`), or `'EXHAUSTED'` (clearing `holder_attempt`), and updating `attempts.state` and `ended_at` consistently.
- [ ] **Implement Legal Task State Machine Transition Validator (`transitionTaskState`):** Enforce the exact directed state graph of all 15 states in [build-pipeline.md](build-pipeline.md#task) (`DRAFTED → READY → LEASED → CODING → STATIC_AUDIT → CLEAN_VERIFY → ACCEPTED → MERGED_TO_FEATURE`, plus `WAITING_INPUT`, `PARKED`, `ESCALATED`, `EXHAUSTED`, `HUMAN_OWNED`, `SUPERSEDED`, `CANCELLED`), rejecting illegal transitions (e.g., `CODING → ACCEPTED` bypassing `STATIC_AUDIT` and `CLEAN_VERIFY`!) with typed `IllegalTaskTransitionError`.
- [ ] **Implement `STATIC_AUDIT → CLEAN_VERIFY` gated transition:** Verify a task can enter `CLEAN_VERIFY` ONLY from `STATIC_AUDIT` with `submission_pending = 1` and matching `epoch`, guaranteeing no candidate ever skips the static completeness gate.
- [ ] **Implement `parkTask` & `resumeParkedTask`:** Transition active attempts cleanly to `PARKED` (recording checkpoint ref, preserving `task_holds`) and resume `PARKED → READY` ONLY when holds permit and the user/resumption policy triggers.
- [ ] **Implement Epoch Fencing Helper (`assertCurrentEpoch`):** Provide a single reusable transaction guard verifying `(task, attempt, epoch)` so every worker MCP mutation (`ask_owner`, `flag_blocked`, `submit_candidate`, `dispute_test`) rejects stale or fenced workers immediately.

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **User pauses email (`user_pause`) AND steers print (`requirement_change`), then print clarifies:** Releasing `requirement_change` leaves `user_pause` active; `isTaskHeld` stays `true` and `claim_task` still refuses the task until the explicit user pause is released ([architecture-review-decisions.md](architecture-review-decisions.md)).
- **Duplicate `submit_candidate` retry with the same `(task, attempt, commit_sha)` after timeout:** Handle idempotently via `operations` + `UNIQUE(task, attempt, commit_sha)` returning the original candidate receipt rather than failing or duplicating verification.
- **Late submission from a fenced attempt (`epoch` older than `task_runtime.epoch`):** `submit_candidate` changes `0` rows; return typed `StaleEpochError` while keeping the attempt's historical worktree/commit inspectable.
- **Direct jump from `CODING` to `ACCEPTED` or `MERGED_TO_FEATURE`:** `transitionTaskState` MUST reject any transition that bypasses `STATIC_AUDIT` or `CLEAN_VERIFY`, closing a major security/completeness bypass.
- **`HUMAN_OWNED` completion ("I'm done"):** Must transition `HUMAN_OWNED → STATIC_AUDIT` (and onward to `CLEAN_VERIFY`), matching [build-pipeline.md](build-pipeline.md#task) and [editor-coexistence.md](editor-coexistence.md#i-fixed-it-myself) so human fixes receive the same audit/verification path.
- **Releasing a hold that doesn't exist (idempotent retry):** Succeed idempotently returning `{ removed: false, remainingHolds }`.
- **Two concurrent `finishSubmission` calls for the same verification run:** Conditional `WHERE submission_pending = 1 AND epoch = :epoch` ensures only the first succeeds (`changes === 1`) and the second is cleanly rejected.

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Independent Hold Reasons Invariant:** `task_holds` primary key `(task, reason, source)` makes it structurally impossible for one hold source to erase another.
- **No-Bypass Verification Pipeline Invariant:** Every path to `ACCEPTED` MUST pass sequentially through `STATIC_AUDIT` and `CLEAN_VERIFY` with `submission_pending = 1`.
- **Submit-Protects-Lease Invariant:** `submit_candidate` and `accept_submission` execute in the exact same transaction so there is zero race window where a submitted candidate could be expired by `sweep_expired_leases`.
- **Strict Epoch Match Invariant:** No fenced attempt (`attempts.state = 'fenced'`) can ever mutate `task_runtime` or create a candidate.
- **No Terminal-State Resurrection Invariant:** Tasks in terminal states (`MERGED_TO_FEATURE`, `SUPERSEDED`, `CANCELLED`) can NEVER transition back to `READY` or `CODING` (undo/rework creates a new forward task!).
- **Deterministic Error Taxonomy:** Distinguish `StaleEpochError`, `IllegalTaskTransitionError`, `DuplicateCandidateError`, and `TaskHeldError` cleanly for caller recovery logic.

#### Multi-Agent Harmony And Branch Isolation

- **Worktree Setup:** Create branch `task/021-holds-submissions-fencing` via `node scripts/agent-worktree.mjs create 021 holds-submissions-fencing`.
- **Strict Subtree Boundary:** Touch ONLY `packages/db/src/holds/**`, `packages/db/tests/holds/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-021.md`.
- **Parallel Safe Execution:** Completely disjoint from `Task 020` (leases) and `Tasks 022–030`.
- **Handoff For `Tasks 058–066` (Audit/Verify), `Task 115` (Steering Holds), `Task 128` (Parking), `Task 173` (Human-Owned):** Export `TaskHoldAndSubmissionRepo` and the canonical `TASK_STATE_TRANSITIONS` table in `.agent-handoffs/task-021.md`.
- **Commit-Only Discipline:** Commit exclusively on `task/021-holds-submissions-fencing`; **NEVER merge** into `main` or `harness/integration`.
- **Canonical Queries Only:** Execute `submit_candidate`, `accept_submission`, and `finish_submission` verbatim from [schema/queries.sql](schema/queries.sql).

#### Verification, Testing And Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Run `pnpm --filter @ef-harness/db test -- holds` testing the exact review scenario (user pause + requirement hold → release requirement hold → task remains held and unclaimable).
- [ ] Verify `submitAndAcceptCandidate` sets `submission_pending = 1` atomically and prevents `sweep_expired_leases` from expiring the task even at `now = 999999999`.
- [ ] Verify exhaustive state-machine test matrix proves every legal edge succeeds and every illegal shortcut (`CODING → ACCEPTED`, `STATIC_AUDIT → ACCEPTED`, `MERGED_TO_FEATURE → READY`) throws `IllegalTaskTransitionError`.
- [ ] Verify fenced attempt submission returns `StaleEpochError` and leaves `candidates` clean.
- [ ] Run `pnpm --filter @ef-harness/db typecheck`, `lint`, and `node scripts/verify-harmony.mjs --task 021`.
- **Acceptance:** Multi-reason holds, atomic submission lease-protection, epoch fencing, and strict 15-state task transition enforcement pass all unit and adversarial tests on `task/021-holds-submissions-fencing`.

### Task 022: Feature & Project Lifecycle State Machines (`feature_runtime`, `project_runtime`) & 7-Condition Feature `DONE` Verifier

- **Milestone & Track:** `M0 · Kernel Storage & Database Layer`
- **Depends On:** `Task 001`, `Task 010`, `Task 012`, `Task 013`, `Task 021`
- **Git Worktree & Branch:** `task/022-feature-project-lifecycles` in `../ef-wt/task-022-feature-project-lifecycles` (commit on own branch only; **NEVER merge**)
- **Owned Write Scope (Disjoint Subtree):** `packages/db/src/lifecycles/**`, `packages/db/tests/lifecycles/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-022.md`
- **Mandatory Reference Files:** [build-pipeline.md](build-pipeline.md#feature), [database-design.md](database-design.md#additions-from-the-18-november-architecture-review), [architecture-deep-review.md](architecture-deep-review.md), [completeness-gate.md](completeness-gate.md), [schema/state.sql](schema/state.sql), [schema/queries.sql](schema/queries.sql), [schema/schema-test.js](schema/schema-test.js), [build-pipeline.svg](build-pipeline.svg)
- **Shared Contracts Consumed / Produced:** Consumes `FEATURE_STATES`, `PROJECT_STATES` (`Task 010`), `ProjectStateDb` (`Task 013`); produces `LifecycleRepo` (`initFeature`, `advanceFeatureLeavesMerged`, `transitionFeatureState`, `verifyFeatureDoneConditions`, `transferIntegrationHolder`, `transitionProjectState`, `setProjectPaused`)

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Implement `feature_runtime` lifecycle transitions:** Support the exact 13 states in [schema/state.sql](schema/state.sql) (`PLANNED → JIT_READY → IN_WAVE → LEAVES_MERGED → WIRED → JOURNEY_PASSED → QUEUED_FOR_MERGE → MERGED → DONE`, plus side states `BLOCKED`, `REOPENED`, `DEFERRED`, `ABANDONED`), enforcing valid transitions and strictly using `LEAVES_MERGED` and `DONE` (deep-review Fix #2 in [architecture-deep-review.md](architecture-deep-review.md)).
- [ ] **Enforce the `LEAVES_MERGED` structural gate via `advance_feature_leaves_merged`:** Execute `advance_feature_leaves_merged` from [schema/queries.sql](schema/queries.sql), proving a feature cannot leave `IN_WAVE` for wiring until at least one task exists AND EVERY leaf task (`coalesce(fields->>'$.task_type','leaf') = 'leaf'`) is in `('MERGED_TO_FEATURE','CANCELLED','SUPERSEDED')` — never while any leaf is merely `ACCEPTED` and not yet squashed onto `harness/f/<feature>`.
- [ ] **Implement the 7-Condition Feature `DONE` Verifier (`verifyFeatureDoneConditions`):** Deterministically evaluate ALL 7 mandatory conditions from [build-pipeline.md](build-pipeline.md#feature) in code before allowing `MERGED → DONE` and emitting `FeatureCompleted(F)`: (1) every task of `F` is `MERGED_TO_FEATURE` at current brief & contract versions (or cancelled/superseded), (2) every requirement & edge case linked to `F` has a passing check (zero `fail`/`skip`/`missing`) or approved waiver, (3) feature-level static audit is clean across all feature paths including integrator commits, (4) real entry-point feature journey passed in a clean environment, (5) merged onto `harness/integration` with all earlier `DONE` feature regression suites green, (6) zero serious accessibility/layout findings for screen-bearing features, and (7) zero open `ccr` nodes from or to `F`.
- [ ] **Implement Transferable Feature Integration Role Lease (`transferIntegrationHolder`):** Store `integration_holder` (the feature plan's author by default) and monotonic `epoch` on `feature_runtime`; transferring the role to a successor increments `epoch` atomically, fencing the prior owner from landing wiring or conflict commits ([parallel-feature-integration.md](parallel-feature-integration.md)).
- [ ] **Implement `project_runtime` singleton state machine:** Enforce the exact 10 states (`DISCOVERY → SPEC_COMPLETE → UPFRONT_DOCS → PREVIEW → PHASE0 → WAVES → COMPLETION → READY_TO_LAND → LANDED → SHIPPING`), updating `current_wave` and `updated_rev`, while keeping `paused` as an independent boolean column (`0 | 1`, NOT a state!) so pausing never erases which project phase was active.
- [ ] **Implement wave-unlock evaluator (`listUnlockableFeatures`):** Return features in `PLANNED`/`JIT_READY` whose upstream feature dependencies are ALL in `DONE` (never merely `MERGED` or `JOURNEY_PASSED`) and whose Phase 0 foundation gate passed.
- [ ] **Implement `REOPENED` transition for mid-build revisions:** When a breaking revision invalidates a `DONE` or `MERGED` feature, cleanly move `feature_runtime.state → 'REOPENED'` (incrementing `epoch`), recording the triggering `change_set` ID and holding downstream dependent features until re-verified.
- [ ] **Emit atomic outbox events on every lifecycle transition:** Write `FeatureStateChanged`, `FeatureCompleted`, `ProjectStateChanged`, and `ProjectPausedChanged` with registered delivery rows inside the exact same transaction as the state update.

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **Feature with 0 tasks attempting `advance_feature_leaves_merged`:** SQL `EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM task_runtime t WHERE t.feature = :feature)` ensures an empty feature cannot falsely jump to `LEAVES_MERGED` or `DONE`.
- **Leaf task `ACCEPTED` on its attempt branch but NOT YET squashed to `harness/f/<feature>`:** Wiring MUST NOT start; `advance_feature_leaves_merged` requires `MERGED_TO_FEATURE`, eliminating the pre-review race where wiring started before leaves were merged.
- **Open Contract Change Request (`ccr` node with `status = 'open'`) targeting or originating from feature `F`:** Condition #7 MUST block `DONE` even if all 6 other conditions are green, returning exact blocking CCR IDs.
- **Requirement with latest check passing on `check_version = 1` while check node moved to `version = 2`:** Condition #2 MUST check `cr.check_version = c.version` via `requirement_status_recompute` so stale passes never satisfy `DONE`.
- **Pausing project during `WAVES` vs `PHASE0`:** Setting `project_runtime.paused = 1` preserves `state = 'WAVES'` and `current_wave = 2`; unpausing resumes the exact phase and wave cleanly.
- **Abandoned or deferred feature blocking wave completion:** `DEFERRED` and `ABANDONED` features must be cleanly excluded from `COMPLETION` blockers once explicitly approved and decoupled from remaining active features.
- **Concurrent successor takeover during `feature-integrator@1` execution:** Comparing `expectedEpoch` in `transitionFeatureState` fences the replaced integrator immediately.

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Single Completion Vocabulary Invariant:** Only `DONE` signifies a completed feature; zero legacy spellings (`FEATURE_DONE`, `COMPLETE`, `LEAVES_ACCEPTED`) exist anywhere in code or events.
- **Code-Enforced 7-Gate `DONE` Invariant:** `FeatureCompleted` can ONLY be emitted after `verifyFeatureDoneConditions` returns `{ ok: true, failedConditions: [] }` inside the commit transaction.
- **Pause-Is-A-Flag Invariant:** `project_runtime.paused` is orthogonal to `project_runtime.state`; pausing never destroys phase state.
- **Wiring-Task Exclusion In `advance_feature_leaves_merged`:** Only `task_type = 'leaf'` tasks gate `LEAVES_MERGED`, so the feature's own `'wiring'` task doesn't deadlock its own prerequisite!

- **Zero Model Judgment In Lifecycle Gates:** All state transitions and all 7 `DONE` conditions are 100% deterministic SQL/TypeScript checks.

### Task 023: Multi-Currency Integer Budget & Atomic Reservation Ledger (Multi-Scope Reserve, Always-Succeeding Overrun Settlement & Paperwork Envelopes)

- **Milestone & Track:** `M0 · Kernel Storage & Database Layer`
- **Depends On:** `Task 001`, `Task 010`, `Task 012`, `Task 013`
- **Git Worktree & Branch:** `task/023-budget-reservation-ledger` in `../ef-wt/task-023-budget-reservation-ledger` (commit on own branch only; **NEVER merge**)
- **Owned Write Scope (Disjoint Subtree):** `packages/db/src/ledger/**`, `packages/db/tests/ledger/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-023.md`
- **Mandatory Reference Files:** [database-design.md](database-design.md#2--the-three-sql-bugs), [coordinator-and-recovery.md](coordinator-and-recovery.md#resource-and-retry-policy), [provider-connections.md](provider-connections.md#budgeting-with-allowance-instead-of-dollars), [build-pipeline.md](build-pipeline.md#economics-paperwork-budget), [stops-undo-and-reentry.md](stops-undo-and-reentry.md#when-the-budget-or-allowance-runs-out), [schema/state.sql](schema/state.sql), [schema/queries.sql](schema/queries.sql), [schema/schema-test.js](schema/schema-test.js)
- **Shared Contracts Consumed / Produced:** Consumes integer currency converters (`Task 010`), `ProjectStateDb` (`Task 013`); produces `BudgetLedgerRepo` (`createBudgetScope`, `registerCurrency`, `reserveAcrossScopes`, `settleReservation`, `releaseReservation`, `markReservationUnknown`, `reconcileUnknownReservation`, `getBudgetRemaining`, `evaluateSpendThresholds`)

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Implement Multi-Currency Integer Scope Setup (`registerCurrency`, `createBudgetScope`):** Support `usd` (`micro-USD`, scale `1_000_000`), `allowance:<connection>` (`ppm` of window share, scale `1_000_000`), and `slots:local` (`slot`, scale `1`), across all 5 scope kinds in [schema/state.sql](schema/state.sql) (`project`, `feature`, `task`, `wave_paperwork`, `grant`) with explicit parent links.
- [ ] **Implement Atomic Multi-Scope Reservation (`reserveAcrossScopes`):** Inside `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` + `SAVEPOINT`, insert `reservations` (`state = 'held'`) and all ancestor `reservation_scopes` rows (e.g., `task` + `feature` + `project` + `grant`, or `wave_paperwork` + `project` + `grant`), execute `reserve` from [schema/queries.sql](schema/queries.sql), and assert `changes === scopes.length`; if ANY single scope is closed or lacks headroom (`reserved_units + spent_units + amount > limit_units`), `ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT` and return `{ ok: false, blockingScopes }` with zero partial debits!
- [ ] **Implement Always-Succeeding Overrun Settlement (`settleReservation`):** Execute `settle` + `settle_mark` atomically so money/allowance ALREADY spent is ALWAYS recorded even when `actual_units > amount_units` and even when `spent_units` exceeds `limit_units`, computing `overrun_units = max(0, actual - amount_units)` ([database-design.md](database-design.md#2--the-three-sql-bugs)). Because `reserve` checks `reserved + spent + amount <= limit`, an overrun automatically blocks all future reservations on that scope until a human raises `limit_units`.
- [ ] **Implement Explicit Release & Unknown-Outcome Retention (`releaseReservation`, `markReservationUnknown`, `reconcileUnknownReservation`):** Release unused reservations cleanly on pre-dispatch cancellation; on paid-call timeout or laptop sleep mid-turn, move reservation to `state = 'unknown'` retaining `reserved_units` in `budgets` until reconciled via provider receipt or explicit human resolution (`settle` or `release`).
- [ ] **Implement Per-Wave Paperwork Budget Envelopes (`wave_paperwork`):** Enforce the separation from [build-pipeline.md](build-pipeline.md#economics-paperwork-budget): coding calls (`purpose = 'model_call'`) NEVER draw from `wave_paperwork` scopes, and paperwork calls (`purpose = 'paperwork'`) draw from their wave's `wave_paperwork` envelope (default 20% total cap split 3% spec / 5% research / 6% arch / 4% planning / 2% audit), supporting unused roll-forward while blocking cross-wave borrowing without explicit approval.
- [ ] **Implement Spend Threshold Evaluator (`evaluateSpendThresholds`):** Read `budget_remaining` and detect crossings of `50%`, `80%` (alert), `90%` (wind-down: stop new dispatches, keep small reserve for checkpoints & verification of finished candidates), and `100%` (stopped/parked) per currency ([stops-undo-and-reentry.md](stops-undo-and-reentry.md#stages)).
- [ ] **Implement 95th-Percentile Stream-Cutoff Reservation Estimator:** Support reserving p95 output units per task class for routes that forbid `max_output_tokens` (Sign in with ChatGPT), settling actual streamed usage cleanly after termination.
- [ ] **Implement `fast-check` Ledger Conservation Property Tests:** Prove across thousands of random concurrent-interleaved reserve/settle/release/overrun sequences that `reserved_units === SUM(open held+unknown reservations)` and `spent_units === SUM(settled actual_units)` with zero drift and zero double-spend.

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **Two concurrent workers both trying to reserve the last $0.20 of a $1.00 budget:** SQLite `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` serializes both; the first succeeds and the second sees `changes < scopes.length`, rolls back its savepoint, and receives `{ ok: false, blockingScopes: ['project'] }`.
- **Actual spend ($0.34) exceeds both reservation ($0.10) AND task limit ($0.30):** `settleReservation` MUST still succeed (`spent_units = 340000`, `reserved_units = 0`, `overrun_units = 240000`), and the very next 1-unit reservation MUST fail cleanly ([schema/schema-test.js](schema/schema-test.js)).
- **Double-settlement or settling an already-released reservation:** `settle` and `settle_mark` guard `state IN ('held','unknown')`; verify second settlement is rejected/idempotent and NEVER double-adds `spent_units` or drives `reserved_units` negative!
- **Floating-point input sneaking into `amount_units` or `actual_units`:** Throw `NonIntegerCurrencyUnitsError` immediately if `!Number.isSafeInteger(amount) || amount < 0`.
- **Closed grant scope (`budgets.closed = 1`) included in reservation chain:** `reserve` filters `AND closed = 0`, causing savepoint rollback and prompting the coordinator to request a fresh grant from the global broker (`Task 024`).
- **Settling a reservation where `actual_units === 0` (e.g., failed pre-billing call):** Valid (`CHECK (actual_units >= 0)`), frees `reserved_units`, adds `0` to `spent_units`, marks `'settled'`.
- **Coding retries attempting to dip into wave 3's `wave_paperwork` budget:** Scope-binding validator rejects mixing `purpose = 'model_call'` with `scope_kind = 'wave_paperwork'`.

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Strict Ledger Conservation Invariant:** For every budget row at every quiescent point: `reserved_units === SUM(r.amount_units for r in held|unknown touching scope)` and `spent_units === SUM(r.actual_units for r in settled touching scope)`.
- **Zero Negative-Balance / Zero Double-Spend Invariant:** `CHECK (reserved_units >= 0)` and `CHECK (spent_units >= 0)` plus atomic multi-scope `UPDATE ... WHERE (scope_kind, scope_id, currency) IN (...)` prevent double-spend structurally.
- **Always-Succeeding Settlement Invariant:** Real incurred spend can NEVER fail to record because of a budget cap; overruns record truthfully and halt future spending.
- **Unknown-Outcome Reservation Hold Invariant:** A timed-out paid call NEVER releases its reservation until reconciled, preventing blind double-billing after a crash.
- **Zero Floating-Point Arithmetic Invariant:** Every internal ledger calculation uses exact integer micro-units / ppm.
- **Paperwork Envelope Isolation Invariant:** Wave coding retries can NEVER starve later waves' JIT planning paperwork envelopes.

#### Multi-Agent Harmony And Branch Isolation

- **Worktree Setup:** Create branch `task/023-budget-reservation-ledger` via `node scripts/agent-worktree.mjs create 023 budget-reservation-ledger`.
- **Strict Subtree Boundary:** Touch ONLY `packages/db/src/ledger/**`, `packages/db/tests/ledger/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-023.md`.
- **Parallel Safe Execution:** Disjoint from `Task 022` (lifecycles) and `Task 024` (cross-DB grants).
- **Handoff For `Task 024`, `Task 034`, `Task 090`, `Task 128`, `Task 140`:** Export `BudgetLedgerRepo`, `ReservationHandle`, and `ThresholdCrossedEvent` in `.agent-handoffs/task-023.md`.
- **Commit-Only Discipline:** Commit exclusively on `task/023-budget-reservation-ledger`; **NEVER merge** into `main` or `harness/integration`.
- **Canonical Queries Only:** Execute `reserve`, `settle`, `settle_mark`, `release`, and `budget_remaining` verbatim from [schema/queries.sql](schema/queries.sql).

#### Verification, Testing And Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Run `pnpm --filter @ef-harness/db test -- ledger` reproducing all budget scenarios from [schema/schema-test.js](schema/schema-test.js) (multi-scope reserve, rollback on single-scope overflow, $0.10→$0.34 overrun settlement blocking subsequent 1-unit reserve, exact `0.1+0.1+0.1 === 0.3`).
- [ ] Run `fast-check` property suite (1,000 randomized command sequences of reserve/settle/release/unknown/overrun/raise-limit) proving 100% ledger conservation and zero double-spend.
- [ ] Verify double-settlement and release-after-settle are safely blocked with zero negative `reserved_units`.
- [ ] Verify `wave_paperwork` isolation refuses coding reservations and enforces 50%/80%/90%/100% threshold signals accurately.

### Task 024: Cross-Database Broker-to-Project Grant Protocol (`global.db` ↔ `state.db` Idempotent Deposit, Closure & Conservative Expiry)

- **Milestone & Track:** `M0 · Kernel Storage & Database Layer`
- **Depends On:** `Task 001`, `Task 013`, `Task 014`, `Task 023`
- **Git Worktree & Branch:** `task/024-cross-db-grant-protocol` in `../ef-wt/task-024-cross-db-grant-protocol` (commit on own branch only; **NEVER merge**)
- **Owned Write Scope (Disjoint Subtree):** `packages/db/src/grants/**`, `packages/db/tests/grants/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-024.md`
- **Mandatory Reference Files:** [database-design.md](database-design.md#3--global-and-project-databases-never-share-a-transaction), [projects-portability-and-sync.md](projects-portability-and-sync.md#running-several-projects-at-once), [provider-connections.md](provider-connections.md#budgeting-with-allowance-instead-of-dollars), [coordinator-and-recovery.md](coordinator-and-recovery.md), [schema/global.sql](schema/global.sql), [schema/state.sql](schema/state.sql), [schema/queries.sql](schema/queries.sql), [schema/schema-test.js](schema/schema-test.js), [database-design.svg](database-design.svg)
- **Shared Contracts Consumed / Produced:** Consumes `ProjectStateDb` (`Task 013`), `GlobalBrokerDb` (`Task 014`), `BudgetLedgerRepo` (`Task 023`); produces `BrokerGrantIssuer`, `ProjectGrantReceiver`, and `GrantReconciler`

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Implement Broker Grant Issuance (`BrokerGrantIssuer.issueGrant` on `global.db` only):** Insert a row into `global.db.grants(id, project, connection, currency, units, concurrency, priority_class, issued_at, expires_at, state='issued')` strictly within `global.db`'s own `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` transaction after verifying connection window headroom, then dispatch an async `GrantIssuedMessage` to the target project coordinator.
- [ ] **Implement Idempotent Project Grant Deposit (`ProjectGrantReceiver.depositGrant` on `state.db` only):** Execute `deposit_grant` (`INSERT OR IGNORE INTO grant_receipts`) and `deposit_grant_budget` (`INSERT OR IGNORE INTO budgets` for `scope_kind='grant'`) inside `state.db`'s own `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` transaction (ensuring `currencies` row exists for the connection's currency), and send a `GrantDepositedAck(grantId)` back to the broker.
- [ ] **Implement Broker Deposit Acknowledgment (`BrokerGrantIssuer.acknowledgeDeposit` on `global.db`):** Transition `grants.state` from `'issued' → 'deposited'` idempotently so repeated acks are no-ops.
- [ ] **Implement Project Grant Closure & Reporting (`ProjectGrantReceiver.closeGrant` on `state.db`):** When a grant expires, nears expiry, or is recalled, execute `close_grant` (`SET closed = 1, limit_units = spent_units + reserved_units`) and `close_grant_receipt` (recording `closed_at`, exact `used_units`, and `unknown_units` from open `'unknown'` reservations) inside `state.db`, then send `GrantClosureReport(grantId, used_units, unknown_units)` to the broker and set `closure_reported_at` ONLY after broker ack.
- [ ] **Implement Broker Idempotent Closure Recording (`BrokerGrantIssuer.recordClosure` on `global.db`):** Update `grants` (`state = 'closed'`, `used_units`, `unknown_units`, `closed_at`), count `used_units + unknown_units` against `connection_windows.estimated_units`, and return the unused remainder (`max(0, units - used_units - unknown_units)`) to the global connection pool.
- [ ] **Implement Conservative Unreported Grant Expiry (`BrokerGrantIssuer.expireUnreportedGrants` on `global.db`):** Execute `global_expire_grants` from [schema/queries.sql](schema/queries.sql) (`WHERE state IN ('issued','deposited') AND expires_at + :grace_ms < :now`), setting `state = 'expired'` and **`used_units = units`** (100% conservatively counted as spent!) so an offline, crashed, or deleted project can NEVER cause the broker to over-promise a shared plan window ([database-design.md](database-design.md#3--global-and-project-databases-never-share-a-transaction)).
- [ ] **Implement Crash-Recovery Reconciliation (`GrantReconciler`):** Handle all 4 crash scenarios from [database-design.md](database-design.md#3--global-and-project-databases-never-share-a-transaction): (1) project crashed before depositing (`issued` without ack → project reports its deposited IDs on restart, broker marks undeposited ones expired & returns unused capacity cleanly), (2) project crashed after closing before broker ack (project re-sends unreported `closure_reported_at IS NULL` closures idempotently), (3) project never returns (conservative full expiry after grace), (4) paid call unknown at closure (`unknown_units` held as spent until late reconciliation message arrives).
- [ ] **Verify Zero Cross-DB Transactions:** Assert via driver-level `ATTACH` guard (`Task 012`) that `BrokerGrantIssuer` ONLY touches `global.db` and `ProjectGrantReceiver` ONLY touches `state.db`.

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **Duplicate `GrantIssuedMessage` delivered 3 times after IPC reconnect:** `deposit_grant` and `deposit_grant_budget` use `INSERT OR IGNORE`; `grant_receipts` has exactly 1 row and `budgets.limit_units` is NEVER doubled.
- **Project closes a grant while 1 reservation is still `'held'` and 1 is `'unknown'`:** `close_grant` freezes `limit_units = spent_units + reserved_units` so no new work can reserve against it while letting the in-flight `'held'` call settle; closure report waits until zero `'held'` reservations remain (or reports pending `'unknown'` calls as `unknown_units`).
- **Late closure report arrives AFTER broker already ran `global_expire_grants` conservatively:** Broker verifies actual `used_units + unknown_units <= units` and safely adjusts from conservative full usage downward (never downward below actual spent!) without corrupting `connection_windows`.
- **Overrun occurred on the project grant (`spent_units > original grant.units`):** Closure report accurately reports `used_units > units`; broker records full actual spend in `connection_windows` and zeroes remaining window headroom so shared allowance stays honest.
- **Project folder deleted or external drive unplugged mid-grant:** Broker never blocks waiting for the dead project; after `expires_at + grace_ms`, `global_expire_grants` closes it conservatively and other projects keep running.
- **Out-of-order messages (closure arrives before deposit ack):** Broker accepts closure cleanly for `'issued'` OR `'deposited'` states without rejecting valid spend reports.
- **Currency missing in `state.db.currencies` on first grant from a new plan connection:** `depositGrant` automatically `INSERT OR IGNORE INTO currencies` inside the deposit transaction before inserting into `grant_receipts` and `budgets`.

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Zero Multi-File WAL Transaction Invariant:** `global.db` and `state.db` NEVER participate in the same SQLite transaction; all state exchange is explicit idempotent messaging.
- **Conservative Over-Promise Prevention Invariant:** An unreported expired grant ALWAYS counts 100% (`used_units = units`), guaranteeing shared plan windows are never over-allocated due to crashes.
- **Idempotent Delivery Invariant:** Replaying `deposit`, `ack`, or `closure` any number of times produces the exact same final rows in both databases.
- **Unknown-Units Preservation Invariant:** Unreconciled paid calls at grant closure are NEVER dropped or treated as free (`unknown_units` flows cleanly into broker window accounting).
- **No Unclosed Grant Leak Invariant:** On project close or crash recovery, every expired grant in `state.db` is closed and queued for broker reporting before new grants are requested.
- **Single-Writer Separation Invariant:** Broker writes exclusively to `global.db`; Project Coordinator writes exclusively to `state.db`.

#### Multi-Agent Harmony And Branch Isolation

- **Worktree Setup:** Create branch `task/024-cross-db-grant-protocol` via `node scripts/agent-worktree.mjs create 024 cross-db-grant-protocol`.
- **Strict Subtree Boundary:** Touch ONLY `packages/db/src/grants/**`, `packages/db/tests/grants/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-024.md`.
- **Parallel Safe Execution:** Disjoint from `Task 023` (single-DB ledger) and `Tasks 025–030`.
- **Handoff For `Task 034` (Sim), `Task 140` (Pacing), `Task 188` (Multi-Project Broker):** Export `BrokerGrantIssuer`, `ProjectGrantReceiver`, `GrantReconciler`, and message schemas in `.agent-handoffs/task-024.md`.
- **Commit-Only Discipline:** Commit exclusively on `task/024-cross-db-grant-protocol`; **NEVER merge** into `main` or `harness/integration`.
- **Canonical Queries Only:** Execute `deposit_grant`, `deposit_grant_budget`, `close_grant`, `close_grant_receipt`, and `global_expire_grants` directly from [schema/queries.sql](schema/queries.sql).

#### Verification, Testing And Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Run `pnpm --filter @ef-harness/db test -- grants` exercising full issue → deposit → ack → local reserve/settle → close → report lifecycle across real separate `global.db` and `state.db` files.
- [ ] Simulate all 4 crash points from [database-design.md](database-design.md#3--global-and-project-databases-never-share-a-transaction) (pre-deposit crash, post-close pre-ack crash, vanished project expiry, unknown-outcome paid call) and verify exact recovery.
- [ ] Verify duplicate deposit and duplicate closure replay produce zero duplicate rows and exact accounting.
- [ ] Verify overrun on a deposited grant propagates actual spend truthfully to `global.db`.
- [ ] Run `pnpm --filter @ef-harness/db typecheck`, `lint`, and `node scripts/verify-harmony.mjs --task 024`.
- **Acceptance:** Cross-database broker↔project grant protocol is 100% atomic per file, idempotent across crashes, conservatively safe against over-promising, and verified on `task/024-cross-db-grant-protocol`.

### Task 025: Idempotency Operations Store (`operations` + `request_hash`), Group-Commit Savepoint Batcher & Knowledge Barrier Scheduler

- **Milestone & Track:** `M0 · Kernel Storage & Database Layer`
- **Depends On:** `Task 001`, `Task 007`, `Task 012`, `Task 013`
- **Git Worktree & Branch:** `task/025-idempotency-group-commit` in `../ef-wt/task-025-idempotency-group-commit` (commit on own branch only; **NEVER merge**)
- **Owned Write Scope (Disjoint Subtree):** `packages/db/src/write-queue/**`, `packages/db/tests/write-queue/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-025.md`
- **Mandatory Reference Files:** [database-design.md](database-design.md#5--group-commit-idempotency-and-wal), [knowledge-database.md](knowledge-database.md#is-one-writer-fast-enough-with-20-workers), [kernel-schema-and-protocol.md](kernel-schema-and-protocol.md#write-path-performance), [schema/state.sql](schema/state.sql), [schema/queries.sql](schema/queries.sql), [schema/schema-test.js](schema/schema-test.js), [research/knowledge-db-consistency.md](research/knowledge-db-consistency.md)
- **Shared Contracts Consumed / Produced:** Consumes `computeRequestHash` (`Task 007`), `ProjectStateDb` (`Task 013`); produces `CoordinatorWriteQueue` (`submitOperation`, `submitKnowledgeBarrier`, `pruneOldOperations`, `getQueueMetrics`)

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Implement Strict `op_id` Idempotency Store with `request_hash` Guard:** Before executing any mutating operation, run `op_lookup` from [schema/queries.sql](schema/queries.sql) inside the active transaction/savepoint: if `op_id` exists with `same_request === 1`, return the stored `result` JSON immediately without re-executing; if `op_id` exists with `same_request === 0`, immediately reject with typed `OpIdReusedError(opId)` ([database-design.md](database-design.md#5--group-commit-idempotency-and-wal)) rather than returning a stale mismatched receipt!
- [ ] **Store `operations` row atomically with the state change:** Insert `(op_id, kind, request_hash, result, committed_rev, created_at)` inside the exact same transaction/savepoint as the mutation so a crash between commit and IPC reply returns the exact original receipt on retry.
- [ ] **Implement Bounded Priority-Class Write Queue:** Maintain three distinct bounded queues matching [knowledge-database.md](knowledge-database.md#is-one-writer-fast-enough-with-20-workers): `interactive` (developer chat, Stop, inbox resolution — highest priority), `runtime` (task transitions, claims, receipts, check results, reservations — batchable), and `knowledge_barrier` (change sets — serialized barrier, NEVER batched!).
- [ ] **Implement Group-Commit Savepoint Batcher (`flushRuntimeBatch`):** Drain up to `N` (configurable, e.g., 32) queued `runtime` / `interactive` non-barrier operations into ONE `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` transaction every few milliseconds (e.g., 2–5 ms coalesce window or immediate when queue idle), executing EACH operation inside its own `SAVEPOINT op_<i>`: if one operation fails validation (e.g., stale epoch, over-budget, `op_id_reused`), `ROLLBACK TO op_<i>` and reject ONLY that caller's promise while all valid sibling operations in the batch commit cleanly in exact serial order!
- [ ] **Enforce Knowledge Change-Set Barrier Execution:** Whenever a `knowledge_barrier` operation is dequeued, flush any prior batch first, execute the knowledge change set ALONE in its own dedicated `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` transaction, and invoke post-commit propagation hooks (reading `read_sets_by_node`) strictly AFTER `COMMIT` ([database-design.md](database-design.md#5--group-commit-idempotency-and-wal)).
- [ ] **Implement 30-Day `operations` Retention Pruner (`pruneOldOperations`):** Execute `prune_operations` (`DELETE FROM operations WHERE created_at < :cutoff` where cutoff = `now - 30 days`) periodically at idle while keeping permanent receipts untouched in `candidates`, `check_results`, and `effects`.
- [ ] **Implement Backpressure & Safe-Mode Circuit Breaker:** Reject incoming queue writes cleanly with `QueueBackpressureError` when bounded queue caps are exceeded and immediately halt dequeue with `ProjectSafeModeError` if `ProjectStateDb.isSafeMode()` activates.
- [ ] **Benchmark 50-Worker Simulated Write Latency (`p99 < 50 ms` target):** Include an automated stress test submitting 50 concurrent simulated workers executing claims, reservations, and check results through `CoordinatorWriteQueue` and measure p50/p95/p99 latency.

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **Two identical `op_id` retries arriving in the SAME group-commit batch:** Because savepoints execute sequentially inside the single `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` transaction, the first inserts into `operations` and the second immediately sees it in `op_lookup` and returns the cached result without double-applying!
- **One malformed operation throwing an unexpected error inside a 20-operation group-commit batch:** `ROLLBACK TO op_<i>` + `RELEASE op_<i>` isolates the error completely; the other 19 valid operations commit intact and receive their receipts.
- **Disk full (`SQLITE_FULL`) occurring at the final `COMMIT` of a 10-operation batch:** ALL 10 caller promises MUST receive rejection (NEVER pre-resolve any promise before `COMMIT` returns!) and `ProjectStateDb.enterSafeMode()` must fire.
- **Task acceptance and breaking `R17` change arriving simultaneously:** Because `knowledge_barrier` runs alone, either `R17` commits first (then T07's acceptance savepoint sees stale read set and rejects) OR T07 commits first (then `R17`'s post-commit propagation finds T07 via `read_sets_by_node` and schedules re-verification) — proving both serial orders end 100% consistent!
- **Caller omitting `op_id` on a mutating request:** Reject synchronously at `submitOperation` entry before queuing.
- **Post-commit propagation callback throwing an exception:** Log and schedule retry cleanly WITHOUT failing the already-committed change set's caller receipt.
- **Graceful drain on daemon shutdown / park-for-update:** `drainAndClose()` stops accepting new writes, finishes the in-flight batch cleanly, and resolves only when every committed promise has been settled.

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Never Resolve Before `COMMIT` Invariant:** No caller promise resolves until SQLite `COMMIT` succeeds on disk (`PRAGMA synchronous = FULL`); a crash before commit leaves zero false receipts.
- **Knowledge-Runs-Alone Barrier Invariant:** Knowledge change sets NEVER share a SQLite transaction with batchable runtime transitions.
- **Exact `op_id` + `request_hash` Invariant:** Reusing an `op_id` with a different canonical request payload ALWAYS fails with `OpIdReusedError`.
- **Savepoint Isolation Invariant:** An invalid runtime operation in a group-commit batch can never abort valid sibling operations or leak partial state into subsequent savepoints.
- **Serializability Invariant:** Within a group-commit batch, operation `i+1` observes the exact committed savepoint state left by operation `i`.
- **Bounded Queue Invariant:** Interactive requests never wait behind unbounded telemetry or runaway worker retries.

#### Multi-Agent Harmony And Branch Isolation

- **Worktree Setup:** Create branch `task/025-idempotency-group-commit` via `node scripts/agent-worktree.mjs create 025 idempotency-group-commit`.
- **Strict Subtree Boundary:** Touch ONLY `packages/db/src/write-queue/**`, `packages/db/tests/write-queue/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-025.md`.
- **Parallel Safe Execution:** Disjoint from `Tasks 022–024` and `Tasks 026–030`.
- **Handoff For `Task 032` (IPC), `Task 034` (M0 Sim), `apps/daemon`:** Export `CoordinatorWriteQueue`, `OpIdReusedError`, `WritePriority`, and latency metrics interface in `.agent-handoffs/task-025.md`.
- **Commit-Only Discipline:** Commit exclusively on `task/025-idempotency-group-commit`; **NEVER merge** into `main` or `harness/integration`.
- **Canonical Queries Only:** Use `op_lookup` and `prune_operations` from [schema/queries.sql](schema/queries.sql).

- [ ] Verify savepoint batch isolation: batch 10 operations where #3 fails validation and #7 duplicates #2's `op_id`; confirm 8 distinct mutations commit, #3 fails cleanly, #7 returns #2's receipt, and zero partial state leaks.
- [ ] Verify both serial orders of breaking `R17` barrier vs `T07` acceptance produce consistent final state.
- [ ] Run 50-simulated-worker throughput stress test asserting `p99 < 50 ms` on local SQLite WAL.
- [ ] Run `pnpm --filter @ef-harness/db typecheck`, `lint`, and `node scripts/verify-harmony.mjs --task 025`.

### Task 026: Transactional Outbox (`outbox` + `outbox_deliveries`), Mandatory Consumer Registration & Safe Pruning

- **Milestone & Track:** `M0 · Kernel Storage & Database Layer`
- **Depends On:** `Task 001`, `Task 012`, `Task 013`, `Task 025`
- **Git Worktree & Branch:** `task/026-transactional-outbox` in `../ef-wt/task-026-transactional-outbox` (commit on own branch only; **NEVER merge**)
- **Owned Write Scope (Disjoint Subtree):** `packages/db/src/outbox/**`, `packages/db/tests/outbox/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-026.md`
- **Mandatory Reference Files:** [database-design.md](database-design.md#6--outbox-telemetry-and-fast-read-models), [architecture-deep-review.md](architecture-deep-review.md), [kernel-schema-and-protocol.md](kernel-schema-and-protocol.md#live-events-without-gaps-or-duplicates), [linked-architecture-revisions.md](linked-architecture-revisions.md), [coordinator-and-recovery.md](coordinator-and-recovery.md), [schema/state.sql](schema/state.sql), [schema/queries.sql](schema/queries.sql), [schema/schema-test.js](schema/schema-test.js)
- **Shared Contracts Consumed / Produced:** Consumes `ProjectStateDb` (`Task 013`), `EventV1Schema` (`Task 008`); produces `OutboxRepo` (`appendEventInTx`, `fetchPendingForConsumer`, `acknowledgeDelivery`, `replayEventsSince`, `getMinRetainedSeq`, `pruneAcknowledgedOutbox`, `auditOutboxDeliveries`) and `OutboxDispatcher`

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Implement atomic `appendEventInTx(conn, event, consumers)`:** Inside the caller's active `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` state-change transaction, require `consumers.length >= 1` (enforcing deep-review Fix #1 from [architecture-deep-review.md](architecture-deep-review.md)!), insert the event into `outbox(id, type, subject, rev, payload, created_at)` letting SQLite `INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT` assign monotonic never-reused `seq`, and immediately run `register_delivery` for EVERY consumer in `consumers` (`scheduler`, `exporter`, `broker`, `ui_projection`, etc.) in the exact same transaction.
- [ ] **Implement At-Least-Once Consumer Polling & Atomic Acknowledgment (`OutboxDispatcher`):** Poll pending deliveries per consumer via index `outbox_pending`, invoke registered consumer handlers with `(event, seq, deliveryKey = event_id + ':' + consumer)`, retry with exponential backoff on transient failures, and record `outbox_deliveries.delivered_at = now` inside the consumer's own idempotent state transaction where applicable.
- [ ] **Implement Window Replay Stream (`replayEventsSince(sinceSeq, topics?, limit?)`):** Return gap-free strictly increasing `seq` batches (`WHERE seq > :since_seq ORDER BY seq ASC LIMIT :limit`), plus expose `getMinRetainedSeq()` and `meta.stream_epoch` so the window protocol (`Task 032`) deterministically detects when `since_seq` fell behind retained history or `stream_epoch` changed and responds with `resync_required`.
- [ ] **Implement Safe Outbox Pruner (`pruneAcknowledgedOutbox`):** Execute `prune_outbox` from [schema/queries.sql](schema/queries.sql) (default retention 7 days), which deletes ONLY rows older than cutoff that BOTH have at least one row in `outbox_deliveries` (`EXISTS`) AND have ZERO unacknowledged rows (`NOT EXISTS ... delivered_at IS NULL`), guaranteeing `seq` numbers are NEVER reused even after pruning (`AUTOINCREMENT` verified!).
- [ ] **Implement `outbox_without_deliveries` Periodic Self-Check (`auditOutboxDeliveries`):** Execute `outbox_without_deliveries` from [schema/queries.sql](schema/queries.sql) at startup and periodic maintenance; any row returned indicates a severe internal bug (an event written without consumer registration) and logs a high-severity alert without pruning the event!
- [ ] **Implement Event-Type Default Consumer Routing Table:** Map domain event types (`TaskAccepted`, `TaskHoldPlaced`, `FeatureCompleted`, `RevisionPublished`, `BudgetThresholdCrossed`, `InboxItemCreated`, `ShipRunUpdated`, etc.) to their mandatory consumers so callers cannot accidentally omit `exporter` or `ui_projection`.
- [ ] **Implement Crash-Safe Startup Replay:** On `harnessd` restart, immediately resume pending `outbox_deliveries WHERE delivered_at IS NULL` in exact `seq ASC` order before dispatching new worker turns.
- [ ] **Verify Distinct Multi-Event Delivery In One Revision:** Confirm that a single revision committing both `ContractChanged` and `DependencyReady` inserts two distinct outbox rows and delivers both independently to every subscribed consumer ([linked-architecture-revisions.md](linked-architecture-revisions.md)).

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **Buggy caller passes `consumers: []` to `appendEventInTx`:** Hard-reject synchronously with `EmptyOutboxConsumersError` BEFORE SQL insert so deep-review Bug #1 can never occur through the repo API.
- **Legacy or manually inserted outbox row with 0 `outbox_deliveries` rows:** `prune_outbox` MUST preserve it (never delete!) AND `auditOutboxDeliveries` MUST surface its ID immediately ([schema/schema-test.js](schema/schema-test.js) Test `R1`).
- **Consumer crashes AFTER applying side effect but BEFORE marking `delivered_at`:** On restart, `OutboxDispatcher` redelivers the same `event_id`; consumer deduplicates cleanly using `(event_id, consumer)` receipt without duplicating work.
- **Pruning the highest `seq` row in `outbox` then inserting a new event:** SQLite `AUTOINCREMENT` (`sqlite_sequence`) guarantees the next `seq` is strictly `old_max + 1`, never reusing pruned numbers so connected windows never mistake a new event for a duplicate!
- **One slow or offline consumer (e.g., `exporter` paused for Markdown edits) holding back pruning:** `prune_outbox` retains events needed by the slow consumer while allowing healthy consumers to keep advancing; emit a lag metric if pending backlog grows large.
- **Window requests `since_seq = 0` on a freshly created project vs a project whose oldest retained `seq` is `500`:** When `minRetainedSeq > since_seq + 1` (and `since_seq > 0`), report `resyncRequired: true`; when `since_seq === 0` and `minRetainedSeq === 1`, replay normally from `seq = 1`.
- **High-rate progress/token updates accidentally sent to `outbox`:** Reject telemetry event kinds (`telemetry.*`, `worker.heartbeat`, `token.delta`) at `appendEventInTx` with `TelemetryNotAllowedInOutboxError` (those belong strictly in `telemetry.db`!).

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Atomic Event-With-State Invariant:** Every domain event commits inside the exact same SQLite `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` transaction as the state mutation it describes.
- **Mandatory Delivery Registration Invariant:** Zero outbox events may ever be created without at least one registered consumer row in `outbox_deliveries`.
- **Monotonic Never-Reused `seq` Invariant:** `outbox.seq` uses `INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT` and strictly increases forever within a `stream_epoch`.
- **Never-Prune-Unseen Invariant:** Neither unacknowledged events nor orphaned delivery-less events can ever be deleted by `prune_outbox`.
- **No Telemetry Pollution Invariant:** `outbox` stores ONLY durable domain state events; high-frequency progress/tokens/heartbeats are structurally blocked from entering `state.db`.
- **Deterministic Ordering Invariant:** All replays and consumer dispatches strictly follow `ORDER BY seq ASC`.

#### Multi-Agent Harmony And Branch Isolation

- **Worktree Setup:** Create branch `task/026-transactional-outbox` via `node scripts/agent-worktree.mjs create 026 transactional-outbox`.
- **Strict Subtree Boundary:** Touch ONLY `packages/db/src/outbox/**`, `packages/db/tests/outbox/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-026.md`.
- **Parallel Safe Execution:** Disjoint from `Task 025` (write queue) and `Tasks 027–030`.
- **Handoff For `Task 032` (Window Event Stream), `Task 034` (Sim), `Task 085` (Exporter), `Task 186` (Portability):** Export `OutboxRepo`, `OutboxDispatcher`, and `DEFAULT_EVENT_CONSUMERS` in `.agent-handoffs/task-026.md`.
- **Commit-Only Discipline:** Commit exclusively on `task/026-transactional-outbox`; **NEVER merge** into `main` or `harness/integration`.
- **Canonical Queries Only:** Execute `register_delivery`, `prune_outbox`, and `outbox_without_deliveries` verbatim from [schema/queries.sql](schema/queries.sql).

#### Verification, Testing And Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Run `pnpm --filter @ef-harness/db test -- outbox` verifying atomic event + delivery creation, `EmptyOutboxConsumersError` on `[]`, and `TelemetryNotAllowedInOutboxError` on heartbeat/token events.
- [ ] Reproduce exact `schema-test.js` R1 & pruning checks: unacknowledged event survives prune, delivery-less event survives prune AND is flagged by `auditOutboxDeliveries`, and `seq` never reuses pruned values (`1, 2 -> delete 2 -> next is 3`).
- [ ] Verify crash-redelivery simulation: handler throws once, succeeds on retry, marks `delivered_at`, and is never delivered a third time.
- [ ] Verify `replayEventsSince` accurately returns gap-free batches and signals `resyncRequired` when `since_seq` precedes retained history.
- [ ] Run `pnpm --filter @ef-harness/db typecheck`, `lint`, and `node scripts/verify-harmony.mjs --task 026`.
- **Acceptance:** Transactional outbox, consumer delivery dispatcher, safe pruner, and `outbox_without_deliveries` audit pass 100% of tests on `task/026-transactional-outbox`.

- **Milestone & Track:** `M0 · Kernel Storage & Database Layer`
- **Depends On:** `Task 001`, `Task 012`, `Task 013`, `Task 017`
- **Git Worktree & Branch:** `task/027-read-models-rollups-drift` in `../ef-wt/task-027-read-models-rollups-drift` (commit on own branch only; **NEVER merge**)

- **Mandatory Reference Files:** [database-design.md](database-design.md#6--outbox-telemetry-and-fast-read-models), [architecture-deep-review.md](architecture-deep-review.md), [completeness-gate.md](completeness-gate.md#traceability-every-requirement-has-a-task-and-a-check), [knowledge-database.md](knowledge-database.md#records-and-their-owners), [schema/state.sql](schema/state.sql), [schema/queries.sql](schema/queries.sql), [schema/schema-test.js](schema/schema-test.js), [research/sqlite-database-engineering.md](research/sqlite-database-engineering.md)
- **Shared Contracts Consumed / Produced:** Consumes `ProjectStateDb` (`Task 013`); produces `ReadModelRepo` (`getBoardSummary`, `getFeatureProgress`, `syncRequirementStatusForChecks`, `runDriftCheckAndHeal`, `getTraceabilityGaps`)

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Implement Ultra-Fast Board & Feature Progress Queries (`getBoardSummary`, `getFeatureProgress`):** Read directly from trigger-maintained `rollup_feature_tasks(feature, state, n)` and `rollup_feature_requirements(feature, status, n)` joined with `feature_runtime` so Board lane counts and requirement progress bars read only a few rows per feature regardless of project scale (meeting the M0 `< 10 ms` target at 500 tasks and 5,000 requirements per [database-design.md](database-design.md#6--outbox-telemetry-and-fast-read-models)).
- [ ] **Implement Transactional Requirement Status Updater (`syncRequirementStatusInTx`):** Whenever `check_results` are recorded, a check node updates version, a waiver is created/retired, or a requirement node is added/retired, recompute and upsert the affected rows in `requirement_status(requirement, feature, status, updated_rev)` in the EXACT same transaction (triggering `requirement_status_ai` / `requirement_status_au` automatically to keep `rollup_feature_requirements` live!).
- [ ] **Implement Full Requirement Status Recompute (`recomputeAllRequirementStatuses`):** Execute `requirement_status_recompute` from [schema/queries.sql](schema/queries.sql) (using the latest `check_results` row per check at the check's CURRENT `nodes.version`, honoring active `waivers`, and distinguishing `'waived'`, `'uncovered'`, `'failing'`, `'pending'`, `'passing'` — deep-review Fix #9!).
- [ ] **Implement Periodic Drift Detection & Automatic Self-Healing Job (`runDriftCheckAndHeal`):** Check BOTH (1) `rollup_drift` (`rollup_feature_tasks` vs `SELECT feature, state, count(*) FROM task_runtime`), (2) `rollup_feature_requirements` vs `SELECT coalesce(feature,''), status, count(*) FROM requirement_status`, AND (3) `requirement_status` vs `requirement_status_recompute`. On ANY discrepancy, emit a structured bug-alert log entry with exact diff rows and atomically rebuild the drifted rollup/status rows inside `BEGIN IMMEDIATE`.
- [ ] **Implement Traceability Gap Query Facade (`getTraceabilityGaps`):** Expose `requirements_without_task`, `requirements_without_check`, and `tasks_without_requirement` from [schema/queries.sql](schema/queries.sql) cleanly for Graph Compile (`Task 092`) and Final Audit (`Task 101`).
- [ ] **Enforce Zero Direct Application Writes To Rollup Tables:** Expose `rollup_feature_tasks` and `rollup_feature_requirements` strictly read-only everywhere outside the drift self-healing rebuild routine so application code never competes with SQLite triggers.
- [ ] **Include Scale Benchmark Test (500 Tasks, 5,000 Requirements):** Seed 20 features, 500 tasks, 5,000 requirements, and 5,000 checks in a unit/perf test and assert `getBoardSummary()` completes in `< 10 ms` with `0` drift rows.
- [ ] **Handle NULL-Feature Global Requirements Safely:** Match the trigger's `coalesce(new.feature, '')` convention cleanly when aggregating project-wide cross-cutting rules (`X-01`–`X-14`) that have no single feature ID.

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **Check fails at `recorded_at = 10` then passes at `recorded_at = 20`, both at `check_version = 1`:** `requirement_status_recompute` partitions by `check_id ORDER BY recorded_at DESC` (`rn = 1`), accurately transitioning status from `'failing'` to `'passing'`.
- **Check passed at `check_version = 1`, then check node is revised to `version = 2` with no new result yet:** Because `requirement_status_recompute` joins `cr.check_version = c.version`, the old v1 pass disappears and the requirement immediately reverts from `'passing'` to `'pending'`!
- **Requirement has 2 checks — one `'pass'` and one `'skip'` or `'missing'`:** `l.status <> 'pass'` triggers `'failing'` (never `'passing'`), enforcing [completeness-gate.md](completeness-gate.md)'s rule that skipped/missing checks count as failure.
- **Requirement with a failing check receives an approved `waiver` node + `waives` edge:** `WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM waivers ...)` evaluates first, transitioning requirement status cleanly to `'waived'`.
- **Task moves between features (`UPDATE task_runtime SET feature = 'F13'`):** `task_runtime_au` decrements `(old.feature, old.state)` and increments `(new.feature, new.state)`; verify zero negative rollup counts and zero drift.
- **Simulated trigger corruption / manual test tampering with `rollup_feature_tasks`:** `runDriftCheckAndHeal` detects exact `{ feature, state, rollup_n, actual_n }`, logs a high-severity bug event, rebuilds accurate counts, and confirms post-heal drift is 0.
- **Two check results inserted with identical millisecond timestamp `recorded_at`:** Add deterministic tie-breaker awareness or ensure monotonic timestamps per transaction so latest result ranking is always unambiguous.

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Derived-Never-Manual Rollup Invariant:** Application code NEVER directly increments/decrements `rollup_feature_tasks` or `rollup_feature_requirements`; SQLite triggers maintain them atomically inside the mutating transaction.
- **Current-Check-Version Invariant:** Only `check_results` matching the check node's current `nodes.version` count toward `requirement_status = 'passing'`.
- **Zero-Drift Self-Healing Invariant:** Any discrepancy detected by `runDriftCheckAndHeal` is BOTH logged as a kernel bug (so it gets fixed) AND immediately healed (so the UI never stays wrong).
- **Sub-10ms Board Read Invariant:** `getBoardSummary` executes in `O(features × states)` regardless of whether a project has 50 or 5,000 requirements.
- **Waiver Risk Integrity:** `waivers` view exposes `risk_max` and `approved_by` so high/critical requirements cannot be silently waived without developer approval.
- **Exact Parity With `schema/queries.sql`:** `rollup_drift`, `requirement_status_recompute`, and all three traceability gap queries run directly from the canonical SQL file.

#### Multi-Agent Harmony And Branch Isolation

- **Worktree Setup:** Create branch `task/027-read-models-rollups-drift` via `node scripts/agent-worktree.mjs create 027 read-models-rollups-drift`.
- **Strict Subtree Boundary:** Touch ONLY `packages/db/src/read-models/**`, `packages/db/tests/read-models/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-027.md`.
- **Parallel Safe Execution:** Disjoint from `Tasks 022–026` and `Tasks 028–030`.
- **Handoff For `Task 032` (`snapshot.get`), `Task 066` (Acceptance), `Task 092` (Graph Compile), `Task 124` (Board UI):** Export `ReadModelRepo`, `BoardSummary`, and `DriftReport` types in `.agent-handoffs/task-027.md`.
- **Commit-Only Discipline:** Commit exclusively on `task/027-read-models-rollups-drift`; **NEVER merge** into `main` or `harness/integration`.
- **Performance Guard:** Keep the 500-task / 5,000-requirement read benchmark as a permanent automated test in `packages/db/tests/read-models/`.

### Task 028: Content-Addressed Artifact Store (CAS): SHA-256, Windows `EPERM`/`EBUSY` Rename Retries, Read-Only Promotion & `global.db` Pin-Safe GC

- **Milestone & Track:** `M0 · Kernel Storage & Database Layer`
- **Depends On:** `Task 001`, `Task 011`, `Task 013`, `Task 014`
- **Git Worktree & Branch:** `task/028-cas-artifact-store-gc` in `../ef-wt/task-028-cas-artifact-store-gc` (commit on own branch only; **NEVER merge**)
- **Owned Write Scope (Disjoint Subtree):** `packages/db/src/cas/**`, `packages/db/tests/cas/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-028.md`
- **Mandatory Reference Files:** [database-design.md](database-design.md#7--shared-blob-store), [kernel-schema-and-protocol.md](kernel-schema-and-protocol.md#content-addressed-store-and-cleanup), [schema/global.sql](schema/global.sql), [schema/state.sql](schema/state.sql), [schema/queries.sql](schema/queries.sql), [schema/schema-test.js](schema/schema-test.js), [research/sqlite-database-engineering.md](research/sqlite-database-engineering.md), [research/kernel-storage-and-ipc.md](research/kernel-storage-and-ipc.md)
- **Shared Contracts Consumed / Produced:** Consumes `GlobalBrokerDb` (`Task 014`), `ProjectStateDb` (`Task 013`); produces `CasBlobStore` (`putBlob`, `getBlob`, `verifyBlobIntegrity`, `pinBlob`, `unpinHolder`, `syncProjectPins`, `runGarbageCollection`, `quarantineBlob`)

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Implement Sharded Content-Addressed On-Disk Layout:** Store blobs under `%LOCALAPPDATA%\EFHarness\cas\sha256\<h[0..2]>\<h[2..4]>\<hash>.zst` (plus `.raw` if uncompressed), where `<hash>` is ALWAYS the lowercase SHA-256 of the **uncompressed** content ([database-design.md](database-design.md#7--shared-blob-store)).
- [ ] **Implement Windows-Safe Atomic Write & Promotion (`putBlob`):** Stream content to `cas\tmp\<uuid>.tmp`, hash uncompressed bytes on the fly while compressing with `zstd`, `fsync` / flush, then rename into final path with explicit Windows antivirus/indexer retry loop on `EPERM` / `EBUSY` / `EACCES` (exponential backoff `50 ms → 1,000 ms`, up to 10 attempts per [database-design.md](database-design.md#7--shared-blob-store)). If final path already exists, verify existing blob's uncompressed SHA-256 and discard the temp file; set promoted blob file mode to **read-only** (`0o444`).
- [ ] **Enforce Pin-Before-Record Ordering In `global.db`:** Every `putBlob` for a holder (`project | backup | research | export | pending`) inserts into `global.db.cas_blobs` and `global.db.cas_pins` BEFORE returning the hash to be recorded in `state.db.artifacts` — guaranteeing a live referenced blob can NEVER be seen as unpinned by GC!
- [ ] **Implement Mandatory On-Read Hash Verification & Quarantine (`getBlob`, `verifyBlobIntegrity`):** Always verify uncompressed SHA-256 on every read of `'evidence'` and `'asset'` retention classes; on hash mismatch, mark `cas_blobs.state = 'quarantined'`, emit a structured corruption event marking dependent receipts, and return typed `CasIntegrityMismatchError` (never silently serving corrupted bytes!).
- [ ] **Implement Safe 7-Day Grace Garbage Collection (`runGarbageCollection`):** Execute `global_cas_gc_candidates` from [schema/queries.sql](schema/queries.sql) (`created_at < now - 7d AND NOT EXISTS cas_pins`, `LIMIT 1000`), verify no pin appeared concurrently, unset read-only attribute before `fs.unlink` on Windows, delete file, and remove `cas_blobs` row. Never delete a blob pinned by ANY holder (including offline projects, backups, exports, or research cache!).
- [ ] **Implement Periodic Full Pin Sync Per Project (`syncProjectPins`):** Reconcile a project's live `state.db.artifacts` hashes against `global.db.cas_pins(holder_kind='project', holder_id=projectId)` to clean up any lazy unpins or crash-orphaned `'pending'` pins safely.
- [ ] **Implement Missing-CAS Graceful Degradation:** If a user manually deletes the `cas/` folder ([kernel-schema-and-protocol.md](kernel-schema-and-protocol.md#edge-cases)), return structured `CasBlobMissingError(hash)` so affected receipts report missing evidence without crashing `harnessd` or blocking re-verification.
- [ ] **Implement Immediate Secret-Purge Bypass Delete (`forceDeletePurgedBlob`):** Support an explicit privileged method used ONLY by `Task 030` (Secret Purge) to immediately unlink an old secret-bearing blob bypassing the 7-day grace window after replacing references and pins.

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **Windows `fs.unlink` failing with `EPERM` on read-only promoted blobs:** Promoted CAS files have the read-only attribute set (`0o444`); on Windows, `fs.unlink` fails with `EPERM` unless `fs.chmod(path, 0o666)` runs immediately prior to unlink! Test this explicitly on Windows.
- **Concurrent writers putting the exact same content hash simultaneously:** Both write distinct `cas\tmp\<uuid>.tmp` files; one wins the rename, the second detects `EEXIST`/target present, verifies the existing file's SHA-256 matches, cleans up its temp file, and adds its own pin cleanly.
- **Process crashes mid-write leaving orphan files in `cas\tmp\`:** Startup/GC cleanup sweeps files in `cas\tmp\` older than 1 hour cleanly without ever touching `cas\sha256\`.
- **Offline project on unplugged drive while GC runs:** Because `cas_pins` lives in `global.db` (not in the offline project's `state.db`), GC NEVER selects its blobs as candidates ([database-design.md](database-design.md#7--shared-blob-store)).
- **Zero-byte artifact put into CAS:** Valid edge case (e.g., empty stderr log); SHA-256 of empty buffer (`e3b0c442...`) must store, compress, verify, and read back as empty `Buffer` cleanly.
- **Corrupted existing blob at target path when a new writer tries to put identical hash:** If target exists AND fails SHA-256 integrity check, quarantine or atomically replace the corrupt file with the freshly verified temp file and log a scrub recovery alert!
- **Backup pin surviving after project deletes its own diagnostic pin:** Verify `schema-test.js` scenario: blob `h1` unpinned by project but pinned by `'backup'` MUST NOT be returned by `global_cas_gc_candidates`.

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Pin-Before-Record Invariant:** A blob's `cas_pins` entry in `global.db` ALWAYS precedes recording its reference in `state.db.artifacts`.
- **Uncompressed-Content Hash Key Invariant:** The CAS hash is ALWAYS SHA-256 of uncompressed payload bytes, independent of compression level or format (`zstd` vs `zstd-seekable` vs `raw`).
- **Evidence/Asset Mandatory Read-Verify Invariant:** Reading any `evidence` or `asset` artifact ALWAYS verifies SHA-256 before returning bytes.
- **7-Day Unpinned Grace Invariant:** Ordinary GC NEVER deletes a blob younger than 7 days OR with `>= 1` pin in `cas_pins`.
- **No Silent Corruption Invariant:** Corrupted blobs immediately transition to `state = 'quarantined'` and throw `CasIntegrityMismatchError`.
- **Windows Antivirus Resilience Invariant:** Temp-to-final renames retry `EPERM`/`EBUSY`/`EACCES` up to 10 times with 50 ms → 1 s exponential backoff.

#### Multi-Agent Harmony And Branch Isolation
