### Task 029: Large-Log Seekable Zstd Storage, Sidecar Line Index, Retention Eviction, Integrity Scrubbing & `turn_log` Archival

- **Milestone & Track:** `M0 · Kernel Storage & Database Layer`
- **Depends On:** `Task 001`, `Task 013`, `Task 014`, `Task 028`
- **Git Worktree & Branch:** `task/029-seekable-logs-retention-archive` in `../ef-wt/task-029-seekable-logs-retention-archive` (commit on own branch only; **NEVER merge**)
- **Owned Write Scope (Disjoint Subtree):** `packages/db/src/artifacts/**`, `packages/db/tests/artifacts/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-029.md`
- **Mandatory Reference Files:** [database-design.md](database-design.md#7--shared-blob-store), [kernel-schema-and-protocol.md](kernel-schema-and-protocol.md#content-addressed-store-and-cleanup), [worker-loop.md](worker-loop.md#shrinking-tool-output-before-it-enters-history), [schema/state.sql](schema/state.sql), [schema/global.sql](schema/global.sql), [schema/queries.sql](schema/queries.sql), [schema/schema-test.js](schema/schema-test.js), [research/sqlite-database-engineering.md](research/sqlite-database-engineering.md)
- **Shared Contracts Consumed / Produced:** Consumes `CasBlobStore` (`Task 028`), `ProjectStateDb` (`Task 013`), `GlobalBrokerDb` (`Task 014`); produces `ArtifactManager` (`storeArtifact`, `readLogRange`, `queryLogStream`, `enforceRetentionAndStorageCap`, `runWeeklyIntegrityScrub`, `archiveClosedAttemptTurnLog`)

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Implement Seekable Zstd Frame Writer & Reader (`zstd-seekable` format for text artifacts `> 1 MB`):** Split text logs/traces exceeding 1 MB into independent `~1 MB` zstd-compressed frames followed by a standard seekable-format seek table (`format = 'zstd-seekable'` in `cas_blobs`), enabling random-access frame decompression without decompressing a 200 MB trace into RAM ([database-design.md](database-design.md#7--shared-blob-store)).
- [ ] **Build Sidecar Line Index (`artifacts.line_index`):** While writing any `> 1 MB` text artifact, record `(lineNumber → { frameIndex, uncompressedOffsetInFrame })` every `1,000` lines, store that compact JSON/binary index as a pinned sidecar CAS artifact linked via `artifacts.line_index`, and use it in `readLogRange(artifactId, startLine, endLine)` so reading lines `50,000–50,200` decompresses ONLY the covering frame(s)!
- [ ] **Implement Streaming Bounded Log Search (`queryLogStream(artifactId, pattern, maxMatches)`):** Decompress seekable logs frame by frame (supporting lines crossing frame boundaries safely!) with an explicit match cap and byte budget so `harness.read_log(id, query)` never OOMs `harnessd`.
- [ ] **Implement Retention-Class Policy & Storage Cap Enforcer (`enforceRetentionAndStorageCap`):** Enforce all 5 retention classes from [kernel-schema-and-protocol.md](kernel-schema-and-protocol.md#content-addressed-store-and-cleanup): `evidence` (project lifetime), `diagnostic` (14 days after attempt end), `ephemeral` (3 days), `asset` (until developer removes), `research` (until TTL/minor version change). When total CAS stored bytes exceed the configurable cap (default `10 GB`), evict the **oldest `diagnostic` pins first**, then expired `ephemeral`, NEVER evicting live `evidence` or `asset` pins!
- [ ] **Implement Weekly Sampled Integrity Scrub (`runWeeklyIntegrityScrub`):** Periodically verify a rotating sample of non-evidence blobs (updating `cas_blobs.last_verified_at`), quarantining any corrupted blob and flagging dependent artifacts for regeneration.
- [ ] **Implement Closed-Attempt `turn_log` Archival (`archiveClosedAttemptTurnLog`):** For closed attempts (`attempts.state NOT IN ('running','submitted','parked')`), serialize all `turn_log` rows into one compressed JSONL CAS artifact, pin it, insert `artifacts` row, execute `archive_turn_log` (recording `steps`, `tokens_in`, `tokens_out`, `archived_at` in `turn_log_archives`), and execute `purge_archived_turn_log` ([schema/queries.sql](schema/queries.sql), deep-review & five-traps fix in [database-design.md](database-design.md#five-more-traps))!
- [ ] **Protect Active & Parked Attempts From `turn_log` Purge:** Prove via SQL guard + unit tests that `running`, `submitted`, and `parked` attempts are NEVER purged from `turn_log`, preserving step-by-step crash and resume recovery.
- [ ] **Implement `artifact_refs` Ownership Tracking:** Record `(artifact, owner_kind, owner_id)` links cleanly so `evidence` promotion (when a candidate becomes accepted) automatically upgrades an attempt's cited logs from `diagnostic` to `evidence` retention!

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **A single log line spanning across two 1 MB seekable zstd frames:** `readLogRange` and `queryLogStream` MUST carry partial-line UTF-8 bytes cleanly across frame boundaries without splitting multi-byte UTF-8 characters (`🚀`, accented chars) or breaking regex matches!
- **Requested line range exceeds EOF (`startLine = 999999`) or inverted range (`endLine < startLine`):** Return empty slice `{ lines: [], totalLines, truncated: false }` cleanly for past-EOF and throw typed `InvalidLineRangeError` for negative/inverted bounds.
- **Storage cap (10 GB) exceeded when ALL stored blobs are `evidence` and `asset`:** Never silently delete `evidence` or `asset`; emit a high-priority `StorageCapExceeded` warning telling the user what can be cleaned in Settings → Storage ([app-shell-and-governor.md](app-shell-and-governor.md#disk)).
- **`archiveClosedAttemptTurnLog` called twice on the same attempt or on an attempt with 0 `turn_log` steps:** Handle idempotently (`HAVING count(*) > 0` prevents zero-step archive rows; already-archived attempt returns existing archive artifact ID).
- **Attempt transitions `parked` → `running` → `accepted`:** `turn_log` stays intact during `parked` and `running`, and only becomes archivable once `state` is terminal (`accepted | rejected | fenced | crashed`).
- **Missing sidecar `line_index` artifact (e.g., deleted or legacy blob):** Gracefully fall back to streaming frame scan from frame 0 while logging a warning and optionally regenerating the sidecar.
- **ReDoS catastrophic backtracking regex passed into `queryLogStream`:** Enforce literal/safe regex compilation (or bounded step/time budget per frame) so an agent passing `(a+)+$` to `harness.read_log` cannot freeze the daemon.

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Bounded Memory Decompression Invariant:** Reading lines `95,000–95,100` of a 10 MB seekable log MUST decompress ONLY the 1–2 covering frames (verified via frame-decompression counter instrumentation in tests!).
- **Active-Attempt `turn_log` Protection Invariant:** `purge_archived_turn_log` structurally refuses to delete rows for `'running'`, `'submitted'`, or `'parked'` attempts.
- **Evidence/Asset Non-Eviction Invariant:** Storage-cap eviction NEVER drops `'evidence'` or `'asset'` pins.
- **Retention Promotion Atomicity Invariant:** Accepting a candidate atomically promotes all receipt-cited artifacts to `'evidence'` retention before diagnostic expiry can run.
- **Exact Token Total Conservation Invariant:** `turn_log_archives.tokens_in` and `tokens_out` equal the exact sum of the purged `turn_log` rows (verified against [schema/schema-test.js](schema/schema-test.js)).
- **UTF-8 Frame-Boundary Safety Invariant:** Multi-byte UTF-8 sequences split across 1 MB frame boundaries decode with zero replacement characters (`U+FFFD`).

#### Multi-Agent Harmony And Branch Isolation

- **Worktree Setup:** Create branch `task/029-seekable-logs-retention-archive` via `node scripts/agent-worktree.mjs create 029 seekable-logs-retention-archive`.
- **Strict Subtree Boundary:** Touch ONLY `packages/db/src/artifacts/**`, `packages/db/tests/artifacts/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-029.md`.
- **Parallel Safe Execution:** Disjoint from `Task 028` (CAS core) and `Task 030` (secret purge).
- **Handoff For `Task 033` (Binary Stream), `Task 047` (`harness.run`), `Task 055` (`harness.read_log`):** Export `ArtifactManager`, `SeekableLogReader`, and `TurnLogArchiver` in `.agent-handoffs/task-029.md`.
- **Commit-Only Discipline:** Commit exclusively on `task/029-seekable-logs-retention-archive`; **NEVER merge** into `main` or `harness/integration`.
- **Canonical Queries Only:** Execute `archive_turn_log` and `purge_archived_turn_log` directly from [schema/queries.sql](schema/queries.sql).

- [ ] Verify `queryLogStream` matches patterns across frame boundaries, enforces `maxMatches`, and resists ReDoS patterns.

### Task 030: Sanctioned Secret Purge Engine (`secret_occurrences`, History Rewrite, HMAC Audit, FTS/WAL/VACUUM, Blob & Backup Scrub)

- **Milestone & Track:** `M0 · Kernel Storage & Database Layer`
- **Depends On:** `Task 001`, `Task 007`, `Task 011`, `Task 013`, `Task 016`, `Task 018`, `Task 028`
- **Git Worktree & Branch:** `task/030-secret-purge-engine` in `../ef-wt/task-030-secret-purge-engine` (commit on own branch only; **NEVER merge**)
- **Owned Write Scope (Disjoint Subtree):** `packages/db/src/secret-purge/**`, `packages/db/tests/secret-purge/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-030.md`
- **Mandatory Reference Files:** [database-design.md](database-design.md#10--code-index-secret-purge-and-query-bounds), [sandbox-and-security.md](sandbox-and-security.md#data-at-rest), [build-cockpit.md](build-cockpit.md#edge-cases), [schema/state.sql](schema/state.sql), [schema/queries.sql](schema/queries.sql), [schema/schema-test.js](schema/schema-test.js)
- **Shared Contracts Consumed / Produced:** Consumes `computeNodeContentHash` (`Task 007`), `computeSecretHmac` (`Task 011`), `KnowledgeSearchService` (`Task 018`), `CasBlobStore` (`Task 028`); produces `SecretPurgeEngine` (`locateSecret`, `executeSecretPurge`, `PurgeReceipt`, `ProviderRotationLinkMap`)

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Implement Step 1 — Complete Occurrence Locator (`locateSecret`):** Execute `secret_occurrences` from [schema/queries.sql](schema/queries.sql) (scanning `node_versions`, `turns`, `evidence`, `outbox`, `change_sets` using parameterized `:secret` — NEVER logging `:secret`!), ALSO scan current `nodes` (`title`, `text`, `fields`), `candidates.payload`, `inbox_items.payload`, `turn_log.result_summary`, AND stream-scan all text CAS blobs referenced by the project (checking raw, Base64, and URL-encoded forms!).
- [ ] **Implement Step 2 — Sanctioned History Rewrite & `redactions` Audit Log:** Replace every occurrence across current AND historical rows with `[REDACTED:<LABEL>]`, recompute canonical RFC 8785 `content_hash` for rewritten `nodes` and `node_versions` rows, save the `old_hash → new_hash` mapping JSON as a pinned CAS artifact (`redactions.hash_map_artifact`) so verification receipts stay explainable, and insert an immutable row into `redactions(id, secret_fingerprint, label, counts, hash_map_artifact, created_at)` storing ONLY the keyed HMAC fingerprint (NEVER the raw secret!).
- [ ] **Implement Step 3 — Full FTS5 Re-Index & Optimize:** Re-index every touched `nodes` row in BOTH `kb_words` and `kb_ident`, then execute `INSERT INTO kb_words(kb_words) VALUES('optimize')` and `INSERT INTO kb_ident(kb_ident) VALUES('optimize')` so deleted FTS5 postings segments no longer retain plaintext substrings of the secret!
- [ ] **Implement Step 4 — Zeroing Free Pages (`secure_delete` + `wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE)` + `VACUUM`):** Verify `PRAGMA secure_delete = ON`, close all worker-thread readers cleanly, execute `PRAGMA wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE)` (clearing old WAL frames containing the secret!), and execute `VACUUM` so freed B-tree pages are rewritten and zeroed on disk ([database-design.md](database-design.md#10--code-index-secret-purge-and-query-bounds)).
- [ ] **Implement Step 5 — CAS Blob Rewrite & Immediate Bypass Unlink:** For every affected text CAS blob, create a new redacted blob under its new SHA-256 hash, pin the new blob, update `artifacts.hash` references, unpin the old blob, and invoke `CasBlobStore.forceDeletePurgedBlob` to immediately delete the old file bypassing the 7-day grace window!
- [ ] **Implement Step 6 — Backup Scrubbing:** Scan all existing backup files in `projects/<id>/backups/*.db`; for any backup containing the secret, run the identical redaction + FTS optimize + `VACUUM INTO` onto a new copy, verify `quick_check`, update its `cas_pins`, and securely delete the old backup file.
- [ ] **Implement Step 7 — Remote `harness-state` Rewrite Warning Gate:** Check `export_state.commit_sha` and remote push status; if the secret reached a pushed `harness-state` branch, NEVER force-push automatically—return `remoteHistoryRewriteRequired: true` requiring explicit developer approval (`Task 186`).
- [ ] **Implement Step 8 — Mandatory Provider Key-Rotation Guidance:** Map detected secret label/prefix (`STRIPE_SECRET_KEY`, `OPENAI_API_KEY`, `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, `GITHUB_TOKEN`, etc.) to the official provider key-rotation URL and return `rotationMandatory: true` in `PurgeReceipt`, explaining honestly that SSD wear-leveling and remote API exposure require rotating the key ([database-design.md](database-design.md#10--code-index-secret-purge-and-query-bounds)).

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **Secret bytes surviving inside the binary `state.db`, `state.db-wal`, or FTS5 shadow tables after SQL `UPDATE`:** Test MUST read the raw binary bytes of `state.db`, `state.db-wal`, backup `.db` files, and CAS files after `executeSecretPurge` and assert `Buffer.indexOf(secretBytes) === -1`!
- **`nodes_version_guard` trigger blocking sanctioned hash/text rewrite during purge:** Temporarily bypass or perform sanctioned rewrite via a documented purge transaction protocol (keeping `nodes.version` stable so downstream read sets remain coherent while mapping old→new content hashes in `redactions.hash_map_artifact`) and immediately verify `nodes_version_guard` remains active afterwards!
- **Secret passed into `executeSecretPurge` accidentally written into structured logs or Error messages:** Wrap the purge pipeline in a zero-log secret scope and assert ZERO bytes of the secret appear in structured JSONL logs or `redactions` table!
- **Active readers holding WAL open preventing `wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE)` and `VACUUM`:** Require pausing project readers/workers cleanly before Steps 3–6, failing loudly with `PurgeLockUnavailableError` if readers cannot drain rather than silently leaving the secret in the WAL.
- **Secret appears inside `telemetry.db` or `logs/*.jsonl`:** Also scrub or recreate `telemetry.db` (since it's lossy!) and scan/rewrite active/rotated log files so no copy lingers outside `state.db`.
- **Two different secrets purged sequentially:** Each purge creates its own distinct `redactions` record with distinct `hash_map_artifact` and cumulative hash traceability.
- **Secret shorter than 8 characters accidentally submitted to purge:** Reject trivially short strings (`<8` chars) unless explicitly forced by developer confirmation, preventing accidental corruption of common words like `"the"` or `"id"`.

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Zero Raw-Byte Survival Invariant:** After `executeSecretPurge`, raw byte scan of `state.db`, `state.db-wal`, all `backups/*.db`, rewritten CAS blobs, and `telemetry.db` MUST find **0** occurrences of the secret!
- **Zero Secret In `redactions` Table Invariant:** `redactions` stores ONLY `HMAC(localKey, secret)` and the symbolic label `[REDACTED:<NAME>]`, NEVER the plaintext secret.
- **Auditability Preservation Invariant:** `redactions.hash_map_artifact` preserves the exact `old_hash → new_hash` mapping so historical verification receipts remain verifiable without breaking chain of custody.
- **No Unapproved Force-Push Invariant:** Purging locally NEVER force-pushes `harness-state` silently; remote history rewrite requires explicit developer click.
- **Always-Rotate Guidance Invariant:** `PurgeReceipt` ALWAYS sets `rotationMandatory: true` with honest SSD/provider-exposure messaging.
- **Atomic Recovery On Failure:** If purge fails mid-backup-scrub, leave clear partial status in `PurgeReceipt` so retrying purge is idempotent and completes remaining targets.

#### Multi-Agent Harmony And Branch Isolation

- **Worktree Setup:** Create branch `task/030-secret-purge-engine` via `node scripts/agent-worktree.mjs create 030 secret-purge-engine`.
- **Strict Subtree Boundary:** Touch ONLY `packages/db/src/secret-purge/**`, `packages/db/tests/secret-purge/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-030.md`.
- **Parallel Safe Execution:** Disjoint from `Tasks 028–029` and `Tasks 031–034`.
- **Handoff For `Task 120` (Vault), `Task 127` (Inbox Secret Alert), `Task 199` (Security Audit):** Export `SecretPurgeEngine`, `PurgeReceipt`, and `PROVIDER_ROTATION_URLS` in `.agent-handoffs/task-030.md`.
- **Commit-Only Discipline:** Commit exclusively on `task/030-secret-purge-engine`; **NEVER merge** into `main` or `harness/integration`.
- **Canonical Queries Only:** Use `secret_occurrences` from [schema/queries.sql](schema/queries.sql) as the core table locator.

### Task 031: Windows Named Pipe Daemon Transport (`\\.\pipe\efharness-<user>`, Current-User ACL, Session Token & Binary/JSON-RPC Framing)

- **Milestone & Track:** `M0 · Window ↔ Daemon IPC Protocol`
- **Depends On:** `Task 001`, `Task 008`, `Task 011`
- **Git Worktree & Branch:** `task/031-named-pipe-ipc-transport` in `../ef-wt/task-031-named-pipe-ipc-transport` (commit on own branch only; **NEVER merge**)
- **Owned Write Scope (Disjoint Subtree):** `packages/ipc/src/transport/**`, `packages/ipc/tests/transport/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-031.md`
- **Mandatory Reference Files:** [kernel-schema-and-protocol.md](kernel-schema-and-protocol.md#window--daemon-protocol), [desktop-app.md](desktop-app.md#processes), [research/desktop-app-shell.md](research/desktop-app-shell.md), [research/kernel-storage-and-ipc.md](research/kernel-storage-and-ipc.md), [desktop-app.svg](desktop-app.svg)
- **Shared Contracts Consumed / Produced:** Consumes JSON-RPC schemas (`Task 008`), `StructuredLogger` (`Task 011`); produces `NamedPipeServer`, `NamedPipeClient`, `FrameCodec`, `SessionTokenStore`, and `MessagePortBridge`

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Implement Exact Binary Frame Codec (`FrameCodec`):** Encode and decode the exact wire framing from [kernel-schema-and-protocol.md](kernel-schema-and-protocol.md#framing): `4-byte uint32BE length` + `1-byte channel` (`0 = JSON-RPC 2.0`, `1 = binary stream`) + `4-byte uint32BE streamId` (present on channel `1`) + payload bytes, handling arbitrary TCP/pipe partial chunk splits, coalesced multi-frame buffers, and hard frame size limits (`1 MB` max on channel `0`, `64 KB` max chunk on channel `1`).
- [ ] **Implement Windows Per-User Named Pipe Server (`NamedPipeServer`):** Listen strictly on `\\.\pipe\efharness-<sanitized-username>` (or test-scoped `\\.\pipe\efharness-test-<uuid>` on Windows; user-mode `0o600` Unix domain socket path on Linux/macOS for future portability), applying a strict Windows current-user-only security descriptor (DACL granting access ONLY to the current user SID + SYSTEM) so other Windows accounts and ALL browser web pages can NEVER reach `harnessd` ([desktop-app.md](desktop-app.md#processes)).
- [ ] **Implement Per-Session Cryptographic Token Authentication (`SessionTokenStore`):** Generate a 256-bit random session token on `harnessd` start, write it to `%LOCALAPPDATA%\EFHarness\session.token` with current-user-only permissions (atomic rename), require `session.hello { token, protocol: "1.x", client }` as the MANDATORY first frame on every connection using constant-time comparison (`crypto.timingSafeEqual`), and immediately close any connection that fails auth or sends any other method before `session.hello`!
- [ ] **Implement Protocol Minor-Version Compatibility Negotiation:** Validate `protocol` (`1.x`) in `session.hello`: support current and previous minor versions (`1.0`, `1.1`), return server capabilities and `daemonVersion`, and reject incompatible major versions with structured `ProtocolVersionMismatchError` ([kernel-schema-and-protocol.md](kernel-schema-and-protocol.md#session)).
- [ ] **Implement `NamedPipeClient` with Automatic Reconnect & Heartbeat (`session.ping`):** Connect to the named pipe with bounded exponential backoff, send periodic `session.ping` liveness checks, fail in-flight request promises cleanly on disconnect, and emit `connected` / `reconnecting` / `disconnected` lifecycle events.
- [ ] **Implement Electron Utility-Process ↔ Renderer `MessagePort` Bridge (`MessagePortBridge`):** Transfer binary channel `1` `ArrayBuffer` chunks zero-copy (`postMessage(msg, [buffer])`) between the Electron utility process holding the named pipe and the React renderer so the UI main thread NEVER blocks on pipe I/O ([kernel-schema-and-protocol.md](kernel-schema-and-protocol.md#window--daemon-protocol)).
- [ ] **Enforce Zero-Localhost-Port Policy:** Verify the daemon transport opens ZERO TCP/UDP listening sockets—all UI↔daemon communication runs exclusively over the user-restricted named pipe.
- [ ] **Handle Stale Pipe & Multi-Window Connections:** Allow multiple concurrent authenticated client connections (main window, pop-out tabs, second project window, CLI diagnostics) simultaneously on one `NamedPipeServer`, cleanly removing dead clients on socket error/close.

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **Oversized JSON frame (`> 1 MB`) sent by a buggy or hostile client:** `FrameCodec` MUST inspect the 4-byte length header BEFORE allocating a giant buffer, immediately aborting the frame with `FrameTooLargeError` and closing the offending client socket to prevent OOM DoS!
- **Partial frame split across 1-byte reads or 50 coalesced frames in one `data` chunk:** `FrameCodec` streaming state machine must reassemble byte-by-byte fragmented frames and drain multi-frame chunks identically.
- **Unauthenticated client sends `build.start` before `session.hello` or sends wrong token:** Server responds with JSON-RPC auth error `-32001` and destroys the socket within 100 ms; constant-time compare prevents timing leaks.
- **Client hangs open without sending `session.hello` (slowloris):** Enforce a 5-second handshake timeout closing idle unauthenticated sockets.
- **Two `harnessd` processes attempting to bind the same user named pipe:** Detect `EADDRINUSE` cleanly on startup so single-instance daemon logic (`Task 067`) knows another daemon is already running and checks its version instead of crashing blindly.
- **Backpressure on slow renderer reading a 200 MB trace:** Honor Node `socket.write()` backpressure (`drain` event) and reject unbounded outbound buffering per client.
- **Daemon restarts with a new `session.token` while a window stays open:** Client detects disconnect, re-reads `%LOCALAPPDATA%\EFHarness\session.token` from disk on reconnect, and re-authenticates seamlessly!

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Zero Localhost Listener Invariant:** `NamedPipeServer` NEVER calls `net.createServer().listen(port, '127.0.0.1')`; eliminates browser DNS-rebinding and CSRF attacks completely.
- **Auth-First Invariant:** Zero RPC methods (other than `session.hello`) can execute on an unauthenticated connection.
- **Strict Frame-Size Cap Invariant:** Channel `0` strictly rejects payloads `> 1_048_576` bytes before full buffering; Channel `1` strictly enforces `<= 65_536` byte chunks.
- **Timing-Safe Token Verification Invariant:** Always use `crypto.timingSafeEqual` on fixed-length buffers; never `===` on session tokens.
- **Zero-Copy Binary Transfer Invariant:** `MessagePortBridge` transfers ownership of `ArrayBuffer` payloads on Channel `1` rather than copying multi-megabyte diffs/logs across Electron IPC.
- **Never Log Session Token Invariant:** `SessionTokenStore` registers the active token with `SecretRedactor` (`Task 011`) so the token can never appear in logs or diagnostics.

#### Multi-Agent Harmony And Branch Isolation

- **Worktree Setup:** Create branch `task/031-named-pipe-ipc-transport` via `node scripts/agent-worktree.mjs create 031 named-pipe-ipc-transport`.

### Task 032: Window ↔ Daemon Session Protocol, Gap-Free Numbered Outbox Streaming, `stream_epoch` Resync & Paginated `snapshot.get`

- **Milestone & Track:** `M0 · Window ↔ Daemon IPC Protocol`
- **Depends On:** `Task 001`, `Task 008`, `Task 025`, `Task 026`, `Task 027`, `Task 031`
- **Git Worktree & Branch:** `task/032-ipc-event-stream-resync` in `../ef-wt/task-032-ipc-event-stream-resync` (commit on own branch only; **NEVER merge**)
- **Owned Write Scope (Disjoint Subtree):** `packages/ipc/src/protocol/**`, `packages/ipc/tests/protocol/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-032.md`
- **Mandatory Reference Files:** [kernel-schema-and-protocol.md](kernel-schema-and-protocol.md#live-events-without-gaps-or-duplicates), [database-design.md](database-design.md#6--outbox-telemetry-and-fast-read-models), [schema/state.sql](schema/state.sql), [schema/telemetry.sql](schema/telemetry.sql), [research/kernel-storage-and-ipc.md](research/kernel-storage-and-ipc.md)
- **Shared Contracts Consumed / Produced:** Consumes `NamedPipeServer`/`NamedPipeClient` (`Task 031`), `OutboxRepo` (`Task 026`), `ReadModelRepo` (`Task 027`), `CoordinatorWriteQueue` (`Task 025`); produces `RpcRouter`, `EventSubscriptionServer`, `SnapshotAssembler`, and `ClientStateSyncer`

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Implement JSON-RPC 2.0 Method Router (`RpcRouter`):** Dispatch all documented RPC namespaces (`project.*`, `chat.*`, `question.*`, `batch.*`, `node.*`, `graph.*`, `impact.*`, `plan.*`, `build.*`, `task.*`, `inbox.*`, `artifact.*`, `diff.*`, `preview.*`, `settings.*`, `diag.*`) with automatic Zod parameter validation, strict `op_id` requirement on every mutating method, and direct delegation into `CoordinatorWriteQueue`.
- [ ] **Implement `events.subscribe { project, topics, since_seq, stream_epoch? }` on Daemon:** Check the project's current `meta.stream_epoch` and `outbox.getMinRetainedSeq()`: if `stream_epoch` differs OR `since_seq` fell behind retained outbox history, immediately return `{ status: 'resync_required', current_stream_epoch, latest_seq }`; otherwise replay all matching rows `seq > since_seq` in bounded `events.batch { from_seq, to_seq, events }` notifications and seamlessly transition to live tailing without dropping or duplicating any event at the replay-to-live seam!
- [ ] **Implement Client-Side Gap-Free State Syncer (`ClientStateSyncer`):** Enforce the strict rule from [kernel-schema-and-protocol.md](kernel-schema-and-protocol.md#live-events-without-gaps-or-duplicates): apply an incoming event ONLY if `event.seq === last_applied + 1`; ignore any event with `seq <= last_applied` (duplicate); if `seq > last_applied + 1` (gap!), immediately resubscribe from `last_applied`; on `resync_required`, invoke `snapshot.get`, replace local view state at `as_of_seq`, and resubscribe from `as_of_seq`.
- [ ] **Implement Bounded Paginated `snapshot.get { project, views, cursor? }`:** Assemble current read-model views (Board summary, feature progress, open inbox items, active holds, project/feature runtime states, budget meters) at one consistent read snapshot returning `{ as_of_seq, stream_epoch, sections, nextCursor }`, strictly enforcing `<= 2 MB` per view section ([database-design.md](database-design.md#10--code-index-secret-purge-and-query-bounds)) using keyset pagination so giant projects never exceed IPC caps.
- [ ] **Implement Ephemeral `telemetry` Notification Channel:** Forward high-rate `telemetry` notifications (worker progress lines, live token counts, governor meters, heartbeat ticks) without sequence numbers, shedding oldest telemetry notifications per slow client socket without EVER delaying ordered `events.batch` domain events!
- [ ] **Support Concurrent Multi-Window Project Subscriptions:** Allow two or more Electron windows (e.g., main cockpit + popped-out Office or Canvas window) to subscribe to the same project simultaneously, ensuring both receive identical `seq`-ordered streams and serialized mutations via `CoordinatorWriteQueue`.
- [ ] **Handle Forward-Compatible Minor Protocol Versions:** Ensure client deserializers ignore unknown additive fields on responses/notifications from newer minor daemon versions without failing validation.
- [ ] **Record UI Subscription Lag & Resync Metrics:** Emit internal metrics tracking replay duration, resync counts, and dropped ephemeral telemetry count per client for `Task 133` diagnostics.

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **Event commits in SQLite during the exact millisecond between replay query and live-listener registration:** Register the live-event buffer BEFORE running the SQL replay query, then drain buffered events with `seq > replayMaxSeq` deduplicating `seq <= replayMaxSeq` — mathematically closing the replay-to-live gap race!
- **Project rehydrated from `harness-state` or restored from backup (new `stream_epoch`):** Even if `latest_seq` happens to equal the client's old `last_applied`, the mismatched `stream_epoch` MUST trigger `resync_required` so the window never mixes two timelines!
- **Daemon crashes and restarts while window stays open:** Client reconnects (`Task 031`), automatically resubscribes from `last_applied`, replays missed domain events cleanly from `state.db.outbox`, and never requires manual page reload.
- **Topic-filtered subscription causing apparent `seq` gaps:** When a window subscribes to a subset of `topics` (`['board']`), server MUST either send contiguous filtered sequence envelopes (`from_seq`, `to_seq` marking skipped non-matching seqs) or advance `to_seq` explicitly so `ClientStateSyncer` distinguishes legitimate topic filtering from real transport gaps!
- **Project snapshot section exceeds 2 MB (e.g., 5,000 requirements + 500 tasks):** `snapshot.get` splits cleanly across deterministic keyset cursors pinned to the SAME `as_of_seq` (or returns `resync_required` if a change committed mid-pagination beyond buffer).
- **Mutating RPC retried by window after temporary pipe drop:** Because `op_id` is sent on both attempts, `CoordinatorWriteQueue` returns the original stored result rather than creating duplicate chat turns or double-starting a build.
- **Client closes mid-replay of 10,000 missed events:** Abort replay loop immediately on socket `close` event to avoid wasted DB reads and memory growth.

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Exact `last_applied + 1` Invariant:** `ClientStateSyncer` NEVER applies an out-of-order or gapped domain event to UI state; Board and Office views always reflect exact `snapshot + contiguous events`.
- **Replay-to-Live Zero-Gap Invariant:** Registering the live buffer before querying `outbox` guarantees zero events can fall through the crack between replay and live tailing.
- **Telemetry-Never-Blocks-Domain-Events Invariant:** Domain `events.batch` messages have strict priority over ephemeral `telemetry` notifications.
- **2 MB Snapshot Section Cap Invariant:** No single `snapshot.get` response frame may ever exceed `2 MB` serialized size (and respects channel `0` chunking/pagination rules).
- **Idempotent Mutation Invariant:** Every mutating JSON-RPC method enforces a non-empty client-generated `op_id`.
- **Single Source For Board & Office Invariant:** Both views subscribe to this exact identical event stream—neither maintains divergent state sources.

#### Multi-Agent Harmony And Branch Isolation

- **Worktree Setup:** Create branch `task/032-ipc-event-stream-resync` via `node scripts/agent-worktree.mjs create 032 ipc-event-stream-resync`.
- **Strict Subtree Boundary:** Touch ONLY `packages/ipc/src/protocol/**`, `packages/ipc/tests/protocol/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-032.md`.
- **Parallel Safe Execution:** Disjoint from `Task 031` (transport) and `Task 033` (binary streams).
- **Handoff For `Task 067` (M1 Viewer), `Task 122–127` (Cockpit), `Task 153` (Canvas), `Task 162` (Office):** Export `RpcRouter`, `EventSubscriptionServer`, `SnapshotAssembler`, and `ClientStateSyncer` in `.agent-handoffs/task-032.md`.
- **Commit-Only Discipline:** Commit exclusively on `task/032-ipc-event-stream-resync`; **NEVER merge** into `main` or `harness/integration`.
- **Zero React Coupling:** `ClientStateSyncer` is pure TypeScript event-driven state sync usable by React hooks, CLI tools, and simulation tests alike.

#### Verification, Testing And Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Run `pnpm --filter @ef-harness/ipc test -- protocol` verifying end-to-end `events.subscribe`, replay-to-live seam under concurrent writes, duplicate suppression, and gap-triggered resubscribe.
- [ ] Verify `stream_epoch` bump and pruned-outbox `since_seq` both return `resync_required` and drive full `ClientStateSyncer` recovery via `snapshot.get`.
- [ ] Verify multi-page `snapshot.get` on a synthetic large project stays strictly `<= 2 MB` per page and reconstructs 100% consistent state.
- [ ] Verify slow-client telemetry shedding drops noisy `telemetry` frames while delivering 100% of `events.batch` messages in exact `seq` order.
- [ ] Run `pnpm --filter @ef-harness/ipc typecheck`, `lint`, and `node scripts/verify-harmony.mjs --task 032`.
- **Acceptance:** Gap-free numbered outbox streaming, `stream_epoch` resync, paginated `snapshot.get`, and prioritized telemetry separation pass 100% of tests on `task/032-ipc-event-stream-resync`.

### Task 033: Credit-Based Binary Artifact Streaming Channel (64 KB Chunks, `artifact.open`, Range Diff/Log Fetch & 1 MB Cap)

- **Milestone & Track:** `M0 · Window ↔ Daemon IPC Protocol`
- **Depends On:** `Task 001`, `Task 008`, `Task 028`, `Task 029`, `Task 031`, `Task 032`
- **Git Worktree & Branch:** `task/033-binary-artifact-streaming` in `../ef-wt/task-033-binary-artifact-streaming` (commit on own branch only; **NEVER merge**)
- **Owned Write Scope (Disjoint Subtree):** `packages/ipc/src/streams/**`, `packages/ipc/tests/streams/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-033.md`
- **Mandatory Reference Files:** [kernel-schema-and-protocol.md](kernel-schema-and-protocol.md#large-content), [database-design.md](database-design.md#7--shared-blob-store), [build-cockpit.md](build-cockpit.md#layout), [research/kernel-storage-and-ipc.md](research/kernel-storage-and-ipc.md)
- **Shared Contracts Consumed / Produced:** Consumes `FrameCodec`/`NamedPipeServer` (`Task 031`), `ArtifactManager` (`Task 029`), `CasBlobStore` (`Task 028`); produces `BinaryStreamManager`, `ArtifactStreamClient`, `RangeDiffHandler`, and `RangeLogHandler`

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Implement `artifact.open { id, range? }` → `streamId` Channel 1 Handshake:** Authorize the project artifact lookup, validate retention/integrity (verifying SHA-256 on `'evidence'`/`'asset'` blobs!), allocate a connection-scoped `uint32` `streamId`, and return `{ streamId, totalBytes, mime, chunkBytes: 65536, initialCredits }` on Channel `0` JSON-RPC ([kernel-schema-and-protocol.md](kernel-schema-and-protocol.md#large-content)).
- [ ] **Implement Credit-Based Flow Control (`stream.credit { streamId, chunks }`, `stream.close { streamId }`):** Daemon transmits at most `availableCredits` chunks of `<= 64 KB` each on Channel `1` (`[4B len][1B = 1][4B streamId][<=64KB data]`), pausing cleanly whenever credits reach `0` until the client grants more credits, guaranteeing a 200 MB Playwright trace or build log can NEVER flood the named pipe or starve Channel `0` interactive RPCs!
- [ ] **Implement Explicit EOF & Error Terminal Control Frames:** Send `stream.end { streamId, bytesSent, sha256 }` or `stream.error { streamId, code, message }` on Channel `0` (or explicit 0-byte Channel `1` sentinel synchronized with stream completion) so clients reliably distinguish clean EOF from truncated pipe failure.
- [ ] **Implement Range-Based Log Tailing & Seeking (`log.range { artifactId, startLine, endLine }` & `log.search { artifactId, query, maxMatches }`):** Delegate directly into `ArtifactManager.readLogRange` / `queryLogStream` (`Task 029`) over seekable zstd frames so the Cockpit Raw Log Viewer fetches ONLY visible viewport lines or tails live logs cleanly.
- [ ] **Implement Lazy Hunk-Based Diff Fetcher (`diff.get { task, file, hunks? }`):** Serve file diff summaries (path, insertions, deletions, hunk headers) first and stream only requested visible hunk ranges so a 5,000-line diff opens instantaneously in the Diff tab without hitting the 1 MB JSON request/response limit.
- [ ] **Enforce 1 MB JSON-RPC Payload Guard & Automatic Artifact Spillover Helper:** Reject any Channel `0` JSON-RPC request/response exceeding `1 MB` with `PayloadExceedsJsonCapError` and provide a helper directing oversized outputs to `artifact.open`.
- [ ] **Implement Multiplexed Concurrent Stream Scheduling:** Fairly round-robin Channel `1` chunks across multiple concurrently open streams (e.g., viewing a screenshot while tailing a log) while strictly giving Channel `0` JSON-RPC frames higher scheduling priority!
- [ ] **Implement Automatic Stream Cleanup On Client Disconnect Or Idle Timeout:** Release all open file descriptors, decompressors, and `streamId` slots immediately when a client socket closes, cancels (`stream.close`), or stops granting credits past an idle timeout (e.g., 60 s).

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **Slow renderer stops granting credits while reading a 200 MB trace:** Daemon pauses reading from disk/decompressor after exhausting initial credits (e.g., 8 chunks = 512 KB in flight), keeping daemon memory flat (`< 1 MB` per stream) and Channel `0` latency `< 5 ms`!
- **Client attempts to open an artifact belonging to a different `projectId` or forged `artifactId`:** Scope every `artifact.open` strictly to the authenticated project context and return `ArtifactNotFoundError` for cross-project IDs.
- **Client grants malicious negative or huge (`2^31`) credit count:** Validate credits (`1 <= chunks <= 256`, capped total outstanding credits `<= 512`) to prevent integer overflow or credit-flood DoS.
- **Underlying CAS file missing or corrupt mid-stream:** Catch `CasBlobMissingError` / `CasIntegrityMismatchError` cleanly, send `stream.error`, close the `streamId`, and leave the named pipe healthy for all other RPCs.
- **Zero-byte artifact opened via `artifact.open`:** Immediately send clean EOF (`bytesSent: 0`) without deadlocking waiting for chunk credits.
- **Client cancels `stream.close` while chunks are still in flight:** Client ignores late Channel `1` frames for closed `streamId`s without throwing; server silently drops late `stream.credit` for already-closed streams.
- **Binary artifact requested on Channel `1` alongside active Channel `0` `build.stop`:** Verify `build.stop` pre-empts queued Channel `1` chunks and reaches the coordinator immediately!

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Bounded In-Flight Memory Invariant:** Server never buffers more than `outstandingCredits × 64 KB` per stream regardless of total artifact size (verified on a 50 MB synthetic stream test!).
- **Channel 0 Priority Invariant:** Control/JSON-RPC frames (especially `build.stop` and `chat.send`) ALWAYS flush ahead of Channel `1` bulk binary chunks.
- **64 KB Chunk Ceiling Invariant:** Every Channel `1` data frame is strictly `<= 65,536` bytes.
- **Zero FD / Decompressor Leak Invariant:** Disconnecting a client mid-stream releases 100% of open stream handles within 100 ms.
- **Project-Scoped Access Invariant:** No `artifact.open` or `diff.get` call can read artifacts outside its specified `projectId`.
- **1 MB Channel 0 Guard Invariant:** Oversized JSON payloads are rejected deterministically rather than crashing JSON parsing or blocking the pipe.

#### Multi-Agent Harmony And Branch Isolation

- **Worktree Setup:** Create branch `task/033-binary-artifact-streaming` via `node scripts/agent-worktree.mjs create 033 binary-artifact-streaming`.
- **Strict Subtree Boundary:** Touch ONLY `packages/ipc/src/streams/**`, `packages/ipc/tests/streams/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-033.md`.
- **Parallel Safe Execution:** Disjoint from `Task 031` (transport) and `Task 032` (RPC protocol).
- **Handoff For `Task 067` (M1 Viewer), `Task 126` (Inspector Diff/Log Tabs), `Task 133` (Diagnostics Export):** Export `BinaryStreamManager`, `ArtifactStreamClient`, `RangeDiffHandler`, and `RangeLogHandler` in `.agent-handoffs/task-033.md`.
- **Commit-Only Discipline:** Commit exclusively on `task/033-binary-artifact-streaming`; **NEVER merge** into `main` or `harness/integration`.
- **Zero Electron Direct Import:** Pure Node stream/IPC layer compatible with Electron utility process and unit tests alike.

#### Verification, Testing And Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Run `pnpm --filter @ef-harness/ipc test -- streams` streaming a 25 MB synthetic binary artifact over a real Windows named pipe with 4-chunk credit window (`256 KB`), verifying exact SHA-256 round-trip while asserting server memory never exceeds bounded credit window.
- [ ] Verify interactive Channel `0` `session.ping` / `build.stop` completes in `< 10 ms` while 3 heavy binary streams run concurrently.
- [ ] Verify mid-stream client disconnect, `stream.close`, zero-byte artifact, missing blob, and invalid credit counts (`-1`, `999999`) all clean up with 0 leaked stream slots or handles.
- [ ] Verify `log.range` and `diff.get` serve exact viewport slices cleanly without loading full files.
- [ ] Run `pnpm --filter @ef-harness/ipc typecheck`, `lint`, and `node scripts/verify-harmony.mjs --task 033`.
- **Acceptance:** Credit-based 64 KB binary artifact streaming, range log/diff handlers, and Channel 0 prioritization pass all load and fault tests on `task/033-binary-artifact-streaming`.

### Task 034: M0 Exit Gate — Fake Model Adapter, Deterministic Simulation Engine & 10,000-Run Crash-Boundary Proof Suite

- **Milestone & Track:** `M0 · Milestone Exit Certification Gate`
- **Depends On:** `Task 001`, `Task 012`–`Task 033`

- **Mandatory Reference Files:** [roadmap.md](roadmap.md), [database-design.md](database-design.md), [kernel-schema-and-protocol.md](kernel-schema-and-protocol.md), [coordinator-and-recovery.md](coordinator-and-recovery.md), [meta-lab.md](meta-lab.md#testing-the-harness-itself), [architecture-review-decisions.md](architecture-review-decisions.md), [schema/schema-test.js](schema/schema-test.js), [research/evaluating-prompts-and-skills.md](research/evaluating-prompts-and-skills.md)
- **Shared Contracts Consumed / Produced:** Consumes all M0 `packages/db` + `packages/ipc` modules; produces `DeterministicSeededRng`, `FakeDualClock`, `FakeModelAdapter`, `CrashFaultInjector`, `M0KernelSimulator`, and the 10,000-run M0 exit-check verifier

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Build Seeded Deterministic Simulation Core (`DeterministicSeededRng`, `FakeDualClock`, `SimEventLoop`):** Single-threaded FoundationDB/TigerBeetle-VOPR-style deterministic simulator where ONE integer seed reproduces the exact interleaving of workers, timer ticks, wall-clock sleep jumps, grant messages, IPC disconnects, and crashes bit-for-bit ([meta-lab.md](meta-lab.md#testing-the-harness-itself), [research/evaluating-prompts-and-skills.md](research/evaluating-prompts-and-skills.md)).
- [ ] **Build Configurable `FakeModelAdapter`:** Deterministic in-memory model stub supporting scripted outputs, seeded random tool sequences, simulated 429 rate limits with `retry-after`, mid-stream stalls, malformed JSON, paid timeouts with unknown outcomes (reconcilable vs irreconcilable), and variable actual token overruns.
- [ ] **Build Transaction-Boundary Crash Fault Injector (`CrashFaultInjector`):** Inject simulated process crashes at EVERY critical boundary: (1) before `BEGIN IMMEDIATE`, (2) after SQLite write before `COMMIT`, (3) after `COMMIT` before sending IPC receipt, (4) after broker `issueGrant` before project `depositGrant`, (5) after `closeGrant` before broker ack, (6) after outbox append before consumer `delivered_at`, (7) during CAS temp-file rename, (8) during laptop 1-hour sleep jump!
- [ ] **Verify All 9 Hard Kernel Invariants After Every Single Simulated Run:** Assert on EVERY run: (1) zero lost work, (2) zero duplicated work/candidates, (3) zero double-spent budget (`spent + reserved` exact conservation across `state.db` AND `global.db`), (4) at most one active lease holder per task at any instant, (5) zero accepted candidates from fenced/stale epochs or stale read sets, (6) zero pruned unacknowledged or delivery-less outbox events, (7) zero rollup drift (`rollup_drift` = 0 rows), (8) 100% gap-free client window state parity with `state.db`, (9) `PRAGMA quick_check` + `PRAGMA foreign_key_check` = clean!
- [ ] **Execute the Mandatory M0 Roadmap Exit Check (10,000 Simulated Runs):** Run 10,000 deterministic seeded simulation runs (with randomized worker concurrency 1–50, multi-project broker grants, concurrent knowledge barriers, sleep jumps, and injected crashes at every transaction boundary) verifying **10,000/10,000 pass — zero lost or duplicated work, zero double-spent budget** ([roadmap.md](roadmap.md)).
- [ ] **Implement Failing-Seed Minimizer & Replay CLI (`pnpm sim:replay --seed <N>`):** If any seed ever fails an invariant, log the exact seed and operation trace so any developer or agent can replay the exact bug deterministically in milliseconds.
- [ ] **Include M0 Performance Assertions:** Verify 50-simulated-worker write latency `p99 < 50 ms` and 500-task / 5,000-requirement Board query `< 10 ms` inside the M0 exit suite ([database-design.md](database-design.md#6--outbox-telemetry-and-fast-read-models)).
- [ ] **Generate M0 Certification Report (`packages/sim/tests/m0/M0_EXIT_REPORT.md` generator):** Output exact pass counts, fault classes exercised, p50/p95/p99 DB latencies, and sign-off status unlocking Milestone M1.

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **Non-determinism sneaking into simulation via `Date.now()`, `Math.random()`, or `crypto.randomUUID()`:** Enforce injection of `FakeDualClock` and `DeterministicSeededRng` into every M0 kernel module; prove running seed `42` twice produces an identical SHA-256 event log hash!
- **10,000 runs taking too long in CI if each creates real on-disk WAL files:** Run 9,900 fast deterministic runs on `:memory:` SQLite (completing in seconds!) PLUS 100 full on-disk WAL + CAS + named-pipe crash/restart runs to cover real OS durability and file locking too!
- **Simulated crash leaving SQLite connection half-closed:** Test real `db.close()` / discard without committing vs post-commit drop to prove SQLite rollback and restart reconciliation restore exact state.
- **Unreconciled `'unknown'` paid reservation across crash:** Verify restart recovery keeps `reserved_units` held until explicit fake-provider reconciliation settles or releases it—never blindingly re-charging!
- **Concurrent broker grant expiration while project reconnects:** Verify conservative expiry + late closure reconciliation preserves exact non-over-promised window accounting.
- **50 workers competing for 10 tasks while a breaking `R17` change set commits:** Verify zero tasks get two holders, every stale worker is fenced or re-verified, and final state is 100% consistent.
- **Simulated client disconnect + `stream_epoch` bump mid-run:** Verify `ClientStateSyncer` ends at exact equality with `state.db` after resync.

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Strict Roadmap M0 Gate Invariant:** Per [roadmap.md](roadmap.md), M1 features do not ship until M0's 10,000-run crash-boundary simulation passes with **0** violations.
- **Bitwise Seed Reproducibility Invariant:** Same seed MUST produce identical event trace hash across repeated executions on any machine.
- **Zero-Weakening Invariant:** Never skip or relax an invariant check to make a flaky seed pass; any failing seed exposes a real kernel race that must be fixed in `packages/db` or `packages/ipc`.
- **Full Transaction-Boundary Coverage Invariant:** Assert every registered fault-injection point fires at least 100 times across the 10,000-run sweep (zero dead fault hooks!).
- **Real Schema Execution Invariant:** Simulator runs directly against canonical [schema/state.sql](schema/state.sql) and [schema/global.sql](schema/global.sql), never mocked SQL tables.
- **Fast CI + Deep Soak Modes:** `pnpm test` runs a fast 500-run smoke sweep + 10 disk-crash tests (`<15 s`); `pnpm test:m0-exit` runs the complete 10,000-run exit certification!
