- **Mandatory Reference Files:** [workspace-and-git.md](workspace-and-git.md), [desktop-app.md](desktop-app.md#installer-contents-and-on-demand-downloads), [editor-coexistence.md](editor-coexistence.md), [research/git-worktrees-and-workspaces.md](research/git-worktrees-and-workspaces.md), [workspace-git-and-brownfield.svg](workspace-git-and-brownfield.svg)
- **Shared Contracts Consumed / Produced:** Consumes `StructuredLogger` (`Task 011`); produces `GitRunner` (`execGit`, `resolveGitBinary`), `FolderStateInspector` (`inspectWorkspaceFolder`, `FolderStateResult`), and `initializeNewRepo`

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Implement Bundled MinGit Binary Resolver (`resolveGitBinary`):** Prefer the app-bundled MinGit binary (`<resources>/mingit/cmd/git.exe`) so zero user Git installation is required, while honoring an explicit Settings override pointing to system Git ONLY if it passes minimum version check (`>= 2.38`, required for `git merge-tree --write-tree` per [research/git-worktrees-and-workspaces.md](research/git-worktrees-and-workspaces.md)).
- [ ] **Implement Safe Direct-Process `GitRunner` (`execGit`):** Spawn Git directly via `child_process.spawn` (`shell: false`, `windowsHide: true`) passing `-c core.longpaths=true` on every call, scrubbing credential-helper interactive prompts (`GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0`), enforcing configurable per-command timeouts, honoring `.gitattributes` and the developer's configured `core.autocrlf`, and returning structured `{ exitCode, stdout, stderr, durationMs }`.
- [ ] **Implement All 11 Folder State Detectors (`inspectWorkspaceFolder`):** Deterministically classify every folder state from [workspace-and-git.md](workspace-and-git.md#folder-states-and-what-the-user-sees): (1) `empty`, (2) `files_no_git`, (3) `git_clean` (recording `HEAD` & branch), (4) `git_dirty` (exact count + status list of modified/untracked files), (5) `git_unborn` (`git rev-parse --verify HEAD` fails — no commits yet), (6) `git_mid_operation` (detecting `.git/MERGE_HEAD`, `.git/rebase-merge/`, `.git/rebase-apply/`, `CHERRY_PICK_HEAD`, `REVERT_HEAD`, or unmerged conflict paths), (7) `git_detached_head` (`git symbolic-ref -q HEAD` fails), (8) `other_vcs` (`.hg` Mercurial or `.p4config` Perforce → offer "Work on a copy" with Git), (9) `synced_or_network_folder` (detecting OneDrive/Dropbox/iCloud/UNC network paths and warning about locks/slow builds), (10) `missing_git_identity` (checking `user.name`/`user.email`), and (11) `shallow_clone` (`git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository`).
- [ ] **Implement Silent Empty-Folder Init & "Work on a Copy" Helper:** For `empty`, support silent `git init -b main`; for `files_no_git` or `other_vcs`, support copying cleanly (skipping `.hg`/`.p4`/ignored junk) into a new folder and initializing Git there without ever mutating the original folder.
- [ ] **Implement Read-Only Checkout Guarantee Guard (`assertNeverMutatesDeveloperCheckout`):** Structurally classify Git subcommands in `GitRunner` into `read_only` (`status`, `rev-parse`, `symbolic-ref`, `diff`, `merge-tree`, `log`) vs `mutating`, blocking ANY mutating Git command targeting the developer's checkout `cwd` unless an explicit `userExplicitConsentToken` (e.g., landing click or baseline commit click) is passed!
- [ ] **Implement `git merge-tree --write-tree` In-Memory Conflict Predictor:** Wrap `git merge-tree --write-tree <a> <b>` to test merge cleanliness and extract exact conflicting path lists in memory without ever touching any working tree or index!
- [ ] **Detect Case-Collision Paths On Windows:** Provide a helper scanning tree entries (`git ls-tree -r --name-only`) for two paths differing ONLY by letter case (`Foo.ts` vs `foo.ts`), catching Linux-CI breakages locally on Windows ([workspace-and-git.md](workspace-and-git.md#windows-specifics)).
- [ ] **Handle Windows Path & Encoding Quirks:** Pass `-c core.quotepath=false` so UTF-8 international filenames are returned unescaped, and normalize Windows path casing and drive prefixes consistently.

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **Git worktree `.git` file (instead of `.git` directory):** If a developer opens a folder that is ITSELF a Git worktree, `.git` is a text file `gitdir: ...`; use `git rev-parse --git-path MERGE_HEAD` (and `--git-dir`) instead of naive `path.join(cwd, '.git', 'MERGE_HEAD')` so mid-merge/rebase detection works everywhere!
- **Developer folder sits inside OneDrive (`%USERPROFILE%\OneDrive\...`) or UNC share (`\\server\share`):** Detect via Windows environment vars (`OneDrive`, `OneDriveCommercial`, `OneDriveConsumer`), `.dropbox` markers, and `\\` UNC prefix, returning non-blocking warning metadata with "Continue" or "Move project".
- **Folder contains only hidden OS junk (`.DS_Store`, `desktop.ini`, `Thumbs.db`):** Treat cleanly or show transparently as `files_no_git` rather than silently misclassifying as empty.
- **Git version `< 2.38` configured in custom Settings path:** Reject custom system Git `< 2.38` with clear message ("Requires Git 2.38+ for in-memory `merge-tree`") and offer fallback to bundled MinGit.
- **Concurrent `.git/index.lock` held by VS Code or user terminal:** Retry transient read-only status calls briefly with clear `"Git busy in another process"` status rather than deleting `.git/index.lock` (NEVER delete user lockfiles!).
- **Repo with `0` commits AND untracked files (`git_unborn` + dirty):** Classify accurately so onboarding shows baseline-commit review rather than crashing on `git rev-parse HEAD`.
- **Deeply nested Windows path `> 260` characters:** Confirm `-c core.longpaths=true` handles paths up to 400+ characters cleanly.

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Developer Checkout Untouchable Invariant:** Zero code paths in `inspectWorkspaceFolder` or background `GitRunner` routines may run `checkout`, `reset`, `stash`, `clean`, `add`, or `commit` against the developer's checkout without explicit user click consent.
- **No Shell-String Injection Invariant:** `execGit` ALWAYS passes `args: string[]` to `spawn(gitBin, args, { shell: false })` — never interpolating file paths or branch names into shell strings!
- **Never Delete `.git/index.lock` Invariant:** Harness code MUST NEVER forcibly remove a lockfile in the developer's checkout.
- **Never Finish Or Abort Developer Merge/Rebase:** When `git_mid_operation` is detected, block harness operations and show "Open in my editor + Re-check" ([workspace-and-git.md](workspace-and-git.md#folder-states-and-what-the-user-sees)).
- **Minimum Git 2.38 Enforcement Invariant:** Guarantees `git merge-tree --write-tree` and `git worktree repair` are always available.
- **Line-Ending Preservation Invariant:** Never override the repo's `.gitattributes` or force global `autocrlf` mutations in the developer's config.

#### Multi-Agent Harmony And Branch Isolation

- **Worktree Setup:** Create branch `task/035-mingit-wrapper-folder-states` via `node scripts/agent-worktree.mjs create 035 mingit-wrapper-folder-states`.
- **Strict Subtree Boundary:** Touch ONLY `packages/git-engine/src/runner/**`, `packages/git-engine/tests/runner/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-035.md`.
- **Parallel Safe Execution:** Disjoint from `Task 036` (secret scan), `Task 037` (temp-index snapshots), `Task 038` (worktree slots), and `Task 039` (ref leases).
- **Handoff For `Tasks 036–039`, `Tasks 166–173`, `Task 177`:** Export `GitRunner`, `FolderStateInspector`, `predictMergeTree`, and `detectCaseCollisions` in `.agent-handoffs/task-035.md`.
- **Commit-Only Discipline:** Commit exclusively on `task/035-mingit-wrapper-folder-states`; **NEVER merge** into `main` or `harness/integration`.
- **Isolated Test Repos:** All tests create temporary Git repos inside `os.tmpdir()` and never touch the outer EF Harness repository.

#### Verification, Testing And Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Run `pnpm --filter @ef-harness/git-engine test -- runner` testing ALL 11 folder states on real temporary directories/repos (empty, non-Git, clean, dirty, unborn, mid-merge, mid-rebase, detached HEAD, `.hg` Mercurial, simulated OneDrive/UNC path, shallow clone).
- [ ] Verify `assertNeverMutatesDeveloperCheckout` throws if a mutating Git command targets a developer checkout without an explicit consent token.
- [ ] Verify `predictMergeTree` predicts both clean merges and exact conflicting paths in memory while leaving working tree and `git status` 100% untouched.
- [ ] Verify `detectCaseCollisions` catches `src/Foo.ts` vs `src/foo.ts` and `execGit` handles UTF-8 filenames and >260 char Windows paths.
- [ ] Run `pnpm --filter @ef-harness/git-engine typecheck`, `lint`, and `node scripts/verify-harmony.mjs --task 035`.
- **Acceptance:** Safe MinGit wrapper, 11-state folder inspector, in-memory `merge-tree` predictor, and checkout-protection guard pass all unit and integration tests on `task/035-mingit-wrapper-folder-states`.

### Task 036: First-Commit & Diff Safety Scanner (`gitleaks` + Entropy + Large Files + Junk) & `.gitignore` Proposal Generator

- **Milestone & Track:** `M1 · Git Engine & Workspace Isolation`
- **Depends On:** `Task 001`, `Task 011`, `Task 035`
- **Git Worktree & Branch:** `task/036-git-safety-scanner` in `../ef-wt/task-036-git-safety-scanner` (commit on own branch only; **NEVER merge**)
- **Owned Write Scope (Disjoint Subtree):** `packages/git-engine/src/safety-scan/**`, `packages/git-engine/tests/safety-scan/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-036.md`
- **Mandatory Reference Files:** [workspace-and-git.md](workspace-and-git.md#first-commit-safety-scan), [build-cockpit.md](build-cockpit.md#secrets), [completeness-gate.md](completeness-gate.md#static-audit), [desktop-app.md](desktop-app.md#installer-contents-and-on-demand-downloads), [research/git-worktrees-and-workspaces.md](research/git-worktrees-and-workspaces.md)
- **Shared Contracts Consumed / Produced:** Consumes `SecretRedactor` (`Task 011`), `GitRunner` (`Task 035`); produces `GitSafetyScanner` (`scanWorkingTreeForBaseline`, `scanCommitDiffForSecrets`, `generateGitignoreProposal`)

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Implement Deterministic First-Commit Safety Scanner (`scanWorkingTreeForBaseline`):** Before ANY baseline commit (`files_no_git`, `git_unborn`) or dirty-work snapshot (`Task 037`), deterministically scan all candidate files for: (1) `.env*` files (excluding `.env.example`/`.env.sample`/`.env.template`), (2) private key files (`*.pem`, `*.key`, `*.p12`, `*.pfx`, `id_rsa`, `id_ed25519`), (3) secrets detected by bundled `gitleaks` rules + built-in Shannon entropy + `SecretRedactor` vault value matching, (4) large files `> 50 MB`, (5) `node_modules/`, `.venv/`, `vendor/`, `target/`, `dist/`, `build/`, `.next/` build outputs, and (6) OS junk (`.DS_Store`, `Thumbs.db`, `desktop.ini`).
- [ ] **Integrate Bundled `gitleaks` CLI + Pure-TS Fallback Engine:** Invoke bundled `gitleaks detect --no-git --report-format json` (with `shell: false` and timeout) when the bundled binary is present, AND run the built-in deterministic TypeScript regex + high-entropy + vault-match scanner so secret detection works identically even in minimal CI environments without external binaries.
- [ ] **Implement Candidate-Diff Secret Scanner (`scanCommitDiffForSecrets`):** Scan every worker candidate commit diff (`git diff --unified=0 <base> <candidate>`) against `gitleaks`, high-entropy patterns, and registered vault secrets (raw, Base64, URL-encoded), hard-rejecting any candidate with a hit and returning an `Interrupt-now` finding (`path`, `line`, `ruleId`, masked preview — NEVER raw secret!) ([build-cockpit.md](build-cockpit.md#secrets)).
- [ ] **Implement Smart `.gitignore` Proposal Generator (`generateGitignoreProposal`):** Inspect detected stack (`package.json`, `pyproject.toml`, `Cargo.toml`, `go.mod`) and flagged directories/files to propose clean, deduplicated `.gitignore` additions preserving any existing `.gitignore` lines, plus an explicit list of "these look like secrets and will not be committed" for user review/edit/accept/cancel ([workspace-and-git.md](workspace-and-git.md#first-commit-safety-scan)).
- [ ] **Implement `.git/info/exclude` Harness Entry Manager:** Add/verify `.harness/views/`, `.harness/tmp/`, and mounted runtime skill folders inside `.git/info/exclude` (local repo exclude, NOT tracked `.gitignore`) so harness-generated views and mounted skills NEVER pollute the developer's Git commits ([knowledge-database.md](knowledge-database.md#where-the-files-are-and-what-they-look-like), [agent-runtime-adapters.md](agent-runtime-adapters.md#giving-their-agent-our-brief)).
- [ ] **Implement Streaming Large-File Threshold Guard:** Stat files BEFORE reading content so a 2 GB video or database dump in a project folder is immediately flagged as `> 50 MB` without attempting to read 2 GB into Node memory!
- [ ] **Implement Allowlist/False-Positive Suppression Rules:** Ignore benign synthetic fixture tokens explicitly marked `test-fixture-not-secret` ONLY inside declared test/fixture paths (never disabling real `sk_live_` / vault-match checks!).
- [ ] **Return Structured Reviewable `SafetyScanReport`:** Group findings cleanly into `blockedSecrets`, `largeFiles`, `recommendedIgnores`, `proposedGitignoreDiff`, and `safeToCommit`.

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **5 GB ISO or `.mp4` file sitting in a non-Git folder:** `fs.stat` catches `size > 50 * 1024 * 1024` immediately in `<1 ms` without reading file bytes or causing OOM.
- **`.env.example` containing `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY=sk_test_replace_me` vs `.env.local` containing real `sk_live_...`:** `.env.example` is allowed (unless containing a real high-entropy/vault secret!), while `.env`, `.env.local`, `.env.production` are ALWAYS flagged for `.gitignore` and excluded from commits.
- **Vault secret committed in Base64 or split inside a JSON fixture by a confused worker:** `scanCommitDiffForSecrets` checks vault secrets across raw, Base64, and URL-encoded forms and hard-rejects the candidate.
- **Binary files (PNG, PDF, WOFF2) triggering false high-entropy secret alerts:** Detect binary files via NUL-byte check in first 8 KB and skip text-entropy scans on true binary formats (still checking filename/magic-bytes for `.p12`/`.pfx`/keystore certificates!).
- **Symlink pointing outside the workspace (e.g., to `~/.ssh/id_rsa`):** Use `fs.lstat` and NEVER follow symlinks escaping the project root; flag escaping symlinks as a security finding.
- **Developer rejects a `.gitignore` entry or edits the proposal:** Support applying user-edited proposal cleanly without re-adding deleted lines silently.
- **`gitleaks` exit code `1` (leaks found) vs exit code `>1` (tool crash):** Distinguish `exitCode === 1` with valid JSON findings from binary crash/quarantine (`desktop-app.md` antivirus repair signal).

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Never Log Or Echo Raw Secret Values Invariant:** `SafetyScanReport` returns ONLY `file`, `line`, `rule`, and a redacted preview (`sk_live_****...****`) — NEVER raw secret bytes!
- **Zero-Memory-Blowup On Huge Files Invariant:** `lstat` size check strictly precedes any file read (`> 50 MB` skipped from text scan and flagged directly).
- **Never Follow Out-of-Tree Symlinks Invariant:** Prevents a malicious repo symlink from dragging `%USERPROFILE%\.ssh` into a snapshot or baseline commit.
- **Zero Untracked Harness Pollution Invariant:** `.harness/views/` and mounted skills live strictly in `.git/info/exclude`, never dirtying tracked `.gitignore` unless the team opts in.
- **Live-Key Zero-Tolerance Invariant:** Any `sk_live_` or registered vault value in a candidate diff ALWAYS triggers a hard block regardless of path or fixture allowlist.
- **Read-Only Scan Invariant:** `scanWorkingTreeForBaseline` and `scanCommitDiffForSecrets` NEVER modify any file in the developer's folder.

#### Multi-Agent Harmony And Branch Isolation

- **Worktree Setup:** Create branch `task/036-git-safety-scanner` via `node scripts/agent-worktree.mjs create 036 git-safety-scanner`.
- **Strict Subtree Boundary:** Touch ONLY `packages/git-engine/src/safety-scan/**`, `packages/git-engine/tests/safety-scan/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-036.md`.
- **Parallel Safe Execution:** Disjoint from `Task 035` (runner), `Task 037` (snapshots), `Task 038` (worktrees), and `Task 039` (ref leases).
- **Handoff For `Task 037` (Snapshots), `Task 059` (Static Audit), `Task 120` (Vault):** Export `GitSafetyScanner`, `SafetyScanReport`, and `ensureGitInfoExclude` in `.agent-handoffs/task-036.md`.
- **Commit-Only Discipline:** Commit exclusively on `task/036-git-safety-scanner`; **NEVER merge** into `main` or `harness/integration`.
- **No Real Secrets In Tests:** Use clearly synthetic fake-format canary strings (`sk_live_synthetic_test_0000000000000000`) generated dynamically in test code.

#### Verification, Testing And Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Run `pnpm --filter @ef-harness/git-engine test -- safety-scan` testing `.env*`, PEM keys, synthetic high-entropy tokens, vault secrets (raw + Base64), `>50 MB` sparse files, `node_modules`, and OS junk.
- [ ] Verify `.env.example` with placeholders passes while `.env.local` and live-prefix keys fail cleanly with redacted previews (0 raw secret bytes in report).
- [ ] Verify out-of-tree symlink test proves scanner refuses to traverse outside repo root and flags the symlink.
- [ ] Verify `ensureGitInfoExclude` adds `.harness/views/` idempotently without modifying `.gitignore`.
- [ ] Run `pnpm --filter @ef-harness/git-engine typecheck`, `lint`, and `node scripts/verify-harmony.mjs --task 036`.
- **Acceptance:** First-commit and diff safety scanner, `.gitignore` proposal generator, and `.git/info/exclude` manager pass 100% of security and edge-case tests on `task/036-git-safety-scanner`.

### Task 037: Temporary-Index Dirty-Work Snapshotter (`GIT_INDEX_FILE`, `write-tree`, `commit-tree`, `refs/harness/snapshots/*`)

- **Milestone & Track:** `M1 · Git Engine & Workspace Isolation`
- **Depends On:** `Task 001`, `Task 035`, `Task 036`
- **Git Worktree & Branch:** `task/037-temp-index-snapshots` in `../ef-wt/task-037-temp-index-snapshots` (commit on own branch only; **NEVER merge**)
- **Owned Write Scope (Disjoint Subtree):** `packages/git-engine/src/snapshots/**`, `packages/git-engine/tests/snapshots/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-037.md`
- **Mandatory Reference Files:** [workspace-and-git.md](workspace-and-git.md#snapshot-of-uncommitted-work), [worker-loop.md](worker-loop.md#checkpoints-and-recovery), [stops-undo-and-reentry.md](stops-undo-and-reentry.md), [research/git-worktrees-and-workspaces.md](research/git-worktrees-and-workspaces.md), [workspace-git-and-brownfield.svg](workspace-git-and-brownfield.svg)
- **Shared Contracts Consumed / Produced:** Consumes `GitRunner` (`Task 035`), `GitSafetyScanner` (`Task 036`); produces `SnapshotManager` (`createDirtyWorkSnapshot`, `createCheckpointWipCommit`, `listSnapshots`, `pruneSnapshots`)

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Implement Read-Only Dirty-Work Snapshotter (`createDirtyWorkSnapshot`):** Execute the exact temporary-index sequence from [workspace-and-git.md](workspace-and-git.md#snapshot-of-uncommitted-work) using a unique temp file `GIT_INDEX_FILE = <harnessTmp>/snapshot-<uuid>.index`: (1) run `GitSafetyScanner` on the uncommitted delta first (blocking secrets and `>50 MB` files before writing any Git object!), (2) `git read-tree HEAD`, (3) `git add -A` (honoring `.gitignore` and writing ONLY to `GIT_INDEX_FILE`!), (4) `tree = git write-tree`, (5) `commit = git commit-tree <tree> -p HEAD -m "harness: snapshot of uncommitted work"`, (6) `git update-ref refs/harness/snapshots/<project>/<n> <commit>`, and (7) unconditionally delete the temp index file in `finally`!
- [ ] **Guarantee 100% Untouched Developer Working Tree & Staging Area:** Assert before and after snapshotting that the developer's `.git/index` SHA-256 hash, staged changes (`git diff --cached`), unstaged changes (`git diff`), untracked files, and `HEAD` ref are bit-for-bit identical!
- [ ] **Implement Worker Step Checkpoint WIP Committer (`createCheckpointWipCommit`):** Use the exact same temporary-index mechanism inside an attempt worktree to create `refs/harness/checkpoints/<attempt>/<step>` (with parent = previous checkpoint or attempt `HEAD`, plus trailers `Harness-Task`, `Harness-Attempt`, `Harness-Step`) at every worker loop step boundary WITHOUT modifying the worktree's real Git index or working files ([worker-loop.md](worker-loop.md#checkpoints-and-recovery)).
- [ ] **Support Unborn-HEAD Edge Case & Partial Exclusions:** Handle excluded secret files cleanly by removing flagged secret paths from the temporary index (`git rm --cached --ignore-unmatch -- <paths>` against `GIT_INDEX_FILE` ONLY!) when the developer explicitly chooses "Snapshot excluding flagged secrets", while NEVER touching those files on disk.
- [ ] **Handle Submodules & Empty-Delta Snapshots Cleanly:** If the working tree has zero net changes relative to `HEAD`, return `HEAD` directly (or explicit `noChanges: true`) without cluttering `refs/harness/snapshots/*`; handle submodule dirty pointers safely without crashing `git add -A`.
- [ ] **Implement Snapshot Metadata & Safe Pruning (`listSnapshots`, `pruneSnapshots`):** List all `refs/harness/snapshots/<project>/*` and `refs/harness/checkpoints/<attempt>/*` with timestamps and parent SHAs, and prune only explicitly retired snapshot refs (never deleting checkpoints belonging to parked or unlanded features!).
- [ ] **Verify GC Survival Of Snapshot & Checkpoint Refs:** Because snapshots and checkpoints are real Git refs under `refs/harness/*`, prove `git gc --prune=now` retains every reachable snapshot and checkpoint commit intact ([workspace-and-git.md](workspace-and-git.md#edge-cases)).
- [ ] **Verify Clean Landing Convergence:** Prove that when a developer later commits their identical dirty edits on `main` and the harness merges a feature built atop the snapshot commit, three-way merge converges cleanly with zero spurious conflicts ([workspace-and-git.md](workspace-and-git.md#snapshot-of-uncommitted-work)).

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **Developer has BOTH staged changes (`git add a.ts`), unstaged modifications (`b.ts`), deleted tracked file (`c.ts`), AND brand-new untracked file (`d.ts`):** Snapshot tree MUST capture ALL four accurately (unlike `git stash create` which drops untracked files!) while leaving the developer's staged vs unstaged split 100% untouched!
- **Process crashes midway between `git add -A` and `unlink(tempIndex)`:** Because `GIT_INDEX_FILE` lives inside `%LOCALAPPDATA%\EFHarness\tmp\` (NEVER inside `.git/`!), a crash leaves zero stale `.git/index.lock` files in the developer's repository and temp files sweep cleanly on next startup!
- **Developer edits a file during the exact millisecond `git add -A` runs:** Handle transient Windows sharing violations or changed-stat races with bounded retry rather than corrupting state.
- **Safety scanner detects `.env` or a real API key in an untracked file:** `createDirtyWorkSnapshot` MUST abort with `SnapshotSafetyBlockedError(report)` BEFORE calling `git write-tree` so zero secret blobs ever enter `.git/objects`!
- **Path containing spaces, brackets, or Unicode characters on Windows:** Pass paths safely as `-- <path>` arguments without shell quoting bugs.
- **Running `createCheckpointWipCommit` when worktree has zero file changes since last step:** Skip creating redundant identical tree commits when `newTree === prevTree` and reuse the previous `wip_ref` cleanly.
- **Line-ending preservation inside temp index:** Confirm temporary-index `git add -A` respects `.gitattributes` and repo `core.autocrlf` identically to normal Git commits.

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Zero Developer-Index Mutation Invariant:** SHA-256 of `<repo>/.git/index` before and after `createDirtyWorkSnapshot` MUST be bit-for-bit identical.
- **Zero Secret Object Creation Invariant:** Safety scan runs strictly BEFORE `git add -A` / `git write-tree` so secret blobs never enter Git's object database.
- **Zero Temp-Index Leak Invariant:** `GIT_INDEX_FILE` always sits in `harnessTmp` (never `.git/`) and is unlinked in `finally`.
- **GC-Proof Ref Persistence Invariant:** Every snapshot and checkpoint is anchored under `refs/harness/snapshots/*` or `refs/harness/checkpoints/*`, surviving `git gc` and `git worktree prune`.
- **No `git stash` Ever Used Invariant:** Codebase contains zero `git stash` invocations inside automatic snapshotting.
- **Exact Committer/Author Attribution Invariant:** Checkpoint and snapshot commits carry structured Harness identity (`Harness Kernel <kernel@harness.local>`) plus trailers (`Harness-Task`, `Harness-Attempt`, `Harness-Step`).

#### Multi-Agent Harmony And Branch Isolation

- **Worktree Setup:** Create branch `task/037-temp-index-snapshots` via `node scripts/agent-worktree.mjs create 037 temp-index-snapshots`.
- **Strict Subtree Boundary:** Touch ONLY `packages/git-engine/src/snapshots/**`, `packages/git-engine/tests/snapshots/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-037.md`.
- **Parallel Safe Execution:** Disjoint from `Tasks 035–036` and `Tasks 038–039`.
- **Handoff For `Task 057` (Worker Loop Checkpoints), `Task 128` (Budget Stop), `Task 171` (Coexistence):** Export `SnapshotManager`, `SnapshotResult`, and `CheckpointCommitResult` in `.agent-handoffs/task-037.md`.
- **Commit-Only Discipline:** Commit exclusively on `task/037-temp-index-snapshots`; **NEVER merge** into `main` or `harness/integration`.
- **Temp-Repo Tests Only:** All snapshot and `git gc` survival tests operate strictly on temporary repos inside `os.tmpdir()`.

#### Verification, Testing And Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Run `pnpm --filter @ef-harness/git-engine test -- snapshots` on a dirty repo containing staged + unstaged + deleted + untracked files, verifying snapshot captures all 4 while `.git/index` SHA-256, `git diff --cached`, `git diff`, and untracked files remain 100% unchanged!
- [ ] Verify safety scan blocks a dirty repo with a synthetic API key BEFORE any object is written to `.git/objects`.
- [ ] Verify `git gc --prune=now` preserves both `refs/harness/snapshots/*` and `refs/harness/checkpoints/*`.
- [ ] Verify clean three-way merge convergence when developer later commits the same dirty edits on `main`.
- [ ] Run `pnpm --filter @ef-harness/git-engine typecheck`, `lint`, and `node scripts/verify-harmony.mjs --task 037`.
- **Acceptance:** Temporary-index dirty-work snapshotter and step-checkpoint WIP committer preserve developer working trees bit-for-bit, block secrets pre-object, and survive `git gc` on `task/037-temp-index-snapshots`.

### Task 038: Reusable Worktree Slot Manager, Persistent Integration Worktree, Submodules/LFS/Sparse-Checkout & `git worktree repair`

- **Milestone & Track:** `M1 · Git Engine & Workspace Isolation`
- **Depends On:** `Task 001`, `Task 013`, `Task 035`
- **Git Worktree & Branch:** `task/038-worktree-slot-manager` in `../ef-wt/task-038-worktree-slot-manager` (commit on own branch only; **NEVER merge**)
- **Owned Write Scope (Disjoint Subtree):** `packages/git-engine/src/worktrees/**`, `packages/git-engine/tests/worktrees/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-038.md`
- **Mandatory Reference Files:** [workspace-and-git.md](workspace-and-git.md#worktrees), [execution-capacity.md](execution-capacity.md#no-permission-or-antivirus-storms), [app-shell-and-governor.md](app-shell-and-governor.md#disk), [architecture-deep-review.md](architecture-deep-review.md), [research/git-worktrees-and-workspaces.md](research/git-worktrees-and-workspaces.md), [research/sandbox-capacity-on-windows.md](research/sandbox-capacity-on-windows.md)
- **Shared Contracts Consumed / Produced:** Consumes `GitRunner` (`Task 035`); produces `WorktreeSlotManager` (`acquireSlot`, `resetSlotForAttempt`, `releaseSlot`, `ensureIntegrationWorktree`, `fastForwardIntegrationWorktree`, `repairWorktreesAfterMove`, `pruneStaleWorktrees`)

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Implement Short-Path Reusable Worktree Slot Pool:** Create worktrees strictly outside the project folder at `%LOCALAPPDATA%\EFHarness\wt\<project-short-id>\<slot-id>` (using compact 6-char short IDs to defeat Windows path limits!), writing an explicit `.ef-harness-slot-owner` ownership marker file so Disk Cleanup (`Task 118`) only ever touches harness-owned folders ([app-shell-and-governor.md](app-shell-and-governor.md#disk)).
- [ ] **Implement Slot Creation & Warm Slot Reuse (`acquireSlot`, `resetSlotForAttempt`):** Create new empty slot folders ONCE (exposing an `onEmptySlotCreated(slotPath)` hook so `Task 042` sets inheritable Windows ACLs on the empty folder before checkout — zero permission storms!), attach via `git worktree add --detach <path> <base-commit>` + attempt branch creation `harness/t/<task>/<attempt>`, and on reuse reset via `git checkout --force --detach <newBase>` + `git clean -fd` **preserving ignored `node_modules` when lockfile hash matches** (keeping dependencies warm across attempts while wiping untracked build/temp output!).
- [ ] **Implement Persistent Integration Worktree (`ensureIntegrationWorktree`, `fastForwardIntegrationWorktree`):** Maintain ONE dedicated persistent worktree `wt\<project>\integration` checked out at `harness/integration` (deep-review Fix #19 in [architecture-deep-review.md](architecture-deep-review.md)). ONLY the project merge queue holding the integration lease may fast-forward it (`git checkout --detach <newSha>`) after CAS ref update, emitting an event so the App Preview (`Task 160`) restarts cleanly; workers and merge-candidate builds NEVER execute in this worktree!
- [ ] **Implement Dedicated Fresh Merge Worktrees:** Provide `acquireMergeWorktree(baseCommit)` for `feature-integrator@1` and `project-integrator@1` conflict resolution and combined verification so integration testing never disturbs the live App Preview worktree.
- [ ] **Implement Non-Secret Allowlisted Local Config Copy & Ignored-File Handling:** Read the project's environment manifest to copy ONLY explicitly allowlisted non-secret local config files into a new worktree, while strictly REFUSING to copy `.env*` or vault secrets (secrets enter ONLY via runtime env vars!).
- [ ] **Support Submodules, Git LFS & Sparse-Checkout Cone Mode:** Detect `.gitmodules` and run `git submodule update --init --reference <mainRepo>` reusing local objects; detect `.gitattributes` `filter=lfs` and fetch ONLY LFS objects matching the task's paths; for large monorepos declaring sparse paths in the brief, run `git sparse-checkout init --cone` + `git sparse-checkout set <readSet + sharedPackages>` ([workspace-and-git.md](workspace-and-git.md#worktrees)).
- [ ] **Implement Missing-Worktree Recovery & Repo Relocation (`repairWorktreesAfterMove`):** If the developer manually deletes a worktree folder, detect missing path, report fence-and-recreate from the attempt's latest checkpoint ref; if the developer moves the main repo or data folder, execute `git worktree repair` cleanly and verify all slot links recover!
- [ ] **Implement Single Disk-Lane Serialization & Retention Policy:** Serialize cold worktree creation / heavy resets through a 1-wide disk-lane mutex (`execution-capacity.md`) to prevent disk queue thrashing; keep failed attempt slots 24 h for inspection before recycling, while recycling merged attempt slots immediately after `git worktree prune`.

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **Running dev server or file watcher locking files inside a slot during reset/remove on Windows:** Require caller-provided `beforeSlotReset(slotPath)` hook (stopping the attempt's Job Object in `Task 040` first!) and retry transient `EBUSY`/`EPERM` with exponential backoff before failing cleanly.
- **Lockfile changed between previous attempt and new attempt reusing the same warm slot:** Compare SHA-256 of lockfile (`pnpm-lock.yaml`, `package-lock.json`, `yarn.lock`) at `oldBase` vs `newBase`; if identical, preserve warm read-only `node_modules`; if changed, wipe `node_modules` and trigger kernel dependency sync (`Task 046`)!
- **Developer deletes `wt\<project>\<slot>` manually via Explorer while app is closed:** Startup reconciliation detects missing directory, runs `git worktree prune`, recreates slot cleanly from `refs/harness/checkpoints/<task>/<n>`, and never crashes with `ENOENT`.
- **Two parallel tasks trying to check out the exact same branch name (`harness/f/F12`):** Git forbids two worktrees checking out the same branch simultaneously; ALWAYS check out detached commits (`git worktree add --detach`) or unique per-attempt branches (`harness/t/<task>/<attempt>`).
- **Huge repository with 100,000+ files:** Measure initial `git worktree add` duration during setup; if duration exceeds threshold (e.g., 10 s), return `recommendSparseCheckout: true` and lower recommended parallelism automatically ([workspace-and-git.md](workspace-and-git.md#edge-cases)).
- **Integration worktree accidentally modified externally:** Before fast-forwarding `wt\<project>\integration`, verify `git status --porcelain` is clean (or reset cleanly since neither workers nor developers may edit it) and log an integrity warning if unexpected dirty files appeared.
- **Nested `.git` inside a submodule during `git clean -fd`:** Never run `-ffdx` blindly when preserving warm `node_modules`; use targeted exclude patterns (`-e node_modules -e .pnpm-store`) matched to the environment manifest.

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Never Copy `.env*` Or Secrets Into Worktrees Invariant:** Local-config allowlist copier explicitly rejects any path matching `.env*`, `*.pem`, `*.key`, or vault names.
- **Integration Worktree Exclusivity Invariant:** `wt\<project>\integration` is strictly read-only to workers and updated ONLY via `fastForwardIntegrationWorktree` under a valid integration lease epoch.
- **Ownership Marker Safety Invariant:** Automated cleanup NEVER deletes any directory lacking a valid `.ef-harness-slot-owner` marker matching the project ID.
- **Single Disk-Lane Invariant:** At most one cold worktree creation or heavy clean executes at once, preventing antivirus and SSD queue-depth storms.
- **Empty-Slot ACL Hook Timing Invariant:** `onEmptySlotCreated` fires strictly BEFORE `git worktree add` populates files so Windows inheritable ACEs apply in `O(1)` time.
- **Zero Branch-Checkout Collision Invariant:** Every attempt worktree uses detached `HEAD` or its unique `harness/t/<task>/<attempt>` branch.

#### Multi-Agent Harmony And Branch Isolation

- **Worktree Setup:** Create branch `task/038-worktree-slot-manager` via `node scripts/agent-worktree.mjs create 038 worktree-slot-manager`.
- **Strict Subtree Boundary:** Touch ONLY `packages/git-engine/src/worktrees/**`, `packages/git-engine/tests/worktrees/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-038.md`.
- **Parallel Safe Execution:** Disjoint from `Tasks 035–037` and `Task 039`.
- **Handoff For `Task 042` (Empty-Slot ACLs), `Task 096` (Integrator), `Task 111` (Merge Queue), `Task 160` (App Preview):** Export `WorktreeSlotManager`, `SlotHandle`, and `IntegrationWorktreeController` in `.agent-handoffs/task-038.md`.
- **Commit-Only Discipline:** Commit exclusively on `task/038-worktree-slot-manager`; **NEVER merge** into `main` or `harness/integration`.
- **Isolated Test Roots:** Every test uses a temp main repo + temp `wtRoot` inside `os.tmpdir()` and tears down all worktrees cleanly.

#### Verification, Testing And Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Run `pnpm --filter @ef-harness/git-engine test -- worktrees` verifying slot creation, `onEmptySlotCreated` timing, warm slot reuse preserving unchanged `node_modules`, and wipe when lockfile hash changes.
- [ ] Verify persistent integration worktree fast-forwards cleanly on merge-queue advance and rejects unauthorized/stale-epoch calls.
- [ ] Verify sparse-checkout cone mode limits checked-out files to declared paths on a multi-package test repo.
- [ ] Verify manual deletion recovery (delete slot folder → recreate from checkpoint ref) AND repo-relocation recovery (`fs.renameSync` main repo → `repairWorktreesAfterMove` repairs links cleanly).
- [ ] Run `pnpm --filter @ef-harness/git-engine typecheck`, `lint`, and `node scripts/verify-harmony.mjs --task 038`.
- **Acceptance:** Reusable worktree slot manager, persistent integration worktree, sparse-checkout/submodule support, and `git worktree repair` pass all tests on `task/038-worktree-slot-manager`.

### Task 039: Harness Branch & Ref Lease Manager (`ref_leases`), Worker Trailers & Atomic CAS `git update-ref`

- **Milestone & Track:** `M1 · Git Engine & Workspace Isolation`
- **Depends On:** `Task 001`, `Task 013`, `Task 035`
- **Git Worktree & Branch:** `task/039-branch-ref-leases-cas` in `../ef-wt/task-039-branch-ref-leases-cas` (commit on own branch only; **NEVER merge**)
- **Owned Write Scope (Disjoint Subtree):** `packages/git-engine/src/refs/**`, `packages/git-engine/tests/refs/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-039.md`
- **Mandatory Reference Files:** [workspace-and-git.md](workspace-and-git.md#branches-and-refs), [build-pipeline.md](build-pipeline.md#git-branches-handoffs-and-merges), [database-design.md](database-design.md), [editor-coexistence.md](editor-coexistence.md), [schema/state.sql](schema/state.sql), [research/assembly-line-pipeline.md](research/assembly-line-pipeline.md)
- **Shared Contracts Consumed / Produced:** Consumes `ProjectStateDb` (`Task 013`), `GitRunner` (`Task 035`); produces `RefLeaseManager` (`acquireRefLease`, `releaseRefLease`, `advanceRefCas`, `createSquashCommit`, `createMergeCommit`, `parseHarnessTrailers`, `findAcceptedCommitsSince`)

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Enforce Strict Harness Ref Namespace Isolation:** Validate that automated harness writes target ONLY `refs/heads/harness/integration`, `refs/heads/harness/f/<feature>`, `refs/heads/harness/t/<task>/<attempt>`, `refs/heads/harness/s/<sweep>`, `refs/harness/snapshots/*`, `refs/harness/checkpoints/*`, and `refs/heads/harness-state`; structurally forbid touching `refs/heads/main` (or developer's base branch) except through the explicit user-consented landing API (`Task 172`).
- [ ] **Implement SQLite `ref_leases` Fencing Manager (`acquireRefLease`, `renewRefLease`, `releaseRefLease`):** Manage exclusive epoch-fenced leases in `state.db.ref_leases(ref, holder, epoch, expected_sha, expires_at)` for `harness/integration`, `harness/f/*`, and `harness/s/*`, incrementing `epoch` on every succession so a stale integrator or displaced process can NEVER advance a shared branch.
- [ ] **Implement Atomic Compare-And-Swap Ref Advancement (`advanceRefCas`):** Verify inside `state.db` that `(ref, holder, epoch)` is still current, then execute `git update-ref <ref> <newSha> <expectedOldSha>` (Git's atomic compare-and-swap!) and update `ref_leases.expected_sha = newSha` in SQLite; if Git rejects because the ref moved concurrently, return `{ ok: false, reason: 'cas_mismatch', actualSha }` cleanly so the merge queue retries from the new head ([build-pipeline.md](build-pipeline.md#feature--integration-project-merge-queue)).
- [ ] **Implement Standardized Harness Commit Attribution & Trailers (`createSquashCommit`, `createMergeCommit`):** Create commits with exact authorship from [workspace-and-git.md](workspace-and-git.md#branches-and-refs): author `<role> <agent-id> <agent-id@harness.local>` (e.g., `Worker A0014 <A0014@harness.local>`), committer = the developer's configured Git identity (preserving human author verbatim for "I fixed it myself" commits!), plus structured trailers `Harness-Feature: <F>`, `Harness-Task: <T>`, `Harness-Attempt: <N>`, and `Harness-Checks: <receipt-or-ids>`.
- [ ] **Implement Intentional Squash vs Non-FF Merge Semantics ([architecture-deep-review.md](architecture-deep-review.md#not-changed-on-purpose)):** Support single-commit squash for `leaf → harness/f/<feature>` (so any individual task can be reverted cleanly on a feature branch) AND explicit `--no-ff` merge commit for `harness/f/<feature> → harness/integration` (so an entire feature can be reverted in one step via `git revert -m 1`!).
- [ ] **Implement Trailer Parser & Recovery Scanner (`parseHarnessTrailers`, `findAcceptedCommitsSince`):** Parse `Harness-Feature`, `Harness-Task`, `Harness-Attempt`, and `Harness-Checks` trailers from Git log ranges (`<backupSha>..harness/integration`) to power Step 3 of `CorruptionRecoveryEngine` (`Task 016`).
- [ ] **Implement Safe Branch Deletion & Orphan Protection:** Delete merged `harness/t/*` attempt branches only after retention period and `MERGED_TO_FEATURE`, never force-deleting unmerged human-exported `wip/*` branches.
- [ ] **Verify Identity Fallback When Developer Has No Global `user.name`/`user.email`:** Detect missing committer identity upfront and fail with structured `MissingGitIdentityError` prompting the one-time setup form ([workspace-and-git.md](workspace-and-git.md#folder-states-and-what-the-user-sees)).

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **`harness/integration` advances externally (e.g., base sync merged developer's commit on `main`) while merge queue tests a candidate:** `git update-ref refs/heads/harness/integration <new> <old>` atomically fails (`cas_mismatch`); `advanceRefCas` never overwrites the intervening commit and returns exact `actualSha` for re-merge!
- **Stale integrator with `epoch = 2` attempts `advanceRefCas` after successor took `epoch = 3`:** Rejected immediately in SQLite before calling Git, guaranteeing zero split-brain branch updates.
- **Creating a brand-new branch (`expectedOldSha = '0000000000000000000000000000000000000000'`):** `git update-ref` zero-OID guard guarantees creation fails cleanly if the branch already exists!
- **Commit message body already contains lines looking like trailers or special characters (`"`, `$`, `%`):** Pass commit messages via stdin (`-F -`) using `git commit-tree` / `git commit` so special characters never break Windows argument quoting, and format trailers via `git interpret-trailers` conventions.
- **Human-fixed task ("I fixed it myself"):** MUST preserve the developer as Git `author` (`GIT_AUTHOR_NAME` / `GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL`) while still appending `Harness-Task` and `Harness-Checks` trailers!
- **Crash AFTER `git update-ref` succeeded but BEFORE `ref_leases.expected_sha` updated in SQLite:** On startup reconciliation, compare Git's actual ref SHA against `ref_leases.expected_sha` and check trailers to reconcile idempotently without re-merging the same commit twice.
- **Attempting to pass `refs/heads/main` into `advanceRefCas`:** Hard-refused by namespace guard unless explicit `LandingAuthorization` token is presented.

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Compare-And-Swap Ref Update Invariant:** Every shared branch update (`harness/integration`, `harness/f/*`, `harness/s/*`) MUST use 3-argument `git update-ref <ref> <new> <expectedOld>` — NEVER blind `git branch -f` or `git push --force`.
- **Epoch-Fenced Write Authority Invariant:** Zero Git ref mutations occur unless `ref_leases` verifies `(ref, holder, epoch)` is active and unexpired.
- **Namespace Protection Invariant:** Automated harness operations can NEVER mutate `refs/heads/main` or non-`harness/*` branches.
- **Squash-vs-Merge Commit Topology Invariant:** Task→Feature ALWAYS squashes to 1 commit per task; Feature→Integration ALWAYS creates a 2-parent merge commit.
- **Structured Trailer Integrity Invariant:** Every accepted harness commit carries parseable `Harness-Feature`, `Harness-Task`, and `Harness-Checks` trailers for audit and corruption replay.
- **Zero Shell-Escaping Bugs Invariant:** All commit messages flow via stdin (`-F -`) with `shell: false`.

#### Multi-Agent Harmony And Branch Isolation

- **Worktree Setup:** Create branch `task/039-branch-ref-leases-cas` via `node scripts/agent-worktree.mjs create 039 branch-ref-leases-cas`.
- **Strict Subtree Boundary:** Touch ONLY `packages/git-engine/src/refs/**`, `packages/git-engine/tests/refs/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-039.md`.
- **Parallel Safe Execution:** Disjoint from `Tasks 035–038` and `Tasks 040–047`.
- **Handoff For `Task 016` (Recovery Replay), `Task 096` (Feature Integrator), `Task 111` (Merge Queue), `Task 129` (Undo):** Export `RefLeaseManager`, `HarnessCommitTrailers`, and `findAcceptedCommitsSince` in `.agent-handoffs/task-039.md`.
- **Commit-Only Discipline:** Commit exclusively on `task/039-branch-ref-leases-cas`; **NEVER merge** into `main` or `harness/integration`.
- **Isolated Test Repos:** All ref-lease and CAS race tests run against temp Git repos + temp `state.db` instances.

#### Verification, Testing And Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Run `pnpm --filter @ef-harness/git-engine test -- refs` verifying `ref_leases` acquisition, epoch fencing on stale holder, and atomic CAS `advanceRefCas` rejection when ref moves concurrently.
- [ ] Verify namespace guard hard-blocks `refs/heads/main` mutations without landing authorization.
- [ ] Verify squash commits (1 parent) for leaf→feature and merge commits (2 parents) for feature→integration, with exact author/committer attribution and parseable `Harness-*` trailers.
- [ ] Verify `findAcceptedCommitsSince` accurately reconstructs task IDs and check receipts from commit history for `Task 016` recovery.
- [ ] Run `pnpm --filter @ef-harness/git-engine typecheck`, `lint`, and `node scripts/verify-harmony.mjs --task 039`.
- **Acceptance:** Epoch-fenced ref lease manager, atomic CAS `git update-ref`, standardized squash/merge commit builders, and trailer recovery scanner pass all tests on `task/039-branch-ref-leases-cas`.

### Task 040: Windows Job Object Manager (Nested Per-Command & Per-Environment Jobs, Resource Caps & Safe PID+StartTime Startup Sweep)

- **Milestone & Track:** `M1 · Windows Sandbox & Security Boundaries`
- **Depends On:** `Task 001`, `Task 003`, `Task 011`, `Task 013`
- **Git Worktree & Branch:** `task/040-windows-job-objects` in `../ef-wt/task-040-windows-job-objects` (commit on own branch only; **NEVER merge**)
- **Owned Write Scope (Disjoint Subtree):** `packages/sandbox/src/job-objects/**`, `packages/sandbox/tests/job-objects/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-040.md`
- **Mandatory Reference Files:** [sandbox-and-security.md](sandbox-and-security.md#one-execution-path), [test-environments.md](test-environments.md#process-supervision-and-cleanup), [app-shell-and-governor.md](app-shell-and-governor.md#hardware-governor), [coordinator-and-recovery.md](coordinator-and-recovery.md#effects-and-restart), [schema/state.sql](schema/state.sql), [research/windows-sandboxing.md](research/windows-sandboxing.md), [research/test-environments-on-windows.md](research/test-environments-on-windows.md), [sandbox-and-security.svg](sandbox-and-security.svg)
- **Shared Contracts Consumed / Produced:** Consumes `ProjectStateDb` (`Task 013`), `StructuredLogger` (`Task 011`); produces `WindowsJobManager` (`createJob`, `assignProcess`, `queryJobAccounting`, `terminateJob`, `reconcileOrphanedProcesses`) and `ProcessIdentityVerifier`

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Implement Native Windows Job Object Controller (`WindowsJobManager`):** Create Windows Job Objects configured with `JOB_OBJECT_LIMIT_KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE`, `JOB_OBJECT_LIMIT_JOB_MEMORY` (configurable commit limit), `JOB_OBJECT_LIMIT_ACTIVE_PROCESS` (process-count cap defeating fork bombs), CPU rate-control cap where configured, and `JOB_OBJECT_UILIMIT_HANDLES` / UI restrictions preventing sandboxed processes from sending input to developer windows ([sandbox-and-security.md](sandbox-and-security.md#common-rules-in-every-tier)).
- [ ] **Support Nested Job Hierarchy (Windows 8+/10/11 Nested Jobs):** Support (1) Project Service Job (Postgres, Mailpit, OAuth mock — dies if `harnessd` dies), (2) Environment Job nested under project (dev server + per-env services — dies on `env.destroy()`), (3) Attempt Job (attempt processes), and (4) Per-Command Nested Job for every `harness.run` invocation (closes immediately when the command's main process exits, killing every leftover grandchild watcher or hung dev server!) ([sandbox-and-security.md](sandbox-and-security.md#harnessrun)).
- [ ] **Implement Suspended-Start Race-Free Assignment:** Spawn child processes in suspended state (or assign immediately before child spawns grandchildren) and attach them to their Job Object before resuming, closing the classic fork-before-assign escape race!
- [ ] **Implement Per-Job Resource Accounting (`queryJobAccounting`):** Query Win32 `QueryInformationJobObject` (`JobObjectBasicAccountingInformation` + `JobObjectExtendedLimitInformation` peak/current memory & CPU user/kernel time) so the Hardware Governor (`Task 117`) gets exact per-attempt and per-environment RAM/CPU footprints.
- [ ] **Implement `env_processes` Registry Synchronization:** Record `(pid, start_time, environment, role, port, job_name)` inside `state.db.env_processes` atomically on process spawn and remove on clean teardown.
- [ ] **Implement Positive-Identity Startup Orphan Sweep (`reconcileOrphanedProcesses`):** On `harnessd` startup after a hard crash, iterate `state.db.env_processes`, query the live OS process's EXACT creation timestamp (`GetProcessTimes` / WMI / Win32 API) and executable/command metadata, and terminate ONLY processes whose `(pid, start_time)` matches positively; if `pid` was reused by an unrelated process OR ownership cannot be positively established, **leave the process untouched and log a warning** ([coordinator-and-recovery.md](coordinator-and-recovery.md#effects-and-restart), [test-environments.md](test-environments.md#process-supervision-and-cleanup))!
- [ ] **Implement Wall-Clock Command & Attempt Timeout Enforcer:** Attach monotonic wall-clock timers to every Job Object so a hung test runner or infinite loop is terminated cleanly with `reason: 'timeout'`, capturing final accounting and partial stdout/stderr.
- [ ] **Provide Portable POSIX Process-Group Fallback Adapter:** Implement a clean interface fallback (`detached: true` + `-pgid` kill) so unit tests and future Linux/macOS targets satisfy the same `ProcessSupervisor` contract cleanly.

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **Child process spawns a detached grandchild (`cmd /c start /b node sleeper.js`) then exits immediately:** Nested per-command Job Object closes upon main process exit (`JOB_OBJECT_LIMIT_KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE` + `TerminateJobObject`), killing the detached grandchild within milliseconds!
- **Fork bomb inside a buggy worker test (`while(true) spawn()`):** `JOB_OBJECT_LIMIT_ACTIVE_PROCESS` (e.g., 64 processes max) stops process creation in kernel space immediately before Windows runs out of PIDs or freezes the desktop.
- **PID reuse after hard reboot or crash:** `env_processes` recorded `pid = 4812, start_time = 1700000100000`; on reboot `pid = 4812` is now `explorer.exe` with `start_time = 1700009000000`. `reconcileOrphanedProcesses` MUST detect the `start_time` mismatch, refuse to kill `4812`, remove the stale DB row, and log safe skip!
- **Process exits with `0` while memory limit was hit on a worker child:** Capture Job Object completion-port / accounting notification (`PeakJobMemoryUsed >= JobMemoryLimit`) so OOM kills are reported accurately as `'memory_limit_exceeded'` rather than mysterious exit code `1`.
- **Nested Job limit weaker than parent Job limit:** Windows enforces the stricter of parent and child Job limits; validate limit configs so child requests never silently fail with `ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED`.
- **Job handle leaked across 1,000 sequential `harness.run` calls:** Explicitly close every Win32 Job Object handle in `finally` and verify handle count remains flat over 200 rapid spawn/terminate cycles!
- **Antivirus delaying child process termination by 200 ms:** Await full job exit confirmation (`ActiveProcesses === 0`) with a short bounded poll before releasing the worktree slot for `git clean` (`Task 038`)!

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Kill-On-Close Structural Guarantee Invariant:** Every Job Object created by `WindowsJobManager` MUST set `JOB_OBJECT_LIMIT_KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE`, guaranteeing zero orphaned processes even if `harnessd` is killed with `Task Manager` / `SIGKILL`.
- **Positive-Identity-Before-Kill Invariant:** Startup sweep NEVER kills a PID without matching BOTH `pid` AND OS `start_time` (plus harness ownership record); when unsure, leave intact and report!
- **Active-Process Ceiling Invariant:** Every attempt/command Job sets an explicit finite `ActiveProcessLimit` and `JobMemoryLimit`.
- **Nested Per-Command Cleanup Invariant:** Every `harness.run` closes its nested command Job on command completion; long-running servers MUST use `harness.start_service` attached to the Environment Job instead.
- **Zero Handle Leak Invariant:** All native Win32 Job handles are deterministically closed in `finally` and on process exit.
- **Clean Accounting Separation Invariant:** `queryJobAccounting` returns structured integer bytes & CPU milliseconds for `Task 117` governor without shelling out to slow PowerShell per second.

#### Multi-Agent Harmony And Branch Isolation

- **Worktree Setup:** Create branch `task/040-windows-job-objects` via `node scripts/agent-worktree.mjs create 040 windows-job-objects`.
- **Strict Subtree Boundary:** Touch ONLY `packages/sandbox/src/job-objects/**`, `packages/sandbox/tests/job-objects/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-040.md`.
- **Parallel Safe Execution:** Disjoint from `Tasks 041–047` (sandbox tiers, proxy, doc fetcher, installer, `harness.run`).
- **Handoff For `Tasks 041–043`, `Task 047`, `Tasks 049–050`, `Task 117`:** Export `WindowsJobManager`, `JobHandle`, `JobLimits`, `JobAccounting`, and `reconcileOrphanedProcesses` in `.agent-handoffs/task-040.md`.
- **Commit-Only Discipline:** Commit exclusively on `task/040-windows-job-objects`; **NEVER merge** into `main` or `harness/integration`.
- **Spike Alignment:** Reuse verified Win32 / native helper approach settled in `Task 003` and `Task 005`.

#### Verification, Testing And Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Run `pnpm --filter @ef-harness/sandbox test -- job-objects` spawning a multi-level process tree (parent → child → detached grandchild), closing the Job Object, and asserting 0 surviving descendants.
- [ ] Verify fork-bomb containment test (`ActiveProcessLimit = 8`) blocks excess spawns cleanly without destabilizing host.
- [ ] Verify memory-limit test and wall-clock timeout test terminate runaway child cleanly with exact reason (`memory_limit_exceeded`, `timeout`) and accurate `queryJobAccounting` numbers.
- [ ] Verify `reconcileOrphanedProcesses` kills a genuine orphaned test child matching `(pid, start_time)` while refusing to touch a mismatched-`start_time` live process!
- [ ] Run `pnpm --filter @ef-harness/sandbox typecheck`, `lint`, and `node scripts/verify-harmony.mjs --task 040`.
- **Acceptance:** Nested Windows Job Object manager, resource accounting, and positive-identity startup orphan sweep pass 100% of reliability and crash-cleanup tests on `task/040-windows-job-objects`.

### Task 041: Windows Sandbox Launcher — Tier A (Microsoft Execution Containers / MXC) Policy Engine & Execution Wrapper

- **Milestone & Track:** `M1 · Windows Sandbox & Security Boundaries`
- **Depends On:** `Task 001`, `Task 003`, `Task 011`, `Task 040`
- **Git Worktree & Branch:** `task/041-sandbox-tier-a-mxc` in `../ef-wt/task-041-sandbox-tier-a-mxc` (commit on own branch only; **NEVER merge**)

- **Mandatory Reference Files:** [sandbox-and-security.md](sandbox-and-security.md#the-windows-sandbox-in-tiers), [execution-capacity.md](execution-capacity.md), [agent-runtime-adapters.md](agent-runtime-adapters.md), [research/windows-sandboxing.md](research/windows-sandboxing.md), [research/sandbox-capacity-on-windows.md](research/sandbox-capacity-on-windows.md), [sandbox-and-security.svg](sandbox-and-security.svg)
- **Shared Contracts Consumed / Produced:** Consumes `WindowsJobManager` (`Task 040`), spike verdict from `Task 003`; produces `TierAMxcProvider` implementing the common `SandboxTierProvider` interface (probe, policy compile, warm instance pool binding, wrapped & per-command execution)

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Define the Shared `SandboxTierProvider` Interface & Capability Descriptor:** Standardize `tier: 'A' | 'B' | 'C' | 'D'`, `probe(): Promise<TierProbeResult>`, `acquireWarmInstance(spec)`, `executeCommand(instance, cmdSpec)`, `spawnWrappedProcess(spec)`, `disposeInstance(instance)`, and truthful capability flags (`fileWritesEnforced`, `secretReadsDenied`, `networkEnforced`, `requiresAdmin`).
- [ ] **Implement Tier A MXC Availability Prober (`probeMxcAvailability`):** Detect Windows 11 24H2 (`>= 26100.9278`) and 25H2 (`>= 26200.9278`) builds with MXC runtime support without requiring elevation, returning structured `{ available, osBuild, reason, policyBasedGrants }`.
- [ ] **Implement Tier A Policy Compiler (`compileMxcPolicy`):** Generate exact declarative MXC filesystem + network rules matching [sandbox-and-security.md](sandbox-and-security.md#common-rules-in-every-tier):
  - **Writable:** ONLY the attempt worktree (excluding `.git` internals!), attempt temp dir, and attempt build output dir.
  - **Read-only:** toolchains, shared pnpm package store (`node_modules` strictly read-only!), worktree `.git` objects, and (in Gemini CLI wrapped mode ONLY per [sandbox-and-security.md](sandbox-and-security.md#foreign-agents-native-tools-or-ours)) the single exact vendor login folder in place!
  - **Denied (read):** `%USERPROFILE%\.ssh`, `.aws`, `.azure`, `.gnupg`, `.npmrc`, browser profiles, `%APPDATA%` credential stores, `%LOCALAPPDATA%\EFHarness` harness data folder, other worktrees, and the developer's checkout!
  - **Denied (write):** `.git/**` internals (only kernel commits!).
  - **Network:** Blocked at OS level; loopback allowed ONLY to the attempt's harness MCP port and loopback allowlisting proxy (`Task 044`).
- [ ] **Integrate Codex Open-Source Windows Sandbox Reusable Core Or Native MXC Launcher (per `Task 003` verdict):** Wire the exact verified MXC execution path chosen in `Task 003`, combining MXC isolation with `WindowsJobManager` (`Task 040`) and scrubbed environment variables (`HOME`, `USERPROFILE`, `TEMP`, `TMP`, `XDG_CACHE_HOME` redirected inside attempt temp folder; zero `GH_TOKEN`, provider keys, or personal env vars!).
- [ ] **Implement Warm MXC Pool Instance Reuse:** Support rebinding a warm Tier A execution instance cleanly across sequential commands from different worktrees while wiping temp folders between commands and ensuring zero cross-attempt residue ([execution-capacity.md](execution-capacity.md#the-execution-pool)).
- [ ] **Support Both Per-Command Mode (`harness.run`) & Wrapped Foreign-Agent Mode:** In wrapped mode, run the entire vendor CLI process tree inside Tier A MXC with network restricted strictly to the vendor's provider API domains via the loopback proxy + harness MCP loopback, inheriting OS file/secret boundaries across all vendor tools and subagents!
- [ ] **Handle MXC Deny-Read Start-Time Globs & Foreground-Exit Child Semantics:** Account explicitly for the two documented MXC nuances in [research/windows-sandboxing.md](research/windows-sandboxing.md): evaluate and freeze all deny-read globs strictly at process start, and keep detached long-running dev servers managed explicitly through the environment orchestrator (`Task 049`) rather than expecting background survival past a `harness.run` exit.
- [ ] **Emit Sandbox Denial Audit Events:** Capture OS-level access-denied events and structured launch latency (`p50`/`p95`) to `StructuredLogger` and the Governor (`Task 117`).

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **Running on Windows 10 or pre-26100.9278 Windows 11:** `probeMxcAvailability()` returns `{ available: false, reason: 'os_build_too_old' }` cleanly in `< 5 ms` so the launcher immediately falls through to Tier B (`Task 042`).
- **Attempt worktree path contains spaces, Unicode, or `..` traversal attempts:** Canonicalize and resolve all paths with `path.resolve` BEFORE compiling MXC policy rules, rejecting any path containing `..` escapes or matching the developer checkout or `%LOCALAPPDATA%\EFHarness\projects\`.
- **Sandboxed worker attempts to write to a hard-linked file inside `node_modules`:** MXC read-only rule on `node_modules` and the pnpm store MUST return `EACCES`/`EPERM`, preventing cross-worktree store corruption ([execution-capacity.md](execution-capacity.md#no-permission-or-antivirus-storms)).
- **Worker attempts to tamper with `.git/config`, `.git/HEAD`, or `.git/hooks/`:** Denied-write rule on `.git` internals MUST block all mutations even though `.git` lies inside or linked from the worktree!
- **Tool cache writes (`eslint`, `vitest`, `turbo`, `playwright`, `npm_config_cache`) failing because `node_modules` is read-only:** Redirect `TMPDIR`, `TEMP`, `TMP`, `npm_config_cache`, `XDG_CACHE_HOME`, and tool cache envs into the writable attempt temp folder automatically!
- **Vendor agent in wrapped mode needing its provider API token (e.g., Codex `ACCESS_TOKEN`, `CURSOR_API_KEY`, Claude Console `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`):** Inject ONLY that single scoped token into the wrapped process env while network allowlist restricts outbound traffic exclusively to that provider's host!
- **Mocked unit-test execution on non-MXC CI runners:** Separate pure policy-compilation & validation tests (running on EVERY machine) from live MXC kernel execution tests (auto-executed when `probeMxcAvailability().available === true`, explicitly reported otherwise — NEVER silently faked as passing!).

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Policy-First Scrubbed-Env Invariant:** Every process launched by `TierAMxcProvider` receives an explicit allowlisted environment map—NEVER `{ ...process.env }`!
- **Zero `.git` Write Invariant:** `.git` internals (and linked `.gitdir` in the main repo!) are strictly read-only to all sandboxed workers.
- **Zero Harness-Data Read Invariant:** `%LOCALAPPDATA%\EFHarness\` (`state.db`, `global.db`, held-back tests, vault metadata, other worktrees) is unconditionally in the deny-read policy list.
- **Zero Direct Internet Invariant:** Coding worker commands get zero non-loopback network egress; wrapped vendor processes reach ONLY their provider domain through the allowlisting proxy.
- **Zero Silent Downgrade Invariant:** If Tier A fails to start on an MXC-capable machine, surface an explicit error rather than silently running unsandboxed!
- **Honest Test Reporting Invariant:** If host lacks MXC build, live MXC execution tests report `skipped_env_no_mxc` transparently and never claim OS enforcement passed without running.

#### Multi-Agent Harmony And Branch Isolation

- **Worktree Setup:** Create branch `task/041-sandbox-tier-a-mxc` via `node scripts/agent-worktree.mjs create 041 sandbox-tier-a-mxc`.
- **Strict Subtree Boundary:** Touch ONLY `packages/sandbox/src/tier-a-mxc/**`, `packages/sandbox/tests/tier-a-mxc/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-041.md`.
- **Parallel Safe Execution:** Disjoint from `Task 040` (Job Objects), `Task 042` (Tier B), `Task 043` (Tier C/D), and `Tasks 044–047`.
- **Handoff For `Task 042`, `Task 043`, `Task 047`, `Task 119`:** Export `SandboxTierProvider`, `SandboxLaunchSpec`, `TierAMxcProvider`, and `compileMxcPolicy` in `.agent-handoffs/task-041.md`.
- **Commit-Only Discipline:** Commit exclusively on `task/041-sandbox-tier-a-mxc`; **NEVER merge** into `main` or `harness/integration`.
- **No Unapproved Native Build Edits:** If `Task 003` recommended a Rust/Codex helper binary, reference its pinned manifest path rather than modifying root `package.json`.

- [ ] Verify `probeMxcAvailability` accurately parses Windows build numbers (`26100.9277` → false, `26100.9278` → true, `26200.9278` → true, Windows 10 → false).

### Task 042: Windows Sandbox Launcher — Tier B (Offline/Online Sandbox Users, Empty-Slot Inheritable ACLs & Loopback Firewall Rules)

- **Milestone & Track:** `M1 · Windows Sandbox & Security Boundaries`
- **Depends On:** `Task 001`, `Task 003`, `Task 011`, `Task 038`, `Task 040`, `Task 041`
- **Git Worktree & Branch:** `task/042-sandbox-tier-b-users` in `../ef-wt/task-042-sandbox-tier-b-users` (commit on own branch only; **NEVER merge**)
- **Owned Write Scope (Disjoint Subtree):** `packages/sandbox/src/tier-b-users/**`, `packages/sandbox/tests/tier-b-users/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-042.md`
- **Mandatory Reference Files:** [sandbox-and-security.md](sandbox-and-security.md#the-windows-sandbox-in-tiers), [execution-capacity.md](execution-capacity.md#no-permission-or-antivirus-storms), [research/windows-sandboxing.md](research/windows-sandboxing.md), [research/sandbox-capacity-on-windows.md](research/sandbox-capacity-on-windows.md), [sandbox-and-security.svg](sandbox-and-security.svg)
- **Shared Contracts Consumed / Produced:** Consumes `SandboxTierProvider` (`Task 041`), `WindowsJobManager` (`Task 040`), `onEmptySlotCreated` hook (`Task 038`); produces `TierBSandboxUsersProvider`, `TierBAdminProvisioner`, and `EmptySlotAclManager`

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Implement One-Time Consented Admin Provisioner (`TierBAdminProvisioner`):** Generate and execute (ONLY upon explicit user UAC admin consent during Settings → Sandbox setup!) an auditable provisioning script creating two low-privilege Windows local accounts (`EFHarnessSandboxOffline` and `EFHarnessSandboxOnline` with strong random passwords kept strictly in DPAPI/LSA, zero interactive desktop logon, zero admin groups) and Windows Firewall outbound rules blocking `EFHarnessSandboxOffline` from ALL non-loopback network traffic while allowing ONLY the loopback allowlisting proxy port (`Task 044`) and harness MCP loopback!
- [ ] **Implement Tier B Capability & Health Prober (`probeTierB`):** Check (without admin elevation!) whether both local sandbox accounts exist, firewall rules are active and unmodified, and DPAPI logon credentials are valid; report exact `{ available, provisioned, firewallActive, missingComponents }` so Settings shows accurate repair steps if broken.
- [ ] **Implement O(1) Empty-Slot Inheritable ACL Manager (`EmptySlotAclManager`):** Wire into `WorktreeSlotManager`'s `onEmptySlotCreated(slotPath)` (`Task 038`) to apply ONE inheritable ACE granting the sandbox user SID modify access to the **empty** slot folder and temp folder BEFORE checkout — so every checked-out file inherits permissions at creation with ZERO recursive `icacls` storm over 50,000 files ([execution-capacity.md](execution-capacity.md#no-permission-or-antivirus-storms))!
- [ ] **Enforce Read-Only Hard-Linked pnpm Store & Denied `.git` Internals:** Apply ONE inheritable read-only (`RX`) ACE on the shared pnpm store root (so hard-linked `node_modules` cannot be mutated by sandboxed workers!), explicit DENY write on `.git/` internals, and verify that sandbox users CANNOT read `%USERPROFILE%\.ssh`, browser profiles, `%LOCALAPPDATA%\EFHarness\`, or the developer's Windows Credential Manager (DPAPI) store (inherently enforced by Windows user-profile isolation!).
- [ ] **Implement Warm Logon-Session Execution & Per-Command Job Attachment:** Maintain a small pool of warm restricted logon tokens (`LogonUser` + `CreateRestrictedToken` + `CreateProcessAsUserW` attached to a nested Job Object from `Task 040`), executing commands as `EFHarnessSandboxOffline` (coding workers) or `EFHarnessSandboxOnline` (only kernel-approved proxy/test-endpoint tasks), and wiping temp folders between commands.
- [ ] **Support Wrapped Mode vs Stripped Mode Login Semantics For Tier B:** Enforce the exact rule in [sandbox-and-security.md](sandbox-and-security.md#foreign-agents-native-tools-or-ours): in Tier B wrapped mode, run vendors that accept client-supplied tokens (`ACCESS_TOKEN`, `gitHubToken`, `CURSOR_API_KEY`, Claude Console `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`); for file-based login vendors (Gemini CLI) whose login lives in the developer's profile, NEVER weaken permissions on the developer's home folder—automatically route Gemini CLI to Mode S (stripped) on Tier B!
- [ ] **Implement Separate Window Station / Desktop Isolation Where Supported:** Launch Tier B worker processes on a non-interactive desktop/window station so sandboxed code cannot enumerate or send UI input (`SendInput`/`WM_CHAR`) to the developer's desktop windows.
- [ ] **Implement Clean De-Provisioner (`unprovisionTierB`):** Allow the developer in Settings to cleanly remove the two sandbox users, firewall rules, and vault entries in one reversible UAC-consented operation.

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **Project sits on a network drive (`\\server\share`) or FAT32 USB drive incapable of NTFS ACLs:** Detect non-NTFS/UNC volumes upfront in `probeTierBForPath(path)` and refuse Tier B with clear guidance ("Move project to local NTFS/Dev Drive, or use Tier A/D") ([sandbox-and-security.md](sandbox-and-security.md#edge-cases)).
- **Corporate Group Policy disables creating local users or alters Windows Firewall rules:** `TierBAdminProvisioner` detects exact Win32/NetUserAdd/Firewall policy error codes and falls back cleanly to Tier A/D or Tier C with a plain-English explanation.
- **Someone runs recursive ACLs on an already-populated `node_modules` directory by mistake:** Add a hard guard in `EmptySlotAclManager` asserting `fs.readdirSync(slotPath).length === 0` before applying inheritable slot ACEs, structurally preventing permission storms!
- **Two parallel attempts running under the SAME `EFHarnessSandboxOffline` user could theoretically peek at each other's worktree if both slots share the same user SID:** Restrict per-slot ACLs dynamically (or revoke inactive slot ACEs when a slot isn't actively assigned to that warm instance, or isolate by per-slot restricted-SID capability) AND verify cross-worktree read denial!
- **Antivirus or corporate EDR flagging `CreateProcessAsUserW`:** Document exact event logging and diagnostics capture so failures are transparent rather than cryptic exit codes.
- **Developer renames or moves `%LOCALAPPDATA%\EFHarness\wt\`:** Re-verify inheritable ACEs on the new root folder once during storage relocation (`Settings → Storage`).
- **Automated CI execution without UAC admin elevation:** Separate pure ACL/firewall command-plan + policy unit tests (running unprivileged everywhere!) from live elevated Tier B tests (gated by `--tier-b-live` when provisioned).

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **DPAPI Secret Isolation Invariant:** Sandbox local users structurally CANNOT decrypt the developer's Windows Credential Manager / DPAPI blobs.
- **Empty-Folder-Only ACL Invariant:** `EmptySlotAclManager` refuses to run on non-empty worktrees, guaranteeing zero recursive file-system permission storms.
- **Never Relax Developer-Home ACLs Invariant:** Tier B NEVER grants `EFHarnessSandbox*` read access to `%USERPROFILE%` (including `~/.gemini` or `~/.ssh`); file-login vendors fall back to Mode S automatically.
- **Firewall-Backed Network Enforcement Invariant:** `EFHarnessSandboxOffline` has OS-enforced firewall block against all non-loopback sockets (surviving raw `net.connect` bypasses of `HTTP_PROXY`).
- **Read-Only Store Invariant:** Shared pnpm store ACL is strictly read-and-execute (`RX`), never write, protecting hard-linked dependencies from tampering.
- **Explicit Consent Invariant:** Zero UAC prompts or local user changes ever happen silently during normal startup; provisioning runs ONLY on explicit Settings action.

#### Multi-Agent Harmony And Branch Isolation

- **Worktree Setup:** Create branch `task/042-sandbox-tier-b-users` via `node scripts/agent-worktree.mjs create 042 sandbox-tier-b-users`.
- **Strict Subtree Boundary:** Touch ONLY `packages/sandbox/src/tier-b-users/**`, `packages/sandbox/tests/tier-b-users/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-042.md`.
- **Parallel Safe Execution:** Disjoint from `Task 041` (Tier A), `Task 043` (Tier C/D), and `Tasks 044–047`.
- **Handoff For `Task 047`, `Task 119`, `Task 148` (Gemini Mode S rule):** Export `TierBSandboxUsersProvider`, `TierBAdminProvisioner`, and `EmptySlotAclManager` in `.agent-handoffs/task-042.md`.
- **Commit-Only Discipline:** Commit exclusively on `task/042-sandbox-tier-b-users`; **NEVER merge** into `main` or `harness/integration`.
- **Non-Destructive Test Hygiene:** Unit tests never create or modify real Windows user accounts or firewall rules unless explicitly opted in on an isolated test VM.
