### Task 051: Local Node OAuth/OIDC Mock Identity Provider, `stripe-mock` + Signed Webhook Deliverer & Hard-Coded Port Fallback Handler

- **Milestone & Track:** `M1 · Test Environments Without Docker`
- **Depends On:** `Task 001`, `Task 005`, `Task 040`, `Task 049`
- **Git Worktree & Branch:** `task/051-oauth-stripe-mocks-port-fallback` in `../ef-wt/task-051-oauth-stripe-mocks-port-fallback` (commit on own branch only; **NEVER merge**)
- **Owned Write Scope (Disjoint Subtree):** `packages/test-env/src/auth-payment-mocks/**`, `packages/test-env/tests/auth-payment-mocks/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-051.md`
- **Mandatory Reference Files:** [test-environments.md](test-environments.md#services-without-docker), [verification-for-real-apps.md](verification-for-real-apps.md#other-entry-points), [v1-knowledge-corpus.md](v1-knowledge-corpus.md#cross-cutting-rules-for-v1), [research/test-environments-on-windows.md](research/test-environments-on-windows.md), [research/testing-real-apps.md](research/testing-real-apps.md)
- **Shared Contracts Consumed / Produced:** Consumes `ServiceProvider` (`Task 049`), `WindowsJobManager` (`Task 040`); produces `LocalOAuthMockProvider`, `StripeMockAndWebhookProvider`, and `HardCodedPortFallbackManager`

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Implement Local Multi-Environment Node OAuth/OIDC Mock Server (`LocalOAuthMockProvider`):** Host ONE in-process/child Node OIDC server bound strictly to `127.0.0.1:<leased-port>` supporting per-environment issuer paths (`http://127.0.0.1:<port>/<envId>`), full OIDC discovery (`/.well-known/openid-configuration`), RS256 JWKS signing (`/.well-known/jwks.json`), `/authorize`, `/token`, `/userinfo`, dynamic per-environment redirect-URI registration, and seeded test identities with explicit role claims (`admin`, `manager`, `kitchen_staff`, `member`, `unauthorized`)!
- [ ] **Support Explicit Negative Auth Scenarios For Clean Verifiers ([verification-for-real-apps.md](verification-for-real-apps.md#other-entry-points)):** Provide deterministic verifier control methods to issue: (1) valid authorization code + ID/access tokens with expected claims, (2) tampered/mismatched `state` parameter, (3) expired authorization code / expired JWT, (4) invalid JWT signature, and (5) valid login with a forbidden role — enabling full `X-01` role-check and auth-callback verification with zero external Google/GitHub/Auth0 accounts!
- [ ] **Implement `StripeMockAndWebhookProvider`:** Manage `stripe-mock` (or lightweight built-in Stripe API shape emulator when binary absent) per project AND implement a **cryptographic Stripe-format webhook signer & deliverer** (`deliverSignedWebhook(envUrl, eventPayload, signingSecret, options?)`) supporting valid `Stripe-Signature: t=...,v1=<HMAC-SHA256>`, intentionally **forged signature** delivery, **replayed identical event ID** delivery (testing `X-09` idempotency!), and expired-timestamp delivery!
- [ ] **Implement Generic Inbound Webhook Signer For Non-Stripe Providers:** Support HMAC-SHA256 header signing (`X-Hub-Signature-256`, Svix/Standard Webhooks format) so ANY feature touching `inbound_webhook` can deterministically run `X-09` forged & replayed webhook verification offline!
- [ ] **Implement Hard-Coded Port Fallback Handler (`HardCodedPortFallbackManager`):** Handle brownfield apps that hard-code `localhost:3000` (flagged by `Task 049` or `Task 166`) using the exact 3-option precedence from [test-environments.md](test-environments.md#isolation): (1) recommend Phase 0 / brownfield configurability task, (2) allocate Tier D container network namespace per environment if Docker is available, or (3) acquire an **exclusive resource lease on port `3000`** inside `global.db` so environments needing port `3000` serialize cleanly one at a time while stateless tasks stay parallel!
- [ ] **Implement Exclusive External-Sandbox Account Lease:** When a separately authorized live-test task needs a single shared external test account (and cannot be replayed offline), support an exclusive resource lease preventing two environments from corrupting the same remote sandbox state ([test-environments.md](test-environments.md#edge-cases)).
- [ ] **Enforce Per-Environment OAuth State Cleanup On `env.destroy()`:** Drop all registered clients, redirect URIs, issued codes, and seeded users belonging to `<envId>` immediately when `<envId>` tears down.
- [ ] **Verify Zero Live Payment / Identity Network Traffic:** Guarantee test keys (`whsec_test_...`, mock issuer URLs) never touch production Stripe or real OAuth providers.

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **Environment 1 registers redirect URI `http://env1.localhost:41001/api/auth/callback`, Environment 2 attempts to use Env 1's authorization code:** Issuer path + client ID + `envId` namespace MUST strictly reject cross-environment code redemption with `invalid_grant`!
- **App validates OIDC `iss` claim strictly against `OAUTH_ISSUER`:** Ensure discovery document `issuer`, `authorization_endpoint`, `token_endpoint`, `jwks_uri`, and JWT `iss` claim ALL match `http://127.0.0.1:<port>/<envId>` (or `http://env<id>.localhost:<port>/<envId>`) consistently!
- **Clock skew or injectable fake clock in time-sensitive JWT expiry tests:** Allow `LocalOAuthMockProvider` to accept explicit `iat`/`exp` overrides so verifiers testing expired sessions execute in 10 ms without sleeping 60 seconds!
- **Webhook replay test sends identical `evt_123` twice concurrently (`Promise.all`):** Support both sequential and simultaneous duplicate webhook delivery to catch non-atomic idempotency race conditions (`X-09`)!
- **Two projects both have brownfield apps hard-coding port `3000`:** Exclusive port `3000` lease lives machine-wide via the global broker so Project A and Project B serialize cleanly instead of failing with `EADDRINUSE`!
- **App inspects `jwks_uri` dynamically during middleware cold start:** Generate ephemeral RSA-2048 keypair once on mock startup (fast, cached in memory) and serve valid standard `kid` + `n` + `e` JWK format compatible with `jose`, `jsonwebtoken`, `NextAuth`/`Auth.js`, and `openid-client`.
- **Redirect URI contains query parameters or trailing slashes:** Enforce exact RFC 6749 redirect URI matching (rejecting open-redirect tampering!).

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Per-Environment OIDC Isolation Invariant:** Codes, tokens, users, and redirect URIs issued under `/<env1>` are 100% invalid under `/<env2>`.
- **Real Cryptographic Signing Invariant:** OAuth mock signs real RS256 JWTs verifiable by standard libraries (never `alg: "none"` hacks!), and webhook deliverer computes real HMAC-SHA256 signatures matching Stripe/Standard-Webhooks specs.
- **Negative-Case First-Class Invariant:** Every auth and webhook mock natively supports bad state, expired code, wrong role, forged signature, and replay attacks.
- **Loopback-Only Bind Invariant:** Mock OIDC and webhook servers bind exclusively to `127.0.0.1`.
- **Clean Hard-Coded Port Serialization Invariant:** Exclusive port leases never deadlock and release automatically on Job termination or `env.destroy()`.
- **Zero Hardcoded Real Credentials Invariant:** All signing keys and test webhook secrets (`whsec_test_mock_...`) are ephemerally generated per test server instance.

#### Multi-Agent Harmony And Branch Isolation

- **Worktree Setup:** Create branch `task/051-oauth-stripe-mocks-port-fallback` via `node scripts/agent-worktree.mjs create 051 oauth-stripe-mocks-port-fallback`.
- **Strict Subtree Boundary:** Touch ONLY `packages/test-env/src/auth-payment-mocks/**`, `packages/test-env/tests/auth-payment-mocks/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-051.md`.
- **Parallel Safe Execution:** Disjoint from `Tasks 049–050` and `Task 052`.
- **Handoff For `Task 063` (Auth & API Verifiers), `Task 077` (`X-01`/`X-09` Rule Checks), `Task 170` (Brownfield Baseline):** Export `LocalOAuthMockProvider`, `StripeMockAndWebhookProvider`, `GenericWebhookDeliverer`, and `HardCodedPortFallbackManager` in `.agent-handoffs/task-051.md`.
- **Commit-Only Discipline:** Commit exclusively on `task/051-oauth-stripe-mocks-port-fallback`; **NEVER merge** into `main` or `harness/integration`.
- **Zero External Account Dependencies:** 100% self-contained Node crypto/HTTP tests.

### Task 052: Pre-Seeded Template Database Builder & Deterministic Code-Generated Synthetic Data Engine

- **Milestone & Track:** `M1 · Test Environments Without Docker`
- **Depends On:** `Task 001`, `Task 007`, `Task 049`, `Task 050`
- **Git Worktree & Branch:** `task/052-template-db-synthetic-data` in `../ef-wt/task-052-template-db-synthetic-data` (commit on own branch only; **NEVER merge**)
- **Owned Write Scope (Disjoint Subtree):** `packages/test-env/src/synthetic-data/**`, `packages/test-env/tests/synthetic-data/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-052.md`
- **Mandatory Reference Files:** [test-environments.md](test-environments.md#templates-and-fast-clones), [verification-for-real-apps.md](verification-for-real-apps.md#database-migrations-preserving-data), [planning-and-crew.md](planning-and-crew.md#shared-foundations-phase-0), [research/test-environments-on-windows.md](research/test-environments-on-windows.md)
- **Shared Contracts Consumed / Produced:** Consumes `EmbeddedPostgresProvider`/`SqliteEnvProvider` (`Task 050`), `@faker-js/faker`; produces `TemplateDatabaseManager` (`ensureTemplate`, `cloneFromTemplate`, `pruneOldTemplates`) and `SyntheticDataGenerator` (`generateDataset`, `generateMigrationPredecessorFixture`)

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Implement Deterministic Schema-Driven Synthetic Data Engine (`SyntheticDataGenerator` — Zero LLM Tokens!):** Parse target project schema metadata (tables, columns, types, nullability, check/unique/FK constraints) and generate reproducible datasets from an integer seed using `@faker-js/faker` + configured discovery locale:
  1. **Topological FK Order:** Topologically sort tables by foreign keys; automatically break circular FKs by inserting `NULL` on the nullable cycle edge in pass 1 and issuing `UPDATE` in pass 2 ([test-environments.md](test-environments.md#synthetic-data)).
  2. **Typed Column Generators & Optional Domain Vocabularies:** Map column types/hints (`email`, `money_minor_units`, `timestamp_utc`, `dish_name` from optional planner vocabularies) deterministically without spending a single LLM token on rows!
  3. **Spec-Derived Edge-Case Injection:** Automatically synthesize rows exercising EVERY boundary named in the spec: max-length strings, Unicode/emoji (`🍜`, `Ümlaut`), right-to-left Arabic/Hebrew text, timestamps 1 second before/at/after cutoff and across DST transitions, 0/1/many children, soft-deleted records, and empty nullable fields!
  4. **Functional vs Performance Seed Profiles:** Default `functional` seed (tens of rows per table covering every edge case once → `<1 s` clone); separate `performance` seed (`10,000+` rows with Zipfian/Pareto realistic heavy-user vs light-user distributions, loaded via bulk `COPY` / batched multi-row `INSERT` in seconds) used ONLY for performance checks!
- [ ] **Implement Template Database Builder & Fast Cloner (`TemplateDatabaseManager`):** Compute `templateKey = sha256(migrationsHash + ':' + seedRecipeHash + ':' + profile)`; build `tpl_<shortHash>` ONCE asynchronously in the background (while workers code!) inside the single disk lane, apply migrations + bulk seed, lock template (`datallowconn = false` on Postgres, read-only file on SQLite), and serve every `env.create` via instant `CREATE DATABASE env_<id> TEMPLATE tpl_<shortHash>` (or fast SQLite file copy)!
- [ ] **Implement Predecessor-Schema Fixture Builder For Migration Checks (`generateMigrationPredecessorFixture`):** Given a previous Git commit's schema (`Task 063`), generate a populated fixture database at the **previous** schema with nulls, Unicode, max lengths, duplicates where allowed, boundary dates, and orphan-looking rows so migration verification can prove row-count and column-checksum preservation!
- [ ] **Implement Background Template Pre-Warming & Cache Pruning:** Rebuild templates ONLY when migrations or seed recipes change; garbage-collect unused old `tpl_*` databases past a configurable cap (e.g., keep newest 5 templates per project) after confirming zero active clones.
- [ ] **Support Unique Constraint & Composite-Key Collision-Free Generation:** Track generated unique tuples per table deterministically so 10,000-row performance seeds never crash mid-bulk-load on random Faker email/slug collisions!
- [ ] **Export Stable Checksum Snapshots (`computeTableChecksums`):** Compute deterministic per-table row counts and column-value SHA-256 digests used by `Task 063` migration preservation tests.
- [ ] **Support SQLite & Postgres Dialects Equally:** Emit valid bulk SQL/parameterized inserts or `COPY FROM STDIN` streams cleanly for both SQLite and Postgres test targets.
- [ ] **Verify Zero Production Data Leakage:** Confirm generator uses strictly synthetic `.test`/`.example` domains and deterministic seeded values—never reading external dumps unless explicitly provided as sanitized brownfield input.

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **Self-referencing foreign key (`categories.parent_id → categories.id`) or mutual cycle (`users.primary_team_id ↔ teams.owner_id`):** Cycle breaker inserts root rows with `parent_id = NULL` first, inserts dependent rows, then updates cyclic nullable pointers cleanly in pass 2; if a cycle has ZERO nullable edges, emit an explicit schema-cycle diagnostic!
- **Two concurrent `env.create` calls request the exact same unbuilt `tpl_<hash>` simultaneously:** Deduplicate in-flight template builds via a per-`templateKey` promise map so Postgres never throws `ERROR: database "tpl_abc" already exists`!
- **`CREATE DATABASE ... TEMPLATE` fails because the builder forgot to close its own connection to `tpl_<hash>`:** Explicitly close the builder's pool, run `pg_terminate_backend` on `tpl_<hash>`, and set `datallowconn = false` BEFORE resolving the template-ready promise!
- **Column has `CHECK (quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 20)` or `VARCHAR(32)`:** Parse column min/max bounds and string length limits so generated max-length and Unicode emoji strings (counting UTF-16/UTF-8 bytes vs code points accurately!) NEVER violate table constraints!
- **Migration check runs on a table with 0 rows vs 100 rows:** Ensure every table in the functional seed receives at least 3 rows (normal, boundary, nullable/soft-deleted) unless explicitly constrained to singleton.
- **SQLite `PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON` during bulk load:** Verify topological ordering succeeds with `foreign_keys = ON` enabled throughout (never masking broken FKs by disabling checks!).
- **Determinism across Node versions / timezones:** Anchor Faker's reference date (`faker.setDefaultRefDate(...)`) and seed explicitly so `generateDataset(schema, seed=42)` produces byte-identical output on any laptop timezone!

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Zero-Token Synthetic Data Invariant:** `SyntheticDataGenerator` makes ZERO LLM calls; all rows are generated deterministically by code.
- **Exact Seed Reproducibility Invariant:** Same `(schema, specBoundaries, seed, profile)` ALWAYS yields identical rows and identical table checksums across runs and timezones.
- **Template Immutability Invariant:** Once built, `tpl_<hash>` is strictly read-only (`datallowconn = false` on Postgres, `0o444` on SQLite) so no environment can ever mutate a shared template.
- **Foreign-Key Validity Invariant:** Generated datasets pass `PRAGMA foreign_key_check` / Postgres FK constraints with 0 violations.
- **Safe Synthetic Domain Invariant:** All generated emails use `@example.test` / `@env.test` (RFC 2606 reserved), preventing accidental real-world email delivery.
- **Bulk Performance Invariant:** Loading 10,000 synthetic rows into SQLite or Postgres completes in `< 3 seconds`.

#### Multi-Agent Harmony And Branch Isolation

- **Worktree Setup:** Create branch `task/052-template-db-synthetic-data` via `node scripts/agent-worktree.mjs create 052 template-db-synthetic-data`.
- **Strict Subtree Boundary:** Touch ONLY `packages/test-env/src/synthetic-data/**`, `packages/test-env/tests/synthetic-data/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-052.md`.
- **Parallel Safe Execution:** Disjoint from `Tasks 049–051` and `Tasks 053–057`.

### Task 053: Own Worker Loop — Model Protocol Adapters (OpenAI Responses, Anthropic Messages, OpenAI-Compatible Chat, Gemini API) & Model Profile Registry

- **Milestone & Track:** `M1 · Native TypeScript Worker Loop`
- **Depends On:** `Task 001`, `Task 008`, `Task 011`, `Task 023`
- **Git Worktree & Branch:** `task/053-worker-loop-provider-protocols` in `../ef-wt/task-053-worker-loop-provider-protocols` (commit on own branch only; **NEVER merge**)
- **Owned Write Scope (Disjoint Subtree):** `packages/worker-loop/src/protocols/**`, `packages/worker-loop/tests/protocols/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-053.md`
- **Mandatory Reference Files:** [worker-loop.md](worker-loop.md#components), [provider-connections.md](provider-connections.md), [agent-handoffs.md](agent-handoffs.md), [research/worker-loop-and-edits.md](research/worker-loop-and-edits.md), [research/provider-subscriptions.md](research/provider-subscriptions.md)
- **Shared Contracts Consumed / Produced:** Consumes `SecretRedactor`/`LocalTracer` (`Task 011`), integer currency units (`Task 010`); produces `ModelProtocolAdapter` interface, 4 streaming protocol implementations (`OpenAIResponsesAdapter`, `AnthropicMessagesAdapter`, `OpenAICompatibleChatAdapter`, `GeminiApiAdapter`), and `ModelProfileRegistry`

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Define Unified `ModelProtocolAdapter` & `ModelProfile` Schema:** Every model roster entry declares: `family`, `contextWindow`, `maxOutputTokens`, `editFormat` (`apply_patch | str_replace | search_replace`), `supportsParallelToolCalls`, `supportsReasoningReplay`, `supportsStreamingToolArgs`, `toolCallReliabilityTier`, `supportsPromptCaching`, and `routeConstraints` ([worker-loop.md](worker-loop.md#model-profile)).
- [ ] **Implement `OpenAIResponsesAdapter` (API Key AND Sign in with ChatGPT):** Stream SSE from the OpenAI Responses API, honoring strict **Sign in with ChatGPT** preview constraints when `route === 'siwc'` (`store: false`, `stream: true`, omit `previous_response_id`, omit `max_output_tokens`, omit `temperature`, function/custom tools only, ZERO hosted tools!), requesting `include: ["reasoning.encrypted_content"]` where supported, and preserving opaque returned reasoning items verbatim in exact order for stateless multi-turn replay ([worker-loop.md](worker-loop.md#checkpoints-and-recovery), [research/worker-loop-and-edits.md](research/worker-loop-and-edits.md))!
- [ ] **Implement Streaming Output-Budget Cutoff For Routes Without `max_output_tokens`:** On Sign in with ChatGPT (which rejects `max_output_tokens`), track streamed output tokens live and cleanly abort the HTTP stream (`AbortController`) if output exceeds the attempt's reserved output budget, settling exact actual streamed usage and returning `stopReason: 'output_budget_cutoff'` so the loop requests a shorter continuation ([worker-loop.md](worker-loop.md#checkpoints-and-recovery))!
- [ ] **Implement `AnthropicMessagesAdapter` (Claude Console API Key ONLY):** Stream Anthropic Messages SSE with explicit `cache_control: { type: "ephemeral" }` breakpoints on the pinned Zone 1+2 stable prefix to maximize prompt-cache discounts, capturing exact `input_tokens`, `cache_creation_input_tokens`, `cache_read_input_tokens`, `output_tokens`, and thinking blocks verbatim for replay!
- [ ] **Implement `OpenAICompatibleChatAdapter` (OpenRouter, Ollama, LM Studio):** Stream standard Chat Completions SSE with tool-call delta accumulation, `usage` extraction (`stream_options: { include_usage: true }`), OpenRouter provider/cost headers, and graceful handling of local models (Ollama/LM Studio) lacking parallel tool calls or streaming usage.
- [ ] **Implement `GeminiApiAdapter` (AI Studio / Vertex API Key):** Stream Gemini API (`generateContent` / `streamGenerateContent`) function calls, thought signatures/parts where returned, structured JSON schema outputs, and exact `usageMetadata` token accounting.
- [ ] **Implement Unified Error Taxonomy & Rate-Limit Header Parser:** Map HTTP statuses and provider error codes into exact normalized errors: `auth` (`401`), `rate_limit` (`429` with parsed `retry-after` / `x-ratelimit-reset-*` ms), `usage_limit` (`subscription_sharing_usage_limit_exceeded` — distinct from transient 429!), `billing`, `overloaded` (`529`/`503`), `context_overflow`, `stream_stall` (`60 s` no-token watchdog!), and `unknown_timeout` (timeout AFTER request body transmitted → triggers reconciliation, NEVER blind retry!).
- [ ] **Implement Pre-Send Secret Redaction & Encrypted-Reasoning Probe:** Run `SecretRedactor` on outgoing message payloads (never altering local auth headers) and support a one-turn probe verifying whether a given ChatGPT plan route returns encrypted reasoning items (falling back cleanly to working without them if absent).

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **Sign in with ChatGPT request accidentally includes `max_output_tokens`, `temperature`, `previous_response_id`, or `store: true`:** Enforce a hard pre-flight assertion in `OpenAIResponsesAdapter` stripping/rejecting forbidden parameters whenever `route === 'siwc'` so SIWC calls NEVER fail with `400 Unsupported parameter`!
- **SSE chunk splits mid-JSON or mid-multi-byte UTF-8 character across TCP packets:** Implement a strict UTF-8 `TextDecoder({ stream: true })` + line-buffered SSE frame parser tested with 1-byte fragmentation.
- **Stream hangs silently for 60 seconds after emitting 3 tokens (network half-open stall):** Per-chunk idle watchdog fires at `60_000 ms`, aborts the fetch cleanly, and emits `StreamStallError` with exact partial usage so the worker loop retries once then parks cleanly ([worker-loop.md](worker-loop.md#guards-against-spirals)).
- **Timeout occurs AFTER request transmitted (`unknown_timeout`) on a paid API call:** Emit `UnknownOutcomeTimeoutError` preserving exact `clientRequestId` / provider `idempotencyKey` so the ledger holds the reservation in `'unknown'` state instead of blindly double-charging!
- **Provider sends `429` with `subscription_sharing_usage_limit_exceeded` vs ordinary `429` RPM throttle:** Classify `subscription_sharing_usage_limit_exceeded` strictly as `usage_limit` (which closes the plan window and parks tasks!) rather than a transient backoff retry loop!
- **Model emits malformed JSON inside streaming `function.arguments`:** Capture raw string cleanly and return a typed `MalformedToolArgsItem` so the worker loop's 1-retry repair prompt handles it rather than crashing `JSON.parse`!
- **Local Ollama model lacks tool-calling support or reports 8k context window:** `ModelProfileRegistry` flags `supportsToolCalling: false` / `smallContext: true` upfront so onboarding and crew routing never assign coding tasks to incompatible models!

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Stateless Replay Fidelity Invariant:** `OpenAIResponsesAdapter` (`store: false`) replays returned opaque reasoning items verbatim in exact original order; never strips, summarizes, or mutates encrypted reasoning blobs!
- **Strict SIWC Constraint Compliance Invariant:** Unit tests assert serialized HTTP body for `route === 'siwc'` NEVER contains `max_output_tokens`, `temperature`, `previous_response_id`, or `store: true`.
- **Stream-Cutoff Budget Bound Invariant:** On routes without `max_output_tokens`, aborting the stream bounds any output overrun to at most one SSE chunk.
- **429-Is-Not-Worker-Failure Invariant:** Rate-limit and usage-limit errors carry explicit `isProviderSchedulingError: true` so they never decrement worker pass-rate calibration or burn retry attempts.
- **Zero Live-Network Unit Tests Invariant:** All 4 adapters are 100% verified against local loopback mock SSE servers replaying authentic wire captures for OpenAI Responses, Anthropic Messages, OpenRouter/Ollama Chat, and Gemini API.
- **Zero Secret In Prompt Body Invariant:** Outgoing prompt text is scanned/redacted before HTTP transmission.

#### Multi-Agent Harmony And Branch Isolation

- **Worktree Setup:** Create branch `task/053-worker-loop-provider-protocols` via `node scripts/agent-worktree.mjs create 053 worker-loop-provider-protocols`.
- **Strict Subtree Boundary:** Touch ONLY `packages/worker-loop/src/protocols/**`, `packages/worker-loop/tests/protocols/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-053.md`.
- **Parallel Safe Execution:** Disjoint from `Task 054` (context builder), `Task 055` (tool output shrinker), `Task 056` (edit tools), and `Task 057` (loop executor/checkpoints).
- **Handoff For `Task 057`, `Tasks 136–138` (Connections), `Task 140` (Pacing):** Export `ModelProtocolAdapter`, `ModelProfile`, `StreamEvent`, `NormalizedModelError`, and all 4 adapters in `.agent-handoffs/task-053.md`.

### Task 054: Own Worker Loop — 6-Zone Pinned Context Builder, Working Memory (`notes.update`) & Compaction Pipeline

- **Milestone & Track:** `M1 · Native TypeScript Worker Loop`
- **Depends On:** `Task 001`, `Task 008`, `Task 009`, `Task 053`
- **Git Worktree & Branch:** `task/054-worker-loop-context-compaction` in `../ef-wt/task-054-worker-loop-context-compaction` (commit on own branch only; **NEVER merge**)
- **Owned Write Scope (Disjoint Subtree):** `packages/worker-loop/src/context/**`, `packages/worker-loop/tests/context/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-054.md`
- **Mandatory Reference Files:** [worker-loop.md](worker-loop.md#the-context-zone-by-zone), [knowledge-slicing.md](knowledge-slicing.md#the-packet), [prompt-contracts.md](prompt-contracts.md#turn-summarizer1), [research/worker-loop-and-edits.md](research/worker-loop-and-edits.md), [research/context-slicing.md](research/context-slicing.md)
- **Shared Contracts Consumed / Produced:** Consumes `TaskPacketV1Schema` (`Task 008`), `buildPromptEnvelope` (`Task 009`), `ModelProfile` (`Task 053`); produces `WorkerContextBuilder`, `WorkingMemoryStore` (`notes.update`), `CompactionPipeline`, and `TokenEstimator`

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Implement Exact 6-Zone Context Assembly (`WorkerContextBuilder.buildRequest`):** Assemble every model request in the exact immutable zone order from [worker-loop.md](worker-loop.md#the-context-zone-by-zone) to defeat "lost in the middle" degradation and maximize provider prompt caching:
  - **Zone 1 (Pinned, Stable Prefix):** Kernel rules + `leaf-worker@1` role instruction (byte-identical across turns for cache hits!).
  - **Zone 2 (Pinned, Never Compacted):** Task packet's `MUST` band (goal, write scope, contracts, spec items, cross-cutting rules, edge cases, visible checks, pinned required skills).
  - **Zone 3 (Trimmed First):** `SHOULD` band (relevant conventions, research warnings, dependency module cards, design tokens).
  - **Zone 4 (Survives Compaction Verbatim):** Structured **Working Memory** maintained by the worker via `notes.update` (plan steps, completed items keyed to `MUST` IDs, open problems, facts learned).
  - **Zone 5 (History):** Recent `K` steps verbatim (including opaque reasoning items in original order!), older steps collapsed to one-line summaries or compacted progress note.
  - **Zone 6 (Pinned Tail Checklist):** Repeated compact checklist of `MUST` rule IDs, required checks, write scope, and current step number right at the tail of the prompt!
- [ ] **Implement Structured Working Memory Tool (`notes.update(patch)`):** Provide bounded JSON-patch/section-update semantics (`planSteps`, `doneByMustId`, `openProblems`, `learnedFacts`), capping total working memory size (e.g., `<= 1,500` tokens) so the worker cannot accidentally fill its whole window with verbose notes, and persisting updates inside `turn_log` so working memory survives crash recovery verbatim!
- [ ] **Implement Ordered 4-Step Compaction Pipeline (`CompactionPipeline`):** Trigger automatically whenever estimated request tokens exceed **70% of `modelProfile.contextWindow`** ([worker-loop.md](worker-loop.md#compaction)), applying stages strictly in order until the request fits under budget:
  1. **Trim Zone 3 (`SHOULD`)** and **drop superseded file reads** (any `read_file` of `src/x.ts` that was later re-read or edited becomes `[read of src/x.ts @ step 5, superseded]`).
  2. **Collapse old tool results** beyond the last `K` steps to their deterministic one-line `turn_log.result_summary` (keeping artifact IDs intact!).
  3. **Summarize old turns** beyond the last `K` steps into a bounded `progress_note` using `turn-summarizer@1` (keyed to rule IDs, keeping exact filenames/function names/errors, NEVER rewording pinned rules!) — OR reuse current Working Memory directly if already up to date (0 extra tokens!).
  4. **Hard Refusal If Pinned Zones Don't Fit:** If Zones 1 + 2 (`MUST`) + 6 (`Tail Checklist`) + minimal reserve alone exceed the model window, **NEVER silently truncate `MUST` content** — return `{ status: 'task_too_large_for_model', mustTokens, windowTokens }` so the kernel parks the task and returns it to the planner to split or escalate!
- [ ] **Implement Small Local Model Profile Caps (16k–32k Windows):** When `modelProfile.contextWindow <= 32_768`, automatically enforce tighter context caps from [worker-loop.md](worker-loop.md#compaction): `K = 4` recent verbatim steps, max `200`-line file reads, max `10` test failures in summary, and windowed symbol-outline file views!
- [ ] **Implement Fast Deterministic Token Estimator (`TokenEstimator`):** Provide conservative model-family-aware token estimation (accounting for code density, JSON tool schemas, and safety headroom) so compaction triggers cleanly before hitting provider `context_overflow` errors!
- [ ] **Preserve Prompt-Cache Prefix Stability Across Turns:** Ensure Zones 1 and 2 remain **byte-for-byte identical** from Step 1 through Step 80 (never embedding changing timestamps, step counters, or mutable notes inside Zones 1–2; mutable step counter sits strictly in Zone 6 tail!) so OpenAI/Anthropic cached-input discounts apply on every turn!
- [ ] **Preserve Opaque Reasoning Items Across Compaction:** Ensure compaction in Zone 5 NEVER drops or mutates encrypted reasoning items attached to the recent `K` verbatim turns, and cleanly drops reasoning items belonging to fully compacted older turns together with their assistant turn pair!
- [ ] **Handle Provider `context_overflow` Recovery Gracefully:** If a provider still returns `context_overflow` due to tokenizer underestimate, immediately tighten target budget by 15% and re-run `CompactionPipeline` once before parking.

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **Task `MUST` band alone is 18k tokens on a 16k local model:** Step 4 MUST refuse cleanly with `task_too_large_for_model` — NEVER slicing or dropping even 1 rule from Zone 2!
- **Worker edits `src/a.ts` at Step 6 after reading `src/a.ts` at Step 2 and Step 5:** Both Step 2 and Step 5 reads are marked `[read of src/a.ts @ step N, superseded]`, freeing thousands of tokens with zero information loss!
- **Worker calls `notes.update` attempting to delete or override a `MUST` rule or write 20,000 tokens of raw code into Working Memory:** Working memory sits strictly inside `<data source="working_memory">` in Zone 4 (cannot override Zone 1/2 instructions!) and rejects patches exceeding the `1,500`-token cap with a concise error asking the worker to keep notes compact.
- **Step counter or dynamic timestamp accidentally placed in Zone 1 system prompt:** Snapshot test MUST verify `prefixHash(step=1) === prefixHash(step=25)` byte-for-byte so prompt caching is never accidentally broken!
- **Compaction splits a tool-call assistant message from its matching `tool_result` message:** Always compact in atomic turn pairs (`assistant tool_use` + `tool_result` together) so providers never reject requests with `"orphaned tool_result without matching tool_use"`!
- **`turn-summarizer@1` returns text exceeding its token cap or invalid schema:** Validate against `TurnSummarizerV1Schema` (`Task 009`), fall back cleanly to deterministic one-line turn summaries + Zone 4 Working Memory if summarizer fails.
- **Zero history turns (Step 1 initial dispatch):** Assembles Zones 1, 2, 3, empty Zone 4, initial user brief, and Zone 6 cleanly.

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Never-Compact-MUST Invariant:** Zones 1, 2 (`MUST`), and 6 (`Tail Checklist`) are NEVER dropped, summarized, or truncated by compaction; oversized `MUST` ALWAYS triggers planner task-split.
- **Byte-Identical Cache-Prefix Invariant:** Zones 1 + 2 produce identical byte strings across every step of an attempt.
- **Atomic Tool-Pair Compaction Invariant:** Zone 5 history NEVER contains an unmatched `tool_use` or orphaned `tool_result`.
- **70% Proactive Compaction Threshold Invariant:** Compaction runs proactively at `70%` of `contextWindow` before hitting hard provider overflow errors.
- **Small-Model Cap Invariant:** Windows `<= 32,768` deterministically enforce `K = 4`, 200-line reads, and 10 test failures.
- **Working-Memory Survival Invariant:** Zone 4 (`notes.update`) survives every compaction round intact without LLM summarization loss.

#### Multi-Agent Harmony And Branch Isolation

- **Worktree Setup:** Create branch `task/054-worker-loop-context-compaction` via `node scripts/agent-worktree.mjs create 054 worker-loop-context-compaction`.
- **Strict Subtree Boundary:** Touch ONLY `packages/worker-loop/src/context/**`, `packages/worker-loop/tests/context/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-054.md`.
- **Parallel Safe Execution:** Disjoint from `Task 053` (protocols), `Task 055` (shrinker), `Task 056` (edit tools), and `Task 057` (executor).
- **Handoff For `Task 057` (Step Executor) & `Task 088` (Packet Slicer):** Export `WorkerContextBuilder`, `WorkingMemoryStore`, `CompactionPipeline`, and `TokenEstimator` in `.agent-handoffs/task-054.md`.
- **Commit-Only Discipline:** Commit exclusively on `task/054-worker-loop-context-compaction`; **NEVER merge** into `main` or `harness/integration`.
- **Mockable Summarizer Call:** Accept `turnSummarizer` as an injected function so all compaction tests execute deterministically offline with zero real LLM calls.

#### Verification, Testing And Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Run `pnpm --filter @ef-harness/worker-loop test -- context` verifying exact 6-zone order, byte-identical Zone 1+2 prefix hash from Step 1 to Step 30, and Zone 6 tail checklist presence.
- [ ] Verify all 4 compaction stages in sequence: superseded read collapsing, old tool-result collapsing, `turn-summarizer@1` fallback, and hard `task_too_large_for_model` refusal when `MUST` exceeds window.
- [ ] Verify atomic tool-use/tool-result pairing holds across 200 `fast-check` randomized turn histories during compaction.
- [ ] Verify 16k/32k small-model profile automatically enforces `K = 4`, 200-line read caps, and 10 test failure caps.
- [ ] Run `pnpm --filter @ef-harness/worker-loop typecheck`, `lint`, and `node scripts/verify-harmony.mjs --task 054`.
- **Acceptance:** 6-zone pinned context builder, bounded `notes.update` working memory, and 4-stage `MUST`-preserving compaction pipeline pass all unit and property tests on `task/054-worker-loop-context-compaction`.

### Task 055: Own Worker Loop — Tool Output Shrinker, Windowed File Reader With Symbol Outlines & `harness.read_log`

- **Milestone & Track:** `M1 · Native TypeScript Worker Loop`
- **Depends On:** `Task 001`, `Task 011`, `Task 029`, `Task 047`, `Task 054`
- **Git Worktree & Branch:** `task/055-worker-loop-tool-shrinker` in `../ef-wt/task-055-worker-loop-tool-shrinker` (commit on own branch only; **NEVER merge**)
- **Owned Write Scope (Disjoint Subtree):** `packages/worker-loop/src/read-tools/**`, `packages/worker-loop/tests/read-tools/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-055.md`
- **Mandatory Reference Files:** [worker-loop.md](worker-loop.md#shrinking-tool-output-before-it-enters-history), [sandbox-and-security.md](sandbox-and-security.md#harnessrun), [investigations-and-sweeps.md](investigations-and-sweeps.md#5--context-overflow-and-truncated-files), [research/worker-loop-and-edits.md](research/worker-loop-and-edits.md)
- **Shared Contracts Consumed / Produced:** Consumes `ArtifactManager` (`Task 029`), `SecretRedactor` (`Task 011`); produces `WindowedFileReader` (`readFile`, `listFiles`, `grepFiles`), `ToolOutputShrinker` (test/build/grep/file/kb shrinkers), and `ReadLogTool` (`harness.read_log`)

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Implement `WindowedFileReader` (`read_file(path, range?)`):** Enforce strict worktree containment + secret-file read exclusion (blocking `.env*`, `*.pem`, `*.key`, `.git/` private credential configs!), honor configurable line caps (`400` lines default, `200` lines on `<=32k` local models per [worker-loop.md](worker-loop.md#shrinking-tool-output-before-it-enters-history)), return line-numbered text (`L0040: ...`) + per-range SHA-256 `range_hash` (feeding `replace_lines` recovery in `Task 056`!), and for files larger than the line cap when no range is specified, return a **compact symbol outline with exact line numbers** (classes, functions, exports, interfaces, React components) plus the first chunk and explicit instruction `"File has 1,420 lines; call read_file(path, { start, end }) for specific ranges"`!
- [ ] **Implement Bounded `list(glob)` & `grep(pattern, glob?)` Tools:** Respect `.gitignore`, exclude `node_modules/` and `.git/` by default (unless explicitly targeting local package source), return at most **50 matches** with exact `file:line:column` and trimmed matching line (`<=200` chars), plus exact total match count and hint `"Showing first 50 of 412 matches; refine pattern or glob"`!
- [ ] **Implement Structured Test-Run Shrinker (`shrinkTestOutput`):** Parse Vitest, Jest, Playwright, pytest, Go test, and Cargo test outputs BEFORE they enter conversation history: emit pass/fail/skip counts, each failing test (capped at `10` on small models, `25` on large models) with its first assertion message and **stack trace trimmed strictly to project source frames** (collapsing repeated `node_modules`/framework frames!), collapse repeated identical log lines (`[repeated 84 times]`), and attach the exact `artifactId` for deep inspection!
- [ ] **Implement Build & Type-Error Shrinker (`shrinkBuildOutput`):** Parse TypeScript (`tsc`), ESLint, Vite/Next.js, and Rust/Go compiler errors, deduplicate identical error codes/messages, group cleanly by file, cap at the **first 30 deduplicated errors** with exact total count, and attach `artifactId`!
- [ ] **Implement `harness.read_log(artifactId, { query?, startLine?, endLine?, maxLines? })` Tool:** Backed directly by `ArtifactManager.readLogRange` / `queryLogStream` (`Task 029`), allowing workers and investigators to seek into specific line ranges or regex-search a 4,000-line or 200 MB test log without ever loading the full log into context (enforcing a strict per-call returned byte/line cap of e.g., 200 lines / 16 KB!).
- [ ] **Implement Exact `oneLineSummary` Generator For `turn_log.result_summary`:** Produce a compact deterministic 1-line summary for every tool call (`read src/kitchen/print.tsx L1-120`, `grep "toPrintRows": 4 hits in 2 files`, `test: 14 passed, 1 failed (AC-31) [ART-42]`) used verbatim during Step 2 compaction (`Task 054`)!
- [ ] **Wrap Every Read Output In Provenance Data Tags:** Return all file contents, grep matches, and log slices inside escaped `<data source="file:..." trust="untrusted">` wrappers with `SecretRedactor` applied!
- [ ] **Track File-Hash Read Cache For Stale-Edit Detection:** Return the current file's SHA-256 content hash alongside `read_file` results so `Task 056` immediately detects if an external developer edit modified the file between `read_file` and `edit` ([worker-loop.md](worker-loop.md#edge-cases))!

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **Minified single-line JS bundle (`dist/bundle.js`, 1 line of 500 KB) opened via `read_file`:** Detect long lines (`> 500` chars) and return binary/minified summary (`"Line 1 is 502,144 chars (minified/generated); truncated"`) instead of blowing 125,000 tokens in a single `read_file`!
- **Binary file (`logo.png`, `font.woff2`, `.db`) passed to `read_file`:** Detect NUL bytes in first 4 KB and return structured metadata (`{ binary: true, bytes, mimeGuess }`) cleanly instead of corrupting UTF-8 JSON.
- **Worker attempts `read_file("../../../Users/Ayush/.ssh/id_rsa")` or follows a worktree symlink pointing outside the worktree:** Resolve `fs.realpathSync` and reject any path outside `worktreePath` (except explicitly allowlisted read-only package store reads via `readLocalPackageSource`), throwing `PathEscapeDeniedError`!
- **Test output has 4,000 lines of stack trace noise from a single React render loop:** Shrinker collapses repeated identical frames (`× 312`) and strips `node_modules` frames, turning 4,000 lines into a crisp 18-line summary + `artifactId` ([worker-loop.md](worker-loop.md#decisions-in-plain-words))!
- **Unrecognized custom test runner format:** Fall back gracefully to first 40 + last 60 lines with repeated-line deduplication, explicit omitted-line count, and `artifactId` — never returning an empty summary!
- **Grep pattern with invalid regex syntax or catastrophic backtracking (`(a+)+b`):** Catch invalid regex cleanly with actionable error and enforce safe literal/bounded matching (or ripgrep-style linear engine) so ReDoS never freezes the loop!
- **Empty file or requesting lines past EOF:** Return `{ lines: [], totalLines: 0, fileHash }` cleanly without off-by-one crashes.

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Pre-History Shrinking Invariant:** Raw multi-thousand-line tool outputs NEVER enter Zone 5 model history; EVERY tool output passes through `ToolOutputShrinker` first.
- **Explicit Omission + Artifact Pointer Invariant:** Every shrunk/truncated test, build, grep, or file result states exact counts omitted and how to retrieve details (`read_file(range)` or `harness.read_log(id)`).
- **Realpath Containment Invariant:** `read_file`, `list`, and `grep` resolve symlinks via `realpath` and NEVER read outside the attempt worktree or expose `.env*`/secret files.
- **Small-Model Cap Honoring Invariant:** `read_file` and `shrinkTestOutput` read their caps directly from `modelProfile` (200 lines / 10 failures for `<=32k` models).
- **Redacted Read Invariant:** Every output slice passes through `SecretRedactor` before returning to the model.

### Task 056: Own Worker Loop — Model-Family Edit Tools (`apply_patch`, `str_replace`, Search/Replace), 4-Tier Non-Guessing Applier & 4-Step Edit Recovery Ladder

- **Milestone & Track:** `M1 · Native TypeScript Worker Loop`
- **Depends On:** `Task 001`, `Task 007`, `Task 053`, `Task 055`
- **Git Worktree & Branch:** `task/056-worker-loop-edit-applier` in `../ef-wt/task-056-worker-loop-edit-applier` (commit on own branch only; **NEVER merge**)
- **Owned Write Scope (Disjoint Subtree):** `packages/worker-loop/src/edits/**`, `packages/worker-loop/tests/edits/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-056.md`
- **Mandatory Reference Files:** [worker-loop.md](worker-loop.md#edits), [investigations-and-sweeps.md](investigations-and-sweeps.md#5--context-overflow-and-truncated-files), [completeness-gate.md](completeness-gate.md#static-audit), [research/worker-loop-and-edits.md](research/worker-loop-and-edits.md)
- **Shared Contracts Consumed / Produced:** Consumes `ModelProfile.editFormat` (`Task 053`), `WindowedFileReader` (`Task 055`); produces `EditToolDispatcher` (`applyPatch`, `strReplace`, `searchReplace`, `writeNewFile`, `replaceLines`), `FourTierMatcher`, and `EditRecoveryTracker`

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Implement Model-Family Edit Tool Selection ([worker-loop.md](worker-loop.md#edits)):** Expose ONLY the trained edit format matching `modelProfile.editFormat`: (1) OpenAI GPT-5/Codex → `apply_patch` (OpenAI `*** Begin Patch` / `*** Update File` / `*** Add File` / `*** Delete File` envelope), (2) Anthropic Claude → exact `str_replace(path, old_text, new_text)`, (3) Other & local models → `search_replace` blocks, PLUS `write_new_file(path, content)` strictly for files that do NOT exist yet, and **NEVER offer whole-file rewrite of an existing file**!
- [ ] **Enforce Write-Scope Globs, `.git` Protection & Elision-Placeholder Rejection At Apply Time:** Before writing a single byte, verify target path resolves strictly inside `worktreePath`, matches `task-packet@1.write_scope` globs, is NOT inside `.git/` or `node_modules/`, and reject any replacement containing lazy elision placeholders (`// ... existing code ...`, `/* ... rest of file unchanged ... */`, `# ... existing code ...`) per [investigations-and-sweeps.md](investigations-and-sweeps.md#5--context-overflow-and-truncated-files)!
- [ ] **Implement The 4-Tier Tolerant, Never-Guessing Matcher (`FourTierMatcher`):** Match search/old text strictly in tier order stopping at the first tier with a **unique** match:
  1. **Tier 1:** Exact byte-for-byte match.
  2. **Tier 2:** Line endings normalized (`\r\n` ↔ `\n`, preserving the file's original dominant EOL on write!).
  3. **Tier 3:** Trailing horizontal whitespace ignored per line.
  4. **Tier 4:** Common leading indentation ignored (re-indenting replacement lines cleanly to match the matched block's base indentation!).
  5. **Ambiguity Hard Stop:** If MORE THAN ONE location matches at any tier, **immediately reject as `AmbiguousEditMatchError(matchLineNumbers)`** — NEVER silently guess the first occurrence!
- [ ] **Implement The 4-Step Per-File Edit Recovery Ladder (`EditRecoveryTracker`):** Track consecutive failed edits per `(attemptId, filePath)` matching [worker-loop.md](worker-loop.md#edits):
  - **1st failure:** Return precise error + nearest fuzzy candidate region with line numbers (`"Your search text wasn't found. Closest match at lines 40–52: ..."`).
  - **2nd failure:** Automatically return a fresh numbered view of that region with a hint to use a smaller hunk.
  - **3rd failure:** Dynamically enable `replace_lines(path, start, end, text, range_hash)` for THAT file ONLY, requiring the exact SHA-256 `range_hash` of current lines `start..end` so edits can never apply against stale content!
  - **4th failure:** Return `EditStuckEscalation` so the worker loop checkpoints and feeds the kernel's loop fingerprint ladder!
- [ ] **Detect Concurrent External File Modification Before Apply:** Compare the file's current SHA-256 hash against the last hash observed by this attempt's `WindowedFileReader` (`Task 055`); if changed externally (e.g., developer edited the file), reject with `FileChangedExternallyError` returning a fresh numbered view of the modified region ([worker-loop.md](worker-loop.md#edge-cases))!
- [ ] **Preserve Line Endings & Defer Formatting Until Submit:** Preserve existing CRLF vs LF line endings untouched and NEVER auto-run Prettier/formatters after individual edits so subsequent search blocks still match what the model saw ([worker-loop.md](worker-loop.md#edits))!
- [ ] **Enforce `write_new_file` Non-Overwrite Guard:** `write_new_file` MUST hard-fail with `FileAlreadyExistsError` if the file already exists (closing the backdoor to whole-file rewrites!).
- [ ] **Use Atomic Temp-Write + Windows Rename Retry On Disk Writes:** Write edited content via temp file + atomic rename (with Windows `EPERM`/`EBUSY` retry) so a crash mid-edit never leaves a half-written 0-byte source file!

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **File has two identical `return null;` lines and model calls `str_replace` with `"return null;"`:** Tier 1 finds 2 matches → MUST reject as `AmbiguousEditMatchError([14, 48])` asking for more surrounding context, never modifying line 14 blindly!
- **Windows CRLF file edited by model sending LF `\n` patch:** Tier 2 matches cleanly and writes back preserving the file's original `\r\n` line endings (zero massive CRLF diff churn!).
- **Model sends 2-space indented replacement for a 4-space indented block:** Tier 4 matches cleanly and shifts replacement indentation by +2 spaces (preserving relative nested indentation within the replacement!).
- **Model calls `replace_lines` on a file BEFORE hitting the 3rd failure OR with a stale `range_hash`:** Reject with `ReplaceLinesNotEnabledError` or `StaleRangeHashError` (returning current lines + fresh hash) so `replace_lines` never becomes a blind line-number footgun!
- **Model attempts `write_new_file` on an existing file to bypass whole-file rewrite ban:** Hard-fail with `FileAlreadyExistsError("Use <editTool> for existing files")`.
- **Multi-file `apply_patch` where File 1 is inside `write_scope` and File 2 is outside `write_scope` (e.g., protected test file!):** Validate ALL hunks and ALL paths in the patch atomically BEFORE writing File 1, so a partially invalid patch leaves the worktree 100% unchanged!
- **Model writes `// ... existing code ...` inside a 20-line replacement:** Elision detector rejects the edit immediately before touching disk!

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Zero Whole-File-Rewrite Invariant:** Existing files can ONLY be mutated via targeted diff/replace hunks (`apply_patch`, `str_replace`, `search_replace`, or failure-3 `replace_lines` with `range_hash`).
- **Zero Ambiguous-Match Guessing Invariant:** Matching `> 1` site at ANY tier ALWAYS fails loudly with exact candidate line numbers.
- **Atomic Multi-Hunk Patch Invariant:** A multi-hunk / multi-file `apply_patch` either validates and applies completely or modifies 0 files.
- **Scope-Enforcement-Before-Write Invariant:** Every edit checks `write_scope` globs and worktree realpath BEFORE any disk write.
- **Zero Mid-Edit Auto-Formatting Invariant:** Formatter runs ONLY at submit time, never after individual edits.
- **Elision-Placeholder Blocking Invariant:** Known lazy truncation comments (`// ... existing code ...`, `rest of file unchanged`) are rejected at edit time.

#### Multi-Agent Harmony And Branch Isolation

- **Worktree Setup:** Create branch `task/056-worker-loop-edit-applier` via `node scripts/agent-worktree.mjs create 056 worker-loop-edit-applier`.
- **Strict Subtree Boundary:** Touch ONLY `packages/worker-loop/src/edits/**`, `packages/worker-loop/tests/edits/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-056.md`.
- **Parallel Safe Execution:** Disjoint from `Tasks 053–055` and `Task 057`.
- **Handoff For `Task 057` (Step Executor) & `Task 184` (Sweep Worker):** Export `EditToolDispatcher`, `FourTierMatcher`, `EditRecoveryTracker`, and `parseOpenAiApplyPatch` in `.agent-handoffs/task-056.md`.
- **Commit-Only Discipline:** Commit exclusively on `task/056-worker-loop-edit-applier`; **NEVER merge** into `main` or `harness/integration`.
- **Property-Tested Patch Round-Trips:** Include `fast-check` fuzzing on `FourTierMatcher` verifying CRLF preservation, indentation shift fidelity, and zero silent corruptions.

### Task 057: Own Worker Loop — Step Executor, Per-Step Checkpointing (`turn_log` + Git WIP), Crash Recovery Matrix & Spiral/Stall Guards

- **Milestone & Track:** `M1 · Native TypeScript Worker Loop`
- **Depends On:** `Task 001`, `Task 020`, `Task 021`, `Task 023`, `Task 037`, `Task 048`, `Task 053`, `Task 054`, `Task 055`, `Task 056`
- **Git Worktree & Branch:** `task/057-worker-loop-executor-checkpoints` in `../ef-wt/task-057-worker-loop-executor-checkpoints` (commit on own branch only; **NEVER merge**)
- **Owned Write Scope (Disjoint Subtree):** `packages/worker-loop/src/executor/**`, `packages/worker-loop/tests/executor/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-057.md`
- **Mandatory Reference Files:** [worker-loop.md](worker-loop.md#checkpoints-and-recovery), [stops-undo-and-reentry.md](stops-undo-and-reentry.md), [coordinator-and-recovery.md](coordinator-and-recovery.md), [schema/state.sql](schema/state.sql), [research/worker-loop-and-edits.md](research/worker-loop-and-edits.md)
- **Shared Contracts Consumed / Produced:** Consumes all `packages/worker-loop` modules (`Tasks 053–056`), `SnapshotManager` (`Task 037`), `BudgetLedgerRepo` (`Task 023`), `AttemptMcpServer` tool handlers (`Task 048`); produces `NativeWorkerLoop` (`runAttempt`, `resumeAttemptFromCheckpoint`, `pauseAtBoundary`, `stopImmediately`, `deliverSteer`)

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Implement Core Sequential Step Executor (`NativeWorkerLoop.runAttempt`):** Execute one attempt cleanly inside `harnessd` with ZERO subagents in v1 ([worker-loop.md](worker-loop.md#decisions-in-plain-words)): build 6-zone context (`Task 054`), atomically reserve budget (`Task 023`), stream model response (`Task 053`), settle actual tokens/cost immediately, execute returned tool calls **one at a time in order** (through `WindowedFileReader`, `EditToolDispatcher`, `HarnessRunEngine`, `kb.*`, `notes.update`, `ask_owner`, `flag_blocked`, `dispute_test`, `submit_candidate`), check holds/steers at every tool boundary, and loop until terminal outcome (`submitted | parked | waiting_input | stuck | budget_exhausted | fenced | blocked`)!
- [ ] **Implement Atomic Per-Step Checkpointing (`turn_log` + `refs/harness/checkpoints/<attempt>/<step>`):** After EVERY tool step, if files changed in the worktree, create a temp-index WIP Git commit (`Task 037`), store full returned provider items (including encrypted reasoning blobs!) in CAS (`items_artifact`), write the `turn_log` row + update `attempt_checkpoints` (`step`, `wip_ref`, `contract_versions`, `pending_effects`, code-generated `handoff_artifact`) in ONE coordinator transaction!
- [ ] **Implement Exact 4-Crash-Point Recovery Matrix ([worker-loop.md](worker-loop.md#checkpoints-and-recovery)):** On `resumeAttemptFromCheckpoint(attemptId)`:
  1. Crash during model call → rebuild identical request from `turn_log` (handling any `'unknown'` paid reservation via reconciliation first!) and invoke model cleanly.
  2. Crash after model response recorded, before tool execution → execute the recorded pending tool call deterministically.
  3. Crash during tool execution → reset worktree cleanly to last `checkpoint_commit` (`wip_ref`) and rerun the step (safe because all tool effects stay confined to attempt worktree/env!).
  4. Crash after tool execution, before `turn_log` commit → reset worktree to last `wip_ref` and redo the step!
- [ ] **Implement All 7 Spiral & Stall Guards from [worker-loop.md](worker-loop.md#guards-against-spirals):**
  1. Max steps per attempt (`40` Junior / `80` Senior, configurable) → park/stuck.
  2. Same tool + same normalized arguments + same result `3` times → `stuck`.
  3. No progress (`8` consecutive steps with unchanged worktree tree hash AND same failing check fingerprint) → `stuck`.
  4. Stream stall (`60 s` no tokens) → abort and retry exact same request **once**; on 2nd stall → `parked`!
  5. Rate limit (`429`) → honor provider pacing/backoff WITHOUT counting as worker failure or consuming a step; usage-limit → checkpoint & park cleanly!
  6. Malformed tool call or unknown tool name → send **one** repair message listing validator error / available tools; repeated → `stuck`!
  7. Budget exhaustion → checkpoint & park cleanly (never failing the task!).
- [ ] **Implement Prose-Only & Premature-Done Recovery Nudges ([worker-loop.md](worker-loop.md#edge-cases)):** If the model outputs code blocks in plain prose instead of calling its edit tool, send one concise reminder (repeated → `stuck`); if the model says "I'm done" without calling `harness.submit_candidate`, prompt once to either call `harness.submit_candidate` or call `harness.flag_blocked` stating what's missing!
- [ ] **Implement Boundary Hold, Steer & Park Handling:** Before starting each model call AND between tool calls, check `task_holds`, pending steers (`deliverSteer`), and `pauseAtBoundary`: on a hard hold or user pause, checkpoint immediately and yield cleanly; on an additive/compatible steer, inject the steer notice and require brief acknowledgment before next edit!
- [ ] **Implement Code-Generated Handoff Note Writer (`generateHandoffNote`):** Deterministically generate the structured handoff note stored in `attempt_checkpoints.handoff_artifact` from `turn_log` and events (brief version, steps completed/remaining from working memory, changed files, last check results, last failing check) — ZERO LLM tokens spent!
- [ ] **Run Configured Formatter Strictly At Submit Time:** Right before `harness.submit_candidate` creates the candidate commit (NOT after individual edits!), run the project's declared formatter over modified in-scope paths only, then snapshot and submit!

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **Crash injected at EVERY one of the 4 step boundaries (during model call, pre-tool, mid-tool, pre-log-commit):** Automated crash-injection tests simulate all 4 points and verify `resumeAttemptFromCheckpoint` completes the task with exact final code and zero corrupted `turn_log` step numbers!
- **Model returns 3 parallel tool calls in one assistant message (`read`, `edit`, `run`):** Executor runs them strictly one at a time in order, checking epoch & holds between each, and recording atomic step/substep progress so a crash on tool #2 recovers cleanly!
- **Budget runs out right after Step 12 finishes editing but before `submit_candidate`:** Loop checkpoints Step 12 to `refs/harness/checkpoints/<attempt>/12`, settles exact spent units, writes code-generated handoff note, and transitions cleanly to `PARKED` (zero lost work!).
- **Model tries to call a tool outside `task-packet@1.tools` (e.g., hallucinated `bash` or `web_search`):** Reject with structured tool error listing ONLY actual allowed tools and increment malformed-call counter!
- **Brief changes by contradiction while attempt is paused at Step 8:** On resume, detect `briefChangedContradiction === true`, rebuild a fresh conversation context from the new brief + clearly labeled WIP diff from `wip_ref` instead of replaying contradictory old turns!
- **Worker hits `harness.flag_blocked("Brief rule R17 contradicts test AC-31")`:** Immediately stop cleanly, record `outcome = 'blocked'`, preserve checkpoint, and route to task author (`AskOwner`) without counting as a failed attempt!
- **Worktree has uncommitted garbage left from a hard crash mid-tool:** Resetting to `wip_ref` restores exact clean pre-step files before re-running the step!

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Single Source Of Truth Conversation Invariant:** Full conversation history is ALWAYS reconstructible strictly from `state.db.turn_log` + CAS `items_artifact` — zero reliance on provider-side server session state (`store: false`).
- **One-Turn Maximum Loss Invariant:** Per-step checkpointing bounds worst-case crash/limit/sleep loss to at most the single turn currently in flight.
- **No-Subagents-In-V1 Invariant:** Native worker loop exposes zero recursive agent-spawning tools; all parallelism flows through the kernel scheduler.
- **Atomic Budget Reservation Before Every Model Call Invariant:** Zero model API calls execute without a committed `held` ledger reservation first.
- **Rate-Limit Non-Penalty Invariant:** `429` backoffs never increment step count, stuck counters, or failure calibration metrics.
- **Code-Generated Handoff Invariant:** Handoff notes are 100% deterministic code outputs from `turn_log` and events.

#### Multi-Agent Harmony And Branch Isolation

- **Worktree Setup:** Create branch `task/057-worker-loop-executor-checkpoints` via `node scripts/agent-worktree.mjs create 057 worker-loop-executor-checkpoints`.
- **Strict Subtree Boundary:** Touch ONLY `packages/worker-loop/src/executor/**`, `packages/worker-loop/tests/executor/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-057.md`.
- **Parallel Safe Execution:** Disjoint from `Tasks 053–056` and `Tasks 058–066`.

### Task 058: Static Completeness Gate (`STATIC_AUDIT`) Part 1 — Deterministic Text & AST Scanners (Markers, Stubs, Swallowed Errors, Dead Controls & Elision)

- **Milestone & Track:** `M1 · Completeness Gate & Clean Verification`
- **Depends On:** `Task 001`, `Task 008`, `Task 011`, `Task 035`
- **Git Worktree & Branch:** `task/058-static-audit-scanners-p1` in `../ef-wt/task-058-static-audit-scanners-p1` (commit on own branch only; **NEVER merge**)
- **Owned Write Scope (Disjoint Subtree):** `packages/completeness-gate/src/ast-scanners/**`, `packages/completeness-gate/tests/ast-scanners/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-058.md`
- **Mandatory Reference Files:** [completeness-gate.md](completeness-gate.md#static-audit), [build-pipeline.md](build-pipeline.md#state-machines), [research/static-completeness-checks.md](research/static-completeness-checks.md), [completeness-gate.svg](completeness-gate.svg)
- **Shared Contracts Consumed / Produced:** Consumes `StaticAuditReportSchema` (`Task 008`), `GitRunner` (`Task 035`); produces `StaticAuditAstEngine` covering unfinished markers, stub bodies, swallowed errors, dead UI controls, elision placeholders, and unplanned large deletions

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Build Fast Diff-Scoped Deterministic Scanner Pipeline (`StaticAuditAstEngine`):** Operate strictly on the candidate's changed and newly added files (`git diff --name-status <base> <candidate>`) in seconds of CPU with **ZERO LLM tokens**, emitting visible structured findings (`ruleId`, `severity: 'hard' | 'soft'`, `file`, `line`, `column`, `snippet`, `message`, `remediation`) returned directly to the worker ([completeness-gate.md](completeness-gate.md#static-audit)).
- [ ] **Implement Check 1 — Unfinished Markers Scanner:** Scan code comments and string literals in owned non-test paths for `TODO`, `FIXME`, `XXX`, `HACK`, `"not implemented"`, `"placeholder"`, `"lorem ipsum"` (case-insensitive); allow ONLY exact `TODO(DEF-<id>)` referencing an **active kernel-approved deferral ID** supplied in the audit context (verifying the ID actually exists and is approved, and recording it for the final report!).
- [ ] **Implement Check 2 — Stub Body AST Detector (TypeScript Compiler AST + `ast-grep` rules):** Inspect every exported function/method/handler named in the task's produced contracts: hard-fail trivial stub bodies (returning only a constant literal `null`/`[]`/`{}`/`true`/`0`/`""`, empty body `{}`, or throwing `new Error("not implemented")` / `"TODO"`) UNLESS the contract explicitly declares a constant/empty return!
- [ ] **Implement Check 3 — Swallowed Errors AST Detector:** Hard-fail empty `catch {}`, `catch (e) {}`, `.catch(() => {})`, `.catch(() => null)` where error swallowing violates contract, AND catch blocks that ONLY call `console.log`/`console.error` when the project's error-handling convention (`X-11`) requires surfacing/rethrowing/returning structured errors!
- [ ] **Implement Check 4 — Dead UI Controls AST Detector (JSX/TSX/HTML):** Hard-fail `onClick={() => {}}`, `onChange={() => {}}`, `onSubmit={() => {}}`, `<a href="#">` / `<a href="javascript:void(0)">`, `<button>` with neither `onClick` nor `type="submit"` inside a form, and `<form>` with no `onSubmit` / `action` handler!
- [ ] **Implement Check 5 — Elision Placeholders & Unplanned Large Deletions Detector:** Hard-fail truncated-file markers (`// ... existing code ...`, `// ... rest of file ...`, `/* unchanged */`, `# ...`) AND detect high deletion ratios (e.g., `>50%` of an existing file deleted when the task brief did not declare a deletion/removal task!).
- [ ] **Implement Soft-Finding Complexity & Special-Casing Signals:** Compute advisory soft findings recorded in the receipt (and triggering `reviewer@1` on high-risk tasks): (a) diff dramatically smaller than task size estimate, (b) cyclomatic complexity far below the count of rules/branches in the task's `MUST` list, and (c) suspicious `if (input === "<visible_example_literal>")` branches matching literals from visible acceptance examples!
- [ ] **Implement Graceful Language Fallback Reporting:** Provide full AST scanning for TypeScript/JavaScript/TSX/JSX (plus `ast-grep` patterns for Python/Go/Rust where configured); for unsupported languages lacking AST grammars, still execute text/regex + type/build scans and explicitly set `coverageMode: 'reduced_text_only'` in `StaticAuditReport` ([completeness-gate.md](completeness-gate.md#edge-cases))!

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **Legitimate deferral comment `// TODO(DEF-12): swap SMTP provider in v2` vs fake `// TODO(DEF-999)`:** Scanner verifies `DEF-12` against `auditContext.approvedDeferralIds`: approved `DEF-12` passes (and is logged for the landing report); unapproved `DEF-999` or bare `TODO` HARD-FAILS!
- **Legitimate empty catch with an explicit documented ignore comment ONLY where allowed vs swallowed error:** Ensure test files / declared cleanup helpers don't false-positive while production handlers strictly fail empty catches!
- **Legitimate placeholder attribute `<input placeholder="Enter dish name" />` in React JSX:** Unfinished-marker scanner MUST NOT false-positive on valid HTML/JSX `placeholder="..."` attribute names, while STILL catching `<p>Placeholder text</p>` or `"Lorem ipsum"` values!
- **Arrow function stub `export const computeTotals = () => [];` vs legitimate constant enum export `export const EMPTY_TOTALS = [] as const;`:** Cross-reference exported symbol names against the task's `produces` contract operations/functions so real constants don't trigger stub false positives while stubbed contract functions ALWAYS hard-fail!
- **Worker puts `TODO` inside a template literal or multi-line JSDoc comment:** AST comment + string-literal walker catches single-line, multi-line, JSDoc, and string occurrences cleanly.
- **Generated code paths (`prisma/client`, `src/generated/**`) or seed/fixture paths (`tests/fixtures/**`, `prisma/seed.ts`):** Honor declared `excludedGeneratedPaths` and `seedFixturePaths` from project conventions (derived from the plan, NEVER worker-declared!) so generated files don't cause false failures!
- **Repeated identical static audit failure fingerprint (`3×` same fingerprint):** Compute deterministic fingerprint per hard-finding set so `Task 021`/`Task 065` escalates a stuck worker repeating the exact same static violation 3 times without treating static audits as clean-verification retries ([completeness-gate.md](completeness-gate.md#static-audit))!

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Zero-Token Speed Invariant:** Complete `STATIC_AUDIT` Part 1 executes deterministically in milliseconds to seconds using zero LLM tokens.
- **Plan-Owned Exemptions Only Invariant:** Approved deferral IDs, generated paths, and seed/fixture exclusions come strictly from the kernel's plan/conventions—a worker can NEVER exempt its own diff!

- **Deterministic Fingerprint Invariant:** Identical hard-finding sets always produce identical failure fingerprints for 3× loop escalation.

### Task 060: Clean Verifier Execution Harness (Immutable Checkout, Protected Expectation Materialization, Zero-Test Rejection & Immutable Receipts)

- **Milestone & Track:** `M1 · Completeness Gate & Clean Verification`
- **Depends On:** `Task 001`, `Task 008`, `Task 021`, `Task 028`, `Task 038`, `Task 047`, `Task 049`, `Task 059`
- **Git Worktree & Branch:** `task/060-clean-verifier-harness` in `../ef-wt/task-060-clean-verifier-harness` (commit on own branch only; **NEVER merge**)
- **Owned Write Scope (Disjoint Subtree):** `packages/verifier/src/runner/**`, `packages/verifier/tests/runner/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-060.md`
- **Mandatory Reference Files:** [verification-and-isolation.md](verification-and-isolation.md#independent-acceptance), [verification-for-real-apps.md](verification-for-real-apps.md), [completeness-gate.md](completeness-gate.md), [schema/state.sql](schema/state.sql), [research/testing-real-apps.md](research/testing-real-apps.md), [verification-for-real-apps.svg](verification-for-real-apps.svg)
- **Shared Contracts Consumed / Produced:** Consumes `WorktreeSlotManager` (`Task 038`), `TestEnvOrchestrator` (`Task 049`), `HarnessRunEngine` (`Task 047`), `CompletenessGateRunner` (`Task 059`), `CasBlobStore` (`Task 028`); produces `CleanVerifierRunner` (`verifyCandidate`, `materializeProtectedExpectations`, `parseCollectedCaseIds`, `writeImmutableReceipt`)

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Implement Strict Clean-Checkout Verification Pipeline (`CleanVerifierRunner.verifyCandidate`):** Never execute acceptance checks inside the worker's dirty attempt worktree! Check out the candidate's exact immutable `commit_sha` into a **separate clean verifier worktree slot**, attach locked dependencies from the read-only shared store, provision a fresh Tier 0–3 test environment (`Task 049`) isolated completely from the worker's environment, and run ONLY AFTER `CompletenessGateRunner.runLeafStaticAudit` passes!
- [ ] **Implement Protected Expectation Materialization & Fingerprint Verification:** Materialize locked visible checks, sealed held-back checks (decrypted ONLY inside the clean verifier's private host/verifier process — NEVER exposed into the worker worktree!), pinned test runner config, and binder files directly from harness CAS/SQLite storage; verify SHA-256 fingerprints of runner, command, config, and expectation files against the dispatch-time fingerprints before running ([verification-and-isolation.md](verification-and-isolation.md#independent-acceptance))!
- [ ] **Keep Expectation Comparison Outside The Candidate Process:** Run the candidate under test inside the sandboxed attempt/verifier environment and collect raw structured observations over a host-owned channel; perform the authoritative `observed === expected` comparison and receipt generation inside trusted kernel code **outside the candidate's write surface** so compromised product code can NEVER forge a pass receipt!
- [ ] **Enforce Mandatory Collected-IDs & Zero-Test Rejection Rule:** Parse structured test reporter JSON (Vitest JSON, Playwright JSON, JUnit/TAP, or custom oracle harness output) and verify that EVERY required `check_id` linked to the task's requirements (INCLUDING all in-scope cross-cutting rule checks `X-01`–`X-14`!) was ACTUALLY collected and reported `status === 'pass'`. Exit code `0` with `0` collected tests, a skipped case (`status = 'skip'`), or a missing check ID (`status = 'missing'`) MUST FAIL verification ([verification-and-isolation.md](verification-and-isolation.md#independent-acceptance), [completeness-gate.md](completeness-gate.md))!
- [ ] **Implement Failure Attribution Classifier (`attributeVerificationFailure`):** Classify every non-pass outcome into one of the 5 distinct root owners from [architecture.md](architecture.md#6-verify-the-feature-independently) & [verification-and-isolation.md](verification-and-isolation.md): `implementation` (worker defect → hint ladder), `contract_mismatch` (visible contract missing → plain message, doesn't burn hidden ladder), `binding_defect` (binder crash/missing setup → task author), `environment` (service crash / OOM / port failure → env owner, **excluded from worker pass-rate calibration!**), or `flaky_test` (clean replay disagrees with first run → test owner, check stays unresolved!).
- [ ] **Implement Clean-State Flake Detection Re-Run:** For time/network/browser checks that fail non-deterministically (or when flagged flaky), run a clean replay in a fresh isolated environment with fixed clock & seed; if Run 1 and Run 2 disagree, record BOTH runs + traces as `'unstable'`, route to test owner, and keep the requirement unresolved (NEVER silently accepting a flaky pass!).
- [ ] **Write Immutable Verification Receipts (`check_results` + CAS Evidence Promotion):** Record `(check_id, attempt, check_version, artifact_digest, status, receipt, recorded_at)` in `state.db.check_results`, store full run log/trace/observations in CAS with `retention = 'evidence'` (if accepted) or `'diagnostic'` (if failed), and stamp exact `sandboxTier` + `commit_sha` + `checkVersions`!
- [ ] **Verify Clean Teardown Of Verifier Environment & Sealed Files:** Unconditionally shred/delete materialized held-back expectation files from temp directories and call `env.destroy()` in `finally` so hidden test inputs NEVER linger on disk!

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **Product code monkey-patches `process.exit(0)` inside a unit test to fake a green exit code:** Because `CleanVerifierRunner` parses required `check_id` results collected outside the candidate process, `exitCode === 0` with 0 collected required IDs IMMEDIATELY FAILS with `MissingRequiredChecksError(missingIds)` ([architecture-review-decisions.md](architecture-review-decisions.md))!
- **Candidate attempts to read materialized held-back expectation files during execution:** Held-back expectation data stays strictly in the trusted host verifier process memory (never written inside the sandboxed worktree's readable paths!); only input payloads pass into the sandboxed target!
- **Worker passed all visible tests and failed 1 held-back test:** `CleanVerifierRunner` MUST redact the raw hidden input/expected values from the worker-facing error payload and pass the raw failure ONLY into the Hint Ladder (`Task 065`)!
- **Backing Postgres crashes midway through verifier run (environment failure):** Attribution tags it `'environment'`, retries/holds for env recovery, and explicitly sets `affectsWorkerQualityScore: false` so the worker model isn't unfairly downgraded!
- **Candidate depends on a cross-cutting rule (`X-03` timezone) whose check was accidentally omitted from the worker's local run:** Verifier pulls the full required check list directly from `state.db` (`task_requirements` + in-scope cross-cutting rules!) and runs `X-03`'s check automatically!
- **Verifier run takes 4 minutes while original attempt lease TTL was 3 minutes:** Because `accept_submission` (`Task 021`) set `submission_pending = 1`, the attempt's lease is protected cleanly during slow browser/migration verification!
- **Candidate modifies `package.json` test script to `echo "all passed"`:** Verifier ignores untrusted candidate `package.json` test scripts for protected checks and executes the pinned verifier command/runner fingerprinted at dispatch!

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Zero-Trust Candidate Process Invariant:** Expectation comparison, required-ID verification, and receipt signing ALWAYS occur outside the candidate process and outside the worker's write scope.
- **No-Zero-Test-Pass Invariant:** Passing exit code with missing or skipped required check IDs NEVER yields `'pass'`.
- **Clean-Checkout Separation Invariant:** Verification ALWAYS runs against a fresh checkout of `commit_sha` in a dedicated verifier slot and fresh Tier 0–3 environment—never reusing the worker's dirty worktree or DB.
- **Hidden-Input Non-Leakage Invariant:** Raw held-back inputs and expected values NEVER appear in worker-visible logs, worktree files, or stderr summaries.
- **Environment-Failure Fairness Invariant:** Environment crashes and flaky tests NEVER count against worker model pass-rate calibration or burn worker retry attempts.
- **Fingerprint-Before-Run Invariant:** Any mismatch in protected test/config/runner SHA-256 rejects verification with `VerifierIntegrityError` before running candidate code.

#### Multi-Agent Harmony And Branch Isolation

- **Worktree Setup:** Create branch `task/060-clean-verifier-harness` via `node scripts/agent-worktree.mjs create 060 clean-verifier-harness`.
- **Strict Subtree Boundary:** Touch ONLY `packages/verifier/src/runner/**`, `packages/verifier/tests/runner/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-060.md`.
- **Parallel Safe Execution:** Disjoint from `Task 061` (red-before-green & blind binder), `Tasks 062–064` (specialized surface verifiers), `Task 065` (hint ladder), and `Task 066` (acceptance transaction).
- **Handoff For `Tasks 061–066`, `Task 068` (M1 Exit Gate), `Task 173` (Human Fix):** Export `CleanVerifierRunner`, `VerificationOutcome`, `FailureAttribution`, and `SurfaceVerifierAdapter` interface in `.agent-handoffs/task-060.md`.
- **Commit-Only Discipline:** Commit exclusively on `task/060-clean-verifier-harness`; **NEVER merge** into `main` or `harness/integration`.
- **Pluggable Surface Verifiers:** Accept surface-specific verifiers (UI Playwright, API OpenAPI, Auth, CLI, Migration, AI Eval) via `SurfaceVerifierAdapter` registry so `Tasks 062–064` plug in cleanly without editing `runner/`.

- [ ] Verify flake-replay test detects Run-1 fail / Run-2 pass disagreement, marks `'unstable'`, and leaves requirement unresolved.
