- **Owned Write Scope (Disjoint Subtree):** `packages/planner/src/scheduler/**`, `packages/planner/tests/scheduler/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-107.md`
- **Mandatory Reference Files:** [planning-and-crew.md](planning-and-crew.md#scheduling-and-crew-presets), [execution-capacity.md](execution-capacity.md), [schema/state.sql](schema/state.sql), [planning-and-crew.mmd](planning-and-crew.mmd), [planning-and-crew.svg](planning-and-crew.svg), [research/planning-and-crew-scheduling.md](research/planning-and-crew-scheduling.md)
- **Shared Contracts Consumed / Produced:** Consumes `TaskClaimManager` (`Task 020`), `TaskHoldsManager` (`Task 021`), `DeterministicGraphCompiler` (`Task 092`), `ExpectedCostLevelSelector` (`Task 106`); produces `HeftCriticalPathScheduler`, `WaveParallelismCalculator`, `CrewPresetProfileEngine`, and `DynamicScheduleRebalancer`

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Implement HEFT Upward-Rank Critical-Path List Scheduler (`HeftCriticalPathScheduler`):** Compute deterministic **HEFT upward rank** (`rank_u(t) = avg_exec_time(t) + max_{s in succ(t)} (comm_delay(t, s) + rank_u(s))`) over the compiled task + feature DAG in `< 10 ms`, prioritizing highest-`rank_u` ready tasks first so critical-path bottlenecks NEVER sit behind low-priority cosmetic leaves while idle worker slots are available!
- [ ] **Implement Multi-Constraint Wave Parallelism Calculator (`WaveParallelismCalculator`):** Compute safe effective concurrency `W_eff = min(dag_disjoint_width, hardware_pool_cap, provider_pacing_cap, worktree_slot_cap, user_preset_cap)` — guaranteeing the scheduler NEVER launches more concurrent workers than the DAG's disjoint write scopes (`Task 092`), Hardware Governor (`Task 118`–`119`), or Provider Pacing (`Task 140`) can cleanly sustain!
- [ ] **Implement Exact 3 User-Facing Crew Presets (`CrewPresetProfileEngine`):** Expose clean, plain-English build presets in Plan Preview (`Task 108`) and mid-build controls:
  1. **`Fastest`:** Maximizes `W_eff` up to hardware/provider ceiling, assigns higher first-pass-probability Senior/Principal models to critical-path tasks to minimize retry latency, and pre-warms Wave `N+1` JIT architecture early!
  2. **`Balanced` (Default):** Uses expected-cost-optimal levels (`Task 106`), assigns Senior to critical-path/complex tasks and Junior/Mid to parallel non-critical leaves, and caps parallelism at smooth laptop-friendly utilization!
  3. **`Cheapest`:** Minimizes total `E[cost]` strictly (still honoring `Task 106` safety floors & retry escalation!), maximizes prompt-cache locality by batching same-feature sibling tasks, and prefers subscription-window pacing (`Task 140`) before any paid API spend!
- [ ] **Implement Explicit-Requirement Priority Boost & Starvation Prevention:** Combine HEFT `rank_u` with an explicit-decision boost (so user-explicit features finish ahead of optional defaulted polish) AND an aging term preventing long-waiting ready tasks from starving across waves!
- [ ] **Implement Dynamic Runtime Rebalancer (`DynamicScheduleRebalancer`):** Reactively recompute `rank_u` and dispatch assignments whenever live conditions shift mid-wave: (1) a task hits a retry/escalation (`exec_time` spikes → its branch becomes the new critical path!), (2) a task enters `task_holds` (`Task 021` → immediately fills its freed worker slot with the next highest-rank unheld disjoint task!), (3) Hardware Governor shifts `Green → Yellow/Orange` (`Task 118` → gracefully scales down active concurrency without killing in-flight turns!), or (4) Provider Pacing throttles one connection (`Task 140` → smoothly routes eligible tasks to unthrottled authorized connections, NEVER violating `Task 141` no-silent-paid-fallback)!
- [ ] **Implement Parallel Multi-Feature Wave Dispatch:** Upgrade M2's sequential runner (`Task 095`) to dispatch multiple disjoint leaf tasks simultaneously across multiple active Wave features (`harness/f/<feat-A>`, `harness/f/<feat-B>`) while preserving strict per-feature worktree isolation (`Task 038`) and write-scope disjointness!
- [ ] **Implement Projected Makespan & Wall-Clock Estimator:** Output accurate `{ criticalPathMinutes, parallelSpeedupFactor, activeSlotsByTime }` directly from HEFT schedules so Plan Preview (`Task 108`) shows honest wall-clock estimates (e.g., `"~12–18 min with 4 parallel workers vs ~45 min sequential"`)!
- [ ] **Implement Live Preset Switching Mid-Build:** Allow the user to switch `Fastest ↔ Balanced ↔ Cheapest` mid-build — applying cleanly to all newly claimed tasks and next retries without aborting in-flight turns!

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **Critical-path task `T-Auth` is placed on `task_holds` waiting for a user reply while 3 disjoint UI/Data tasks are ready:** `DynamicScheduleRebalancer` immediately promotes the unheld disjoint tasks into open worker slots instead of stalling the entire wave!
- **Two parallel features `F-Menu` and `F-Orders` both have ready leaf tasks, while Hardware Governor enters `Orange` (max 1 active run slot):** `WaveParallelismCalculator` shrinks `W_eff` to `1` immediately, letting the higher-`rank_u` critical-path task finish while smoothly queueing the other until pressure drops!
- **Task `T-C` on a previously short branch hits Hint 2 retry and suddenly dominates makespan:** Rebalancer recomputes `rank_u`, upgrades `T-C` priority, and escalates its model tier (`Task 106`) so the wave tail doesn't drag!
- **DAG is a pure linear chain (`T1 → T2 → T3 → T4`) with `dag_disjoint_width = 1`:** Even under `Fastest` preset, `WaveParallelismCalculator` caps `W_eff = 1` and truthfully reports `"Sequential dependency chain — 1 worker active"` instead of claiming fake 4× parallelism!
- **All connected providers except one paid API hit 5-hour allowance limit while user did NOT approve paid fallback:** Scheduler parks cleanly with `"Waiting for reset / Switch connection"` (`Task 128`/`141`) instead of routing silently to the paid API!
- **User switches `Fastest → Cheapest` while 4 workers are mid-turn:** Running 4 turns finish cleanly without wasting in-flight tokens; new claims immediately adopt `Cheapest` levels and caps!
- **500-task DAG triggers rebalance on every task completion:** Incremental HEFT recomputation runs in `< 10 ms` (`O(V + E)`), keeping daemon scheduling latency negligible!

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Strict Multi-Constraint Concurrency Invariant:** Active workers NEVER exceed `min(dag_disjoint_width, hardware_cap, pacing_cap, slot_cap, preset_cap)`.
- **HEFT Critical-Path Priority Invariant:** Unheld critical-path tasks always claim freed slots ahead of lower-rank non-critical tasks.
- **Zero-Starvation Invariant:** Every unheld ready task eventually claims a slot via monotonic aging + completion progress.
- **No-Abort-On-Preset-Switch Invariant:** Switching presets or governor levels mid-build drains cleanly at turn boundaries rather than killing active tokens mid-generation.
- **Sub-10ms Rebalance Invariant:** HEFT upward-rank calculation + dispatch selection executes in `< 10 ms` on 500-task graphs.
- **Disjoint-Concurrent-Claim Invariant:** No two simultaneously dispatched tasks ever violate `Task 092`'s disjoint write-scope or active `path_leases` sweep locks (`Task 020`).

#### Multi-Agent Harmony And Branch Isolation

- **Worktree Setup:** Create branch `task/107-heft-scheduler-crew-presets` via `node scripts/agent-worktree.mjs create 107 heft-scheduler-crew-presets`.
- **Strict Subtree Boundary:** Touch ONLY `packages/planner/src/scheduler/**`, `packages/planner/tests/scheduler/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-107.md`.
- **Parallel Safe Execution:** Disjoint from `Task 106` (`src/crew-levels/**`), `Task 108` (`src/plan-preview/**`), and `Task 119` (`packages/governor/src/capacity-pools/**`).
- **Handoff For `Task 108` (Plan Preview Presets & Wall-Clock Estimates), `Task 119` (Governor Pool Limits), `Task 134` (M3 `>= 2×` Parallel Exit Gate), `Task 140` (Pacing Cap Feed):** Export `HeftCriticalPathScheduler`, `WaveParallelismCalculator`, `CrewPresetProfileEngine`, and `DynamicScheduleRebalancer` in `.agent-handoffs/task-107.md`.
- **Commit-Only Discipline:** Commit exclusively on `task/107-heft-scheduler-crew-presets`; **NEVER merge** into `main` or `harness/integration`.
- **Discrete-Event Simulation Tests:** Simulate 50-task and 500-task DAGs proving HEFT achieves `>= 2×` speedup over sequential M2 on Kitchen-shaped graphs and strictly beats naive FIFO scheduling!

- **Milestone & Track:** `M3 · Transparent Plan Preview & Revision Auto-Start`

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Implement Honest Split Plan Preview Builder (`PlanPreviewBuilder`):** Assemble a crisp, truthful pre-build summary explicitly separating **CONCRETE PLANNED WORK** from **COARSE PROJECTED WORK** ([planning-and-crew.md](planning-and-crew.md)):
  - **Planned Now (Exact Compiled Tasks):** Phase 0 (`P0.1`–`P0.8`) + Wave 1 exact leaf tasks, exact assigned crew levels (`Junior`/`Mid`/`Senior`), exact write scopes, exact estimated cost (`micro-USD` or `ppm` window %) and HEFT wall-clock estimate!
  - **Projected Later (Explicit Ranges — NEVER Fake Precision!):** Waves `2..K` + Completion Wave presented strictly as honest feature summaries with low–high task/cost/time ranges (e.g., `"Wave 2: Admin & Catering Email — ~6–9 tasks, ~$0.60–$1.10 (planned in detail after Wave 1 finishes)"`)!
- [ ] **Include Complete Paperwork Breakdown & Delegated/Deferred Transparency:** Show exact `<= 20%` paperwork envelope breakdown (`Research 3% · Arch 5% · Plan/Oracles 6% · Integration/Review 4% · Audit 2%`), live `Chosen for you` count (`Task 073`, clickable to review/override any delegated/defaulted choice BEFORE building!), and any bounded deferred items (`Task 074`)!
- [ ] **Implement Interactive Pre-Build Plan Editor (`InteractivePlanEditor`):** Let the developer interactively tweak the preview before clicking **Start build** with instant zero-LLM recomputation (`< 30 ms`):
  - Switch crew preset (`Fastest` / `Balanced` / `Cheapest`) with immediate cost/time delta preview
  - Override assigned model/tier on a specific feature or critical task (respecting `Task 106` safety floors!)
  - Reorder optional wave priorities, defer a non-prerequisite Wave 2 feature out of v1 scope, or adjust budget cap / spend guard!
- [ ] **Enforce Mandatory First-Build Explicit Approval Gate (`FirstBuildApprovalGate`):** Hard-enforce the non-negotiable owner rule from [open-design-questions.md](open-design-questions.md): **a project's FIRST build ALWAYS stops at Plan Preview and waits for an explicit developer click on `Start build` — NEVER auto-starting regardless of how small the project is!**
- [ ] **Implement Exact Revision Auto-Start Policy (`RevisionAutoStartPolicy`):** For **subsequent** small mid-build/post-build revisions (`Task 087`) ONLY, evaluate deterministic auto-start eligibility using the exact owner defaults from [open-design-questions.md](open-design-questions.md) (all configurable in Settings, with strict safety ceilings!):
  - **Size & Cost Thresholds (ALL must hold):** `deltaTasks <= 5` AND `deltaCost <= $1.00 (1_000_000 micro-USD)` AND `deltaPlanWindow <= 2% (20_000 ppm)`!
  - **Rolling 24-Hour Auto-Start Daily Cap:** Cumulative auto-started spend within rolling 24h strictly `<= $5.00` OR `<= 10%` of plan window (whichever applies to the active connection!) — exceeding the daily cap forces explicit approval!
  - **Zero Hard-Stop Triggers (ANY one forces Plan Preview approval even for a 1-task `$0.10` change!):**
    1. Any unresolved `must_ask` criterion or `conflict`!
    2. Any **breaking** contract/API/schema change (`Task 087`/`112`)!
    3. Any **destructive** DB migration (`DROP`/`ALTER` narrowing/data delete)!
    4. Any **new external dependency** (`package.json` addition requiring `Task 048`)!
    5. Any **external side effect** (push, PR, deploy, live webhook/email registration, secret mutation)!
- [ ] **Implement 10-Second Undoable Auto-Start Toast / Cancel Grace Window:** When a tiny revision qualifies for auto-start, emit a visible non-intrusive `"Auto-starting 2-task fix (~$0.22) — Pause / Review"` banner with a 5-second pause affordance AND full entry in the Build Cockpit timeline!
- [ ] **Implement Cost-Honesty Labeling For API vs Subscription Plans:** Display API connections clearly as `"Estimated ~$X.XX (from published token rates)"` and subscription connections clearly as `"Estimated ~X% of 5-hour allowance"` (NEVER showing misleading dollar estimates for flat-rate subscriptions or promising exact penny accuracy!).
- [ ] **Implement Plan Snapshot Diffing On Revision Approval:** When a revision DOES require approval, show a crisp **Before → After Plan Delta** (`+3 tasks`, `1 task re-verified`, `+$0.85`, `"Adds new dependency: date-fns"`) explaining the EXACT reason approval was requested!

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **Brand-new tiny 2-task CLI project (`$0.15` estimated) finishes Discovery & Planning:** `FirstBuildApprovalGate` STILL waits for explicit **Start build** click (NEVER auto-starts first build!).
- **User makes a tiny 1-task `$0.20` revision that adds a new npm package `chart.js`:** `new_dependency` hard-stop trigger blocks auto-start and opens Plan Preview with `"Needs approval: adds new package 'chart.js'"`!
- **User makes 6 consecutive tiny `$0.90` auto-start tweaks in one afternoon (`6 × $0.90 = $5.40 > $5.00` daily cap):** Tweaks 1–5 auto-start cleanly; Tweak 6 hits the `$5.00` rolling 24h cap and pauses for explicit confirmation!
- **User makes a 2-task `$0.30` revision that renames an existing DB column (destructive migration):** `destructive_migration` hard-stop trigger blocks auto-start immediately!
- **User switches preset from `Balanced` to `Cheapest` inside Plan Preview:** Live cost/time numbers recompute locally in `< 30 ms` with zero LLM calls and update exact Wave 1 task tiers!
- **User tries to defer Feature `F-Auth` while Wave 2 `F-Orders` depends on `F-Auth`:** `InteractivePlanEditor` detects the dependency constraint and shows `"Required by Orders — defer both or keep Auth"` instead of creating a broken graph!
- **User inspects `Chosen for you` in Plan Preview and overrides 1 delegated choice (`"Use Magic Link instead of Email+Password"`):** Plan Preview cleanly routes the override into `Task 087` revision, updates impacted tasks, and refreshes the preview before build start!

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **First-Build-Always-Explicit Invariant:** No project's initial build can EVER auto-start without an explicit developer `Start build` approval.
- **Exact Auto-Start Safety Envelope Invariant:** Auto-start requires `deltaTasks <= 5 && deltaCost <= $1 && deltaWindow <= 2%`, rolling 24h cap `<= $5 / <= 10%`, AND ZERO must-ask, breaking contract, destructive migration, new dependency, or external effect triggers.
- **Planned-vs-Projected Honesty Invariant:** Wave 1 shows exact compiled tasks; Waves `2+` ALWAYS display honest min–max ranges labeled `Projected`.
- **Zero-Hidden-Delegation Invariant:** Every `delegated`/`defaulted` choice and deferred item is surfaced visibly in Plan Preview prior to build start.
- **Instant Local Preset-Recalc Invariant:** Interactive preset/order edits in Plan Preview run deterministically in `< 30 ms` with 0 LLM calls.
- **Honest Currency Labeling Invariant:** API plans show estimated USD; subscription plans show estimated window `%`, never fabricated billing claims.

### Task 109: Artifact-Based Agent Handoff Engine (`harness.read_result`, Pinned Bases/Slices, Durable Role Mailbox, Wait-Graph Cycle Detector & Owner Resolution)

- **Milestone & Track:** `M3 · Inter-Agent Handoffs & Deadlock Freedom`
- **Depends On:** `Task 001`, `Task 017`, `Task 021`, `Task 028`, `Task 049`, `Task 088`
- **Git Worktree & Branch:** `task/109-artifact-handoff-mailbox-engine` in `../ef-wt/task-109-artifact-handoff-mailbox-engine` (commit on own branch only; **NEVER merge**)
- **Owned Write Scope (Disjoint Subtree):** `packages/integrator/src/handoffs/**`, `packages/integrator/tests/handoffs/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-109.md`
- **Mandatory Reference Files:** [agent-handoffs.md](agent-handoffs.md), [agent-graph-routing.md](agent-graph-routing.md), [schema/state.sql](schema/state.sql), [agent-handoffs.mmd](agent-handoffs.mmd), [agent-handoffs.svg](agent-handoffs.svg), [agent-graph-routing.mmd](agent-graph-routing.mmd), [research/agent-control-protocols.md](research/agent-control-protocols.md)
- **Shared Contracts Consumed / Produced:** Consumes `KnowledgeGraphRepo` (`Task 017`), `TaskHoldsManager` (`Task 021`), `CasBlobStore` (`Task 028`), `LeasedMcpServer` (`Task 049`), `KnowledgePacketSlicer` (`Task 088`); produces `ArtifactHandoffStore`, `ReadResultToolHandler`, `DurableRoleMailbox`, `WaitGraphCycleDetector`, and `OwnerResolutionCoordinator`

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Implement Strict Artifact-Based Handoffs (`ArtifactHandoffStore`) — ZERO Free-Form Agent-to-Agent Chat:** Persist every handoff between agents (Planner → Worker, Worker → Verifier, Leaf → Feature Integrator, Feature → Merge Queue, Worker → Contract Owner) as an immutable, schema-validated, content-addressed **Handoff Artifact** in `state.db` + CAS (`Task 028`) carrying `{ handoffId, fromRole, toRole, artifactType, pinnedBaseCommitSha, pinnedSliceSha256, schemaVersion, summaryJson, blobSha256, createdAt }` — preventing telephone-game drift, hidden prompts, or lost context across restarts!
- [ ] **Implement Bounded `harness.read_result(handoff_id, range?)` MCP Tool (`ReadResultToolHandler`):** Let downstream agents inspect ONLY authorized upstream handoff artifacts (strictly scoped by graph dependency edges and blinded against sealed hidden checks!) with bounded byte/token pagination (`<= 16 KB` per read) and structured manifest previews so workers never pull huge raw logs when they only need a summary!
- [ ] **Implement Pinned Base Commit & Pinned Slice Immutability Guard:** Bind every handoff and active attempt explicitly to its `(pinnedBaseCommitSha, pinnedSliceSha256)`; if an upstream artifact is superseded while a downstream agent is waiting, clearly stamp `superseded_by` on the old handoff and wake the downstream consumer with the fresh artifact version rather than mutating artifacts in place!
- [ ] **Implement Durable Role Mailbox (`DurableRoleMailbox`):** Persist typed asynchronous inter-role requests (e.g., `ContractClarificationRequest`, `SharedTypeAdditionRequest`, `IntegrationConflictHandoff`, `VerificationDispute`) in `state.db.role_mailbox` addressed strictly to canonical **Roles / Feature Owners** (never ephemeral worker PIDs!) so crashes, restarts, or worker replacement (`Task 150`) NEVER lose an in-flight request!
- [ ] **Implement Deterministic Wait-Graph Cycle Detector (`WaitGraphCycleDetector`):** Whenever Task/Role `A` blocks waiting on a mailbox request or artifact owned by Task/Role `B` (`waits_on(A → B)`), immediately run `O(V + E)` DFS cycle detection across ALL active `waits_on` + `depends_on` edges BEFORE committing the wait state: if adding `A → B` creates a cycle (`A → B → A` or `A → B → C → A`), **HARD-REJECT the deadlock**, record a structured `WaitGraphDeadlockBreak`, and automatically escalate the minimal cycle to the Coordinator / Contract Owner (or developer if human decision needed)!
- [ ] **Implement Owner-First Resolution Coordinator (`OwnerResolutionCoordinator`):** Resolve inter-agent dependency questions strictly through the canonical owner registered in `state.db` (`Task 083` single-contract-owner invariant!): if Worker `W-Orders` needs a missing field on `MenuItem`, its mailbox request routes strictly to `owner(MenuItem)` (or `Task 112` CCR pipeline!) — `W-Orders` NEVER chats sideways with `W-Menu` or edits `MenuItem` files out of scope!
- [ ] **Implement Mailbox TTL, Deduplication & Escalation Guard:** Deduplicate identical open requests for the same `(targetOwner, contractId, questionHash)` into one canonical request with multiple subscribed waiters; if an owner cannot resolve within bounded time/turns (or is itself blocked), escalate deterministically to Coordinator / User Inbox (`Task 116`)!
- [ ] **Implement Full Handoff Audit Trail For Inspector & Post-Mortems:** Expose exact handoff lineage (`Planner → T-1 → Verifier → Integrator → Merge Queue`) queryable by `Task 126` Worker Inspector and `Task 133` Diagnostics!

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **Worker `W-A` waits on `W-B` (`MenuItem` contract) while `W-B` simultaneously files a wait request on `W-A` (`Order` contract):** `WaitGraphCycleDetector` detects `W-A → W-B → W-A` synchronously BEFORE persisting the second wait, breaks the deadlock immediately, and routes both to Coordinator / `Task 112` CCR arbitration!
- **Owner worker `W-Owner` crashes mid-turn while 2 downstream tasks have pending messages in `DurableRoleMailbox`:** Because mailbox messages address canonical **roles/owners** in SQLite (not ephemeral PIDs), replacement worker `W-Owner-2` picks up the exact pending requests cleanly after restart!
- **Downstream worker calls `harness.read_result('HO-ORACLE-99')` trying to peek at a sealed hidden-check artifact:** Authorization check verifies `artifactType !== 'sealed_oracle'` AND verifies a valid dependency path; returns indistinguishable `NOT_FOUND`!
- **Three parallel tasks all ask the same missing-field question to `owner(Order)`:** Mailbox deduplicator merges all 3 into ONE request with `waiters: [T1, T2, T3]` and wakes all 3 atomically when the single answer arrives!
- **Upstream artifact `HO-1` is superseded by `HO-2` after a revision (`Task 087`):** `HO-1` remains immutable in CAS for historical audit while `HO-2` links `supersedes: HO-1` and notifies waiting subscribers!
- **Handoff artifact payload is a 2 MB test trace:** `ReadResultToolHandler` serves a crisp 2 KB structured summary by default and requires explicit byte-range pagination (`offset`, `limit <= 16 KB`) so worker context stays protected!
- **Worker attempts to send an unvalidated free-form chat message directly to another worker:** No free-form peer-chat tool exists in the MCP surface — ONLY typed schema-validated mailbox/handoff artifacts are accepted!

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Zero-Free-Form-Agent-Chat Invariant:** Agents communicate exclusively through schema-validated immutable handoff artifacts and typed durable role-mailbox entries.
- **Deadlock-Free Wait-Graph Invariant:** Every persisted wait edge passes `O(V + E)` cycle detection against `(waits_on ∪ depends_on)` before commit.
- **Immutable-Pinned-Handoff Invariant:** Handoff artifacts are write-once in CAS pinned to `(baseCommitSha, sliceSha256)`; updates create new versioned superseding artifacts.
- **Role-Addressed Durability Invariant:** Mailbox items target canonical roles/owners in `state.db`, surviving daemon crashes and worker replacements with zero dropped messages.
- **Strict-Authorization & Oracle-Blindness Invariant:** `harness.read_result` strictly enforces graph lineage access and never exposes sealed hidden checks.
- **Bounded-Read Invariant:** Every `harness.read_result` call enforces `<= 16 KB` pagination ceilings.

#### Multi-Agent Harmony And Branch Isolation

- **Worktree Setup:** Create branch `task/109-artifact-handoff-mailbox-engine` via `node scripts/agent-worktree.mjs create 109 artifact-handoff-mailbox-engine`.

### Task 110: Parallel Feature Branch Manager, Dependency/Migration Intent Aggregator (Timestamp+Hash Migrations + Conflict Lint) & Smart Feature Branch Freshness Sync

- **Milestone & Track:** `M3 · Parallel Feature Branching & Migration Hygiene`
- **Depends On:** `Task 001`, `Task 038`, `Task 039`, `Task 048`, `Task 096`
- **Git Worktree & Branch:** `task/110-parallel-feature-branches-migrations` in `../ef-wt/task-110-parallel-feature-branches-migrations` (commit on own branch only; **NEVER merge**)
- **Owned Write Scope (Disjoint Subtree):** `packages/integrator/src/feature-branches/**`, `packages/integrator/tests/feature-branches/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-110.md`
- **Mandatory Reference Files:** [parallel-feature-integration.md](parallel-feature-integration.md), [workspace-and-git.md](workspace-and-git.md), [build-pipeline.md](build-pipeline.md), [parallel-feature-integration.mmd](parallel-feature-integration.mmd), [parallel-feature-integration.svg](parallel-feature-integration.svg), [workspace-git-and-brownfield.mmd](workspace-git-and-brownfield.mmd), [research/git-worktrees-and-workspaces.md](research/git-worktrees-and-workspaces.md)
- **Shared Contracts Consumed / Produced:** Consumes `WorktreeSlotPool` (`Task 038`), `RefLeaseAndCasManager` (`Task 039`), `KernelPackageInstaller` (`Task 048`), `FeatureIntegratorEngine` (`Task 096`); produces `ParallelFeatureBranchManager`, `DependencyIntentAggregator`, `MigrationIntentAndConflictLinter`, and `SmartBranchFreshnessSync`

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Implement Parallel Per-Feature Branch Lifecycle Manager (`ParallelFeatureBranchManager`):** Manage isolated `harness/f/<feature-slug>` branches concurrently for every active feature in a parallel wave, branching strictly from the verified `harness/integration` HEAD, tracking `{ baseIntegrationSha, headSha, activeLeafSlots[], behindIntegrationCount, status }` in `state.db`, and cleaning up merged refs/worktrees strictly AFTER `Task 111` merge-queue landing!
- [ ] **Implement Serialized Dependency Intent Aggregator (`DependencyIntentAggregator`):** Solve parallel `package.json` / `pnpm-lock.yaml` lockfile warfare cleanly! Feature workers NEVER edit lockfiles directly in parallel; instead, a task needing an approved package submits a typed `DependencyIntent { featureId, packageName, versionRange, devOnly, rationale }` — the kernel validates against `Task 048`'s supply-chain allowlist & approval gate, applies it serially onto `harness/integration` (producing ONE clean lockfile commit via `pnpm install --lockfile-only` + integrity verification!), and propagates cleanly to active feature branches!
- [ ] **Implement Timestamp+Hash Migration Naming & Cross-Branch Migration Conflict Linter (`MigrationIntentAndConflictLinter`):** Eliminate classic `0004_a.sql` vs `0004_b.sql` sequential numbering collisions across parallel feature branches ([parallel-feature-integration.md](parallel-feature-integration.md)):
  - Enforce deterministic **UTC timestamp + short content hash** migration filenames (`YYYYMMDDHHMMSS_<6char_hash>_<slug>.sql`, e.g., `20261119011500_a4f91c_add_menu_tags.sql`) — NEVER bare sequential `001`/`002` integers when parallel features exist!
  - Parse SQL DDL AST across ALL active parallel feature branches BEFORE merge (`MigrationConflictLinter`), immediately detecting: (a) two branches creating the same table/index/enum name, (b) two branches altering the same table incompatibly (e.g., dropping/renaming a column the sibling branch adds an FK/index to!), (c) missing foreign-key target tables ordered in the wrong timestamp order, and (d) destructive DDL sneaking past `Task 083` skeleton lock!
- [ ] **Implement Smart Feature Branch Freshness Sync (`SmartBranchFreshnessSync`):** When Feature `F-A` lands onto `harness/integration` while parallel Feature `F-B` is still actively building, decide intelligently whether `F-B` needs a sync right now:
  - Run zero-checkout `git merge-tree --write-tree` (`Task 096`) between `harness/integration` and `harness/f/F-B`!
  - If `F-B` is **disjoint & clean** AND does not depend on `F-A`'s new lockfile/shared contracts → do **NOT** churn `F-B`'s active leaf workers unnecessarily; let `F-B` finish cleanly and merge once at `Task 111`!
  - If `F-A` landed a shared dependency/lockfile commit, a contract/migration touching `F-B`'s read set, OR `merge-tree` detects an emerging textual conflict → cleanly schedule a single non-disruptive base sync on `harness/f/F-B` at the next leaf boundary (NEVER force-rebasing underneath a running worker's worktree!)!
- [ ] **Implement Safe Merge-From-Integration Over Destructive Rebase:** Sync long-running feature branches by fast-forward or controlled merge commit from `harness/integration` (preserving pinned `baseCommitSha` traceability for in-flight handoffs `Task 109`!) rather than rewriting commit SHAs out from under active workers!
- [ ] **Implement Parallel Shared-File Drift Early Warning:** Continuously monitor `git diff --name-only` across active `harness/f/*` branches; if two parallel branches unexpectedly modify the same untracked/shared helper file despite `Task 092` scopes, raise an early warning before both invest 10 more turns!
- [ ] **Implement Clean Branch GC & Ref Lease Hygiene:** Acquire per-branch ref leases (`Task 039`) for every `update-ref` on `harness/f/*`, automatically pruning retired `harness/f/*` refs ONLY after their commit is reachable from `harness/integration` and zero worktree slots point to them!
- [ ] **Implement Migration Rehearsal Check On Combined DDL:** Verify that applying all active branches' additive migrations in timestamp+hash order against a clone of the template DB (`Task 052`) succeeds cleanly with zero DDL errors!

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **Parallel Features `F-Menu` and `F-Orders` both add a DB migration at the exact same second:** Content-hash suffix (`20261119011500_a4f91c_...` vs `20261119011500_9e02b7_...`) guarantees unique non-colliding filenames AND deterministic sort order!
- **`F-Menu` creates table `dietary_tags` and `F-Orders` adds an FK referencing `dietary_tags` with an earlier timestamp:** `MigrationConflictLinter` catches the FK-ordering dependency immediately and re-stamps `F-Orders`'s migration after `F-Menu` (or enforces explicit `depends_on` ordering)!
- **`F-A` and `F-B` both request adding `zod` / `date-fns` in parallel:** `DependencyIntentAggregator` deduplicates/serializes both intents cleanly onto `harness/integration` in ONE lockfile commit instead of producing unmergeable `pnpm-lock.yaml` conflicts!
- **A leaf worker is actively running on `harness/f/F-B` when `F-A` lands a lockfile update onto `harness/integration`:** `SmartBranchFreshnessSync` waits cleanly for the active leaf boundary (never mutating the active worktree mid-turn!), then updates `harness/f/F-B` safely!
- **`F-C` tries to drop column `users.display_name` while `F-D` adds an index on `users.display_name`:** `MigrationConflictLinter` parses both branches' DDL ASTs and flags the exact incompatible column collision BEFORE merge-queue runtime!
- **Branch `harness/f/F-A` was manually deleted or corrupted on disk:** Manager detects missing ref on sync, reconstructs cleanly from `state.db`'s last recorded verified SHA in Git object store, or surfaces a clear recovery card!
- **Legacy brownfield repo uses Prisma (`prisma/migrations/YYYYMMDDHHMMSS_name`) or Drizzle (`0001_...`):** Linter adapts cleanly to the repo's existing migration tool conventions while serializing conflicting sequence numbers at the merge queue (`Task 111`)!

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Zero-Parallel-Lockfile-Conflict Invariant:** Feature workers NEVER directly race on `pnpm-lock.yaml`; all package installs serialize through `DependencyIntentAggregator` + `Task 048`.
- **Zero-Migration-Filename-Collision Invariant:** Greenfield parallel migrations ALWAYS use `YYYYMMDDHHMMSS_<hash>_<slug>.sql` and pass cross-branch DDL AST conflict lint.
- **Zero-Mid-Turn-Rebase Invariant:** Active running worker worktrees are NEVER rebased or hard-reset out from under a live agent turn.
- **Zero-Churn Disjoint Sync Invariant:** Disjoint clean parallel branches skip unnecessary syncs until merge time, avoiding wasted re-verification churn.
- **Pinned-Commit-History Preservation Invariant:** Branch freshness syncs never rewrite commit SHAs referenced by active `state.db` handoffs/receipts.
- **Reachability-Before-Prune Invariant:** `harness/f/*` refs are pruned strictly AFTER verified inclusion in `harness/integration`.

#### Multi-Agent Harmony And Branch Isolation

- **Worktree Setup:** Create branch `task/110-parallel-feature-branches-migrations` via `node scripts/agent-worktree.mjs create 110 parallel-feature-branches-migrations`.
- **Strict Subtree Boundary:** Touch ONLY `packages/integrator/src/feature-branches/**`, `packages/integrator/tests/feature-branches/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-110.md`.
- **Parallel Safe Execution:** Disjoint from `Task 096` (`src/feature-integrator/**`), `Task 109` (`src/handoffs/**`), and `Task 111` (`src/merge-queue/**`).
- **Handoff For `Task 111` (Project Merge Queue Ordering & Rehearsal), `Task 134` (M3 Parallel Exit Gate):** Export `ParallelFeatureBranchManager`, `DependencyIntentAggregator`, `MigrationIntentAndConflictLinter`, and `SmartBranchFreshnessSync` in `.agent-handoffs/task-110.md`.
- **Commit-Only Discipline:** Commit exclusively on `task/110-parallel-feature-branches-migrations`; **NEVER merge** into `main` or `harness/integration`.
- **Real Multi-Branch Git + SQLite DDL Tests:** Exercise 3 simultaneous feature branches with concurrent migrations, conflicting column DDL, dependency intents, and freshness sync on local temp Git repos!

- [ ] Verify `DependencyIntentAggregator` serializes concurrent package additions cleanly without lockfile conflicts.

### Task 111: Project Merge Queue & `project-integrator@1` (Serialized Feature→Integration Gate, Fresh Merge Worktree, Cross-Feature Conflicts, Regression Gate, Non-FF Commits, CAS `update-ref` & Batch Bisection)

- **Milestone & Track:** `M3 · Serialized Project Merge Queue`
- **Depends On:** `Task 001`, `Task 009`, `Task 022`, `Task 038`, `Task 039`, `Task 055`, `Task 096`, `Task 110`
- **Git Worktree & Branch:** `task/111-project-merge-queue-integrator` in `../ef-wt/task-111-project-merge-queue-integrator` (commit on own branch only; **NEVER merge**)
- **Owned Write Scope (Disjoint Subtree):** `packages/integrator/src/merge-queue/**`, `packages/integrator/tests/merge-queue/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-111.md`
- **Mandatory Reference Files:** [parallel-feature-integration.md](parallel-feature-integration.md#the-project-merge-queue), [workspace-and-git.md](workspace-and-git.md), [prompt-contracts.md](prompt-contracts.md#project-integrator1), [schema/state.sql](schema/state.sql), [parallel-feature-integration.mmd](parallel-feature-integration.mmd), [parallel-feature-integration.svg](parallel-feature-integration.svg), [research/git-worktrees-and-workspaces.md](research/git-worktrees-and-workspaces.md)
- **Shared Contracts Consumed / Produced:** Consumes `ProjectIntegratorV1Schema` (`Task 009`), `FeatureLifecycleManager` (`Task 022`), `WorktreeSlotPool` (`Task 038`), `RefLeaseAndCasManager` (`Task 039`), `CleanVerifierHarness` (`Task 055`), `ParallelFeatureBranchManager` (`Task 110`); produces `ProjectMergeQueue`, `ProjectIntegratorEngine`, `CombinedRegressionGate`, and `MergeBatchBisector`

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Implement Strictly Serialized Project Merge Queue (`ProjectMergeQueue`):** Maintain a durable FIFO + priority-ordered queue in `state.db` (`merge_queue_items`) for features ready to land from `harness/f/<feature>` onto `harness/integration`, acquiring the exclusive `ref_lease` (`Task 039`) on `harness/integration` so **`harness/integration` is ALWAYS green and NEVER suffers simultaneous unverified writes!**
- [ ] **Implement Fresh Clean Merge-Worktree Staging:** For every queued feature (or small speculative batch of `<= 3` disjoint features under high throughput!), check out a dedicated clean ephemeral merge worktree (`Task 038`) at exact `harness/integration` HEAD, perform a real `--no-ff` merge of `harness/f/<feature>` preserving clean feature-level ancestry and structured `EF-*` Git trailers (making future `git revert -m 1` Feature Undo in `Task 129` clean and deterministic!)!
- [ ] **Implement Cross-Feature Conflict & Migration Ordering Resolution (`ProjectIntegratorEngine` via `project-integrator@1`):** When merging `F-B` after `F-A` already landed produces a cross-feature textual conflict (e.g., both updated global nav, shared route manifest, or Prisma/Drizzle sequential schema index) OR migration ordering issue (`Task 110`), feed `project-integrator@1` ONLY the exact conflicting hunks + both features' canonical specs + migration AST diff, verify zero dropped feature logic, zero test weakening, and valid schema order!
- [ ] **Implement Mandatory Combined Regression Gate (`CombinedRegressionGate`):** BEFORE advancing `harness/integration` via CAS `update-ref`, run the real combined verification gate inside the fresh merge worktree (`Task 055`):
  1. Clean `typecheck` + `lint` + `build` on the combined tree
  2. Combined migration apply from scratch on fresh template DB (`Task 052`)
  3. The incoming feature's full journey + sealed Step 3b checks PLUS the full regression suite of ALL already-landed features on `harness/integration` (parallelized cleanly inside the test runner, targeting `< 2 min`!)
  4. `STATIC_AUDIT` + `gitleaks` check on the merge diff!
- [ ] **Implement Atomic CAS `update-ref` Advancement & 7-Condition `DONE` Commit:** Advance `refs/heads/harness/integration` strictly with `git update-ref refs/heads/harness/integration <newMergeSha> <expectedOldHeadSha>` (`Task 039`); inside the exact same kernel acceptance sequence, commit the feature's 7-condition `DONE` transition (`Task 022`) and trigger `Task 160` Live App Preview hot-reload!
- [ ] **Implement Automatic Batch Bisection (`MergeBatchBisector`):** When optimistic batching merges `[F-1, F-2, F-3]` together to amortize full regression runs and the combined suite fails, deterministically bisect (`[F-1]` vs `[F-2, F-3]`, etc.): land every innocent passing feature cleanly onto `harness/integration` immediately, and evict ONLY the exact guilty/interacting feature back to `INTEGRATING` with the exact interaction failure trace!
- [ ] **Implement Semantic Interaction Failure Pinpointing:** When `F-1` passed alone AND `F-2` passed alone, yet `F-1 + F-2` fails a combined test (classic semantic integration conflict, e.g., both register keyboard shortcut `Ctrl+K` or conflicting middleware ordering!), isolate the exact failing test + offending commits cleanly and route a single focused `project-integrator@1` fix task (bounded `<= 2` attempts before escalating to the developer)!
- [ ] **Implement Crash-Safe Queue Recovery & Zero-Half-Landed State:** Persist queue state transitions (`QUEUED → STAGING → VERIFYING → LANDED | EVICTED`) durably in `state.db`; if `harnessd` crashes mid-verification, restart cleanly resets the ephemeral merge worktree and resumes the queue with `harness/integration` completely untouched!

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **Features `F-Menu`, `F-Orders`, and `F-Email` enter the queue together as a batch; `F-Menu` and `F-Email` are clean while `F-Orders` clashes with `F-Menu`:** `MergeBatchBisector` lands `F-Menu` and `F-Email` cleanly onto `harness/integration` and evicts ONLY `F-Orders` with exact failing test trace!
- **While `F-B` is verifying in the merge worktree, `Task 171` base-sync advances `harness/integration` HEAD from `SHA-1` to `SHA-2`:** Atomic CAS `update-ref` rejects advancing from stale `SHA-1`, cleanly re-stages `F-B` onto `SHA-2`, re-verifies, and lands cleanly with zero lost commits!
- **`F-A` and `F-B` pass 100% of their own tests independently, yet together they produce a duplicate React route `/settings`:** `CombinedRegressionGate` catches the duplicate route immediately BEFORE `harness/integration` advances — `harness/integration` NEVER turns red!
- **`project-integrator@1` attempts to silence a cross-feature regression by editing `F-A`'s existing passing test:** Anti-test-weakening diff guard rejects the candidate immediately!
- **Feature `F-C` is fast-forwardable cleanly, yet we need single-commit revertability for `Task 129` Feature Undo:** Queue enforces `--no-ff` merge commits (`git merge --no-ff`) with complete `EF-Feature` trailers so every feature landing has a clear revertible merge boundary!
- **Daemon is killed (`SIGKILL` / power loss) right after `CombinedRegressionGate` finishes but before `update-ref`:** On restart, `harness/integration` still points cleanly to old green HEAD and queue re-runs safely with zero corruption!
- **A feature fails eviction twice on an irreconcilable cross-feature contract clash:** Escalates cleanly to `Task 112` CCR / User Decision Card with both features' specs side-by-side instead of looping infinitely!

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Always-Green `harness/integration` Invariant:** No commit can ever advance `refs/heads/harness/integration` without passing `CombinedRegressionGate` on the exact combined tree.
- **Strictly-Serialized CAS Ref Invariant:** All advancements to `harness/integration` acquire the exclusive ref lease and execute atomic CAS `git update-ref <new> <old>`.
- **Non-FF Revertible Boundary Invariant:** Feature merges onto `harness/integration` ALWAYS create `--no-ff` merge commits carrying structured `EF-*` trailers (enabling clean `Task 129` Feature Undo).
- **Innocent-Feature Preservation Invariant:** Batch bisection ALWAYS lands innocent passing features and evicts ONLY the exact failing feature(s).
- **Zero-Regression-Test-Weakening Invariant:** `project-integrator@1` can NEVER delete or skip previously passing feature tests to force a merge.
- **Crash-Atomic Queue Invariant:** Daemon termination at any point during merge-queue processing leaves `harness/integration` untouched and green.

#### Multi-Agent Harmony And Branch Isolation

- **Worktree Setup:** Create branch `task/111-project-merge-queue-integrator` via `node scripts/agent-worktree.mjs create 111 project-merge-queue-integrator`.
- **Strict Subtree Boundary:** Touch ONLY `packages/integrator/src/merge-queue/**`, `packages/integrator/tests/merge-queue/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-111.md`.
- **Parallel Safe Execution:** Disjoint from `Task 110` (`src/feature-branches/**`), `Task 112` (`src/ccr/**`), and `Task 129` (`src/undo/**`).
- **Handoff For `Task 112` (CCR Escalation), `Task 129` (Non-FF Merge Revert Undo), `Task 134` (M3 Parallel Exit Gate), `Task 160` (Live Preview Reload Hook):** Export `ProjectMergeQueue`, `ProjectIntegratorEngine`, `CombinedRegressionGate`, and `MergeBatchBisector` in `.agent-handoffs/task-111.md`.
- **Commit-Only Discipline:** Commit exclusively on `task/111-project-merge-queue-integrator`; **NEVER merge** into `main` or `harness/integration`.
- **Real Git Merge-Queue + Bisection Suite:** Test real `--no-ff` merges, CAS race rejection, 3-feature batch bisection isolating 1 bad feature, semantic interaction failure catching, and simulated crash recovery on local temp Git repos!

### Task 112: Contract Change Request (`ccr@1`) Pipeline (Additive vs Breaking Schema-Diff Classifier, Owner Fast-Path & Breaking Revision Reopener)

- **Milestone & Track:** `M3 · Parallel Feature Integration & Contract Governance`
- **Depends On:** `Task 001`, `Task 009`, `Task 017`, `Task 083`, `Task 087`, `Task 109`, `Task 110`, `Task 111`
- **Git Worktree & Branch:** `task/112-contract-change-request-pipeline` in `../ef-wt/task-112-contract-change-request-pipeline` (commit on own branch only; **NEVER merge**)
- **Owned Write Scope (Disjoint Subtree):** `packages/integrator/src/ccr/**`, `packages/integrator/tests/ccr/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-112.md`
- **Mandatory Reference Files:** [parallel-feature-integration.md](parallel-feature-integration.md#contract-change-requests-ccrs), [linked-architecture-revisions.md](linked-architecture-revisions.md), [agent-handoffs.md](agent-handoffs.md), [prompt-contracts.md](prompt-contracts.md#ccr1), [schema/state.sql](schema/state.sql), [parallel-feature-integration.mmd](parallel-feature-integration.mmd), [agent-handoffs.mmd](agent-handoffs.mmd), [research/knowledge-db-consistency.md](research/knowledge-db-consistency.md)
- **Shared Contracts Consumed / Produced:** Consumes `CcrV1Schema` (`Task 009`), `SkeletonLockEnforcer` (`Task 083`), `ChangeClassifier` & `ReverseImpactWalker` (`Task 087`), `DurableRoleMailbox` (`Task 109`); produces `ContractChangeRequestEngine`, `DeterministicSchemaDiffClassifier`, `AdditiveOwnerFastPath`, and `BreakingCcrRevisionReopener`

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Implement Structured CCR Intake & Deduplication (`ContractChangeRequestEngine`):** Accept typed `ContractChangeRequest` proposals submitted via `DurableRoleMailbox` (`Task 109`) when a worker or integrator discovers a needed change to a locked entity, API schema, event payload, shared TypeScript contract, or shared UI primitive (`{ requestingTaskId, targetContractNodeId, proposedDelta, rationale, urgency }`), deduplicating identical concurrent CCRs targeting the same contract cleanly!
- [ ] **Implement Deterministic Schema-Diff Additive vs Breaking Classifier (`DeterministicSchemaDiffClassifier`):** Run 100% deterministic AST/JSON-Schema/OpenAPI/SQL-DDL diff classification BEFORE invoking `ccr@1` (NEVER trusting an agent's self-reported `"additive"` claim!):
  - **Strictly `ADDITIVE` (Backward-Compatible):** Adding a nullable/defaulted DB column, adding a new optional request/response field, adding a new enum value on output-only types where consumers handle defaults, adding a new API endpoint, or adding a new optional UI primitive variant!
  - **Strictly `BREAKING`:** Dropping or renaming any existing column/table/field/endpoint, narrowing a column type or validation constraint, making an optional request field required, changing HTTP status codes or error envelope shapes, changing auth/tenant semantics, or removing an existing shared export!
- [ ] **Implement Additive Owner Fast-Path (`AdditiveOwnerFastPath`):** For verified strictly-`ADDITIVE` CCRs that satisfy `SkeletonLockEnforcer` (`Task 083`) and cause 0 contradictions (`Task 081`):
  1. Route execution strictly to the **canonical contract/data owner** registered in `state.db` (`Task 083`) — the requesting consumer worker NEVER edits the shared contract/migration directly!
  2. Schedule ONE tiny, surgical owner task producing the additive schema/contract update + timestamp+hash migration (`Task 110`) + backward-compatibility test!
  3. Land via `ProjectMergeQueue` (`Task 111`) cleanly and immediately wake all waiting consumer tasks via `DurableRoleMailbox` (`Task 109`) with ZERO disruption to unrelated parallel features!
- [ ] **Implement Breaking CCR Full-Revision Reopener (`BreakingCcrRevisionReopener`):** Whenever `DeterministicSchemaDiffClassifier` (or `ccr@1` semantic check) classifies a CCR as **`BREAKING`**:
  1. **HARD-BLOCK auto-execution** (NEVER bypassing user approval or `Task 108` auto-start bans on breaking contract changes!).
  2. Run `ReverseImpactWalker` (`Task 087`) to compute the exact blast radius across all consuming features, screens, and merged tasks!
  3. Surface ONE clear **Contract Change Decision Card** to the developer showing the exact requested change, why the worker hit it, affected features/tasks, and safe alternatives (e.g., `"Prefer additive expand-then-contract field instead"` vs `"Approve breaking revision"`).
  4. On approval, execute cleanly through `Task 087` Hybrid Revision + `Task 021` surgical holds on impacted consumers!
- [ ] **Implement `ccr@1` Semantic Compatibility & Alternative-Proposer Review:** For subtle non-structural contract changes (e.g., changing pagination sort default or timezone interpretation where JSON Schema looks identical!), run `ccr@1` to detect hidden behavioral breaking changes AND propose cleaner additive workarounds when available!
- [ ] **Implement Deadlock-Free Wait Registration:** Before placing the requesting task in `waiting_on_ccr`, validate via `Task 109`'s `WaitGraphCycleDetector` that waiting on `owner(contract)` does not introduce a circular wait (`A waits on B's contract while B waits on A's contract`)!
- [ ] **Implement Per-Feature CCR Spam Guard:** Cap automatic CCR submissions per task (`<= 3` CCRs per task); if a worker keeps requesting contract rewrites, halt and escalate to Coordinator / Planner because the task brief or architecture decomposition itself needs review!
- [ ] **Implement Immutable CCR Audit Ledger:** Persist every CCR lifecycle (`PROPOSED → CLASSIFIED → APPROVED/REJECTED → LANDED`) in `state.db.ccr_requests` with schema diffs, owner commit SHAs, and woken task IDs!

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **Consumer worker `W-Orders` submits a CCR claiming `additive: true` while changing `price_cents: integer` to `price: string`:** `DeterministicSchemaDiffClassifier` overrides the bogus self-label to `BREAKING` immediately and blocks fast-path execution!
- **`W-Orders` adds a genuinely nullable column `orders.dietary_note TEXT NULL`:** Classifier confirms `ADDITIVE`, routes cleanly to `owner(entity:Order)` (not `W-Orders`!), lands additive migration + typed field, and wakes `W-Orders` automatically while `F-Menu` and `F-Email` keep running uninterrupted!
- **Two parallel features `F-Orders` and `F-Reports` both submit CCRs requesting `orders.submitted_at`:** Deduplicator merges both CCRs into ONE owner task and wakes both features atomically!
- **`W-A` submits a CCR on `W-B`'s contract while `W-B` already has an open CCR waiting on `W-A`'s contract:** `WaitGraphCycleDetector` breaks the cycle immediately and escalates both to Coordinator (`project-integrator@1`) to land both additive fields cleanly in one combined owner commit!
- **Semantic change flips `GET /api/orders` default sort from `created_at DESC` to `created_at ASC` (JSON Schema unchanged!):** `ccr@1` behavioral check flags semantic breaking risk for existing consumers (`M04` / UI tests) and routes through review!
- **User rejects a breaking CCR in the Decision Card and chooses `"Keep original contract"`:** CCR resolves `REJECTED`, wakes the requesting task with explicit `"Contract is locked; implement adapter within your scope"` instruction!
- **Owner feature for `entity:MenuItem` is currently `HOLD`:** CCR stays queued clearly (`blocked_by_owner_hold`) and notifies Coordinator instead of spinning or bypassing ownership!

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Deterministic-Override Classification Invariant:** Structural breaking diffs (`DROP`, rename, type narrowing, required-param addition, route deletion) ALWAYS classify as `BREAKING` regardless of any LLM label.
- **Single-Contract-Owner Mutation Invariant:** Even on additive fast-path CCRs, ONLY the canonical registered contract owner (or Phase 0 owner) mutates the shared contract/migration.
- **Zero-Unapproved-Breaking-CCR Invariant:** Breaking CCRs ALWAYS require explicit user/revision approval via `Task 087` and NEVER auto-start under `Task 108`.
- **Deadlock-Safe CCR Wait Invariant:** Every `waiting_on_ccr` link passes `WaitGraphCycleDetector` before commit.
- **Anti-Spam CCR Cap Invariant:** A task exceeding 3 CCRs escalates for architectural review instead of thrashing contracts.
- **Backward-Compatibility Proof Invariant:** Every additive fast-path CCR commit passes existing consumer regression checks before landing.

### Task 113: Unified Message Sequencing, Input-Start Focus Capture, Ordered Multi-Clause Intent Executor & `router@1` Candidate Shortlist Retrieval

- **Milestone & Track:** `M3 · Mid-Build Steering & Deterministic Message Routing`
- **Depends On:** `Task 001`, `Task 009`, `Task 017`, `Task 018`, `Task 026`, `Task 087`

- **Mandatory Reference Files:** [routing-design.md](routing-design.md), [agent-graph-routing.md](agent-graph-routing.md), [prompt-contracts.md](prompt-contracts.md#router1), [schema/state.sql](schema/state.sql), [mid-build-messages.mmd](mid-build-messages.mmd), [mid-build-messages.svg](mid-build-messages.svg), [requirements-and-agent-routing.mmd](requirements-and-agent-routing.mmd), [requirements-and-agent-routing.svg](requirements-and-agent-routing.svg), [agent-graph-routing.mmd](agent-graph-routing.mmd), [agent-graph-routing.svg](agent-graph-routing.svg)

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Implement Strictly Monotonic Unified Message Sequencer (`UnifiedMessageSequencer`):** Assign every incoming user message (from Chat Composer, Question Card reply, Canvas Box-Chat `Task 156`, App Preview Point-to-Fix `Task 161`, or Stop button) a strictly monotonic `msg_seq` in `state.db` (`user_messages`) and process steering intents in exact causal `msg_seq` order — eliminating race conditions when the user fires two rapid messages 300 ms apart (`"Wait pause Orders"` followed immediately by `"Make cutoff 10:30 instead"`)!
- [ ] **Implement Input-Start Focus Capture (`InputStartFocusSnapshotter`):** Capture an immutable UI context snapshot **at the moment the user STARTS typing/speaking** (`input_started_at`, NOT only at `Send` time!) recording `{ activeTab, selectedCanvasNodeIds[], openQuestionCardId, openQuestionOptionsVersion, focusedFeatureId, inspectedTaskId, previewSelectedElement? }` — so if an unrelated new Inbox card pops up 2 seconds before the user hits Enter on `"Option 2"`, the reply STILL binds faithfully to the exact question they were answering when they started typing (`Task 070` / [routing-design.md](routing-design.md))!
- [ ] **Implement Deterministic Fast-Path Short-Circuit BEFORE `router@1`:** Intercept unambiguous zero-LLM intents in `< 2 ms` before ever calling `router@1`:
  - Explicit UI actions (Stop button, Pause button, Approve/Reject card, explicit `Box` target tag from Composer `Task 155`, explicit `Question` target tag with matching `options_version`)
  - Exact emergency control phrases (`"stop"`, `"stop everything"`, `"pause build"`, `"abort"`) → immediate kernel Stop path (`Task 114`) with **0 ms LLM delay**!
- [ ] **Implement Deterministic Candidate Shortlist Retriever (`RouterShortlistRetriever`):** Before invoking `router@1` on a free-form natural-language message (e.g., `"Also let kitchen export CSV and change the lunch deadline to 10:30"`), run fast hybrid local retrieval (`Task 018` dual FTS5 BM25 + `input_start_focus` boost + active working features/tasks + open questions + recent 3 turns) returning a compact bounded shortlist (`<= 15` candidate targets: features, decisions, rules, open questions, running tasks) so `router@1` chooses ONLY from real canonical IDs in `< 1,500` prompt tokens!
- [ ] **Implement `router@1` Multi-Clause Intent Decomposition & Confidence Gating:** Parse compound user messages into an ordered list of atomic typed clauses (`clauses[]: { clauseText, intentType: 'stop_control' | 'read_only_query' | 'answer_question' | 'edit_existing' | 'add_new_feature' | 'undo_feature', targetCandidateIds[], confidence: 'high' | 'ambiguous', alternateReadings?[] }`), strictly validating every referenced `targetCandidateId` against the shortlist and rejecting invented IDs!
- [ ] **Implement Ordered Multi-Clause Execution Engine (`OrderedMultiClauseExecutor`):** Execute compound clauses in strict deterministic safety order regardless of sentence phrasing:
  1. **Control / Stop / Pause clauses FIRST** (halt unsafe work immediately before interpreting edits!)
  2. **Question Answers & Clarifications SECOND** (settle open questions so downstream impact sees fresh truth!)
  3. **Existing-Feature Edits & Removals THIRD** (placing surgical holds if ambiguous via `Task 115`!)
  4. **New-Feature Additions FOURTH**
  5. **Read-Only Status Queries LAST** (reflecting the freshly updated state accurately!)
- [ ] **Implement Ambiguous Multi-Reading Detection:** When a message plausibly matches 2+ distinct targets (e.g., `"Make it export CSV"` when BOTH `F-Orders` and `F-Inventory` are active and neither was focused at input-start!), instruct `router@1` to return `confidence: 'ambiguous'` + explicit `alternateReadings[]`, immediately triggering `Task 115` Multi-Interpretation Holds instead of silently guessing the wrong feature!
- [ ] **Implement Idempotent Message Replay & Crash Recovery:** Persist every sequenced message's parsed clauses and per-clause execution status (`PENDING → DISPATCHED → DONE | AWAITING_CLARIFICATION`) in `state.db` so a daemon crash midway through executing a 3-clause message resumes strictly at Clause 2 without duplicating Clause 1!

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **User starts typing `"2"` while Question Card `Q-Auth` (`options_version: 1`) is open; 1 second before pressing Enter, an urgent `Q-Budget` card appears on top:** `InputStartFocusSnapshotter` bound the draft to `(Q-Auth, options_version: 1)` at input-start — `"2"` answers `Q-Auth` accurately (or prompts confirmation if focus explicitly changed), NEVER accidentally answering `Q-Budget`!
- **User sends `"Stop the build and change the cutoff to 10:30, also how much have we spent?"`:** `OrderedMultiClauseExecutor` runs: (1) immediate kernel Stop (`< 10 ms`), (2) `edit_existing` cutoff `11:00 → 10:30`, (3) `read_only_query` returning exact spend from `Task 023` — ALL from ONE message in exact safe order!
- **User types `"stop"` while provider API is completely down / timing out:** Deterministic fast-path intercepts `"stop"` BEFORE `router@1` and halts all workers immediately with zero model call!
- **`router@1` hallucinates target ID `F-999` not present in the shortlist:** Shortlist validator hard-rejects `F-999`, retries once with strict enum constraint, and falls back to asking a crisp clarification card if invalid!
- **User sends `"Wait, actually never mind"` 1.5 seconds after `"Change cutoff to 10:00"`:** Monotonic `msg_seq` ensures Message 101 completes or checkpoints cleanly BEFORE Message 102 executes cleanly against Message 101's exact state (zero interleaved corruption)!
- **Free-form message is ambiguous between `F-Orders` and `F-Reports` (`"Change the summary layout"`):** `router@1` emits `confidence: 'ambiguous'` with `alternateReadings: [F-Orders, F-Reports]`, handing off directly to `Task 115`!
- **Long dictation message has 6 sentences spanning 2 edits and 1 question:** Compound decomposer splits cleanly into 3 ordered atomic clauses with exact source text spans, executing each atomically!

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Strict Causal `msg_seq` Ordering Invariant:** Steering messages are NEVER reordered or executed out of `msg_seq` sequence.
- **Input-Start Focus Fidelity Invariant:** Unqualified replies bind to the focus snapshot captured when input began, immune to late-arriving popups/notifications.
- **Zero-LLM Emergency-Stop Invariant:** Stop/Pause/Abort controls execute strictly in local kernel code (`< 10 ms`) even when all LLM providers are offline or throttled.
- **Safety-First Clause Execution Order Invariant:** Control/Stop > Answers > Edits > Additions > Queries across every multi-clause message.
- **Shortlist-Bounded Target Invariant:** `router@1` can ONLY emit canonical IDs present in the deterministic candidate shortlist.
- **Zero-Silent-Guess On Ambiguity Invariant:** Any multi-reading ambiguity routes to `Task 115` holds + user clarification rather than guessing.

#### Multi-Agent Harmony And Branch Isolation

- **Strict Subtree Boundary:** Touch ONLY `packages/steering/src/router/**`, `packages/steering/tests/router/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-113.md`.

- **Handoff For `Task 114` (4-Route Dispatcher), `Task 115` (Multi-Interpretation Holds), `Task 155` (Composer Target State Machine):** Export `UnifiedMessageSequencer`, `InputStartFocusSnapshotter`, `OrderedMultiClauseExecutor`, and `RouterShortlistRetriever` in `.agent-handoffs/task-113.md`.

- **Milestone & Track:** `M3 · Mid-Build Steering Execution Routes`
- **Depends On:** `Task 001`, `Task 017`, `Task 021`, `Task 041`, `Task 069`, `Task 087`, `Task 102`, `Task 108`, `Task 113`

- **Shared Contracts Consumed / Produced:** Consumes `KnowledgeGraphRepo` (`Task 017`), `TaskHoldsManager` (`Task 021`), `WindowsJobSupervisor` (`Task 041`), `DiscoverySessionCoordinator` (`Task 069`), `DebouncedRevisionPropagator` (`Task 087`), `AskOwnerResponderEngine` (`Task 102`), `RevisionAutoStartPolicy` (`Task 108`), `OrderedMultiClauseExecutor` (`Task 113`); produces `FourRouteSteeringDispatcher`, `ImmediateKernelStopController`, `NewFeatureDedupSpawner`, and `MidBuildRouteReceipt`

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Implement Route 1 — Read-Only Evidence-Backed Query (`dispatchReadOnlyQuery`):** Execute read-only developer questions (`"What is worker A0014 doing?"`, `"Show me how auth tokens are stored"`, `"How much budget is left?"`) with **ZERO worker holds, ZERO graph mutations, and ZERO build pause**, delegating to `Task 102`'s `AskOwnerResponderEngine` over canonical `state.db` + `telemetry.db` + pinned diffs and returning clickable node/task citations!
- [ ] **Implement Route 2 — Existing-Feature / Decision Change (`dispatchExistingFeatureChange`):** Route edits targeting an existing feature, decision, requirement, contract, or UI element cleanly through `Task 087` (`ChangeClassifier` + `ReverseImpactWalker` + `DebouncedRevisionPropagator`):
  - Apply surgical holds (`Task 021`) ONLY to impacted active tasks (leaving unrelated workers running at 100% speed!)
  - Evaluate `Task 108` `RevisionAutoStartPolicy`: tiny safe revisions (`<= 5 tasks, <= $1, <= 2%`, 0 hard-stop triggers) execute seamlessly with undoable banner; larger or breaking revisions pause cleanly at Plan Delta Preview!
- [ ] **Implement Route 3 — New Feature Addition With Duplicate-ID Reuse (`dispatchNewFeatureAddition`):** When the user asks mid-build for a brand-new capability (`"Also add a dark mode toggle"` or `"Add weekly CSV export for finance"`):
  1. **Duplicate / Revival Check FIRST (`NewFeatureDedupSpawner`):** Check `state.db` for any existing active, deferred, or previously undone (`Task 129`) feature matching the request (by canonical slug/FTS5 similarity) — if a matching deferred/undone feature exists, **REUSE its canonical `feature_id` / scope** (`"Reviving deferred feature F-CsvExport"`) instead of spawning duplicate `F-CsvExport-2` clutter!
  2. Open a focused, scoped mini-discovery (`Task 069`–`074`) strictly for that new feature's open criteria WITHOUT halting currently building unrelated features!
  3. Schedule the newly ready feature cleanly into the next wave slot (or active wave if completely disjoint & approved via `Task 108`)!
- [ ] **Implement Route 4 — Direct Execution Control & Immediate Kernel Stop Path (`ImmediateKernelStopController`):** Handle ALL direct execution controls (`Stop Now`, `Pause Build`, `Pause Feature X`, `Resume`, `Cancel Task T`, `Retry Task T`, `Switch Preset`, `Skip Optional Task`) **100% deterministically in the kernel** (`0` LLM calls!):
  - **`STOP` (Hard Immediate Stop):** Within `< 100 ms`, flip global `project_runtime.state = 'STOPPED'`, immediately signal cancellation/interrupt to EVERY active native worker (`Task 053`) and foreign runtime adapter (`Task 142`), terminate runaway verification subprocesses cleanly via `Task 041` Windows Job Objects, preserve every worker's latest WIP checkpoint (`Task 053`/`150`), block any in-flight candidate merge (`submission_pending`!), and NEVER leave a half-written commit on `harness/integration`!
  - **`PAUSE` (Graceful Wind-Down):** Stop claiming new ready tasks immediately while letting current atomic steps reach clean checkpoint boundaries (default `<= 15 s` grace, then interrupt cleanly)!
  - **`PAUSE FEATURE X`:** Add `user_paused` hold reason (`Task 021`) ONLY to Feature `X`'s tasks while sibling features keep running!
- [ ] **Implement Auditable Route-Decision Receipt (`MidBuildRouteReceipt`):** Emit a compact real-time UI confirmation pill for every dispatched steering action (`"Paused only 'Orders' (1 worker held; 3 others still running)"`, `"Added 'CSV Export' to mini-discovery — build continuing"`) with a 1-click `"Wrong route?"` override that reverses the routing choice cleanly!
- [ ] **Implement Anti-Concurrent-Stop-Resume Race Guard:** Serialize `STOP` / `PAUSE` / `RESUME` transitions through `state.db` optimistic epoch (`control_epoch`) so a late worker completion arriving 50 ms after `STOP` is cleanly quarantined (`submission_pending`) instead of sneaking a merge through after the user hit Stop!
- [ ] **Implement Safe Route-3 Mid-Build Budget Check:** Before starting a brand-new mid-build feature, check remaining project budget (`Task 023`) and warn immediately if adding the feature will exceed the active spend/window cap!
- [ ] **Implement Structured Telemetry For All 4 Routes:** Record route latencies (`Route 4 Stop < 100 ms`, `Route 1 Query < 2 s`) and `"Wrong route?"` correction rates in `telemetry.db` for Meta-Lab evaluation (`Task 191`)!

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **User clicks `STOP` at the exact millisecond Worker `W-2` calls `CandidateAcceptanceTx` to merge:** Monotonic `control_epoch` rejects the late merge (`STOPPED_EPOCH_MISMATCH`), preserves `W-2`'s verified artifact in `submission_pending` so zero work is lost, and guarantees `harness/integration` does NOT move after `STOP`!
- **User asks `"How is the Orders page coming along?"` while 4 workers are actively coding:** Route 1 answers strictly read-only from `state.db` in `< 2 s` with **0 workers paused and 0 holds added**!
- **User asks mid-build `"Add PDF export"` when `F-PdfExport` was previously deferred in Plan Preview (`Task 108`):** `NewFeatureDedupSpawner` detects the deferred `F-PdfExport` node, revives the SAME `feature_id` cleanly, and preserves its existing settled discovery answers!
- **User asks mid-build `"Add a brand new Analytics Dashboard"` while 3 Wave-1 features are actively building:** Route 3 opens parallel mini-discovery for Analytics Dashboard while the 3 Wave-1 workers continue building completely undisturbed!
- **A runaway Playwright/Vite subprocess ignores `SIGINT` when user hits `STOP`:** `ImmediateKernelStopController` escalates via `Task 041` Windows Job Object `TerminateJobObject` after grace window, proving `0` surviving child PIDs within `< 500 ms`!
- **User clicks `"Wrong route?"` on a message routed as `New Feature` when they meant `Edit Existing Feature F-Orders`:** Route reversal cleanly archives the empty stub scope and re-dispatches the exact original `msg_seq` to Route 2 (`F-Orders`)!
- **User hits `STOP` while a database migration rehearsal is running in an ephemeral merge worktree:** Rehearsal subprocess terminates cleanly, ephemeral worktree resets, and `harness/integration` + production/demo DB remain 100% intact!

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Sub-100ms Zero-LLM Stop Invariant:** Clicking `STOP` or sending `"stop"` transitions `project_runtime` to `STOPPED`, increments `control_epoch`, and signals every active worker/subprocess in `< 100 ms` with zero LLM latency.
- **Zero-Post-Stop-Merge Invariant:** No candidate commit can ever advance `harness/integration` or `harness/f/*` with a stale `control_epoch` after `STOP`.
- **Zero-Disruption Read-Only Invariant:** Route 1 queries NEVER place holds, pause workers, or mutate `state.db` graph nodes.
- **Canonical Feature-ID Reuse Invariant:** Reviving a deferred or undone feature ALWAYS reuses its canonical `feature_id` rather than creating duplicate zombie features.
- **Non-Disruptive Mid-Build Discovery Invariant:** Adding a new feature via Route 3 NEVER pauses unrelated active build workers.
- **Clean Subprocess Termination Invariant:** `STOP` guarantees `0` leaked worker/verifier child processes via Windows Job Object supervision.

- **Strict Subtree Boundary:** Touch ONLY `packages/steering/src/dispatcher/**`, `packages/steering/tests/dispatcher/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-114.md`.

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Implement Per-Reading Affected-Set Traversal (`MultiInterpretationHoldEngine`):** When `router@1` (`Task 113`) returns an ambiguous mid-build message with `k >= 2` plausible interpretations (`alternateReadings[1..k]`, e.g., `"Make the export include timestamps"` could target `F-Orders` OR `F-Reports`), run `ReverseImpactWalker` (`Task 087`) **independently for EVERY plausible reading `R_i`**, compute the union of potentially affected active tasks `AffectedUnion = ⋃_i impact(R_i)`, place surgical holds ONLY on `AffectedUnion` (leaving all unaffected tasks outside the union running at full speed!), and emit ONE crisp clarification card asking the user which reading they meant!
- [ ] **Implement Hard Hold vs Soft Hold + Quarantine Policy (`HoldModeClassifier`):** Choose the least-wasteful safe hold mode per affected task ([routing-design.md](routing-design.md)):
  - **`HARD_HOLD`:** Used when the pending change is likely **contradictory / destructive** to the task's current work (e.g., changing schema, deleting a feature, flipping core rule `11:00 → 10:00`) → immediately pause/interrupt the worker at the current step boundary so ZERO further tokens are wasted building obsolete code!
  - **`SOFT_HOLD` + `QUARANTINE` (`submission_pending`):** Used when the task is nearly finished (`>= 80%` complete / currently in `VERIFYING`) OR the pending clarification might turn out NOT to affect that task (e.g., Reading 2 of an ambiguous message!) → allow the in-flight step/verification to finish cleanly, **quarantine** its output strictly in `submission_pending` (NEVER merging onto `harness/f/*` or `harness/integration`!), so if the user resolves `"No, I meant the OTHER feature"`, the quarantined verified commit lands instantaneously in `< 1 s` with ZERO wasted tokens!
- [ ] **Implement Independent Hold-Reason Stack (`HoldReasonStackCoordinator`):** Leverage `Task 021`'s multi-row `task_holds(task_id, reason_type, reason_ref_id, mode)` table so a single task can simultaneously carry multiple orthogonal hold reasons (e.g., `hold #1: ambiguous_message_104` AND `hold #2: user_paused_feature` AND `hold #3: ccr_pending_12`):
  - Resolving `ambiguous_message_104` removes **ONLY** `hold #1`!
  - The task remains cleanly held until ALL active hold rows for `task_id` are cleared (`COUNT(active holds) === 0`) — eliminating the classic bug where clearing one clarification accidentally unpauses a feature the user explicitly paused!
- [ ] **Implement Additive Resume vs Contradictory Fresh-Session Reconstruction (`AdditiveVsContradictoryResumer`):** When ALL holds on a held task clear and the task now has updated specs/clarifications, inspect the delta between the task's pinned checkpoint brief (`sliceSha256`) and its new compiled brief:
  - **No Spec Change (False-Alarm Reading):** Immediately release quarantine / resume existing session checkpoint seamlessly!
  - **Strictly Additive Delta (e.g., `"also add an aria-label"` or `"include created_at column in CSV"`):** Resume the existing worker session (`NativeWorkerLoop` checkpoint or foreign adapter `resume` `Task 150`) by injecting a concise signed delta steering note — preserving full warm context and existing WIP edits!
  - **Contradictory Delta (e.g., `"switch from REST to GraphQL"`, `"cutoff moved 11:00 → 10:00 contradicting half-written logic"`):** Do **NOT** poison the confused existing conversation history with contradictory instructions! Instead, cleanly **reconstruct a fresh worker session** from clean base + newly compiled brief (`Task 088`), passing any still-salvageable non-conflicting WIP files explicitly labeled as `"Unverified prior draft — verify against new brief"` (or discarding clean WIP completely when contradicted)!
- [ ] **Implement Immediate Quarantine Release Fast-Path:** When a `SOFT_HOLD` task finishes verification into `submission_pending` and the clarification resolves in its favor (no spec change!), immediately validate base-HEAD freshness and commit via `CandidateAcceptanceTx` (`Task 060`) without re-running the worker!
- [ ] **Implement Bounded Ambiguity Hold Timeout Reminder:** If an ambiguous-message hold sits unanswered for `> 10` minutes while blocking critical-path tasks, surface a calm reminder pill in Inbox (`Task 116`/`127`) without auto-guessing!
- [ ] **Implement Clear Board & Inspector Hold Visibility:** Expose every active hold reason with human-readable explanation (`"Held: waiting to confirm whether 'export timestamps' applies to Orders or Reports"`) directly to Board Cockpit (`Task 124`) and Inspector (`Task 126`)!
- [ ] **Implement Multi-Task Atomic Hold/Unhold Transactions:** Place and clear multi-reading hold sets inside single `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` transactions in `state.db` so workers never observe half-held ambiguity sets!

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **Ambiguous message matches Reading A (`F-Orders`, task `T-1` at 20% progress) and Reading B (`F-Reports`, task `T-2` currently verifying at 95%), while `F-Auth` (`T-3`) is completely unrelated:** Engine places `HARD_HOLD` on `T-1`, `SOFT_HOLD + QUARANTINE` on `T-2`, and **ZERO hold** on `T-3` (keeps running)! User replies `"I meant F-Orders"` → `T-2` immediately unquarantines and merges cleanly in `< 1 s`, while `T-1` receives the updated brief!
- **Task `T-5` has BOTH `user_paused` hold AND `ambiguous_msg_88` hold; user resolves `msg_88`:** `HoldReasonStackCoordinator` clears ONLY `ambiguous_msg_88`; `T-5` stays cleanly held because `user_paused` is STILL active!
- **Task `T-6` was held during a contradictory spec change (`"Switch SQLite → Postgres"`):** `AdditiveVsContradictoryResumer` refuses to append onto the confused SQLite chat session — it starts a **fresh clean session** with the new Postgres brief!
- **Task `T-7` was held during a minor additive clarification (`"Also show unit price in tooltip"`):** Resumer injects a clean additive steering note onto the warm checkpoint without throwing away 80% of finished code!
- **While `T-2` sat quarantined in `submission_pending`, another sibling task merged onto `harness/f/F-Reports` advancing HEAD:** Quarantine release detects base drift, triggers quick clean re-verify on the new HEAD before landing rather than forcing a stale commit!
- **Ambiguous message has 4 readings touching 12 tasks:** Atomic `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` transaction writes all 12 hold rows together so zero race window lets task #11 merge while task #1 is being held!
- **User resolves an ambiguous clarification by saying `"Actually, apply it to BOTH Orders AND Reports"`:** Both `T-1` and `T-2` receive their respective updated briefs (discarding `T-2`'s now-stale quarantined commit cleanly and triggering targeted delta work)!

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Union-Of-Readings Safety Invariant:** Ambiguous messages ALWAYS hold the full union `⋃_i impact(R_i)` before clarification so no potentially contradicted branch merges prematurely.
- **Unrelated-Continuity Invariant:** Tasks outside `⋃_i impact(R_i)` NEVER receive holds from an unrelated clarification.
- **Independent-Reason-Stack Invariant:** Removing hold reason `R1` NEVER clears distinct hold reason `R2` on the same task; a task resumes strictly when `active_hold_count === 0`.
- **Contradictory-Fresh-Session Invariant:** Contradictory spec updates ALWAYS reconstruct a fresh worker session rather than appending conflicting prompts to a poisoned session history.
- **Quarantine-Freshness Invariant:** Releasing a `submission_pending` candidate verifies base-HEAD parity before landing.
- **Atomic Hold-Set Commit Invariant:** Multi-task holds for one message commit atomically in a single SQLite transaction.

#### Multi-Agent Harmony And Branch Isolation

- **Strict Subtree Boundary:** Touch ONLY `packages/steering/src/holds/**`, `packages/steering/tests/holds/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-115.md`.
- **Parallel Safe Execution:** Disjoint from `Tasks 113–114` and `Task 116`.
- **Handoff For `Task 124` (Board Held Lane Reasons), `Task 150` (Foreign Runtime Fresh-Session Resume), `Task 194` (Review Area Trials On Holds):** Export `MultiInterpretationHoldEngine`, `HoldModeClassifier`, `HoldReasonStackCoordinator`, and `AdditiveVsContradictoryResumer` in `.agent-handoffs/task-115.md`.
- **Commit-Only Discipline:** Commit exclusively on `task/115-multi-interpretation-hold-engine`; **NEVER merge** into `main` or `harness/integration`.
- **Full Hold-Lifecycle Matrix Tests:** Test hard hold, soft hold + quarantine release, multi-reason stack independence, additive warm resume, contradictory fresh-session reset, and `"apply to both"` resolution offline!
