### Task 116: Shared Question Queue & Arbiter (Owner-First Filtering, Criterion/Scope Dedup w/ `inbox_subscribers`, Priority Order, Aging Reminders & Stale/Retired Reply Reconciliation)

- **Milestone & Track:** `M3 · Calm Human-In-The-Loop Question Arbiter`
- **Depends On:** `Task 001`, `Task 017`, `Task 026`, `Task 109`, `Task 113`, `Task 115`
- **Git Worktree & Branch:** `task/116-shared-question-queue-arbiter` in `../ef-wt/task-116-shared-question-queue-arbiter` (commit on own branch only; **NEVER merge**)
- **Owned Write Scope (Disjoint Subtree):** `packages/steering/src/question-arbiter/**`, `packages/steering/tests/question-arbiter/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-116.md`
- **Mandatory Reference Files:** [agent-graph-routing.md](agent-graph-routing.md#the-shared-question-queue), [build-cockpit.md](build-cockpit.md#calm-inbox), [routing-design.md](routing-design.md), [schema/state.sql](schema/state.sql), [agent-graph-routing.mmd](agent-graph-routing.mmd), [agent-graph-routing.svg](agent-graph-routing.svg)
- **Shared Contracts Consumed / Produced:** Consumes `KnowledgeGraphRepo` (`Task 017`), `OutboxRepo` (`Task 026`), `DurableRoleMailbox` & `OwnerResolutionCoordinator` (`Task 109`), `HoldReasonStackCoordinator` (`Task 115`); produces `SharedQuestionArbiter`, `OwnerFirstQuestionFilter`, `QuestionDedupSubscriberStore`, and `StaleReplyReconciler`

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Implement Owner-First Pre-Inbox Filter (`OwnerFirstQuestionFilter`):** NEVER let 8 parallel workers spam the developer directly with technical questions the harness can already answer! Intercept EVERY worker escalation / question request before it enters the user Inbox:
  1. Check `state.db` settled decisions, contracts, and rules (`Task 018` FTS + exact scope lookup) — if already answered, reply straight to the worker automatically with zero user interruption!
  2. Check canonical contract/feature owner (`Task 109` `OwnerResolutionCoordinator`) — if another agent/integrator owns the technical question (e.g., `"What export name does auth middleware use?"`), route strictly to the owner mailbox instead of waking the developer!
  3. Promote to the user-facing **Shared Question Queue** ONLY when the question genuinely requires human judgment (unsettled product behavior, ambiguous steering, breaking CCR, secret/approval/human step, `DisputeTest`, or unresolvable escalation)!
- [ ] **Implement Criterion/Scope Deduplication With `inbox_subscribers` (`QuestionDedupSubscriberStore`):** When 4 parallel workers simultaneously hit the SAME unsettled product question (e.g., `"Should cancelled orders appear in daily kitchen totals?"` targeting `(scope_id, criterion_id)` or canonical normalized topic hash), collapse all 4 requests into **ONE single Inbox Question Card** backed by `state.db.inbox_subscribers(question_id, waiting_task_id, waiting_role)`:
  - Show `"Blocking 4 tasks"` cleanly on the single card!
  - When the developer answers that ONE card, atomically persist the settled decision, clear the hold reason across ALL 4 subscribed tasks simultaneously, and wake all 4 workers cleanly!
- [ ] **Implement Deterministic Multi-Tier Priority Ordering (`SharedQuestionArbiter`):** Sort active Inbox items strictly by operational urgency rather than noisy FIFO arrival:
  1. **`P0 — Critical Blocker / Stop / Security / Auth-Expiry / Budget Cap`** (Interrupt-Now lane!)
  2. **`P1 — Critical-Path Blocker`** (questions blocking HEFT critical-path tasks or `>= 2` concurrent tasks!)
  3. **`P2 — Breaking CCR / Conflict / `DisputeTest` / Ambiguous Steering Hold`**
  4. **`P3 — Single Non-Critical Task Question / Medium-Risk Spec Proposal`** (10-minute calm batch lane!)
  5. **`P4 — Advisory / FYI Digest / Optional Review`** (zero-interruption digest!)
- [ ] **Implement Calm Aging Reminders & Critical-Path Flush:** Track `created_at` and `blocked_worker_count` on every queued card; normal `P3` cards batch calmly on a **10-minute cadence** (consumed by `Task 127` Calm Inbox UI), automatically flushing early ONLY if `blocked_worker_count >= 2` or the blocked task enters the active critical path; gentle aging nudge surfaces after `30 min` idle without nagging sounds or modal popups!
- [ ] **Implement Stale & Retired Reply Reconciliation (`StaleReplyReconciler`):** Handle real-world async human timing cleanly — what if Question `Q-19` was already retired (because the user stopped/undid the feature, edited the decision directly in `.harness/views/`, or committed a human fix `Task 173` that answered it!) right before the user clicks Send on `Q-19`?
  - Detect `question.status !== 'open'` or superseded `options_version` BEFORE mutating `state.db`!
  - If the user's late reply AGREES with the already-settled answer → acknowledge smoothly (`"Already saved via your edit — nothing changed"`)!
  - If the user's late reply CONTRADICTS the newer settled state or targets a retired/undone feature → NEVER silently corrupt state or silently drop their words! Surface a crisp inline card: `"This question was already resolved by [X] — Keep [X] or Change to your new reply?"`!
- [ ] **Implement One-Click Batchable Answers & Recommended Defaults:** Attach concrete numbered options (with monotonic `options_version`) + recommended default + `"Why this matters (blocks N tasks)"` metadata to every user-facing question card!
- [ ] **Implement Auto-Retirement On Upstream Cancellation/Undo:** Whenever a feature is undone (`Task 129`), superseded by revision (`Task 087`), or settled via direct Markdown/Canvas edit (`Task 086`/`156`), automatically transition all obsolete open Inbox cards targeting that criterion to `status = 'retired'` with `retired_reason` so dead questions disappear immediately from the user's queue!
- [ ] **Implement Complete Interruption Audit Metrics:** Track total worker questions intercepted automatically by `OwnerFirstQuestionFilter`, duplicates collapsed by `inbox_subscribers`, and net human interruptions per build in `telemetry.db`!

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **5 parallel workers ask `"What date format should we display?"` within 10 seconds:** `QuestionDedupSubscriberStore` presents **1 single Inbox Card** (`"Blocking 5 tasks"`), NOT 5 duplicate cards, and wakes all 5 tasks in one atomic transaction when answered!
- **Worker `W-3` escalates `"What column name does users table use for email?"`:** `OwnerFirstQuestionFilter` resolves it in `< 5 ms` directly from `state.db` entity schema (`users.email`) with **ZERO user interruption**!
- **Developer opens Question Card `Q-42`, steps away for 20 min, edits the rule directly in VS Code `.harness/views/`, returns, and hits Send on the stale `Q-42` card:** `StaleReplyReconciler` detects `Q-42` was retired by Markdown edit and prompts cleanly (`"Keep VS Code edit or apply this reply?"`) instead of silently overwriting!
- **Feature `F-Export` is undone (`Task 129`) while 2 questions for `F-Export` were open in the Inbox:** Auto-retirement immediately marks both cards `retired` and clears them from the active queue!
- **Two `P3` minor questions arrive while the user is in Focus Mode, then a `P0` expired OAuth token blocks ALL 4 workers:** `P3` stays batched quietly while `P0` triggers immediate Interrupt-Now surfacing!
- **A subscribed task `T-9` is cancelled while `T-10` is still subscribed to `Q-15`:** Unsubscribing `T-9` updates `Q-15` cleanly to `"Blocking 1 task"` without retiring `Q-15` prematurely!
- **Last remaining subscribed task `T-10` is cancelled:** `Q-15` sees `0` active subscribers and auto-retires cleanly (`retired_reason: 'no_active_waiters'`)!

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Zero-Duplicate-Question Invariant:** At most ONE open Inbox card may exist for any `(scope_id, criterion_id)` or canonical question key regardless of how many parallel workers hit it.
- **Owner-First Interception Invariant:** Technical questions answerable from `state.db` or an internal agent owner NEVER interrupt the human developer.
- **Atomic Multi-Subscriber Wake Invariant:** Answering a deduplicated Inbox card settles the decision AND clears holds across ALL `inbox_subscribers` atomically in one transaction.
- **Zero-Silent-Stale-Overwrite Invariant:** Late replies to retired or superseded questions ALWAYS reconcile explicitly rather than silently clobbering newer truth.
- **Zero-Zombie-Card Invariant:** Questions whose subscribers are all cancelled/undone auto-retire immediately.
- **Strict Priority Ordering Invariant:** `P0 > P1 > P2 > P3 > P4` always governs queue ranking.

#### Multi-Agent Harmony And Branch Isolation

- **Worktree Setup:** Create branch `task/116-shared-question-queue-arbiter` via `node scripts/agent-worktree.mjs create 116 shared-question-queue-arbiter`.
- **Strict Subtree Boundary:** Touch ONLY `packages/steering/src/question-arbiter/**`, `packages/steering/tests/question-arbiter/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-116.md`.
- **Parallel Safe Execution:** Disjoint from `Tasks 113–115` and `Task 127` (`apps/renderer/src/cockpit/inbox/**`).
- **Handoff For `Task 127` (Calm Inbox UI), `Task 130` (Welcome-Back Commit-Answered Question Recaps), `Task 155` (Composer Question Target):** Export `SharedQuestionArbiter`, `OwnerFirstQuestionFilter`, `QuestionDedupSubscriberStore`, and `StaleReplyReconciler` in `.agent-handoffs/task-116.md`.
- **Commit-Only Discipline:** Commit exclusively on `task/116-shared-question-queue-arbiter`; **NEVER merge** into `main` or `harness/integration`.
- **Multi-Worker Concurrency Simulation Tests:** Simulate 8 workers concurrently hitting duplicate, owner-answerable, and stale/retired questions verifying 0 duplicate cards and 100% atomic wake!

### Task 117: Hardware Governor — Windows Resource Telemetry Collector (`GlobalMemoryStatusEx`, `CreateMemoryResourceNotification`, Job Accounting, DXGI VRAM, Disk Queue, Defender CPU & UI Latency)

- **Milestone & Track:** `M3 · Hardware Governor & Laptop-Friendly Execution`
- **Depends On:** `Task 001`, `Task 014`, `Task 041`
- **Git Worktree & Branch:** `task/117-governor-windows-telemetry` in `../ef-wt/task-117-governor-windows-telemetry` (commit on own branch only; **NEVER merge**)
- **Owned Write Scope (Disjoint Subtree):** `packages/governor/src/telemetry/**`, `packages/governor/tests/telemetry/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-117.md`
- **Mandatory Reference Files:** [app-shell-and-governor.md](app-shell-and-governor.md#the-hardware-governor), [execution-capacity.md](execution-capacity.md), [schema/telemetry.sql](schema/telemetry.sql), [desktop-app.mmd](desktop-app.mmd), [research/shell-and-hardware.md](research/shell-and-hardware.md), [research/sandbox-capacity-on-windows.md](research/sandbox-capacity-on-windows.md)
- **Shared Contracts Consumed / Produced:** Consumes `TelemetryDbRepo` (`Task 014`), `WindowsJobSupervisor` (`Task 041`); produces `WindowsResourceTelemetryCollector`, `MemoryNotificationWatcher`, `UiLatencyHeartbeatMonitor`, and `HardwareSnapshotSchema`

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Implement Native Low-Overhead Windows Memory & Commit Telemetry (`GlobalMemoryStatusEx` + `CreateMemoryResourceNotification`):** Sample real Windows physical memory (`ullTotalPhys`, `ullAvailPhys`), pagefile/commit headroom (`ullTotalPageFile`, `ullAvailPageFile`), and register an OS-native `CreateMemoryResourceNotification(LowMemoryResourceNotification)` kernel event handle (via lightweight N-API addon / safe Win32 helper with pure-Node fallback in non-Windows CI!) so the governor receives **instant kernel low-memory signals** BEFORE Windows starts thrashing the pagefile!
- [ ] **Implement Per-Slot Windows Job Object CPU & Memory Accounting:** Query `QueryInformationJobObject(JobObjectExtendedLimitInformation / BasicAccountingInformation)` on every active worker/verifier Job Object from `Task 041` to measure exact per-attempt `PeakJobMemoryUsed`, `CurrentWorkingSet`, `TotalUserTime`, `TotalKernelTime`, and active child process count — feeding exact real measurements into `Task 118`'s learned `footprints` table!
- [ ] **Implement DXGI GPU / VRAM Headroom Sampler:** Query active GPU adapter VRAM budget & current usage via DXGI (`IDXGIAdapter3::QueryVideoMemoryInfo` with safe graceful fallback when headless/no discrete GPU) so local Whisper (`Task 157`) and local Ollama/LM Studio models (`Task 138`) never OOM the user's GPU or freeze desktop compositing!
- [ ] **Implement Disk Free-Space & Disk Queue Depth Sampler:** Sample free bytes on BOTH the **project workspace drive** AND the **OS/AppData drive** (`GetDiskFreeSpaceExW` — catching split `C:` vs `D:` drives cleanly!) PLUS Windows disk queue depth / I/O busy percentage via PDH (`\PhysicalDisk(_Total)\Current Disk Queue Length`) so heavy `pnpm`/TypeScript/Postgres I/O bursts don't starve the machine!
- [ ] **Implement Windows Defender (`MsMpEng.exe`) CPU Contention Detector:** Track CPU share consumed by `MsMpEng.exe` (Windows Defender real-time AV scanning newly written `node_modules`/build artifacts!) separately from harness CPU so `Task 118` detects AV-induced thrashing (`MsMpEng > 25%` sustained), backs off file-heavy launches cleanly, and offers an optional educational tip on worktree folder exclusions (NEVER silently touching Defender settings itself!)!
- [ ] **Implement Renderer UI Input-to-Paint Latency Heartbeat (`UiLatencyHeartbeatMonitor`):** Receive lightweight `1 Hz` heartbeat samples from the Electron renderer measuring real event-loop / `requestAnimationFrame` input-to-paint p95 latency (`uiLatencyMs`); when the user's desktop app feels sluggish (`uiLatencyMs > 50 ms` sustained while user is interacting), signal the Governor immediately so the laptop stays butter-smooth (`< 50 ms` target in `Task 198`)!
- [ ] **Implement Strict Collector Overhead Budget (`< 0.5%` CPU, `< 15 MB` RAM):** Poll at adaptive cadence (`1 s` when active build running, `5 s` when idle, `0 Hz` when suspended/paused), NEVER spawning slow `powershell.exe` / `wmic.exe` subprocesses every second (use direct native Win32 / N-API calls only!) so telemetry collection itself never causes CPU jitter!
- [ ] **Implement Cross-Platform Interface & Deterministic Simulator Backend:** Expose a clean `ResourceTelemetryProvider` interface with: (1) `Win32NativeTelemetryProvider` (production Windows 10/11), (2) `PosixFallbackTelemetryProvider` (for dev/CI parity), and (3) `SyntheticTelemetryProvider` (deterministic time-series injection for `Task 118` hysteresis tests and `Task 192` fault sim)!

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **System RAM looks 30% free (`ullAvailPhys`), yet Windows Commit Limit is 96% exhausted (`ullAvailPageFile < 1 GB`):** Collector tracks BOTH physical free RAM AND available commit charge so imminent `ERROR_COMMITMENT_LIMIT` crashes are detected BEFORE spawning another Node/Chromium process!
- **Project repo lives on `D:\` (`500 GB` free) while `%LOCALAPPDATA%` (CAS/SQLite/worktrees) lives on `C:\` (`3.2 GB` free):** Collector monitors BOTH volumes independently and reports the tightest threshold (`C:\ < 5 GB`) cleanly!
- **Machine has no dedicated GPU (integrated Intel UHD / headless CI VM) where DXGI returns shared memory or unavailable:** DXGI probe degrades gracefully to `{ gpuAvailable: false, sharedVramBudgetBytes }` without throwing or crashing!
- **Windows Defender `MsMpEng.exe` spikes to `45%` CPU right after `pnpm install` unpacks 8,000 files:** Defender CPU detector flags `avContentionActive: true` so Governor throttles spawning a second heavy build until Defender finishes scanning!
- **Calling `powershell Get-Counter` every second would burn 15% CPU on a laptop:** Strictly forbidden! Native Win32 / N-API PDH + `GlobalMemoryStatusEx` executes in `< 1 ms` per tick (`< 0.2%` CPU)!
- **Electron renderer window is minimized/hidden (`document.hidden === true`):** `UiLatencyHeartbeatMonitor` ignores throttled background `rAF` intervals (`1,000 ms`) so minimizing the window NEVER falsely triggers `"UI lag"` pressure!
- **Telemetry sample hits transient `ACCESS_DENIED` querying a protected system process:** Collector isolates per-metric try/catch, records `metricUnavailable` cleanly, and keeps all other core signals (RAM, Disk, Job Objects) flowing!

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Zero-Subprocess-Polling Invariant:** Production Windows telemetry NEVER spawns `powershell.exe`, `cmd.exe`, or `wmic.exe` on polling ticks.
- **Sub-0.5%-CPU Overhead Invariant:** Telemetry collector averages `< 0.5%` CPU and `< 15 MB` RAM across continuous active builds.
- **Dual-Volume Disk Monitoring Invariant:** Both the project workspace drive AND the AppData/worktree drive are always monitored independently.
- **Physical-AND-Commit Memory Invariant:** Pressure signals inspect BOTH physical RAM and Windows commit charge plus `CreateMemoryResourceNotification`.
- **Minimized-Window rAF Guard Invariant:** Backgrounded/minimized Electron windows never emit false UI-latency pressure spikes.
- **Zero-AV-Tampering Invariant:** Collector observes `MsMpEng.exe` read-only and NEVER attempts to modify Windows Defender configuration automatically.

### Task 118: Hardware Governor — Calibration Run, Learned `footprints`, 4-Level Pressure Hysteresis (Green/Yellow/Orange/Red), Heavy-Lane Semaphore, GPU Whisper Priority & Disk Thresholds

- **Milestone & Track:** `M3 · Hardware Governor Admission & Pressure Control`
- **Depends On:** `Task 001`, `Task 014`, `Task 117`
- **Git Worktree & Branch:** `task/118-governor-hysteresis-footprints` in `../ef-wt/task-118-governor-hysteresis-footprints` (commit on own branch only; **NEVER merge**)
- **Owned Write Scope (Disjoint Subtree):** `packages/governor/src/admission/**`, `packages/governor/tests/admission/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-118.md`
- **Mandatory Reference Files:** [app-shell-and-governor.md](app-shell-and-governor.md#pressure-levels-and-hysteresis), [execution-capacity.md](execution-capacity.md), [schema/global.sql](schema/global.sql), [desktop-app.mmd](desktop-app.mmd), [research/shell-and-hardware.md](research/shell-and-hardware.md), [research/sandbox-capacity-on-windows.md](research/sandbox-capacity-on-windows.md)
- **Shared Contracts Consumed / Produced:** Consumes `GlobalDbRepo.footprints` (`Task 014`), `WindowsResourceTelemetryCollector` & `HardwareSnapshotSchema` (`Task 117`); produces `MachineCalibrationRunner`, `LearnedFootprintStore`, `PressureHysteresisStateMachine`, `HeavyLaneSemaphore`, `GpuWhisperPriorityArbiter`, and `DiskHeadroomGuard`

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Implement First-Run Machine Calibration Runner (`MachineCalibrationRunner`):** On first launch (or hardware change / manual recalibrate in Settings), inspect CPU core count, total physical RAM, GPU/VRAM class, SSD vs HDD I/O latency, and run a fast `<= 3 s` non-intrusive calibration profile establishing safe baseline concurrency caps (e.g., 16 GB laptop defaults conservatively to max `2` warm execution slots vs 64 GB desktop allowing `4`!), persisted in `global.db`!
- [ ] **Implement Empirical Learned `footprints` Store (`LearnedFootprintStore`):** Record actual observed peak RAM (`peak_ram_mb`), peak CPU time, disk write bytes, and wall-clock duration per `(project_id, command_class: 'typecheck' | 'unit_test' | 'playwright' | 'build' | 'pnpm_install' | 'db_migrate')` in `global.db.footprints` (from `Task 117` Job Object readings!) using a conservative `p90` / exponential moving high-watermark so admission control predicts real memory demand (e.g., `"Playwright in this Next.js repo peaks at 1.9 GB RAM"`) before launching a job!
- [ ] **Implement Exact 4-Level Pressure Hysteresis State Machine (`PressureHysteresisStateMachine`):** Prevent rapid oscillation (`Green ↔ Orange` flapping every second!) by enforcing strict asymmetric debounce timers from [app-shell-and-governor.md](app-shell-and-governor.md):
  - **Enter Worse Level:** Sustained threshold breach for **`>= 10 seconds`** (OR **instant `0 s` jump** to `RED` on OS `LowMemoryResourceNotification` or `< 2 GB` disk!)
  - **Recover To Better Level:** Sustained clean headroom below the *lower* recovery margin for **`>= 30 seconds`**!
  - **Exact 4 Levels:**
    - **`GREEN`:** Normal full preset concurrency, Office View animations enabled, normal background indexing
    - **`YELLOW`:** Soft throttle — reduce warm execution slots by 1, defer background indexing/GC/non-critical pre-warming, keep UI & critical workers full speed
    - **`ORANGE`:** Tight laptop protection — cap warm execution slots to `1`, pause background non-critical tasks, emit `governor.orange_entered` triggering automatic **Office View → Board View fallback** (`Task 165`), wait before spawning new heavy Playwright/build jobs!
    - **`RED`:** Emergency preservation — halt all new execution launches immediately, pause non-essential local models, preserve active DB/worktree integrity, surface clear plain-English Hardware Pressure Card (RAM / Disk / GPU)!
- [ ] **Implement Single Heavy-Lane Semaphore (`HeavyLaneSemaphore`):** Serialize inherently heavy resource hogs (`pnpm install`, full `tsc`/Vite production bundle, Playwright browser launch, Docker/Postgres cold init, full DB migrate) across the machine using a fair weighted semaphore (`maxHeavyPermits = 1` on `<= 16 GB` RAM or `Yellow/Orange`, `<= 2` on `>= 32 GB` `Green`) with priority ordering (**Verifier > Worker > Background**) so two Playwright + `tsc` runs never simultaneously spike a 16 GB laptop into swap death!
- [ ] **Implement GPU / Whisper Dictation Priority Arbiter (`GpuWhisperPriorityArbiter`):** Whenever the developer activates local voice dictation (`Task 157` Whisper) while a local Ollama/LM Studio background model (`Task 138`) is sharing GPU VRAM, immediately grant **interactive Whisper dictation priority** (pausing/deferring new local-LLM GPU dispatches cleanly until dictation finishes) so speech transcription never stutters!
- [ ] **Implement Exact 3-Tier Disk Headroom Guard (`DiskHeadroomGuard` — `15 GB / 5 GB / 2 GB`):** Continuously monitor BOTH project drive AND AppData/worktree drive (`Task 117`) against exact thresholds from [app-shell-and-governor.md](app-shell-and-governor.md):
  - **`< 15 GB` (Warning / Soft GC):** Trigger automatic background CAS GC (`Task 028`) + expired temp-worktree / old log cleanup + subtle yellow disk indicator
  - **`< 5 GB` (Pause New Launches / `ORANGE`):** Stop starting new builds/worktrees/component downloads, run aggressive safe cache cleanup, surface clear `"Low disk space (< 5 GB on C:) — Free space or clean caches"` card!
  - **`< 2 GB` (Emergency Hard Stop / `RED`):** Immediate instant transition to `RED` (`0 s` debounce!), pause ALL running writers cleanly before SQLite WAL or Git objects risk `ENOSPC` corruption!
- [ ] **Implement Memory-Footprint Admission Check Before Spawn:** Before granting a run slot to a command of class `C`, verify `availRamMb - safetyReserveMb >= learnedFootprintP90(C)` (and commit headroom sufficient); if insufficient right now while another heavy job is running, queue cleanly rather than spawning into an OOM kill!
- [ ] **Implement Live Telemetry & User-Readable Reason Emitter:** Whenever pressure shifts `Green → Yellow → Orange → Red`, emit the exact primary driver (`"RAM low (1.8 GB free)"`, `"Windows Defender scanning"`, `"UI latency > 50 ms"`, `"Disk C: < 5 GB"`) cleanly for Top Bar / Diagnostics (`Task 133`)!

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **RAM dips briefly for 3 seconds during a short GC spike and bounces back:** 10-second enter debounce absorbs the transient spike completely (`0` flapping transitions, Office View does NOT flicker to Board)!
- **RAM stays critically low for 12 seconds (`Green → Orange`), then improves for 15 seconds, then dips again:** 30-second recovery hysteresis keeps state stably in `Orange` instead of oscillating `Orange → Yellow → Orange`!
- **OS fires `LowMemoryResourceNotification` OR Drive `C:` drops to `1.8 GB` free:** Emergency `0 s` bypass jumps immediately to `RED`, preventing `ENOSPC` / `OOM` database corruption!
- **Two workers request `playwright` and `pnpm build` simultaneously on a 16 GB laptop:** `HeavyLaneSemaphore` (`permits = 1`) runs Verifier's Playwright first (`Verifier > Worker`), then immediately grants the permit to Worker's build — keeping peak RAM safely under 12 GB!
- **User presses Dictation hotkey while local Ollama `qwen2.5-coder:14b` is queued for a background worker turn:** `GpuWhisperPriorityArbiter` reserves GPU headroom for Whisper immediately so dictation streams smoothly at real-time speed!
- **First run of a brand-new repo has 0 rows in `global.db.footprints`:** Uses conservative safe class defaults (`unit_test: 400 MB`, `tsc: 900 MB`, `playwright: 1,500 MB`, `pnpm_install: 1,000 MB`) and updates empirically from actual Job Object readings on run #1!
- **User manually frees 20 GB on `C:` while paused at `< 5 GB`:** Within 30 s recovery window (or instant on user `"Recheck disk"` click), `DiskHeadroomGuard` clears the disk block cleanly and offers Resume!

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Asymmetric Hysteresis Invariant:** Non-emergency pressure worsening requires `>= 10 s` sustained breach; recovery ALWAYS requires `>= 30 s` sustained clean headroom.
- **Zero-Delay Emergency Invariant:** `LowMemoryResourceNotification` and `< 2 GB` disk bypass enter-debounce immediately (`0 s` to `RED`).
- **Exact 15 / 5 / 2 GB Disk Threshold Invariant:** `< 15 GB` warns + triggers safe GC, `< 5 GB` pauses new launches, `< 2 GB` emergency-halts writers before `ENOSPC`.
- **Verifier-Over-Worker Heavy-Lane Priority Invariant:** Under heavy-lane contention, verifying finished work ALWAYS preempts launching new speculative builds.
- **Interactive-Whisper-First GPU Invariant:** User voice dictation always holds top GPU priority over background local-model turns.
- **Footprint-Backed Admission Invariant:** Commands are admitted only when predicted `p90` RAM fits inside available RAM + commit headroom (unless single-slot forward-progress floor applies cleanly!).

- **Strict Subtree Boundary:** Touch ONLY `packages/governor/src/admission/**`, `packages/governor/tests/admission/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-118.md`.

### Task 119: Three-Pool Execution Capacity Scheduler (Thinking 12–20, Warm Execution Pool 2–4 w/ Priority, Session-Process Cap, Single Disk Lane & Tier E Interface)

- **Milestone & Track:** `M3 · Three-Pool Execution Capacity Architecture`
- **Depends On:** `Task 001`, `Task 038`, `Task 045`, `Task 107`, `Task 118`
- **Git Worktree & Branch:** `task/119-three-pool-capacity-scheduler` in `../ef-wt/task-119-three-pool-capacity-scheduler` (commit on own branch only; **NEVER merge**)
- **Owned Write Scope (Disjoint Subtree):** `packages/governor/src/capacity-pools/**`, `packages/governor/tests/capacity-pools/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-119.md`
- **Mandatory Reference Files:** [execution-capacity.md](execution-capacity.md), [app-shell-and-governor.md](app-shell-and-governor.md), [sandbox-and-security.md](sandbox-and-security.md), [planning-and-crew.md](planning-and-crew.md), [research/sandbox-capacity-on-windows.md](research/sandbox-capacity-on-windows.md), [research/shell-and-hardware.md](research/shell-and-hardware.md)
- **Shared Contracts Consumed / Produced:** Consumes `WorktreeSlotPool` (`Task 038`), `SandboxTierSelector` (`Task 045`), `WaveParallelismCalculator` (`Task 107`), `PressureHysteresisStateMachine` & `HeavyLaneSemaphore` (`Task 118`); produces `ThreePoolCapacityScheduler`, `ThinkingPoolCoordinator`, `WarmExecutionSlotPool`, `SessionProcessCapGuard`, `SingleDiskWriteLane`, and `TierERemoteExecutionInterface`

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Implement Pool 1 — High-Concurrency Lightweight `Thinking` Pool (`12–20` Concurrent Slots, `ThinkingPoolCoordinator`):** Separate network-bound LLM thinking/planning/streaming turns (which consume `< 10 MB` RAM and `~0%` local CPU while waiting on remote provider APIs!) from heavy local build/test execution — enabling `12–20` simultaneous thinking agents (bounded by `Task 140` provider pacing and DAG width) without requiring 20 heavyweight OS sandboxes or 20 Vite servers running at once!
- [ ] **Implement Pool 2 — Bounded `Warm Execution Pool` (`2–4` Concurrent Slots, `WarmExecutionSlotPool`):** Maintain strictly `2–4` pre-warmed isolated execution slots (`2` on 16 GB laptops, `3–4` on 32–64 GB desktops, dynamically scaled down to `1` on Governor `Orange` / `0` on `Red`!) where workers and verifiers **lease an execution slot ONLY during actual command execution** (`tsc`, `vitest`, `playwright`, `build`, `migrate`) and immediately release it back to the pool when returning to LLM thinking!
  - Enforce strict priority queue inside Pool 2: **`Verifier` (finishing/merging already-coded work!) > `Active Worker` (`harness.run` build/test step) > `Background` (lint, index, brownfield scan, preview)** — guaranteeing finished work NEVER starves waiting behind speculative new tasks!
  - Expose exact real-time slot state (`thinkingCount`, `waitingForRunSlotCount`, `runningSlotCount`, `slotOwnerTaskIds`) directly to `Task 124` Board Cockpit (`thinking` vs `run-slot` badges!) and `Task 163` Office View!
- [ ] **Implement Pool 3 — `Session-Process Cap` For Heavy Foreign CLI Runtimes (`SessionProcessCapGuard`):** Foreign interactive CLI runtimes (`codex app-server`, `claude`, `copilot`, `cursor`, `opencode`, `gemini` in `Tasks 142–149`) hold long-lived resident Node/Rust child processes (`150–400 MB` RAM each!) even while idle; enforce an explicit **Session-Process Cap** (e.g., `<= 4` active resident foreign CLI processes on 16 GB RAM, `<= 8` on 32+ GB), automatically parking idle wrapped foreign sessions (`Task 150`) to reclaim RAM cleanly before spawning another foreign session!
- [ ] **Implement Single Disk-Heavy Write Lane (`SingleDiskWriteLane`):** Serialize high-I/O filesystem operations (`git worktree add/reset`, `pnpm install`/hardlink unpack, `sqlite VACUUM/backup`, large CAS GC sweeps, brownfield initial index) through a single async disk-write lane so parallel Git/pnpm operations NEVER cause NTFS directory-lock (`EBUSY`) storms or disk-queue saturation!
- [ ] **Implement Forward-Progress Minimum Floor & Deadlock Prevention:** Guarantee that even under `Yellow`/`Orange` pressure (so long as state !== `RED` and disk >= 2 GB), at least **1 execution slot** stays alive for the highest-priority Verifier/Critical-Path task so builds always make guaranteed forward progress without livelocking!
- [ ] **Implement Clean `Tier E` Remote Execution Extension Interface (`TierERemoteExecutionInterface`):** Define the clean pluggable `ExecutionSlotBackend` contract matching `Task 045`'s Tier E stub (`provisionSlot`, `syncDiff`, `execCommand`, `streamOutput`, `collectArtifacts`, `releaseSlot`, `costEstimate`) so post-v1 remote cloud sandboxes can scale Pool 2 beyond local laptop limits with zero scheduler rewrite — keeping v1 strictly local while validating interface fidelity via an in-memory mock backend test!
- [ ] **Implement Starvation Aging On Pool 2:** Apply bounded wait-time aging to queued `Active Worker` slots so continuous `Verifier` bursts cannot starve a `Worker` indefinitely (`maxWaitBoost` after `60 s`)!
- [ ] **Implement Clean Slot Cancellation & Leak Audit On Lease Release:** Whenever a leased Pool 2 slot releases (normal finish, timeout, or `STOP`), verify its associated Windows Job Object (`Task 041`) has `0` active child processes before marking the slot clean and ready for the next lessee!

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **12 workers finish LLM turns simultaneously and all call `harness.run('pnpm test')` at the same millisecond on a 16 GB laptop (`Pool 2 = 2 slots`):** Exactly `2` run immediately; the other `10` wait cleanly in the Pool 2 queue (visible as `"Waiting for run slot"` on the Board!) with ZERO OOM crash and ZERO timeout countdown while queued (command execution timeout starts ONLY once the slot is actually acquired!)!
- **While 6 `Active Workers` are queued for Pool 2, 2 finished candidates enter `VERIFYING`:** `Verifier > Worker` priority jumps both Verifiers to the head of the queue so verified code merges immediately and frees DAG blockers!
- **A `Worker` has been waiting in Pool 2 for 75 seconds while 5 Verifiers arrived back-to-back:** Aging boost ensures the waiting Worker gets the next slot cleanly (zero starvation)!
- **6 foreign Claude/Codex CLI sessions are alive on a 16 GB laptop (`SessionProcessCap = 4`):** `SessionProcessCapGuard` cleanly checkpoints & parks the 2 longest-idle wrapped sessions (`Task 150`) BEFORE spawning Session #5, reclaiming `~600 MB` RAM smoothly!
- **Governor shifts `Green → Orange` while 3 Pool 2 slots are actively running (`target = 1`):** Scheduler does NOT kill slots #2 and #3 mid-test; it stops issuing new leases until active count drops below `1`, draining cleanly!
- **Two tasks try to unpack `node_modules` and clone a worktree simultaneously:** `SingleDiskWriteLane` serializes both disk bursts seamlessly, eliminating Windows NTFS `EPERM`/`EBUSY` races!
- **A worker cancels (`STOP`) while waiting in Pool 2 queue:** Waiter immediately dequeues cleanly with `AbortError`, freeing its thinking slot and never leaking a ghost lease!

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Thinking-Decoupled-From-Execution Invariant:** Remote LLM thinking concurrency (`12–20`) NEVER forces equal numbers of simultaneous heavy local builds/tests (`2–4`).
- **Command-Timeout-Starts-On-Lease Invariant:** Waiting in Pool 2 queue NEVER consumes a worker command's execution timeout budget.
- **Verifier-Priority-With-Zero-Starvation Invariant:** Verifiers preempt Workers in Pool 2 while monotonic aging prevents indefinite Worker starvation.
- **Zero-Leaked-Slot-Process Invariant:** Every Pool 2 slot passes a `0-process` Job Object cleanliness check before reuse.
- **Single-Disk-Lane Serialization Invariant:** Heavy NTFS/Git/pnpm/SQLite-maintenance bursts serialize cleanly without parallel lock thrashing.
- **Session-Process Cap Invariant:** Active resident foreign CLI child processes strictly stay `<= SessionProcessCap`.

#### Multi-Agent Harmony And Branch Isolation

- **Worktree Setup:** Create branch `task/119-three-pool-capacity-scheduler` via `node scripts/agent-worktree.mjs create 119 three-pool-capacity-scheduler`.
- **Strict Subtree Boundary:** Touch ONLY `packages/governor/src/capacity-pools/**`, `packages/governor/tests/capacity-pools/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-119.md`.
- **Parallel Safe Execution:** Disjoint from `Tasks 117–118`, `Task 107`, and `Task 188` (`packages/portability/src/broker/**`).
- **Handoff For `Task 048` (`harness.run` Pool-2 Lease), `Task 107` (HEFT Concurrency Cap), `Task 124` (Board Thinking vs Run-Slot Badges), `Task 150` (Idle Foreign CLI Auto-Park), `Task 188` (Multi-Project Slot Sharing):** Export `ThreePoolCapacityScheduler`, `ThinkingPoolCoordinator`, `WarmExecutionSlotPool`, `SessionProcessCapGuard`, `SingleDiskWriteLane`, and `TierERemoteExecutionInterface` in `.agent-handoffs/task-119.md`.
- **Commit-Only Discipline:** Commit exclusively on `task/119-three-pool-capacity-scheduler`; **NEVER merge** into `main` or `harness/integration`.

- **Milestone & Track:** `M3 · Secrets Vault & Credential Security`
- **Depends On:** `Task 001`, `Task 011`, `Task 014`, `Task 030`, `Task 045`
- **Git Worktree & Branch:** `task/120-dpapi-secrets-vault-env-injection` in `../ef-wt/task-120-dpapi-secrets-vault-env-injection` (commit on own branch only; **NEVER merge**)

- **Shared Contracts Consumed / Produced:** Consumes `PacketSecurityRedactor` (`Task 011`), `GlobalDbRepo` (`Task 014`), `SecretPurgeEngine` (`Task 030`); produces `WindowsDpapiSecretsVault`, `RuntimeOnlyEnvInjector`, `LiveKeyTestRefusalGuard`, `ProviderSecretProber`, and `GitignoredLocalEnvWriter`

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Implement Windows Credential Manager / DPAPI Secrets Vault (`WindowsDpapiSecretsVault`):** Store ALL provider API keys, OAuth refresh tokens, GitHub/Vercel/SSH credentials, and per-project app secrets strictly encrypted via **Windows DPAPI (`CryptProtectData` / `CRYPTPROTECT_UI_FORBIDDEN`, user-scoped) / Windows Credential Manager (`CredWriteW` / `CredReadW` / `CredDeleteW`)** — storing ONLY non-secret metadata (`secretId`, `projectId`, `envScope: 'test' | 'dev' | 'staging' | 'prod'`, `name`, `lastFourMasked`, `providerHint`, `createdAt`, `rotatedAt`, `verifiedStatus`) in `global.db` / `state.db` and **ZERO plaintext secret bytes in SQLite, JSON config files, CAS blobs, or logs!**
- [ ] **Implement Strict Runtime-Only Environment Injection (`RuntimeOnlyEnvInjector`):** When a local preview server, test environment (`Task 050`), or deploy step (`Task 179`) needs an approved secret, inject it strictly into that specific child process's **in-memory environment block** at spawn time — NEVER writing secrets into tracked project files, worktree files, command-line argv strings (visible in Task Manager / `Get-CimInstance Win32_Process`!), or LLM prompts; simultaneously register every injected value into `Task 011`'s live `PacketSecurityRedactor` so even if the child app prints `process.env` to stdout/stderr, every byte is scrubbed before reaching logs, UI, or models!
- [ ] **Implement Hard Live-Key Refusal In Test & Development Environments (`LiveKeyTestRefusalGuard`):** Deterministically inspect EVERY secret scoped to `envScope: 'test' | 'dev'` (or injected into any sandbox/test run) and **HARD-REFUSE production/live secret prefixes & patterns**:
  - Reject `sk_live_*`, `pk_live_*` (when paired with live secret), `rk_live_*` (Stripe live keys!)
  - Reject `SG.` production SendGrid / live Twilio / live AWS production IAM keys (`AKIA*` when tagged prod) / production DB URLs matching configured `prod` hostnames or containing `prod` without explicit test override!
  - Surface a crisp plain-English refusal card (`"Refused to inject Stripe LIVE key (sk_live_...) into local test environment — please supply a Stripe TEST key (sk_test_...) or use the built-in local Stripe mock!"`)!
- [ ] **Implement Lightweight Zero-Charge Provider Secret Probes (`ProviderSecretProber`):** Verify user-entered project & provider secrets on save using safe, read-only, non-destructive endpoints (Stripe `GET /v1/balance` confirming `livemode === false` for test keys, Resend/SendGrid read-only key check, Postgres `SELECT 1` connection check with `5 s` timeout, OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini/OpenRouter zero-token `/models` check), clearly marking secrets `verified_test` / `verified_live` / `invalid` / `unreachable`!
- [ ] **Implement Optional Gitignored Local `.env` Writer (`GitignoredLocalEnvWriter`):** Only when the developer explicitly opts in (so they can also run `pnpm dev` directly from their own VS Code terminal outside EF Harness!), write `<project>/.env.local` atomically **ONLY AFTER proving via `git check-ignore -q .env.local` that `.env.local` is ignored by Git** (refusing to write if not ignored, NEVER modifying tracked `.env.example` with real values!), with strict Windows user-only NTFS ACL (`icacls` owner-only)!
- [ ] **Implement Instant Secret Rotation & Deletion With `Task 030` Purge Hook:** Rotating or deleting a secret immediately deletes/replaces the DPAPI entry, invalidates in-memory caches, and offers 1-click invocation of `Task 030`'s 8-step secret purge if a user accidentally pasted a key into chat!
- [ ] **Implement Strict Worker Sandbox Zero-Secret Boundary:** Guarantee that Tier A/B/C coding worker sandboxes (`Tasks 042–045`) NEVER receive provider API keys, user OAuth tokens, GitHub/Vercel tokens, or production secrets in their environment block (workers call the kernel loopback proxy / MCP server only — zero direct credentials inside worker sandboxes!).
- [ ] **Implement Name-Only Diff Export For Deploy Sync (`Task 179`):** Expose `listSecretNamesAndHashes(projectId, envScope)` returning ONLY secret names + salted HMAC fingerprints (NEVER plaintext values!) so deploy adapters (`Task 179`) can diff which env vars changed without exposing secrets in plan/diff logs!

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **User accidentally pastes `sk_live_51ABC...` into the `"Local Test Stripe Key"` secret card:** `LiveKeyTestRefusalGuard` rejects immediately BEFORE saving or injecting, protecting the user's real Stripe account from automated test charges!
- **A buggy target app runs `console.log(process.env)` during local verification:** Because `RuntimeOnlyEnvInjector` registers every active secret value in `PacketSecurityRedactor`, stdout is scrubbed cleanly to `[REDACTED_SECRET:STRIPE_TEST_KEY]` before reaching logs, SQLite, UI, or the coding worker!
- **Target project forgot to put `.env.local` in `.gitignore`, and user clicks `"Export local .env.local"`:** `GitignoredLocalEnvWriter` runs `git check-ignore -q .env.local`, sees exit code `1` (NOT ignored!), refuses to write, and offers `"Add .env.local to .gitignore first"`!
- **A coding worker tries to read `process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY` or `process.env.GITHUB_TOKEN` inside its sandbox:** Environment is completely clean (`undefined`) because ONLY `harnessd` holds provider/deploy credentials!
- **Secret value contains newlines (e.g., SSH private key or PEM certificate):** DPAPI encrypts raw UTF-8/binary cleanly; `RuntimeOnlyEnvInjector` passes verbatim via process env block (NEVER shell string interpolation!) and redacts every base64 body line in logs!
- **User tries to inspect `state.db` or `global.db` with a hex editor looking for stored secrets:** Zero secret plaintext bytes exist anywhere in SQLite — verified by automated raw-file byte scan!
- **Windows DPAPI returns an error when running under a different Windows user profile (e.g., copied `%LOCALAPPDATA%` folder to a new account):** Vault catches DPAPI decryption failure cleanly and prompts `"Credentials need to be re-entered on this Windows account"` without crashing `harnessd`!

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Zero-Plaintext-At-Rest Invariant:** Secrets are NEVER stored in plaintext in `state.db`, `global.db`, CAS, `.json` config files, or logs; OS DPAPI / Windows Credential Manager is the sole secret store.
- **Zero-Worker-Sandbox-Secret Invariant:** Coding worker processes NEVER receive provider API keys, OAuth tokens, deploy tokens, or prod secrets in their env block or argv.
- **Hard-Live-Key-Test-Refusal Invariant:** Live-mode payment/production credentials (`sk_live_*`, `rk_live_*`, `livemode: true`, prod DB hosts) are unconditionally rejected from `test` and `dev` scopes.
- **Zero-Argv-Secret Invariant:** Secrets are NEVER passed as CLI flags/arguments (strictly env block or stdin pipe).
- **Mandatory-Gitignore-Before-`.env`-Write Invariant:** `GitignoredLocalEnvWriter` strictly requires `git check-ignore -q` exit `0` before writing any local `.env*` file.
- **Live-Redactor-Registration Invariant:** Every injected runtime secret is automatically registered with `PacketSecurityRedactor` for its full process lifetime.

#### Multi-Agent Harmony And Branch Isolation

- **Worktree Setup:** Create branch `task/120-dpapi-secrets-vault-env-injection` via `node scripts/agent-worktree.mjs create 120 dpapi-secrets-vault-env-injection`.
- **Strict Subtree Boundary:** Touch ONLY `packages/governor/src/vault/**`, `packages/governor/tests/vault/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-120.md`.
- **Parallel Safe Execution:** Disjoint from `Tasks 117–119`, `Task 121`, and `Tasks 136–139` (`packages/providers/**`).
- **Handoff For `Task 136`–`139` (Provider Key/OAuth Vault Storage), `Task 160` (Preview Runtime Env), `Task 179` (Deploy `syncEnv` Name-Only Diff), `Task 199` (Security Final Audit):** Export `WindowsDpapiSecretsVault`, `RuntimeOnlyEnvInjector`, `LiveKeyTestRefusalGuard`, `ProviderSecretProber`, and `GitignoredLocalEnvWriter` in `.agent-handoffs/task-120.md`.
- **Commit-Only Discipline:** Commit exclusively on `task/120-dpapi-secrets-vault-env-injection`; **NEVER merge** into `main` or `harness/integration`.
- **Raw-Disk Byte-Scan Tests:** Store synthetic canary secrets (`CANARY_DPAPI_SECRET_999`, `sk_live_CANARY_888`), verify DPAPI round-trip decryption on Windows, scan every SQLite/log/CAS file on disk asserting **0 raw occurrences**, and verify `sk_live_` test refusal!

### Task 121: Human-Step Probing & Verification Engine (Playwright, Docker, DB URL, Cloud API Probes, Consented Terminal Installers & Attested-vs-Verified Labels)

- **Milestone & Track:** `M3 · Honest Human-Step Verification & Tool Onboarding`
- **Depends On:** `Task 001`, `Task 017`, `Task 041`, `Task 116`, `Task 120`
- **Git Worktree & Branch:** `task/121-human-step-probing-verification` in `../ef-wt/task-121-human-step-probing-verification` (commit on own branch only; **NEVER merge**)
- **Owned Write Scope (Disjoint Subtree):** `packages/governor/src/human-steps/**`, `packages/governor/tests/human-steps/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-121.md`
- **Mandatory Reference Files:** [build-cockpit.md](build-cockpit.md#tool-and-account-cards), [test-environments.md](test-environments.md), [ship-and-deploy.md](ship-and-deploy.md), [app-shell-and-governor.md](app-shell-and-governor.md), [research/test-environments-on-windows.md](research/test-environments-on-windows.md)
- **Shared Contracts Consumed / Produced:** Consumes `KnowledgeGraphRepo` (`Task 017`), `WindowsJobSupervisor` (`Task 041`), `SharedQuestionArbiter` (`Task 116`), `WindowsDpapiSecretsVault` (`Task 120`); produces `HumanStepProbeRegistry`, `ConsentedTerminalInstaller`, `HumanStepStateStore`, and `AttestedVsVerifiedBadgePolicy`

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Implement Structured Human-Step Lifecycle Store (`HumanStepStateStore`):** Track every prerequisite or external action requiring the human developer (installing a system runtime, authenticating a CLI, creating an external webhook/DNS record, provisioning a remote database, verifying an email domain) in `state.db.human_steps` with `{ stepId, stepType, title, plainEnglishInstructions[], probeSpec, status: 'pending' | 'probing' | 'verified' | 'attested' | 'failed', lastProbeResult, attestedAt?, verifiedAt?, blockingTaskIds[] }`!
- [ ] **Implement Deterministic Built-In Machine Probes (`HumanStepProbeRegistry`):** Automatically verify prerequisites with real local/read-only checks (strict `<= 10 s` timeout, zero destructive mutations!) whenever the user clicks `"Check again"` or returns to the app (`Task 130`):
  1. **`playwright` Probe:** Check Chromium executable presence, version parity with project's `playwright` version, and headless `about:blank` launch smoke test!
  2. **`docker` Probe:** Check `docker info --format '{{.ServerVersion}}'` confirming Docker Desktop daemon is actually running and responsive (distinguishing `"not installed"` vs `"installed but Docker Desktop not started"`!)!
  3. **`database_url` Probe:** Test real TCP + protocol handshake (`SELECT 1` for Postgres, `PING` for Redis) against vault-stored connection URL (`Task 120`) without mutating schema or printing credentials!
  4. **`cli_tool` Probe:** Check binary presence + minimum semver version (`git`, `gh`, `node`, `pnpm`, `vercel`, `ssh`, `codex`, `claude`, `copilot`, `cursor`, `opencode`) + read-only auth-status check (`gh auth status`, etc.)!
  5. **`cloud_api` / `dns` / `webhook` Probe:** Perform read-only HTTPS/DNS lookup (e.g., `TXT`/`CNAME` DNS record check, Vercel project reachability, OAuth callback URL reachable) proving external registration actually took effect!
- [ ] **Implement Strict `Verified` vs `Attested` Honesty Policy (`AttestedVsVerifiedBadgePolicy`):**
  - Mark a step **`verified`** (green check) **ONLY** when an automated deterministic probe returned PASS!
  - When a step CANNOT be probed automatically (e.g., `"I turned on 2FA in Stripe dashboard"` or `"I accepted Apple legal terms"` or an air-gapped private endpoint), allow the user to click `"I did this manually"` — strictly labeling the step **`attested`** (`"Self-attested by you (unprobed)"`, NEVER falsely stamped `verified`!) so Landing Summary (`Task 101`) and Ship checklists remain 100% honest!
  - Hard-FORBID manual `attested` bypass on **locally probeable hard requirements** where skipping would cause immediate guaranteed failure (e.g., missing Playwright browser binary when Playwright tests must run, or broken Postgres URL when DB migrations must run — user must fix or skip the feature cleanly)!
- [ ] **Implement Consented Visible Terminal Installer (`ConsentedTerminalInstaller`):** For fixable local tool gaps (e.g., installing Playwright Chromium `npx playwright install chromium`, logging into `gh auth login`, or installing an approved CLI via `winget`), NEVER run silent background system-wide installs! Present the **EXACT shell command** in a clear Consent Card (`"Run this command?"`), execute it ONLY after explicit click inside a visible bounded terminal pane supervised by `Task 041` Job Objects with live streaming output + Cancel button, and immediately re-run the matching probe on exit code `0`!
- [ ] **Implement Automatic Task Unblocking Upon Probe Pass:** The instant a probe transitions a human step to `verified` (or allowed `attested`), atomically clear the `waiting_on_human_step` hold reason (`Task 021`/`115`) on all `blockingTaskIds[]` so blocked build/ship workers resume seamlessly!
- [ ] **Implement Re-Entry Auto-Reprobe Hook (`Task 130`):** When the user closes EF Harness, installs Docker or logs into `gh` in their own terminal, and reopens EF Harness, automatically re-probe all `pending`/`failed` human steps on cold open so solved steps clear automatically before the Welcome-Back screen even finishes rendering!
- [ ] **Implement Safe Probe Error Diagnosis:** Translate cryptic OS errors (`ECONNREFUSED 127.0.0.1:5432`, `error during connect: //./pipe/dockerDesktopLinuxEngine`, `ENOENT`) into crisp 1-line actionable fixes (`"Docker Desktop is installed but not running — start Docker Desktop and click Check again"`)!
- [ ] **Implement Strict Read-Only Probe Invariant:** Every built-in probe runs strictly read-only (`SELECT 1`, `GET`, `--version`, `info`) with zero credential logging and strict `10 s` timeout!

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **Docker is installed on Windows, yet Docker Desktop app is closed (`//./pipe/dockerDesktopLinuxEngine` not found):** `docker` probe distinguishes `INSTALLED_NOT_RUNNING` from `NOT_INSTALLED`, giving the exact right instruction instead of telling the user to reinstall Docker!
- **User clicks `"I did this manually"` on a `playwright` browser probe while Chromium is still missing:** `AttestedVsVerifiedBadgePolicy` explains `"Playwright tests need the Chromium binary — click 'Install Chromium' or disable browser checks"` (preventing immediate crash 2 seconds later)!
- **User completes an unprobeable Stripe dashboard setting and clicks `"I did this manually"`:** Step records `status = 'attested'` (never `verified`), logs timestamp + user note, and unblocks cleanly!
- **A `database_url` probe fails with password auth error:** Error formatter masks the URL password completely (`postgresql://user:***@host:5432/db`) and reports `"Authentication failed for database user"` cleanly!
- **User clicks `"Run command"` on a consented `npx playwright install chromium` installer, then clicks `Cancel` midway:** Job Object terminates the installer cleanly, leaves step `pending`, and keeps state consistent!
- **User installs `gh` in PowerShell while EF Harness is open, then switches back to EF Harness:** `"Check again"` (or focus-return reprobe) detects `gh` immediately, flips step to `verified`, and unblocks waiting Ship tasks!
- **Probe hangs due to a blackholed corporate firewall IP:** Hard `10 s` timeout kills the probe cleanly and returns `PROBE_TIMEOUT` with clear network diagnostic!

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Honest `Verified`-vs-`Attested` Invariant:** `verified` is stamped EXCLUSIVELY by a passing automated probe; user manual confirmation ALWAYS records `attested`.
- **Zero-Silent-System-Install Invariant:** EF Harness NEVER executes system package managers (`winget`, `choco`, global `npm -g`) without displaying the exact command and receiving explicit user click consent.
- **Zero-Hard-Bypass On Missing Runtime Invariant:** Locally probeable hard runtime prerequisites cannot be bypassed with fake `attested` clicks.
- **Credential-Free Probe Diagnostic Invariant:** Failed DB/API probes NEVER echo raw passwords or bearer tokens into UI messages or logs.
- **10-Second Bounded Probe Invariant:** No probe may ever block the daemon or UI longer than 10 seconds.
- **Atomic Unblock-On-Verify Invariant:** Passing a human-step probe atomically releases `waiting_on_human_step` holds on all dependent tasks.

#### Multi-Agent Harmony And Branch Isolation

- **Worktree Setup:** Create branch `task/121-human-step-probing-verification` via `node scripts/agent-worktree.mjs create 121 human-step-probing-verification`.
- **Strict Subtree Boundary:** Touch ONLY `packages/governor/src/human-steps/**`, `packages/governor/tests/human-steps/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-121.md`.
- **Parallel Safe Execution:** Disjoint from `Tasks 117–120`, `Task 127` (`apps/renderer/src/cockpit/inbox/**`), and `Task 130` (`packages/steering/src/reentry/**`).
- **Handoff For `Task 127` (Tool & Account Inbox Cards), `Task 130` (Welcome-Back Auto-Reprobe), `Task 181` (External Registration & DNS Verification):** Export `HumanStepProbeRegistry`, `ConsentedTerminalInstaller`, `HumanStepStateStore`, and `AttestedVsVerifiedBadgePolicy` in `.agent-handoffs/task-121.md`.
- **Commit-Only Discipline:** Commit exclusively on `task/121-human-step-probing-verification`; **NEVER merge** into `main` or `harness/integration`.
- **Mocked & Real Probe Tests:** Test real local `node`/`git` CLI probes PLUS mocked Docker-stopped, DB-auth-fail, timeout, consented-installer cancel, and `verified` vs `attested` policy tests offline!

#### Verification, Testing And Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Run `pnpm --filter @ef-harness/governor test -- human-steps` verifying Playwright, Docker (`not_installed` vs `not_running` vs `running`), DB URL (credential-masked!), CLI semver, and DNS/cloud probes with strict `<= 10 s` timeout.
- [ ] Verify `AttestedVsVerifiedBadgePolicy` stamps automated passes `verified`, stamps unprobeable manual confirmations `attested`, and prevents fake `attested` bypasses on hard local runtime prerequisites.
- [ ] Verify `ConsentedTerminalInstaller` requires explicit command approval, streams live output, supports clean Job Object cancellation, and auto-reprobes on exit `0`.
- [ ] Verify passing a probe atomically releases `waiting_on_human_step` holds on all blocked tasks.
- [ ] Run `pnpm --filter @ef-harness/governor typecheck`, `lint`, and `node scripts/verify-harmony.mjs --task 121`.

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

  1. **Fixed Top Bar (`48 px` height, `FixedTopBar`):** Project switcher & active branch badge, 4-step Phase Switcher (`Discover` / `Plan` / `Build` / `Ship`), active Hardware Governor pill (`Green`/`Yellow`/`Orange`/`Red` + tooltip driver), honest dual Spend / Allowance meter (`$X.XX / $Cap` or `Y% of 5h window`), Focus Mode toggle, Connections/Settings trigger, and an **ALWAYS-VISIBLE fixed high-contrast `Stop` / `Pause` button** (`< 100 ms` kernel stop via `Task 114`!)!
  2. **Collapsible Left Rail (`CollapsibleLeftRail`, `300–420 px` resizable):** Unified **Chat + Calm Inbox** panel with quick filter tabs (`All` / `Needs You (N)` / `Chat`), unread badge counter, and collapse toggle preserving exact scroll position!
  3. **Center Main Workspace (`CenterWorkspaceTabs`):** Persistent horizontal workspace tab strip switching smoothly between `Office` (default build view, `Task 162`), `Board` (`Task 124`), `Canvas` (`Task 153`), `Spec / Plan` (`Task 159`), `Preview` (`Task 160`), `Ship` (`Task 178`), and `Diagnostics` (`Task 133`) with zero unmount/data-loss flicker!
  4. **Collapsible Right Inspector (`CollapsibleInspectorShell`, `340–480 px` resizable):** Contextual slide-in detail drawer hosting Worker Inspector (`Task 126`), Canvas Node Popover/Detail (`Task 154`), or Chosen-For-You / Diff inspection — auto-collapsing cleanly when closed to maximize center canvas/office area!
- [ ] **Anchor Persistent Unified Composer Slot:** Mount the single persistent Composer region (`Task 155`) cleanly at the bottom of the Left Rail / active conversational zone so the developer ALWAYS has one predictable place to type or dictate (`Ctrl+Space` / mic button) regardless of which Center Tab is open!
- [ ] **Implement Strict Electron Renderer Security & CSP Compliance:** Verify zero `nodeIntegration`, zero raw `ipcRenderer`, strict `contextIsolation` preload bridge (`Task 067`), strict Content-Security-Policy (`default-src 'self'`), and zero external CDN font/script loads!
- [ ] **Implement Reactive Gap-Free State Store Wired To `Task 032` Event Stream:** Subscribe cleanly to `harnessd`'s gap-free `seq` event stream (`stream_epoch` auto-resync on reconnect!), batching high-frequency worker updates via `requestAnimationFrame` / `16 ms` micro-batching so 50 active workers NEVER trigger React render storms (`Task 198` UI latency `< 50 ms`)!
- [ ] **Implement Accessible Light & Dark Themes + Keyboard Navigation (`ShellKeyboardShortcuts`):** Ship full light/dark/system themes adhering to WCAG AA `>= 4.5:1` contrast, visible `:focus-visible` focus rings, full keyboard shortcuts (`Ctrl+1..4` phases, `Ctrl+B` toggle Left Rail, `Ctrl+I` toggle Inspector, `Ctrl+.` Focus Mode, `Esc` dismiss inspector/popover, `Ctrl+Shift+Backspace` emergency Stop confirmation), and logical ARIA landmark regions (`<header>`, `<nav>`, `<main>`, `<aside>`)!
- [ ] **Implement Resizable Split-Pane Persistence:** Persist user-dragged Left Rail and Inspector widths and collapsed states per window in local UI preferences (`global.db` / Electron store) with safe min/max clamps so panes can never collapse off-screen or crush the Center Workspace below `420 px`!
- [ ] **Implement Live `UiLatencyHeartbeatMonitor` Reporter:** Measure real renderer `rAF` / input-to-paint latency (`p95`) strictly when `!document.hidden` and stream lightweight `1 Hz` heartbeats to `Task 117` Hardware Governor!
- [ ] **Implement Graceful Daemon Disconnect / Reconnecting Banner:** If `harnessd` restarts or temporarily disconnects (`Task 031`–`032`), display a calm top-bar `"Reconnecting to harnessd..."` indicator while disabling mutating buttons cleanly and automatically resyncing full state on reconnect!

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **Window resizes down to narrow `1024 × 768` laptop screen while both Left Rail (`400 px`) and Inspector (`450 px`) are open:** Shell clamp enforces Center Workspace `>= 420 px` by gracefully auto-collapsing the older secondary pane or switching Inspector to an overlay sheet!
- **50 workers emit 200 status/token events per second simultaneously:** `16 ms` rAF event batcher coalesces state patches into a single React commit per frame (`<= 60 Hz`), holding input-to-paint latency `< 16 ms`!
- **`harnessd` crashes and restarts automatically with a new `stream_epoch`:** Shell's event subscriber detects `stream_epoch` change, requests clean snapshot resync (`Task 032`), clears `"Reconnecting..."` banner, and recovers seamlessly without reloading the window!
- **User presses `Stop` in the Top Bar while Center Tab is `Spec Browser` or `Preview`:** Top Bar `Stop` button is ALWAYS fixed and enabled during active runs, firing `ImmediateKernelStopController` (`Task 114`) in `< 100 ms` regardless of active view!
- **User hits `Ctrl+Shift+S` or clicks Stop accidentally vs urgently:** Stop is instant & non-destructive (all WIP checkpoints are preserved cleanly by `Task 114` + `Task 128` Checkpoint Stop Card!), so zero work is lost and Resume is 1 click away!
- **Screen reader / keyboard-only user navigates shell:** Every landmark, tablist (`role="tablist"`, arrow keys), collapsible toggle (`aria-expanded`), and Top Bar status meter (`aria-live="polite"`) operates 100% via keyboard!
- **Spend meter tracks mixed API + Subscription connections simultaneously:** Top Bar displays active connection currency honestly (`"$1.42 / $10"` OR `"14% of 5h window"`) with a clean breakdown popover on click!

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Always-Visible Stop Button Invariant:** The Top Bar `Stop` control is permanently visible and reachable in 1 click across EVERY phase and center tab whenever a build or tool is active.
- **Zero-Unmounted-State-Loss Invariant:** Switching Center Workspace tabs or collapsing rails never drops unsaved composer drafts or active scroll/filter state.
- **Sub-50ms Input-Latency Invariant:** High-frequency daemon event bursts batch strictly to `<= 1` state flush per animation frame so typing/clicking stays `< 50 ms`.
- **Minimum Center-Pane Clamp Invariant:** Resizable Left Rail and Inspector can never crush Center Workspace below `420 px`.
- **Strict Electron Sandbox Invariant:** Renderer accesses `harnessd` exclusively through the narrow `contextIsolation` preload bridge; zero direct Node/FS access.
- **WCAG-AA Contrast & Landmark Invariant:** Both light and dark shell themes maintain `>= 4.5:1` contrast and full keyboard/ARIA accessibility.

  - Show a calm, non-blocking Top-of-Center toast/banner (`"Plan is ready to review → Switch to Plan"` or `"Build complete — Ready to Ship → Switch to Ship"`) with 1-click transition AND `"Stay here"` dismissal — NEVER forcibly stealing focus or changing active tabs mid-typing!
- [ ] **Implement Multi-Monitor Pop-Out Secondary Windows (`PopOutWindowCoordinator` in `apps/desktop/src/windows/`):** Allow the developer to pop out heavy reference views (`Live App Preview`, `Office View`, `Board`, `Architecture Canvas`, or `Worker Inspector`) into dedicated native secondary `BrowserWindow`s (e.g., Live App Preview on Monitor 2 while Board/Chat stays on Monitor 1!), wired to the exact same `harnessd` event stream (zero duplicated daemon state!) with instant `"Dock back into main window"` button and automatic re-docking if the pop-out closes!
- [ ] **Implement Disconnected-Monitor Window Bounds Recovery (`DisconnectedMonitorBoundsGuard`):** Before restoring saved `(x, y, width, height, displayId)` window bounds for the main window OR any pop-out window on startup or Electron `screen.on('display-removed' | 'display-metrics-changed')`, validate the window rectangle intersects at least `>= 120 × 80 px` of a **currently connected** display's `workArea` (handling DPI scaling changes `150% ↔ 100%` on Windows laptops undocking from an external 4K monitor!) — automatically clamping and centering onto the primary display whenever a saved monitor is unplugged so windows can NEVER open invisibly off-screen!
- [ ] **Implement Clean Multi-Window Lifecycle & Focus Coordination:** Closing the primary window either minimizes to tray (when building, `Task 131`) or closes all pop-out windows cleanly together; clicking an entity in a popped-out Canvas cleanly highlights/routes into the main window's Composer or Inspector!
- [ ] **Implement Per-Phase User Customization Memory:** Remember if the user prefers `Board` over `Office` in `Build` phase (`preferredBuildTab: 'office' | 'board'`), respecting their manual preference across sessions!
- [ ] **Implement Pop-Out Window Cap & Memory Guard:** Cap simultaneous pop-out windows cleanly (`<= 3` pop-outs) and prevent popping out a second duplicate instance of the same view (focusing the existing pop-out window instead)!
- [ ] **Implement Cross-Window Theme & Focus-Mode Sync:** Switching Light/Dark theme or toggling Focus Mode propagates synchronously to all open pop-out windows!

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **Laptop was docked to an external `3840 × 2160` monitor at `x = 2560`, user unplugs monitor overnight and reopens EF Harness on built-in `1920 × 1080` screen:** `DisconnectedMonitorBoundsGuard` sees `(2560, 100)` lies outside all connected `workArea`s and immediately restores the window centered cleanly on the built-in display (`width <= workArea.width`, `height <= workArea.height`)!
- **External monitor is unplugged LIVE while a popped-out Preview window is open on Monitor 2:** `screen.on('display-removed')` fires immediately, migrating the popped-out Preview window cleanly onto Monitor 1 without losing preview state!
- **Backend transitions `Build → Ship` while the user is actively typing a follow-up question in the Composer:** `NonDisruptivePhaseSwitchBanner` appears calmly at the top — the user's tab does NOT jump and their keystrokes are 100% uninterrupted!
- **User clicks `"Pop out Preview"` twice quickly:** `PopOutWindowCoordinator` detects the existing `popout:preview` window and calls `.focus()` instead of spawning two Preview windows!
- **User closes a popped-out `Board` window via the OS `X` button:** `Board` tab immediately re-docks smoothly inside the main window's `CenterWorkspaceTabs` (never leaving the user unable to open Board again)!
- **User has `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` enabled on Windows:** `Build` phase preset automatically chooses `Board` (or static seated Office per preference) cleanly on first build!
- **DPI changes from `150%` laptop display to `100%` external monitor (`display-metrics-changed`):** Bounds guard recalculates DIP coordinates cleanly without cutting off the Top Bar `Stop` button!

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Zero-Offscreen-Window Invariant:** No main or pop-out window can ever restore or remain outside currently connected `screen.getAllDisplays()` work areas.
- **Zero-Forced-Focus-Steal Invariant:** Automatic backend phase transitions NEVER forcibly switch the user's active tab or steal focus while typing/inspecting.
- **Zero-Lost-View-On-Popout-Close Invariant:** Closing any pop-out window unconditionally re-docks its tab cleanly inside the main shell.
- **Singleton Pop-Out Per View Invariant:** At most 1 pop-out window exists per view type; duplicate pop-out requests focus the existing window.
- **Single-Daemon-Truth Multi-Window Invariant:** Pop-out windows consume the shared `harnessd` stream and never fork conflicting local state.
- **User-Tab-Preference Respect Invariant:** Explicit user switching between `Office` and `Board` persists across builds cleanly.

- **Shared Contracts Consumed / Produced:** Consumes `CockpitExplainerV1Schema` (`Task 009`), `NativeWorkerLoop` loop/step telemetry (`Task 053`), `VerificationHintLadder` (`Task 059`), `BoardCockpitView` (`Task 124`); produces `BoardHealthSignalEngine`, `HealthSignalBadgeStrip`, and `OnDemandCockpitExplainer`

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Implement Exact 5 Deterministic Health Signal Detectors (`BoardHealthSignalEngine` — ZERO LLM Calls!):** Continuously evaluate structured daemon telemetry per active task & connection and emit crisp, non-alarmist, accurate health pills on Board cards (`Task 124`) and Office desks (`Task 163`) ([build-cockpit.md](build-cockpit.md)):
  1. **`5-Min Stuck Clock` (`stuck_no_progress`):** Fires ONLY when an active task has produced **0 meaningful forward steps** (no new file edit, no completed tool call, no new token chunk, AND NOT validly queued in Pool 2 or waiting on user/throttled provider!) for `>= 300 seconds` (`5 minutes`), showing elapsed clock (`"No progress · 6m"`) with 1-click `"Inspect / Nudge / Restart"`!
  2. **`3× Loop Signal` (`loop_detected`):** Fires immediately when `Task 053`'s deterministic loop detector detects `>= 3` identical failing tool invocations, alternating edit-undo oscillation, or repeating identical test-error fingerprints across consecutive steps (`"Repeating error 3×"`)!
  3. **`Throttled Backoff Timer` (`rate_limited_backoff`):** Fires when provider pacing (`Task 140`) or HTTP `429` imposes an active backoff wait, rendering a calm live countdown (`"Rate-limited · retrying in 0:42"`) — explicitly suppressing false `"Stuck"` alarms during valid backoff!
  4. **`Allowance Reset Countdown` (`allowance_window_wait`):** Fires when a subscription connection (ChatGPT Plus / Copilot / Cursor) pauses cleanly waiting for its 5-hour or weekly allowance reset (`"Paused for ChatGPT reset · 1h 18m"`), offering direct 1-click `"Switch connection / Keep parked"` link (`Task 128`)!
  5. **`Escalation / Hint-Retry Badge` (`escalated_or_retrying`):** Fires when a task advances onto Hint 2/3 (`"Retry 2/3 · Senior escalated"`), files `DisputeTest` (`"Test disputed — needs review"`), or exhausts retries (`"Needs help — 3/3 retries failed"`)!
- [ ] **Implement Strict False-Alarm Suppression Logic:** Guarantee that a worker legitimately waiting for (a) a Pool 2 execution slot (`Task 119`), (b) a user Inbox reply (`Task 116`), (c) a `task_holds` pause (`Task 115`), (d) a provider `429` backoff, or (e) a subscription reset **NEVER triggers the `5-Min Stuck Clock`** — preserving 100% developer trust in health signals!
- [ ] **Implement Strictly On-Demand `cockpit-explainer@1` (`OnDemandCockpitExplainer`):** Provide an explicit **`"Explain what's happening"`** button on any flagged/inspected task (or the Board summary bar) that invokes `cockpit-explainer@1` ONLY when the developer clicks it (NEVER running a background LLM narrator burning tokens continuously!):
  - Passes strictly bounded structured facts (`last 5 timeline events`, `exact failing test/error snippet`, `retry hint level`, `active holds`, `active provider pacing state`, `relevant requirement snippet`)
  - Returns a crisp plain-English 3-bullet answer (`What it was trying to do`, `Why it stalled or failed`, `Recommended next click`) verified against real cited event IDs!
  - Caches the explanation keyed by `(taskId, lastEventSeq)` so re-clicking before new state arrives returns instantaneously at `0` additional tokens!
- [ ] **Implement Board Top-Bar Aggregated Health Summary Pill:** Roll up active health signals across all workers cleanly into one glanceable summary (`"All 8 workers healthy"` vs `"1 looping · 1 waiting on reset"`) clickable to filter the Board strictly to affected cards!
- [ ] **Implement One-Click Safe Remediation Actions Directly On Health Signals:** Pair each signal with the exact right non-destructive action: `Stuck` → `Restart fresh attempt` / `Inspect raw stream`; `3× Loop` → `Escalate tier` / `Give hint` / `I'll fix it myself`; `Throttled` → `Lower concurrency`; `Allowance Reset` → `Open Checkpoint Stop Card` (`Task 128`); `Escalated` → `Open Dispute/Decision Card`!
- [ ] **Implement Calm Visual Hierarchy (No Flashing Red Banners):** Use clean, subtle semantic badges (`amber` for backoff/retry, `violet` for waiting/reset, `red` strictly for true `stuck`/`loop`/`escalated` needs-attention states) consistent with the desktop design system!
- [ ] **Implement Health Event Logging For Post-Mortems:** Record every health-signal trigger + resolution duration in `telemetry.db` so `Task 133` Diagnostics and `Task 191` Meta-Lab track stuck/loop rates across model rosters!
- [ ] **Implement Offline Graceful Fallback For Explainer:** If the user clicks `"Explain what's happening"` while all model providers are down/out-of-budget, render a clean 100% deterministic code-built plain-English fallback summary from the exact structured timeline & error code without throwing an error!

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **Worker waits 7 minutes legitimately in Pool 2 queue behind 2 long Playwright verification suites:** False-alarm suppression sees `poolState === 'waiting_run_slot'` and displays calm `"Waiting for run slot · 7m"` (ZERO false `"Stuck"` alarm!).
- **Worker's remote streaming HTTP connection silently half-opens and stops sending bytes for 5 min 10 sec:** `5-Min Stuck Clock` fires cleanly at `300 s`, surfaces `"No progress · 5m"`, and lets the user or watchdog (`Task 053`) recover cleanly!
- **Worker fails `vitest` with the exact same `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined` 3 times in a row:** `3× Loop Signal` triggers immediately on step 3 without waiting 5 minutes!
- **User clicks `"Explain what's happening"` 3 times in 10 seconds on the same paused task:** `(taskId, lastEventSeq)` cache serves the identical crisp explanation instantaneously on clicks #2 and #3 with **0 extra tokens**!
- **User clicks `"Explain what's happening"` while API key is out of credit (`402`):** Graceful deterministic fallback formats the exact last error, active hint level, and concrete next click locally with zero crash!
- **Provider hits `429` with `Retry-After: 45s`:** Countdown ticks smoothly `0:45 → 0:44 → ... → 0:00` via lightweight `1 Hz` local timer without flooding daemon IPC!
- **All 12 workers are healthy:** Health summary stays calm and unobtrusive (`"All 12 healthy"`), keeping visual cognitive load minimal!

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Zero-Background-Narrator-Token Invariant:** `cockpit-explainer@1` executes EXCLUSIVELY on explicit user click; background health detection is 100% deterministic zero-token code.
- **Zero-False-Stuck-Alarm Invariant:** Legitimate waits (Pool 2 queue, user Inbox, `task_holds`, `429` backoff, allowance reset) NEVER fire `stuck_no_progress`.
- **Exact 5-Signal Coverage Invariant:** All 5 operational signals (`5-min stuck`, `3× loop`, `throttled timer`, `allowance reset`, `escalation/retry`) are deterministically detected and displayed cleanly.
- **Event-Seq Cached Explainer Invariant:** Repeated explainer clicks at identical `(taskId, lastEventSeq)` reuse the cached explanation at 0 additional tokens.
- **Offline Explainer Fallback Invariant:** Provider unavailability degrades `"Explain what's happening"` smoothly to a deterministic structured summary.
- **Zero-Modal-Interrupt Invariant:** Health signals render inline on cards/header without stealing focus or popping modal dialogs.
