#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Implement 5-Tab Contextual Worker Inspector (`WorkerInspectorPanel`):** Open smoothly in `CollapsibleInspectorShell` (`Task 122`) whenever the developer clicks any task card on the Board (`Task 124`), any worker sprite in Office View (`Task 163`), or any task node on the Canvas (`Task 153`), displaying an identity header (`A0014 · print page`, model/connection badge, level `Jr`/`Mid`/`Sr`, elapsed time, spend, current lane/hold status, and quick controls: `Pause`, `Explain`, `I fixed it myself`) plus 5 crisp tabs:
  1. **`Timeline` (`StructuredAttemptTimeline` — Default Tab):** Clean human-readable chronological list of structured milestones (`Claimed → Brief compiled (2.4k tokens) → Edited 2 files → Ran vitest (12/12 passed) → Clean Verifier (PASS) → Merged commit abc123`), grouping retries (`Attempt 1 · Hint 1`, `Attempt 2 · PASS`) cleanly with expandable command summaries and zero raw JSON noise!
  2. **`Diff` (`LazyRangeDiffViewer`):** Render a file tree of modified files with `+added / -deleted` line counts and syntax-highlighted unified/split diff view **lazily range-fetched** via `Task 033` 64 KB credit-based binary streaming (`fetchDiffRange(attemptId, filePath, hunkOffset, limit)`) — so inspecting a task with a large generated snapshot or 20 files NEVER loads megabytes eagerly into renderer RAM!
  3. **`Checks` (`ChecksAndReceiptsTab`):** Display every verification layer run on the candidate (`STATIC_AUDIT`, `typecheck`, `lint`, unit tests, Playwright UI bounding-box/a11y receipts + click-to-view screenshots, `reviewer@1` findings, `taste-reviewer@1` advisory notes, AND sealed hidden-check pass/fail summary **WITHOUT ever leaking sealed hidden-check source code** during active retries if policy hides it — showing clean actionable failure summaries + `DisputeTest` UI!)!
  4. **`Brief` (`PinnedBriefReadSetViewer`):** Reconstruct and display the **EXACT historical pinned brief** (`sliceSha256` from `Task 088`!) that this specific attempt actually received — showing exact `MUST` / `SHOULD` / `COULD` band token counts, matched cross-cutting rules (`X-01`–`X-14`), mounted skills (`<= 2`), owned write scope, AND every `kb.*` pull read (`Task 089`) and `harness.read_result` handoff (`Task 109`) the worker invoked!
  5. **`Raw Stream` (`OptInRawStreamTab` — Opt-In Only!):** Hidden behind an explicit `"Show raw log stream"` toggle so normal developers stay in the calm structured Timeline; when opted in, streams/pages directly from `Task 029`'s seekable zstd `turn_log` via credit-based `Task 033` binary chunks with virtualized terminal rendering (`<= 500` visible lines in DOM, backpressure pause on scroll-up, copy-redacted-snippet button)!
- [ ] **Implement Strict Renderer Memory Ceiling On Large Logs & Diffs:** Guarantee inspecting a task with a 50 MB archived log or a 10,000-line diff consumes `< 25 MB` extra renderer heap by fetching strictly visible byte ranges and discarding off-screen chunks cleanly!
- [ ] **Implement Attempt Switcher For Multi-Retry Tasks:** Let the user flip smoothly between `Attempt 1 (Failed — Hint 1)`, `Attempt 2 (Failed — Hint 2)`, and `Attempt 3 (PASS)` to compare exact diffs, failure hints, and model escalations side-by-side!
- [ ] **Implement Clickable Graph & File Cross-Links:** Clicking a requirement ID in `Brief`, a handoff ID in `Timeline`, or a file path in `Diff` jumps cleanly to the corresponding Canvas node (`Task 153`) or opens the file directly in VS Code (`code -g <path>:<line>`)!
- [ ] **Implement Verified Secret-Redaction Display Guarantee:** Verify every diff preview, command output, and raw stream chunk displayed in the Inspector has passed `Task 011` `PacketSecurityRedactor` on the daemon side (zero leaked credentials ever sent over IPC)!
- [ ] **Implement Auto-Follow Tail With Smart Scroll-Up Pause On Raw Stream:** In `OptInRawStreamTab`, auto-scroll smoothly while pinned to the bottom, immediately pausing auto-scroll the moment the user scrolls up to read an earlier line (with a crisp `"Jump to live"` pill)!
- [ ] **Implement Responsive Pop-Out Compatibility:** Support opening the Inspector inside `CollapsibleInspectorShell` OR inside a dedicated popped-out window (`Task 123`) cleanly!
- [ ] **Implement Empty / Not-Started State Clarity:** When inspecting a `Queued` task that has not yet been claimed, show its upcoming compiled `Brief` preview, blocking upstream tasks (`Waiting on T-2, T-3`), and estimated tier/cost cleanly instead of blank empty tabs!

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **User opens `Diff` on a task that touched a 3 MB generated JSON fixture file:** `LazyRangeDiffViewer` sees file size `> 100 KB`, renders a clean collapsed `"Large file (3.1 MB) — Load preview chunk (64 KB)"` row by default instead of freezing the UI thread!
- **User opens `Raw Stream` on a finished task whose `turn_log` was already archived to seekable zstd (`Task 029`):** Daemon streams exact requested frame ranges seamlessly via `SeekableZstdLogReader` + `Task 033` credit-based flow control!
- **User clicks `Brief` on a completed Wave 1 task AFTER a Wave 2 revision modified Requirement `R-5`:** `PinnedBriefReadSetViewer` resolves exact historical `node_versions` from `brief_manifest` (`sliceSha256`) so the user sees the EXACT `R-5` text the worker saw when it wrote the code (with a subtle `"R-5 updated later"` badge)!
- **User switches rapidly between 10 different worker cards in 2 seconds:** Pending lazy diff/stream IPC requests carry an `AbortController` tied to active `taskId`; stale responses are immediately discarded so Worker B's diff never flickers inside Worker A's panel!
- **A Playwright screenshot receipt exists in CAS (`Task 028`) for a failing UI check:** `ChecksAndReceiptsTab` streams the PNG thumbnail safely over the binary channel (`Task 033`) with click-to-zoom lightbox!
- **User inspects a `Queued` task before Phase 0 finishes:** Timeline shows `"Waiting on Phase 0 Gate 0"` and Brief tab shows the compiled `MUST` requirements clearly with zero errors!
- **Active live worker emits 1,000 log lines/sec while `OptInRawStreamTab` is open:** Credit-based `Task 033` flow control + virtualized log buffer caps DOM size strictly and never drops main-window responsiveness!

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Lazy-Range-Fetch-Only Invariant:** Inspector NEVER fetches unbounded whole diffs or whole raw logs into renderer memory; all large payloads stream strictly via bounded `64 KB` range/credit chunks (`Task 033`).
- **Historical-Brief-Fidelity Invariant:** `Brief` tab ALWAYS renders the exact pinned `(sliceSha256, node_versions)` that the attempt actually executed against.
- **Opt-In Raw Stream Invariant:** Raw streaming logs remain closed by default so the default cockpit experience stays calm and high-signal.
- **Abort-On-Switch Invariant:** Rapidly switching inspected tasks cancels in-flight fetches cleanly with zero cross-worker data bleed.
- **Pre-Redacted IPC Payload Invariant:** Every command output and raw stream chunk displayed has already been scrubbed daemon-side (`Task 011`).
- **Zero-Sealed-Oracle-Source-Leak Invariant:** Active-retry `Checks` view displays safe failure diagnostics without leaking raw sealed hidden-check source if worker retries are still in progress.

#### Multi-Agent Harmony And Branch Isolation

- **Strict Subtree Boundary:** Touch ONLY `apps/renderer/src/cockpit/inspector/**`, `apps/renderer/tests/cockpit-inspector/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-126.md`.
- **Parallel Safe Execution:** Disjoint from `Tasks 124–125` and `Task 127`.

### Task 127: Calm Notification Inbox UI (Interrupt-Now / 10-Min Batch + Critical-Path Flush / FYI Digest, Focus Mode, Interruption Budget & All 6 Card Types)

- **Milestone & Track:** `M3 · Calm Human-In-The-Loop Inbox UI`
- **Depends On:** `Task 001`, `Task 116`, `Task 120`, `Task 121`, `Task 122`
- **Git Worktree & Branch:** `task/127-calm-notification-inbox-ui` in `../ef-wt/task-127-calm-notification-inbox-ui` (commit on own branch only; **NEVER merge**)
- **Owned Write Scope (Disjoint Subtree):** `apps/renderer/src/cockpit/inbox/**`, `apps/renderer/tests/cockpit-inbox/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-127.md`
- **Mandatory Reference Files:** [build-cockpit.md](build-cockpit.md#calm-inbox-and-card-types), [agent-graph-routing.md](agent-graph-routing.md), [app-shell-and-governor.md](app-shell-and-governor.md), [cockpit-and-office.mmd](cockpit-and-office.mmd)
- **Shared Contracts Consumed / Produced:** Consumes `SharedQuestionArbiter` (`Task 116`), `WindowsDpapiSecretsVault` (`Task 120`), `HumanStepProbeRegistry` (`Task 121`), `SingleAppShell` (`Task 122`); produces `CalmInboxPanel`, `NotificationCadenceScheduler`, `FocusModeAndInterruptionBudget`, and all 6 canonical card components (`DecisionCard`, `SecretCard`, `ToolCard`, `AccountCard`, `ApprovalCard`, `ReviewCard`)

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Implement 3-Tier Calm Delivery Cadence (`NotificationCadenceScheduler`):** Protect the developer's deep focus while never hiding true emergencies ([build-cockpit.md](build-cockpit.md)):
  1. **`Interrupt-Now` (`P0` + `P1` critical blockers):** Surfaces immediately with subtle non-jarring indicator (OS toast ONLY when app window is backgrounded and Focus Mode allows critical alerts!) — reserved strictly for Stop/Budget/Auth-Expiry/Disk-Red/Breaking-Stop conditions!
  2. **`10-Minute Calm Batch + Critical-Path Early Flush` (`P2` + `P3`):** Collects routine questions, medium-risk proposals, and single-task clarifications silently for up to **10 minutes** and releases them together in ONE tidy batch (`"3 quick decisions ready"`), flushing early ONLY if a queued card blocks the active HEFT critical path or accumulates `>= 2` waiting tasks (`inbox_subscribers >= 2`)!
  3. **`FYI Digest` (`P4`):** Zero alerts, zero red badges — sits calmly in a collapsed `"Updates (N)"` digest (feature landed, advisory taste note, cache cleaned, auto-started tiny fix)!
- [ ] **Implement Focus Mode & Interruption Budget (`FocusModeAndInterruptionBudget`):**
  - **Focus Mode (`Ctrl+.` in Top Bar):** Suppresses all OS desktop toasts, holds non-emergency `10-min` batches cleanly until Focus Mode turns off (or user manually opens Inbox), while keeping critical `P0` emergencies clearly visible inside the app badge!
  - **Interruption Budget:** Track total user interruptions per hour (`default cap <= 4` non-emergency batch releases/hr), coalescing excess routine cards cleanly and surfacing a `"Pause routine questions for 30 min"` snooze control!
- [ ] **Implement All 6 Canonical Action Card Types With Strict Uniform Anatomy:** Every card displays crisp 1-line title, plain-English `"Why this matters (blocks N tasks)"`, exact provenance link, and direct keyboard-accessible primary/secondary actions:
  1. **`DecisionCard`:** Product/spec choice, conflict resolution, `DisputeTest`, or ambiguous steering reading — numbered concrete options with monotonic `options_version` (`Task 070`/`116`), clearly marked recommended option, and inline `"Reply in composer"` bind!
  2. **`SecretCard`:** Masked password-style input writing directly to Windows DPAPI (`Task 120`, NEVER echoing plaintext into chat history!), live `sk_live_` test-key refusal banner, inline `"Test connection"` probe (`Task 120`), and `"Use built-in local mock instead"` option when available!
  3. **`ToolCard`:** Missing/stopped local prerequisite (`Docker Desktop`, `Playwright Chromium`, `gh`, `node`) showing exact `Task 121` probe diagnosis, visible **exact command preview** for consented terminal install, `"Check again"`, and honest `Verified` vs `Attested` badge!
  4. **`AccountCard`:** Provider OAuth/token expiry (`ChatGPT Plus`, `GitHub Copilot`, `Cursor`, `Vercel`, `GitHub`) with 1-click re-authenticate, allowance reset timer, or `"Switch connection"` action!
  5. **`ApprovalCard`:** External side effects (`Task 176`: push branch, open PR, deploy Staging/Prod, destructive expand-contract migration step, new npm dependency install, breaking CCR) displaying exact structured diff/impact summary + explicit `Approve` / `Edit` / `Decline`!
  6. **`ReviewCard`:** Grouped medium-risk spec proposals (`Task 080`), Markdown 3-way import conflict (`Task 086`), Landing Summary (`Task 101`), or before/after visual baseline approval (`Task 161`) with batch `"Approve all"` + per-item `"Edit / Reject"`!
- [ ] **Implement Dedicated Secret Input Isolation:** Guarantee `SecretCard` inputs NEVER route through the Chat Composer, NEVER enter chat history or `user_messages` SQLite rows, and clear React component state immediately upon DPAPI vault save!
- [ ] **Implement Live Card Retirement & Deduplication Reactivity:** When `Task 116` adds a 3rd waiting task to an existing `DecisionCard` (`"Blocking 1 task"` → `"Blocking 3 tasks"`), update the card counter seamlessly in place; when a card retires (via direct VS Code edit or Feature Undo), animate it cleanly into `"Resolved / Retired"` history without jumping scroll position!
- [ ] **Implement Keyboard-First Batch Triage:** Support `J`/`K` to step across Inbox cards, `1`–`4` to select numbered options on focused `DecisionCard`, and `Ctrl+Enter` to submit cleanly!
- [ ] **Implement Unread Count Honesty:** Top Bar / Left Rail badge counts ONLY active actionable cards (`Interrupt-Now` + flushed `Batch` items), NEVER inflating unread counts with `FYI Digest` noise or un-flushed quiet batch items!
- [ ] **Implement Empty Zen State:** When `0` items need user action, render a calm `"Nothing needs you right now · Build is moving smoothly"` message with optional `"Peek at N queued FYI updates"`!

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **User types a secret API key into `SecretCard` and clicks Save:** Value goes directly over preload IPC strictly to `WindowsDpapiSecretsVault` (`Task 120`), input buffer immediately zeros/clears, and **0 characters** ever appear in chat history, React DevTools logs, or `state.db`!
- **3 routine `P3` cards arrive at `t = 0m, 2m, 4m`:** None pop up noisily — all 3 release calmly together at `t = 10m` as ONE quiet `"3 quick questions"` batch; if card #2 suddenly becomes a critical-path blocker at `t = 4m 30s`, critical-path early flush surfaces it immediately!
- **User enables Focus Mode (`Ctrl+.`) while coding in VS Code; a `P3` batch hits 10 min, then a `P0` Disk `< 2 GB` emergency hits:** `P3` stays muted during Focus Mode, while `P0` Disk Emergency surfaces clearly so data isn't corrupted!
- **User clicks `Option 2` on a `DecisionCard` just after a VS Code edit retired that question:** Card receives `Task 116` `StaleReplyReconciler` response and renders the inline `"Already resolved via VS Code — Keep or Change?"` prompt seamlessly!
- **User pastes `sk_live_...` into a local test `SecretCard`:** Card displays `Task 120`'s exact refusal message inline (`"Live key refused for test scope — use sk_test_ or local mock"`) without clearing the form silently or crashing!
- **12 medium-risk spec proposals arrive from `Task 080`:** Rendered as ONE collapsible grouped `ReviewCard` (`"12 proposed details — Approve all or expand"`) instead of flooding the rail with 12 separate cards!
- **App is minimized in system tray (`Task 131`) when a `P0` Auth Expiry card arrives:** Fires at most 1 clean Windows native notification (`"EF Harness needs you: ChatGPT sign-in expired"`) that focuses the exact `AccountCard` when clicked!

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Zero-Secret-In-Chat Invariant:** `SecretCard` inputs NEVER touch the chat composer, chat transcript, or `state.db.user_messages`.
- **Exact 6-Card-Type Coverage Invariant:** `Decision`, `Secret`, `Tool`, `Account`, `Approval`, and `Review` cards are all first-class typed components with accessible controls.
- **Exact 3-Tier Cadence Invariant:** `Interrupt-Now`, `10-Min Batch + Critical-Path Early Flush`, and `FYI Digest` strictly govern surfacing; `FYI` never inflates actionable unread badges.
- **Focus-Mode Quiet Invariant:** Focus Mode suppresses all non-emergency toasts and routine batch popups cleanly.
- **Zero-Modal-Nag Invariant:** Inbox cards live calmly in the Left Rail without blocking modal popups or audio chimes (unless explicitly opted in).
- **Grouped-Proposal Invariant:** Multiple sibling medium-risk proposals coalesce into 1 grouped `ReviewCard`.

#### Multi-Agent Harmony And Branch Isolation

- **Strict Subtree Boundary:** Touch ONLY `apps/renderer/src/cockpit/inbox/**`, `apps/renderer/tests/cockpit-inbox/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-127.md`.

- **Commit-Only Discipline:** Commit exclusively on `task/127-calm-notification-inbox-ui`; **NEVER merge** into `main` or `harness/integration`.

- **Mandatory Reference Files:** [stops-undo-and-reentry.md](stops-undo-and-reentry.md#budget-wind-down-and-checkpoint-stop), [provider-connections.md](provider-connections.md), [workspace-and-git.md](workspace-and-git.md), [stops-undo-and-reentry.mmd](stops-undo-and-reentry.mmd), [stops-undo-and-reentry.svg](stops-undo-and-reentry.svg), [research/coexistence-undo-and-reentry.md](research/coexistence-undo-and-reentry.md)
- **Shared Contracts Consumed / Produced:** Consumes `BudgetLedger` (`Task 023`), `RefLeaseAndCasManager` (`Task 039`), `NativeWorkerLoop` checkpoints (`Task 053`), `ImmediateKernelStopController` (`Task 114`); produces `BudgetWindDownController`, `CheckpointStopCardView`, and `WipBranchHandoffExporter`

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Implement Exact 4-Step Budget Wind-Down Ladder (`BudgetWindDownController` — `50% / 80% / 90% / 100%`):** Monitor BOTH API spend caps (`micro-USD`) AND subscription allowance windows (`ppm` from `Task 140`) cleanly without abrupt mid-task data loss ([stops-undo-and-reentry.md](stops-undo-and-reentry.md)):
  - **`50%` (Quiet Info):** Subtle FYI update in digest + Top Bar meter turns soft blue/neutral (`0` interruption!)
  - **`80%` (Early Warning + Smart Economy):** Subtle inbox heads-up (`"80% of budget used — $8.00 / $10.00"`), automatically skips purely optional advisory extras (like `taste-reviewer@1` `Task 102`) while keeping mandatory verification intact!
  - **`90%` (Graceful Wind-Down — Stop Starting New Tasks!):** **STOP claiming new queued tasks immediately** while allowing ALREADY-RUNNING near-complete tasks/verifiers to finish cleanly and merge onto `harness/integration` using the reserved `10%` wind-down buffer — preventing half-finished wasted work!
  - **`100%` (Hard Stop & Checkpoint):** Atomically halt all remaining generation/verification turns at clean checkpoint boundaries (`Task 053`/`114`), preserve 100% of verified completed work on `harness/integration` + partial WIP in checkpoints, and present the calm **Checkpoint Stop Card**!
- [ ] **Implement Complete 6-Action Checkpoint Stop Card (`CheckpointStopCardView`):** Whenever a build pauses cleanly due to budget `100%`, subscription 5h/weekly window exhaustion, user `Stop`, or hardware `RED`, render ONE clear honest status card showing `{ finishedFeatures[], finishedTasksCount, inFlightCheckpointedTasks[], remainingTasksCount, spentSummary }` PLUS all **6 concrete recovery options** (enabling ONLY applicable options cleanly!):
  1. **`Add Budget`** (raise dollar cap cleanly by `+$5 / +$10 / Custom` and resume immediately from exact checkpoints!)
  2. **`Switch to Cheaper Models`** (flip active preset to `Cheapest` / lower tiers respecting `Task 106` floors + show new projected remaining cost before resuming!)
  3. **`Switch Connection`** (explicitly choose another connected provider/account — e.g. user-approved switch from paused ChatGPT Plus to Anthropic Console API key or local Ollama; NEVER silent, honoring `Task 141`!)
  4. **`Wait for Reset`** (for subscription windows: display live countdown to exact reset timestamp with optional opt-in `"Auto-resume at reset"` toggle!)
  5. **`Finish by Hand` (`wip/*` Export)** (invoke `WipBranchHandoffExporter` to export clean `wip/<project-slug>-<date>` branch + detailed human `HANDOFF.md` so the developer can finish seamlessly in VS Code / Cursor / terminal!)
  6. **`Keep Parked`** (leave project cleanly parked at `0` CPU / `0` spend, ready for `Task 130` Welcome-Back resume anytime days later!)
- [ ] **Implement Clean `wip/*` Branch Exporter With Handoff Notes (`WipBranchHandoffExporter`):** When the developer clicks **`Finish by Hand`**, assemble a clean developer-ready Git branch `wip/<slug>` WITHOUT dirtying `main` or `harness/integration`:
  1. Branch cleanly from the latest verified green `harness/integration` HEAD (`Task 039`).
  2. Commit any verified-but-unmerged feature commits cleanly AND stage any partial in-flight worker WIP checkpoints as explicitly labeled `[WIP - UNVERIFIED]` commits (or separate per-task commits so the user can cherry-pick/drop easily!).
  3. Generate a crisp, practical, non-jargon `HANDOFF.md` (either untracked/excluded or clearly placed per user toggle!) listing: (a) what is already built & passing (`DONE`), (b) exact remaining unchecked tasks & acceptance criteria, (c) exact partial WIP files & last failing test output for any mid-flight task, and (d) exact commands to run tests & preview locally!
  4. Offer 1-click `"Open in VS Code"` (`code <repo>`) and preserve compatibility with `Task 173` (`"I Fixed It Myself"`) when the developer later comes back!
- [ ] **Implement Zero-Budget-Overrun Pre-Reservation Accounting:** Pair `BudgetWindDownController` with `Task 023`'s atomic reservation ledger so 4 parallel workers finishing simultaneously at `89%` cannot collectively stampede to `130%` — reservations reserve worst-case turn ceilings upfront so actual final spend hugs `<= 100%` tightly!
- [ ] **Implement Exact Per-Milestone Pause Receipts:** Persist the exact stop trigger (`budget_100`, `window_exhausted`, `user_stop`, `disk_red`), timestamp, checkpoint SHAs, and chosen recovery option in `state.db.stop_events`!
- [ ] **Implement Safe Resume Validation Before Unparking:** When clicking `Add Budget`, `Switch Connection`, or `Wait for Reset → Resume`, verify remaining budget/allowance is strictly positive and connections are healthy before lifting the stop state!
- [ ] **Implement Subscription `90%` Wind-Down Alignment With `Task 140`:** Trigger `90%` wind-down cleanly on `ppm >= 900_000` of active 5-hour or weekly allowance so the user finishes their active task cleanly instead of crashing mid-turn into a hard provider `429`!
- [ ] **Implement Zero-Wasted-Work Guarantee On Stop:** Prove that stopping at `90%`/`100%` NEVER reverts or discards already-merged green features on `harness/integration` and NEVER deletes unmerged worker WIP checkpoints until explicitly resumed or discarded!

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **Build hits `90%` (`$9.00 / $10.00`) while 2 workers are at step 6/8 and 5 tasks sit in `Queued`:** Wind-down immediately blocks claiming any of the 5 queued tasks, lets the 2 near-finished workers finish + verify + merge cleanly (landing at `~$9.75`), and stops cleanly with **2 finished features instead of 0**!
- **Build hits `100%` mid-turn on Task `T-7` (`$10.00 / $10.00`):** Current step halts cleanly at checkpoint, `T-7`'s partial diff is saved as an attempt checkpoint, `harness/integration` stays 100% green, and Checkpoint Stop Card opens with all 6 clear actions!
- **User clicks `Finish by Hand` (`wip/*`) while 2 features are already merged on `harness/integration` and 1 leaf task `T-7` has partial edits + 1 failing unit test:** `WipBranchHandoffExporter` creates `wip/<slug>` off `harness/integration`, commits `T-7`'s edits clearly labeled `[WIP - UNVERIFIED: T-7]`, writes `HANDOFF.md` with exact failing test snippet & remaining 3 task specs, and leaves `main` and `harness/integration` untouched!
- **User is on ChatGPT Plus (no dollar cap) and hits `95%` of 5-hour window:** Stop Card automatically highlights **`Wait for Reset (1h 22m)`**, **`Switch Connection`**, and **`Keep Parked`** while hiding irrelevant `"Add $5 Budget"`!
- **User clicks `Switch Connection` from paused ChatGPT Plus to Anthropic API Key:** Explicitly shows `"Anthropic Console API is pay-per-use (~$0.65 est. for remaining 4 tasks) — Confirm?"` before resuming (zero silent spend!)!
- **Developer already has a branch named `wip/kitchen-app-2026-11-19`:** Exporter safely appends `-2` (`wip/kitchen-app-2026-11-19-2`) — NEVER force-overwriting an existing branch!
- **4 parallel workers try to reserve `$0.50` each when only `$1.10` remains before `100%`:** Atomic ledger grants ONLY 2 reservations (`$1.00`) and enters `90%` wind-down immediately for the other 2 (preventing `$11.00` overrun)!

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Exact 50/80/90/100% Wind-Down Invariant:** New task claims strictly cease at `>= 90%`; all active turns stop cleanly at `>= 100%` with zero abrupt state corruption.
- **All-6-Recovery-Actions Invariant:** Checkpoint Stop Card cleanly exposes `Add Budget`, `Cheaper Models`, `Switch Connection`, `Wait for Reset`, `Finish by Hand`, and `Keep Parked` (filtered intelligently by currency/provider).
- **Non-Destructive `wip/*` Export Invariant:** Exporting `wip/*` NEVER force-pushes, NEVER overwrites existing branches, and NEVER dirties `main` or `harness/integration`.
- **Zero-Silent-Paid-Switch Invariant:** Switching from a paused subscription connection to a paid API connection ALWAYS requires explicit user confirmation with cost estimate.
- **Green-Integration Preservation Invariant:** Stopping at any budget or window threshold preserves 100% of already-landed features on `harness/integration` and all unmerged WIP checkpoints.
- **Atomic Budget-Reservation Ceiling Invariant:** Concurrent workers reserve worst-case turn costs upfront so parallel finishes cannot blow past `100%`.

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Implement Strict 3-Step Planned Feature Undo Flow (`FeatureUndoInventoryAnalyzer`):** NEVER blindly run raw `git reset --hard` or destructive `git revert` on a feature that later features now depend on! Execute the exact 3-step safe undo protocol from [stops-undo-and-reentry.md](stops-undo-and-reentry.md):
  - **Step 1 — Undo Inventory & Cross-Feature Usage Scan (`CrossFeatureUsageGraphChecker`):** Combine `state.db` canonical dependency edges (`consumes`, `depends_on`, `implements`, `EF-Feature` commit trailers from `Task 111`!) AND real AST/import symbol usage analysis (scanning actual imports/SQL FK references across the live `harness/integration` codebase!) to classify EVERY artifact created by Feature `F` into 3 exact buckets:
    1. **`Exclusive to F`** (safe to remove completely: routes, screens, handlers, tests, components used ONLY by `F`)
    2. **`Shared — Now Used By Later Features`** (e.g., `F-Print` introduced a `formatDate()` helper or `dietary_tags` table that `F-CateringEmail` now imports!) — **MUST NOT be blindly deleted!**
    3. **`Persistent Data / DB Schema`** (tables/columns/migrations added by `F` that may already hold data in staging/prod or demo seeds!)
  - **Step 2 — Clear User Undo Preview & Choices (`UndoDataRetentionDialog`):** Present ONE crisp plain-English preview BEFORE touching a single file:
    - Exact files/routes/tests to remove
    - Exact shared helpers/tables detected + automatic **Ownership Transfer Plan** (`SharedOwnershipTransferPlanner`: cleanly reassigning `formatDate()` ownership to `phase0-shared` or `F-CateringEmail` in `state.db` instead of breaking `F-CateringEmail`!)
    - Explicit **Data Handling Choice** for any DB tables/columns created by `F`:
      - **`Keep schema/data dormant (Safe default — expand-then-contract)`** (stop writing/reading in app code while leaving DB table intact so data is never lost!)
      - **`Drop table/column in new additive-safe down-migration`** (only with explicit destructive confirmation — NEVER editing historical merged migration files if already deployed!)
    - Explicit choice of **Undo Execution Mode**: automatic **Fast-Path Clean Merge Revert** (when `Exclusive === 100%` AND `git revert -m 1 --no-commit <non-ff-merge-sha>` applies cleanly with zero conflicts!) vs **Planned Surgical Removal Tasks** (when shared pieces or later edits overlap `F`'s files!)
  - **Step 3 — Verified Execution & Canonical Knowledge Graph Archival (`FeatureUndoExecutor`):** Execute either the clean fast-path revert OR the bounded removal + ownership-transfer tasks inside an isolated worktree, run the full `CombinedRegressionGate` (`Task 111`) proving ALL remaining features still compile and pass 100% of their tests, land onto `harness/integration` via atomic CAS `update-ref`, archive `F`'s nodes cleanly as `status = 'undone'` (preserving `feature_id` for clean future revival via `Task 114` Route 3!), and retire all open Inbox questions belonging exclusively to `F` (`Task 116`)!
- [ ] **Implement Active/In-Progress Feature Cancellation Fast Path:** If Feature `F` has NOT yet landed on `harness/integration` (still `QUEUED`, `WORKING`, or `INTEGRATING` on `harness/f/F`), halt its active tasks cleanly (`Task 114`), archive `harness/f/F` / checkpoints cleanly without touching `harness/integration`, and mark `F` `undone` in `< 2 s`!
- [ ] **Implement Transitive Dependent Feature Warning:** If Feature `F-B` has a hard functional dependency on Feature `F-A` (e.g., undoing `F-Auth` while `F-AdminDashboard` requires Auth!), clearly list the dependent features and offer `"Undo F-A + F-B together"` OR `"Cancel undo"` instead of leaving a broken half-app!
- [ ] **Implement Never-Rewrite-Published-History Guard:** Undo ALWAYS creates a clean forward revert/removal commit on `harness/integration` — NEVER running `git reset --hard` or rewriting commits already pushed to a remote or merged into history!
- [ ] **Implement Reversible Undo-Of-Undo (`Revive Feature`):** Because `F`'s canonical specs, settled decisions, and `EF-Feature` commit SHA remain archived (`status = 'undone'`) in `state.db`, asking later `"Actually bring back the print view"` cleanly revives `F`'s exact `feature_id` and decisions!
- [ ] **Implement Post-Undo Orphan-Route & Dead-Nav Audit:** Run `STATIC_AUDIT` (`Task 054`) on the undo candidate ensuring zero dead nav links, dangling route imports, or orphan permissions remain pointing at the removed feature!

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **Feature `F-Print` landed cleanly via `--no-ff` merge commit `M1`, zero other features touch `F-Print`'s files, and zero DB tables were added:** `FeatureUndoInventoryAnalyzer` detects 100% exclusive clean revertability, runs `git revert -m 1 M1` + full regression gate, and removes `F-Print` cleanly at **0 LLM tokens**!
- **Feature `F-Menu` added `src/lib/currency.ts` which later Feature `F-CateringEmail` imported:** `CrossFeatureUsageGraphChecker` catches the live TypeScript import of `currency.ts`, transfers ownership of `src/lib/currency.ts` cleanly to `shared` / `F-CateringEmail`, and removes ONLY `F-Menu`-exclusive files so `F-CateringEmail` stays 100% green!
- **Feature `F-LoyaltyPoints` added a `loyalty_ledger` DB table that already ran in Staging/Prod:** `UndoDataRetentionDialog` defaults to **`Keep table dormant (safe expand-then-contract)`** and forbids rewriting historical migration files, preventing production data loss!
- **Fast-path `git revert -m 1 M1` encounters a textual conflict in `src/App.tsx` because `F-Email` added a nav item on the adjacent line:** Engine detects the revert conflict cleanly via `merge-tree`, switches automatically to a surgical 1-task planned removal preserving `F-Email`'s nav link, and verifies via `CombinedRegressionGate`!
- **User tries to undo an in-flight feature `F-Reports` while 3 workers are actively coding it:** Immediately stops those 3 workers (`Task 114`), retires any open Inbox questions for `F-Reports`, cleans up `harness/f/F-Reports`, and marks `F-Reports` `undone` with zero impact on `harness/integration`!
- **User undoes `F-Print`, then 2 days later says `"Add the print page back"`:** `Task 114` Route 3 finds archived `F-Print`, reuses its canonical `feature_id` and prior settled specs cleanly!
- **Undoing `F-A` leaves a dangling `<Link to="/print">` inside `Header.tsx`:** Post-undo `STATIC_AUDIT` + route check catches the dead link before the undo commit lands on `harness/integration`!

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Zero-Broken-Sibling-Feature Invariant:** Undoing Feature `F` NEVER deletes any helper, contract, or table still imported/referenced by another active feature — shared pieces transfer ownership automatically.
- **Zero-History-Rewrite Invariant:** Landed feature undos ALWAYS land as forward revert/removal commits on `harness/integration`, never destructive `git reset`.
- **Safe-Data-Default Invariant:** DB tables/columns added by an undone feature default strictly to dormant expand-then-contract preservation unless the developer explicitly approves a destructive drop migration.
- **Zero-LLM Fast-Path Revert Invariant:** Purely exclusive clean non-FF merges undo deterministically via `git revert -m 1` + regression verification at `0` LLM tokens.
- **Combined-Regression-Green Invariant:** Every undo commit passes full `CombinedRegressionGate` (`Task 111`) before advancing `harness/integration`.
- **Archival-Not-Purge Invariant:** Undone features archive cleanly (`status = 'undone'`) preserving `feature_id` and audit lineage for future revival.

  1. **Kernel State & Crash Recovery:** Check WAL integrity (`Task 016`), recover any orphaned `WORKING` attempts whose PIDs are dead (converting them cleanly into `CHECKPOINTED` / resumable state with zero lost WIP diffs!), and verify `harness/integration` HEAD matches `state.db`!

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **App opens after a Windows BSOD killed `harnessd` mid-turn on 3 active workers:** `NoRunUntilResumeGate` blocks auto-dispatch, `ColdOpenReconciler` detects all 3 dead PIDs cleanly, salvages their last valid WIP checkpoints, cleans dead locks safely, and shows `"3 tasks were interrupted by an unexpected shutdown — checkpoints recovered cleanly"` ready for 1-click `Resume`!
- **Developer fixed failing Task `T-6` by hand in VS Code and committed `"fix: order cutoff timezone"` while EF Harness was closed:** `CommitAnsweredQuestionDetector` matches commit diff files against `T-6`'s write scope & failing check, offers `"Verify your commit against T-6's checks & mark done?"`, seamlessly bridging into `Task 173` (`"I Fixed It Myself"`)!

- **Developer edited `pnpm-lock.yaml` (`pnpm add lucide-react`) while away:** Lockfile hash drift is detected immediately and presented clearly (`"Include new dependency in harness/integration before resuming?"`)!
- **User closed EF Harness while parked at ChatGPT Plus 100% window, returns 6 hours later:** Reconciler detects allowance reset (`0%` used) and shows `"ChatGPT Plus allowance has reset — Ready to resume 6 remaining tasks"`!
- **Project folder was moved from `D:\code\kitchen` to `D:\projects\kitchen` while away:** Reconciler detects missing path gracefully and provides 1-click folder relocator preserving 100% of `state.db`!
- **User accidentally left an open `.git/index.lock` because a separate VS Code git commit is STILL actively running at cold open:** Lock-cleanup guard checks active OS processes / lock mtime (`< 60 s`) and waits/warns instead of deleting another live git process's lock!

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Strict `No-Run-Until-Resume` Invariant:** Restarting or reopening an in-progress project NEVER dispatches workers, edits repo files, or spends tokens until the user explicitly clicks `Resume`.
- **Zero-Mutation Cold-Open Scan Invariant:** Reconciliation scans are 100% read-only against user repo files (`0` silent `git stash`, `git checkout`, or edits).
- **Complete 7-Domain Reconciliation Invariant:** Cold open always checks state/crash recovery, worktrees, developer repo/branch drift, `.harness/views/`, lockfiles, connections/CLIs, and pending human steps/questions.
- **Live-Lock-Respect Invariant:** Stale `.git/index.lock` cleanup never removes a lock held by an active running git process.
- **Zero-Paid-LLM-On-Open Invariant:** Opening a parked project spends `$0.00` and `0` LLM tokens before user confirmation.
- **Checkpoint-Salvage Invariant:** Crashed active attempts recover cleanly to resumable checkpoints without losing prior verified commits on `harness/integration`.

### Task 131: Electron Desktop Lifecycle (System Tray While Building, 3-Choice Quit Dialog, Windows `powerMonitor` Suspend/Resume, `powerSaveBlocker` & Start-At-Sign-In)

- **Milestone & Track:** `M3 · Production Windows Desktop Lifecycle`
- **Depends On:** `Task 001`, `Task 031`, `Task 067`, `Task 114`, `Task 123`, `Task 130`
- **Git Worktree & Branch:** `task/131-electron-desktop-lifecycle` in `../ef-wt/task-131-electron-desktop-lifecycle` (commit on own branch only; **NEVER merge**)
- **Owned Write Scope (Disjoint Subtree):** `apps/desktop/src/lifecycle/**`, `apps/desktop/tests/lifecycle/**`, `apps/daemon/src/lifecycle/**`, `apps/daemon/tests/lifecycle/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-131.md`
- **Mandatory Reference Files:** [desktop-app.md](desktop-app.md#desktop-lifecycle-tray-quit-sleep-and-autostart), [app-shell-and-governor.md](app-shell-and-governor.md), [desktop-app.mmd](desktop-app.mmd), [desktop-app.svg](desktop-app.svg), [research/desktop-app-shell.md](research/desktop-app-shell.md)
- **Shared Contracts Consumed / Produced:** Consumes `NamedPipeServer` (`Task 031`), M1 Electron/daemon shell (`Task 067`), `ImmediateKernelStopController` (`Task 114`), `PopOutWindowCoordinator` (`Task 123`), `ColdOpenReconciler` (`Task 130`); produces `SystemTrayController`, `QuitWhileBuildingDialog`, `PowerMonitorSleepReconciler`, `OptionalPowerSaveBlocker`, and `StartAtSignInManager`

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Implement System Tray Integration While Building (`SystemTrayController`):** Maintain a clean native Windows system tray icon + context menu (`Open EF Harness`, live status line `"Building Kitchen App · 3 workers active"` or `"1 question needs you"`, `Pause Build`, `Stop Build`, `Quit`) whenever a build is active (or opt-in `"Keep in tray"` setting):
  - Clicking the window `X` button while a build is active offers clean minimize-to-tray (with optional `"Don't ask again"` remember preference) so closing the UI window NEVER accidentally aborts a 20-minute build!
  - Tray icon displays subtle crisp status badge dot (`green` active, `amber` needs-you, `neutral` idle) and restores/focuses the main window on single/double-click!
- [ ] **Implement Exact 3-Choice `Quit While Building` Dialog (`QuitWhileBuildingDialog`):** When the developer triggers `Quit` (`Alt+F4` / Tray Quit / File → Quit) while ANY build, verification, or merge-queue job is active, intercept cleanly (`before-quit`) and present the exact 3 clear choices from [desktop-app.md](desktop-app.md):
  1. **`Keep building in background (Minimize to tray)`** — closes the Electron renderer window (freeing renderer GPU/RAM!) while detached `harnessd` continues building cleanly and notifies via tray when done or needing input!
  2. **`Pause safely & Quit`** — executes clean checkpoint stop (`Task 114` / `128`), waits up to `10 s` for active SQLite WAL flush + WIP checkpoints + Job Object child cleanup (`0` orphaned processes!), then shuts down BOTH Electron and `harnessd` cleanly!
  3. **`Cancel` (Stay open)** — aborts quit cleanly with zero interruption!
  - Note: When `0` builds are active (idle), `Quit` exits immediately cleanly with ZERO annoying confirmation dialog!
- [ ] **Implement Windows `powerMonitor` Suspend / Resume / Lock / Battery Handling (`PowerMonitorSleepReconciler`):** Wire Electron's `powerMonitor` events directly into `harnessd` lifecycle RPCs:
  - **`suspend` (Laptop lid closed / OS sleep):** Immediately pause claiming new tasks, checkpoint active turns cleanly within the OS sleep window, pause stuck-clock timers (`Task 125`) so sleeping for 2 hours NEVER falsely flags every worker as `"Stuck for 120m"` on wake, and note `suspendedAt`!
  - **`resume` (Laptop wakes up):** Detect exact sleep duration (`now - suspendedAt`), notify `Task 020` sleep-skew lease guard (preventing spurious lease expiry bursts!), verify network/provider reachability + local DB/test-env container health, run `Task 130`'s `reconcileAfterWake()`, and resume smoothly (or hold at Welcome-Back if sleep exceeded `> 30 min` or repo/network changed!)!
  - **`on-battery` / `on-ac`:** Emit clean power-source telemetry to Hardware Governor (`Task 118`) with an optional laptop-friendly `"Eco on battery"` cap!
  - **`shutdown` (Windows OS shutdown/restart):** Trigger urgent fast-path checkpoint flush + SQLite WAL checkpoint (`PASSIVE`/`TRUNCATE`) + Job Object child termination within Windows's shutdown budget so OS reboots leave `state.db` 100% intact!
- [ ] **Implement Opt-In `powerSaveBlocker` (`OptionalPowerSaveBlocker`):** Offer a clear **opt-in** Settings toggle (OFF by default, or `"Prevent sleep during active build"` toggle in Build header!) using Electron `powerSaveBlocker.start('prevent-app-suspension')` strictly ONLY while a build is actively running and releasing the blocker **UNCONDITIONALLY** the instant the build finishes, pauses, stops, parks on Inbox wait, or switches to low battery (`< 20%`)!
- [ ] **Implement Clean Start-At-Sign-In Manager (`StartAtSignInManager`):** Provide an explicit **opt-in** (strictly OFF by default!) `"Start EF Harness when Windows signs in"` preference using `app.setLoginItemSettings({ openAtLogin, args: ['--hidden-tray'] })` so users who want background readiness or scheduled sync can opt in cleanly without surprising anyone!
- [ ] **Implement Single-Instance Lock (`app.requestSingleInstanceLock()`):** Prevent two Electron shells from fighting over the same desktop window — launching a second instance focuses the existing primary window (and passes any deep-link / project-path CLI argument cleanly to the running instance)!
- [ ] **Implement Detached `harnessd` Clean Shutdown Handshake (`apps/daemon/src/lifecycle/`):** Implement structured `POST /lifecycle/shutdown` (`drain_and_exit` vs `detach_ui_keep_running`) with strict `<= 10 s` graceful drain timeout, SQLite `wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE)`, and Windows Job Object cleanup verification before process exit!
- [ ] **Implement Renderer Crash / Unresponsive Recovery:** Wire `webContents.on('render-process-gone')` and `mainWindow.on('unresponsive')` to preserve `harnessd` running uninterrupted and offer clean 1-click `"Reload UI"` (reconnecting seamlessly to the live `harnessd` event stream via `Task 032` with ZERO lost build progress!)!

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **User closes laptop lid for 4 hours mid-build and opens it on a train with no Wi-Fi:** `suspend` paused stuck-clocks and saved checkpoints; `resume` detects `4h > 30m` + offline network, holds cleanly at Welcome-Back (`"Paused while laptop slept (4h) · Offline — Resume when back online"`), with **0 false stuck alarms and 0 burned retries**!
- **User selects `"Keep building in background"` from the 3-choice Quit dialog:** Electron renderer window destroys cleanly (freeing `~300 MB` RAM!), tray icon stays live, and when `harnessd` finishes Wave 1 or hits a `P0` card, clicking the tray notification reopens the UI cleanly synced to exact live state!
- **Renderer crashes due to a GPU driver reset mid-build:** Because `harnessd` runs detached (`Task 067`), all active workers keep building completely unaffected; Electron reloads the renderer window cleanly and resyncs via `stream_epoch` in `< 1 s`!
- **Windows initiates automatic overnight Windows Update reboot (`shutdown` event):** Fast-path shutdown hook flushes checkpoints, runs SQLite WAL checkpoint, kills child Job Objects cleanly, and exits cleanly so the next morning's cold open (`Task 130`) finds 0 corruption!
- **User enabled `powerSaveBlocker`, build finishes at 2:00 AM, and laptop is left unattended:** The instant build state leaves `BUILDING` (entering `DONE`, `PAUSED`, `STOPPED`, or `WAITING_ON_USER`), `OptionalPowerSaveBlocker` immediately calls `powerSaveBlocker.stop(id)` so the laptop sleeps normally instead of draining its battery!
- **User tries to launch `ef-harness.exe` a second time from Desktop shortcut while already minimized in tray:** `requestSingleInstanceLock()` catches the second launch, restores the tray window to foreground, and terminates the duplicate process cleanly!
- **User quits while `0` builds are running:** Zero confirmation dialog — exits cleanly and terminates `harnessd` (unless background sync active) in `< 1 s`!

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Exact 3-Choice Quit-While-Building Invariant:** Quitting during active execution ALWAYS offers `Keep building in tray`, `Pause safely & Quit`, and `Cancel` (never silently killing active work OR hanging silently).
- **Zero-False-Stuck-Across-Sleep Invariant:** Sleep duration NEVER counts against worker stuck clocks (`Task 125`) or task leases (`Task 020`).
- **Auto-Release `powerSaveBlocker` Invariant:** `powerSaveBlocker` is strictly opt-in, active ONLY while `state === 'BUILDING'`, and unconditionally released on finish, pause, stop, user-wait, or low battery.
- **UI-Crash-Survivable Daemon Invariant:** Crashing or closing the Electron renderer window NEVER crashes or corrupts detached `harnessd` builds.
- **Single-Instance Invariant:** Only one Electron UI host runs per Windows user session; second launches restore the existing instance.
- **Opt-In Autostart Invariant:** Start-at-sign-in is strictly OFF by default and controlled solely via explicit user toggle.

#### Multi-Agent Harmony And Branch Isolation

- **Strict Subtree Boundary:** Touch ONLY `apps/desktop/src/lifecycle/**`, `apps/desktop/tests/lifecycle/**`, `apps/daemon/src/lifecycle/**`, `apps/daemon/tests/lifecycle/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-131.md`.

- **Handoff For `Task 132` (Park-First Auto-Updater Hook), `Task 196` (NSIS Packaging & Tray Assets):** Export `SystemTrayController`, `QuitWhileBuildingDialog`, `PowerMonitorSleepReconciler`, `OptionalPowerSaveBlocker`, `StartAtSignInManager`, and `DaemonShutdownCoordinator` in `.agent-handoffs/task-131.md`.
- **Commit-Only Discipline:** Commit exclusively on `task/131-electron-desktop-lifecycle`; **NEVER merge** into `main` or `harness/integration`.

### Task 132: Signed On-Demand Component Downloader (Manifest SHA-256, Resumable Downloads, AV Quarantine Repair) & Park-First Auto-Updater With Checkpoint Upcasters

- **Milestone & Track:** `M3 · Desktop Packaging, Components & Safe Auto-Update`
- **Depends On:** `Task 001`, `Task 015`, `Task 028`, `Task 067`, `Task 118`, `Task 131`
- **Git Worktree & Branch:** `task/132-component-downloader-park-updater` in `../ef-wt/task-132-component-downloader-park-updater` (commit on own branch only; **NEVER merge**)
- **Owned Write Scope (Disjoint Subtree):** `apps/desktop/src/updater/**`, `apps/desktop/tests/updater/**`, `apps/daemon/src/components/**`, `apps/daemon/tests/components/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-132.md`
- **Mandatory Reference Files:** [desktop-app.md](desktop-app.md#on-demand-components-and-auto-update), [app-shell-and-governor.md](app-shell-and-governor.md), [database-design.md](database-design.md), [desktop-app.mmd](desktop-app.mmd), [research/desktop-app-shell.md](research/desktop-app-shell.md)
- **Shared Contracts Consumed / Produced:** Consumes `MigrationAndRebuildEngine` (`Task 015`), `DiskHeadroomGuard` (`Task 118`), `DaemonShutdownCoordinator` (`Task 131`); produces `SignedComponentDownloader`, `AvQuarantineIntegrityChecker`, `ParkFirstAutoUpdater`, and `CheckpointSchemaUpcasterRegistry`

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Implement Ed25519-Signed Manifest Component Downloader (`SignedComponentDownloader`):** Keep the base Windows installer lean (`< 180 MB`) by downloading optional heavy runtime components strictly on demand (Whisper `whisper.cpp` binaries + quantized GGUF model `Task 157`, Playwright Chromium browser bundle `Task 057`, optional Postgres/Mailpit/S3 portable binaries `Task 050`, Tree-Sitter grammar updates):
  - Verify the remote `components-manifest.json` signature strictly against a **bundled pinned Ed25519 public key** BEFORE downloading a single byte!
  - Support **HTTP `Range` resumable downloads** with partial `.part` staging, pre-download `DiskHeadroomGuard` check (`Task 118`: refuse if `freeSpace - 2*componentSize < 5 GB`), live progress streaming, pause/cancel, and **mandatory SHA-256 verification before atomic unpack/rename**!
  - NEVER run unsigned executables, NEVER fetch from unpinned `"latest"` mutable URLs without manifest digest verification!
- [ ] **Implement Windows AV Quarantine Detection & Clean Repair (`AvQuarantineIntegrityChecker`):** On component load (and `Task 130` cold open), verify expected component binaries exist on disk and match their manifest SHA-256; if Windows Defender or third-party antivirus silently quarantined/deleted `whisper.exe` or `gitleaks.exe` (`ENOENT` / `EACCES` / hash mismatch!), surface a calm plain-English `"Component missing or blocked by antivirus — Re-verify & Repair"` card instead of throwing cryptic `spawn ENOENT` crashes!
- [ ] **Implement Strictly Park-First Auto-Updater (`ParkFirstAutoUpdater`):** Integrate `electron-updater` (using signed Authenticode + SHA-512 blockmaps) with one ironclad safety rule from [desktop-app.md](desktop-app.md): **NEVER restart or install an app update while ANY build, verification, or merge-queue job is active!**
  - Download update quietly in background ONLY when network/disk headroom is `GREEN` (respecting optional `"Manual updates only"` setting!)
  - Show a non-intrusive `"Update vX.Y.Z ready — Restart when convenient"` pill in the Top Bar
  - If the user clicks `"Update & Restart"` while a build IS active, execute **Park-First**: cleanly pause/checkpoint all running workers (`Task 114`/`128`), wait for clean `harnessd` SQLite WAL flush + Job Object teardown (`Task 131`), verify `state.db` backup snapshot (`Task 016`) BEFORE invoking `quitAndInstall()`!
- [ ] **Implement Forward-Only Checkpoint Schema Upcasters (`CheckpointSchemaUpcasterRegistry`):** When a new version of EF Harness boots over a parked project containing `attempt_checkpoints`, `ship_runs`, or `verification_state` rows written by version `N-1`, run deterministic, tested pure-function **upcasters** (`v1 → v2 → v3`) alongside `Task 015` SQLite migrations so parked mid-build tasks resume cleanly after updating the desktop app — and if a checkpoint format is irreversibly obsolete, safely fall back to fresh clean task retry preserving `harness/integration` 100% intact!
- [ ] **Implement Downgrade Protection Guard:** Refuse to open a `state.db` / `global.db` created by a *newer* schema version (`schema_version > CURRENT_SUPPORTED_VERSION`), displaying a crisp `"This project was opened by EF Harness vX.Y — please update this machine"` message instead of corrupting the newer database!
- [ ] **Implement Component Disk-Usage Manager:** Expose per-component on-disk sizes (`Whisper Medium: 480 MB`, `Playwright Chromium: 290 MB`, `Local Postgres: 140 MB`) in Settings with safe 1-click uninstall/cleanup (blocked only while a running task actively holds a lease on that component)!
- [ ] **Implement Mirror Fallback & Strict TLS Verification:** Support signed mirror URLs from the verified manifest if the primary CDN times out, strictly forbidding `NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=0` or HTTP downgrade!
- [ ] **Implement Rollback-Safe Staged Component Swap:** Extract updates to `<component>.staging` first, verify all extracted file hashes, then atomically swap into place so a power loss mid-unpack never leaves a half-extracted broken binary!

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **Manifest server is compromised or MITM alters download URL / SHA-256:** Bundled Ed25519 signature check fails BEFORE any download starts (`InvalidManifestSignatureError`)!
- **User's Wi-Fi drops at `72%` of a `480 MB` Whisper model download:** `.part` file persists cleanly; clicking `Resume` issues `Range: bytes=<offset>-`, finishes the remaining `28%`, verifies full-file SHA-256, and swaps atomically!
- **Downloaded bytes match content length but final SHA-256 fails due to corruption:** Staged `.part` file is immediately deleted, never unpacked, and retries cleanly (max 2 retries before reporting checksum mismatch)!
- **Corporate antivirus silently deletes `whisper-cli.exe` overnight:** `AvQuarantineIntegrityChecker` detects missing binary on next dictation attempt, falls back gracefully to OS dictation (`Task 157`) while offering 1-click verified repair!
- **Auto-update downloads completely while 4 parallel workers are mid-wave:** `ParkFirstAutoUpdater` NEVER auto-restarts! It quietly shows `"Update ready"` and, if clicked, parks/checkpoints all 4 workers + snapshots `state.db` BEFORE installing!
- **User updates from `v1.0 → v1.1` while Task `T-5` is parked with a `v1` `attempt_checkpoint`:** `CheckpointSchemaUpcasterRegistry` upgrades `v1 → v2` deterministically inside a backup-protected transaction and resumes `T-5` cleanly!
- **Drive `C:` has only `5.2 GB` free and user clicks `"Download Whisper Large (1.6 GB)"`:** `DiskHeadroomGuard` pre-check sees `5.2 - 2*1.6 = 2.0 GB < 5 GB` threshold and refuses cleanly BEFORE filling the disk!

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Ed25519-Signed-Manifest + SHA-256 Invariant:** Zero downloaded component bytes are ever unpacked or executed without verified Ed25519 manifest signature AND exact SHA-256 digest match.
- **Park-First Auto-Update Invariant:** An app update NEVER restarts `harnessd` or Electron while active builds/merges are uncheckpointed.
- **Pre-Update Backup Invariant:** Every auto-update restart creates a verified SQLite pre-upgrade backup snapshot (`Task 016`) first.
- **No-Downgrade-Corruption Invariant:** Older app binaries refuse cleanly to mutate databases stamped with a newer `schema_version`.
- **Disk-Headroom-Before-Download Invariant:** Component downloads strictly verify `freeBytes - 2 * size >= 5 GB` before starting.
- **Atomic-Staging-Swap Invariant:** Interrupted downloads or extracts never corrupt previously working component installations.

#### Multi-Agent Harmony And Branch Isolation

- **Worktree Setup:** Create branch `task/132-component-downloader-park-updater` via `node scripts/agent-worktree.mjs create 132 component-downloader-park-updater`.
- **Strict Subtree Boundary:** Touch ONLY `apps/desktop/src/updater/**`, `apps/desktop/tests/updater/**`, `apps/daemon/src/components/**`, `apps/daemon/tests/components/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-132.md`.
- **Parallel Safe Execution:** Disjoint from `Task 131` (`apps/desktop/src/lifecycle/**`), `Task 133` (`apps/daemon/src/diagnostics/**`), and `Task 196` (`scripts/packaging/**`).
- **Handoff For `Task 157` (Whisper Model On-Demand Download), `Task 121` (Playwright Component Install), `Task 196` (NSIS Signed Release Manifest):** Export `SignedComponentDownloader`, `AvQuarantineIntegrityChecker`, `ParkFirstAutoUpdater`, and `CheckpointSchemaUpcasterRegistry` in `.agent-handoffs/task-132.md`.
- **Commit-Only Discipline:** Commit exclusively on `task/132-component-downloader-park-updater`; **NEVER merge** into `main` or `harness/integration`.
- **Local HTTP Loopback & Real Ed25519 Tests:** Test real Ed25519 signing/tamper rejection, HTTP `Range` mid-stream drop + resume, bad SHA-256 rejection, AV deletion detection, park-first update gating, and `v1 → v2` checkpoint upcasting against a local test HTTP server!

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **A daemon log line accidentally contains `C:\Users\Ayush\Desktop\secret-startup\api.ts` and a leaked bearer header fragment:** `RedactedDiagnosticsBundleExporter` scrubs BOTH the token (`[REDACTED_SECRET]`) AND the Windows user path (`C:\Users\<USER>\...`) verified by a final post-redaction canary assertion!
- **User opens Diagnostics Bundle Preview and inspects `daemon-logs-redacted.txt`:** Exact byte-for-byte text shown in Preview is the exact text written into the `.zip` (zero discrepancy between preview and saved zip!)!
- **A runaway crash loop generates 40 Electron minidumps overnight:** `CrashDumpIndexer` enforces the `<= 10` dumps / `<= 50 MB` retention cap automatically so crash dumps never fill Drive `C:`!
- **`telemetry.db` becomes corrupt or locked:** `DiagnosticsHealthView` catches the error gracefully, displays `"telemetry.db unavailable — click Rebuild Telemetry DB"`, and keeps core `state.db` and build operations 100% unaffected!
- **App runs continuously for 60 days:** 7-day sample pruner keeps `telemetry.db` compact (`< 50 MB`) with zero degradation!
- **User runs `"Run Self-Check"` while `MinGit` or `DPAPI` has an issue:** Self-check completes in `< 2 s` and pinpoints the exact failing subsystem with actionable fix steps!
- **Attempt to include a raw `state.db` or repo source file in bundle generator:** Hard allowlist architecture makes including source code, prompts, or vault files structurally impossible!

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Zero-Phone-Home Invariant:** Diagnostics, crash dumps, and metrics are 100% local; zero automatic network uploads ever occur (`uploadToServer: false`).
- **Zero-Source-Code / Zero-Secret Bundle Invariant:** Diagnostics `.zip` bundles NEVER include repo source code, prompts, chat history, DPAPI secrets, or unredacted Windows usernames/tokens.
- **Preview-Equals-Export Invariant:** The user previews the exact finalized redacted contents of every file in the bundle BEFORE saving the `.zip`.
- **Bounded-Telemetry-Size Invariant:** Automated 7-day fine-sample pruning and 10-dump cap prevent disk growth.
- **Non-Critical Telemetry Isolation Invariant:** `telemetry.db` corruption or rebuild never disrupts `state.db` or live builds.
- **Sub-2s Self-Check Invariant:** Built-in health self-check executes read-only across all core subsystems in `< 2 s`.

### Task 135: Versioned Signed Provider Policy File Engine (Daily Check, Min CLI Versions, Roster Defaults, Immediate Park On `route_revoked` & Anthropic/Google Compliance Locks)

- **Milestone & Track:** `M4 · Provider Policy, Terms Compliance & Safe Defaults`
- **Depends On:** `Task 001`, `Task 014`, `Task 106`, `Task 132`
- **Git Worktree & Branch:** `task/135-signed-provider-policy-engine` in `../ef-wt/task-135-signed-provider-policy-engine` (commit on own branch only; **NEVER merge**)
- **Owned Write Scope (Disjoint Subtree):** `packages/providers/src/policy/**`, `packages/providers/tests/policy/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-135.md`
- **Mandatory Reference Files:** [provider-connections.md](provider-connections.md#the-provider-policy-file), [open-design-questions.md](open-design-questions.md), [agent-runtime-adapters.md](agent-runtime-adapters.md), [schema/global.sql](schema/global.sql), [onboarding-providers-and-runtimes.mmd](onboarding-providers-and-runtimes.mmd), [onboarding-providers-and-runtimes.svg](onboarding-providers-and-runtimes.svg), [research/provider-subscriptions.md](research/provider-subscriptions.md)
- **Shared Contracts Consumed / Produced:** Consumes `GlobalDbRepo` (`Task 014`), `VersionedModelRoster` (`Task 106`); produces `SignedProviderPolicyEngine`, `CompliancePolicyLocks`, `CliMinVersionGate`, and `RouteRevocationParkHandler`

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Implement Ed25519-Signed Versioned Policy File Engine (`SignedProviderPolicyEngine`):** Ship a bundled canonical `provider-policy.json` signed with a pinned Ed25519 public key AND fetch optional daily background refreshes (`<= 1/24h`, strict `5 s` timeout, strictly fail-open to last verified cached policy if offline — NEVER blocking local work when offline!), verifying signature + monotonic `policy_version` (preventing rollback attacks!) BEFORE applying updates to `global.db`!
- [ ] **Enforce Hard Non-Negotiable Provider Terms Compliance Locks (`CompliancePolicyLocks` — Owner Decisions Nov 16–17, 2026 in [open-design-questions.md](open-design-questions.md)):** Encode immutable compliance locks directly in BOTH policy schema AND kernel code so no remote config or accidental UI option can ever violate provider terms:
  1. **Anthropic / Claude Code:** Strictly **Console API keys ONLY** (`sk-ant-api...`)! Strictly block and refuse Claude consumer subscription OAuth tokens, `claude setup-token`, or `~/.claude/.credentials.json` scraping — clearly showing `"Claude Code uses Anthropic Console API keys only (subscription OAuth is withdrawn)"`!
  2. **Google Gemini CLI:** Runs strictly unmodified (`gemini --acp`), **OFF by default**, gated behind an explicit user opt-in checkbox + visible policy notice (`"Verify your Google account terms allow third-party ACP harness use"`), and **NEVER reads or copies `~/.gemini` credentials**!
  3. **Google Antigravity:** **NEVER offered or listed** as a provider or runtime route anywhere in policy, roster, or UI!
  4. **Sign in with ChatGPT (`chatgpt.tokens.use.direct`):** Marked explicitly with current preview-scope terms & constraints (`store: false`, `stream: true`, no `max_output_tokens`/`temperature`/`previous_response_id`, persisted `ext_agent_host_id`)!
- [ ] **Implement Minimum CLI Version & Capability Floor Gate (`CliMinVersionGate`):** Maintain per-runtime minimum safe semver versions (`codex`, `claude`, `copilot`, `cursor-agent`, `opencode`, `gemini`) plus known-broken version denylist ranges (e.g., a broken CLI release that leaks processes or breaks permission hooks!); automatically block or downgrade incompatible CLI versions to `disabled`/`observe-only` with a crisp `"Update <CLI> to >= vX.Y.Z"` card!
- [ ] **Implement Immediate Safe Park On `route_revoked` (`RouteRevocationParkHandler`):** If a daily signed policy update marks an active connection route or auth flow as `status: 'route_revoked'` (e.g., if a provider withdraws a preview OAuth route or deprecates an auth endpoint!), immediately **park** all new dispatches on that connection cleanly (letting any active atomic step checkpoint cleanly without corruption), surface ONE clear `AccountCard` (`Task 127`) with the signed policy's plain-English `revocationNotice` + safe alternatives (`Switch Connection` / `Keep Parked`), and **NEVER silently fall back to a paid API key** (`Task 141`)!
- [ ] **Implement Dynamic Model Roster & Pricing Refresh Hook:** Merge signed policy model additions, deprecations, capability flags (`supportsTools`, `supportsVision`), and published API price updates cleanly into `Task 106`'s `VersionedModelRoster` while preserving user-pinned custom models and local Ollama entries!
- [ ] **Implement Policy Signature Anti-Rollback & Audit Log:** Persist `{ policyVersion, publishedAt, sha256, appliedAt, diffSummary }` in `global.db.policy_history`; hard-reject any remote policy with `policyVersion < currentPolicyVersion` or invalid Ed25519 signature!
- [ ] **Implement Offline-First Zero-Delay Startup:** On app startup, load the locally cached verified policy synchronously in `< 5 ms` (NEVER waiting for a network fetch during boot!), scheduling the daily refresh asynchronously 30 seconds after startup!
- [ ] **Implement Policy Transparency Viewer Hook:** Expose active policy version, last verified timestamp, and per-route compliance status (`allowed` | `opt_in_with_notice` | `disabled_by_policy` | `route_revoked`) cleanly to Settings → Connections (`Task 141`) and Diagnostics (`Task 133`)!

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **Malicious DNS/MITM serves a tampered `provider-policy.json` with a fake `route_revoked` or downgraded version:** Ed25519 signature check + monotonic version check reject the tampered payload immediately and keep the last known-good verified policy intact!
- **A daily signed policy update marks `siwc_preview` as `route_revoked` while a user is mid-wave on ChatGPT Plus:** `RouteRevocationParkHandler` immediately stops new ChatGPT dispatches, checkpoints active turns cleanly, opens a clear `AccountCard` explaining the revocation, and refuses to silently spill onto the user's paid OpenAI API key!
- **Developer has `codex v0.1.0` installed while signed policy requires `minVersion: ">=0.42.0"` due to sandbox/permission bugs:** `CliMinVersionGate` refuses launching `codex v0.1.0` and displays `"Codex CLI 0.1.0 is below minimum safe version 0.42.0 — Update CLI to enable"`!
- **Developer attempts to pass a Claude Pro subscription token or point EF Harness at `~/.claude` or `~/.gemini`:** `CompliancePolicyLocks` hard-rejects at BOTH UI and kernel layers with explicit compliance explanation!
- **User is completely offline on an airplane for 10 days:** App boots instantaneously from bundled/cached verified policy with zero nagging errors (only subtle `"Policy last checked 10d ago"` info in Diagnostics)!
- **Signed policy deprecates `model-old-v1` while a parked project explicitly referenced it:** Roster updater smoothly recommends replacement model in Welcome-Back/Plan Preview without crashing deserialization!
- **Attempt to register `antigravity` route via custom config:** Hard compliance denylist rejects `antigravity` unconditionally!

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Immutable Anthropic Console-Only Invariant:** Claude Code accepts ONLY Anthropic Console API keys; consumer subscription OAuth / `setup-token` is strictly prohibited in code and policy.
- **Immutable Gemini Opt-In & Zero-`~/.gemini` Invariant:** Gemini CLI defaults OFF with explicit policy notice and NEVER reads `~/.gemini`.
- **Zero-Antigravity Invariant:** Antigravity is never offered, registered, or accepted as a provider/runtime.
- **Ed25519 + Monotonic-Version Policy Invariant:** Remote policy updates require valid pinned Ed25519 signature AND `newVersion >= currentVersion`.
- **Immediate-Park-Never-Silent-Fallback On `route_revoked` Invariant:** Revoked routes immediately park dispatches cleanly without silently switching to paid alternatives.
- **Offline-First Startup Invariant:** Policy loading completes locally in `< 5 ms` with zero network blocking at startup.

#### Multi-Agent Harmony And Branch Isolation

- **Worktree Setup:** Create branch `task/135-signed-provider-policy-engine` via `node scripts/agent-worktree.mjs create 135 signed-provider-policy-engine`.
- **Strict Subtree Boundary:** Touch ONLY `packages/providers/src/policy/**`, `packages/providers/tests/policy/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-135.md`.
- **Parallel Safe Execution:** Disjoint from `Tasks 136–141` (`packages/providers/src/{api-keys,siwc,openrouter-local,copilot-cursor-auth,pacing,fallback-guard}/**`).
- **Handoff For `Tasks 136–141` (All Provider Auth & Pacing Modules), `Tasks 142–149` (All Runtime Adapters), `Task 199` (Provider Terms Compliance Final Audit):** Export `SignedProviderPolicyEngine`, `CompliancePolicyLocks`, `CliMinVersionGate`, and `RouteRevocationParkHandler` in `.agent-handoffs/task-135.md`.
- **Commit-Only Discipline:** Commit exclusively on `task/135-signed-provider-policy-engine`; **NEVER merge** into `main` or `harness/integration`.
- **Real Ed25519 Signature & Compliance Lock Tests:** Test real signature verification, rollback rejection, `route_revoked` immediate parking, CLI min-version blocking, and Anthropic/Gemini/Antigravity hard locks offline!

  - `outputMicroUsdPer1M`
  - `cachedInputReadMicroUsdPer1M` (accurate Anthropic/OpenAI/Gemini prompt-cache discount accounting!)
  - `cacheWriteMicroUsdPer1M`
  - `reasoningTokenMicroUsdPer1M` (for thinking/reasoning models!)
  - Compute exact integer cost receipts per turn (`Task 023`), explicitly tagged **`estimated: true`** (`"Estimated from published rates (price table v2026.11)"`) AND ingest provider-returned exact cost headers/fields when available (e.g., OpenRouter `usage.cost`) tagged `provider_reported`!
- [ ] **Implement Prompt-Cache Economics Optimization Hints:** Expose deterministic prefix-stability & cache-TTL metadata per provider (Anthropic ephemeral cache breakpoints, OpenAI automatic prefix caching, Gemini context caching) so `Task 053` Native Worker Loop and `Task 088` Slicer maximize cache hits automatically!
- [ ] **Implement Key Rotation, Soft Disable & Instant Purge:** Let the user rotate an API key in place (preserving connection ID & historical usage receipts), temporarily disable a connection without deleting its history, or delete it completely (wiping DPAPI entry immediately)!
- [ ] **Implement Custom OpenAI-Compatible Endpoint Guard:** When a user configures a custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint (e.g., corporate LiteLLM proxy or self-hosted vLLM), require HTTPS (except `127.0.0.1` / `::1` loopback!), validate `GET /models`, and allow user-supplied custom rate table (defaulting to `$0` / `"Custom endpoint — cost unpriced"` rather than fake pricing)!
- [ ] **Implement Safe Zero-Leak HTTP Error Handling:** Strip `Authorization`, `x-api-key`, and `?key=...` query params (especially critical for Gemini's query-param style — ALWAYS prefer `x-goog-api-key` header instead of URL query param so keys never touch HTTP logs or proxies!) before logging any validation error!

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **User pastes a Claude consumer OAuth token (`sk-ant-oat01-...`) into the API key field:** `ApiKeyPrefixDetector` + `CompliancePolicyLocks` immediately rejects it with `"Claude subscription OAuth tokens are not supported — please paste an Anthropic Console API key (sk-ant-api...)"` without ever sending it over the network!
- **User pastes a brand-new OpenAI API key that authenticates `200` on `/v1/models` OR returns `429 insufficient_quota` on first call:** Validator distinguishes `401 invalid key` from `billing/credit setup needed` with direct plain-English guidance!
- **Gemini API validation sends key in URL `?key=AIza...`:** Explicitly FORBIDDEN! Always passes key strictly via `x-goog-api-key` HTTP header so URLs in traces/proxies NEVER contain API keys!
- **A custom self-hosted endpoint uses a non-existent model pricing entry:** Estimator tags spend cleanly as `pricing_status: 'unpriced_custom_endpoint'` (counting exact input/output tokens accurately without fabricating fake dollar costs)!
- **User pastes a key with accidental leading/trailing whitespace or quotes (`"sk-proj-abc123\n"`):** Pre-detector trims whitespace/quotes cleanly before validation without mutating internal characters!
- **Anthropic/OpenAI cached prompt read accounts for 85% of a 10,000-token worker turn:** `VersionedPriceTableEstimator` applies exact `cachedInputReadMicroUsdPer1M` rates so cost estimates accurately reflect real cache savings instead of over-estimating 5×!
- **User clicks Save on a key while completely offline:** Offers `"Save unverified (offline) — will verify before first build"` cleanly rather than throwing away the form or blindly marking `verified`!

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Zero-Token Validation Invariant:** API key validation calls ONLY read-only model-list endpoints (`0` completion tokens billed).
- **Header-Only Key Transport Invariant:** API keys are NEVER placed in URL query strings (including Gemini — strictly `x-goog-api-key` header) or command-line args.
- **Exact Integer `micro-USD` Pricing Invariant:** All cost math uses exact BigInt/integer `micro-USD` accounting for input, output, cached read, cache write, and reasoning tokens (zero float drift).
- **Honest Estimated-vs-Reported Labeling Invariant:** Every API ledger entry clearly records whether its cost is `estimated` (from versioned table) or `provider_reported`.
- **Anthropic Console-Only Enforcement Invariant:** `sk-ant-oat*` / subscription tokens are hard-rejected before storage or transmission.
- **DPAPI-Only Secret Persistence Invariant:** `global.db.connections` stores ONLY masked previews (`sk-ant-...9x2a`), never raw keys.
