### Task 137: Sign In With ChatGPT (OAuth 2.0 PKCE + OIDC, Persisted `ext_agent_host_id`, `dynamic_agent_client`, `chatgpt.tokens.use.direct` Scope, Preview Guards & Stream-Cutoff Bounding)

- **Milestone & Track:** `M4 · Sign In With ChatGPT Subscription Auth`
- **Depends On:** `Task 001`, `Task 014`, `Task 120`, `Task 135`
- **Git Worktree & Branch:** `task/137-sign-in-with-chatgpt-oauth` in `../ef-wt/task-137-sign-in-with-chatgpt-oauth` (commit on own branch only; **NEVER merge**)
- **Owned Write Scope (Disjoint Subtree):** `packages/providers/src/siwc/**`, `packages/providers/tests/siwc/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-137.md`
- **Mandatory Reference Files:** [provider-connections.md](provider-connections.md#sign-in-with-chatgpt), [open-design-questions.md](open-design-questions.md), [schema/global.sql](schema/global.sql), [onboarding-providers-and-runtimes.mmd](onboarding-providers-and-runtimes.mmd), [research/provider-subscriptions.md](research/provider-subscriptions.md)
- **Shared Contracts Consumed / Produced:** Consumes `GlobalDbRepo.connections` (`Task 014`), `WindowsDpapiSecretsVault` (`Task 120`), `SignedProviderPolicyEngine` (`Task 135`); produces `SignInWithChatGptAuthFlow`, `SiwcTokenRefresher`, `SiwcDirectRequestAdapter`, and `SiwcStreamCutoffGuard`

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Implement OAuth 2.0 PKCE + OIDC Loopback Flow (`SignInWithChatGptAuthFlow`):** Implement the exact official **Sign in with ChatGPT** authorization protocol documented in [provider-connections.md](provider-connections.md) and [open-design-questions.md](open-design-questions.md):
  - Persist a stable per-installation UUID **`ext_agent_host_id`** in `global.db` (generated once per install, reused across logins/refreshes so host registration remains stable!)
  - Perform dynamic client registration (`dynamic_agent_client`) cleanly when required by the policy endpoint
  - Generate cryptographically random PKCE `code_verifier` (`S256` challenge), OAuth `state`, and OIDC `nonce`; bind an ephemeral `127.0.0.1` loopback HTTP callback listener (`<= 120 s` TTL, auto-closing immediately after receiving callback!), and open the user's real default system browser (`shell.openExternal` — NEVER scraping passwords in an embedded Electron WebView!)
  - Exchange authorization code cleanly, validate OIDC `id_token` `nonce`/`iss`/`aud`/`exp`, and **strictly verify granted token scopes include `chatgpt.tokens.use.direct`** (failing clearly with plain-English explanation if the user's ChatGPT tier or consent omitted direct-use scope!)!
- [ ] **Implement Strict Preview-Endpoint Wire Constraints (`SiwcDirectRequestAdapter`):** Enforce EVERY protocol constraint required by the ChatGPT direct responses endpoint in deterministic code (so no caller or prompt builder can accidentally send forbidden fields and trigger `400` rejections!):
  - **ALWAYS set `store: false`** (stateless, zero server-side thread retention!)
  - **ALWAYS set `stream: true`** (SSE streaming mandatory!)
  - **UNCONDITIONALLY STRIP / FORBID `max_output_tokens`, `temperature`, and `previous_response_id`** (never sent on the wire; full conversation state is explicitly managed by the harness's 6-zone context builder `Task 053`!)
  - Respect active policy endpoint URL and required headers (`ext_agent_host_id`, `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`)!
- [ ] **Implement Deterministic Client-Side Stream-Cutoff Bounding (`SiwcStreamCutoffGuard`):** Because `max_output_tokens` cannot be sent on the wire to the direct ChatGPT endpoint, enforce an explicit **client-side streaming output-token & wall-clock watchdog** inside the SSE parser:
  - Track streamed output token/character count live per turn
  - If a runaway generation exceeds the task/role's safety output ceiling (e.g., `> 16,384` output tokens on a bounded JSON/edit turn, or repeats a degenerate loop pattern for `> 512` chars), cleanly **abort the HTTP SSE stream via `AbortController`** so the user's 5-hour ChatGPT allowance isn't burned on an infinite loop — recording `finishReason: 'client_stream_cutoff'` cleanly!
- [ ] **Implement Atomic Single-Flight Refresh Token Rotation (`SiwcTokenRefresher`):** Store `access_token` and rotating `refresh_token` exclusively in `Task 120` DPAPI vault; when 12 concurrent thinking workers (`Task 119`) notice an expiring token simultaneously (`exp - now < 120 s`), coalesce ALL 12 onto **ONE single-flight refresh mutex** so rotating refresh tokens are NEVER double-spent simultaneously (which would trigger OAuth reuse revocation and log the user out mid-build!)!
- [ ] **Implement Preview-Limitation Transparency & Policy Revocation Integration:** Surface a crisp honest label on the Sign in with ChatGPT connection (`"ChatGPT Subscription · Direct Preview · Uses your ChatGPT 5h/weekly allowance"`), honor `Task 135` `route_revoked` immediately, and provide clean fallback guidance (`Task 144` Codex CLI / `Task 128` Switch Connection) if preview terms change!
- [ ] **Implement Clean Disconnect & Token Revocation:** Support 1-click Disconnect that revokes tokens at the provider revocation endpoint (best-effort) AND immediately wipes DPAPI entries + marks `connections.status = 'disconnected'`!
- [ ] **Implement Allowance & Rate-Limit Header Extractor:** Parse any returned `x-ratelimit-*` / `retry-after` / ChatGPT quota headers and error codes (`usage_limit_reached`, `rate_limit_exceeded`, `reset_at`) cleanly and feed them directly into `Task 140` Global Broker Allowance Pacing!
- [ ] **Implement Clean Multi-Account Disambiguation:** Allow connecting e.g. Personal ChatGPT Plus and Work ChatGPT Team simultaneously via distinct DPAPI keys and `connectionId` labels without cross-account token collision!

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **10 parallel workers simultaneously hit `exp - now < 120 s` on a rotating OAuth refresh token:** `SiwcTokenRefresher` single-flight mutex runs EXACTLY ONE `/oauth/token` refresh request; the other 9 await the same promise and all 10 receive the fresh token cleanly (ZERO accidental refresh-token reuse logout!)!
- **A buggy prompt caller passes `{ temperature: 0.2, max_output_tokens: 4096, previous_response_id: 'resp_1' }` to `SiwcDirectRequestAdapter`:** Adapter unconditionally strips all 3 forbidden fields AND enforces `store: false, stream: true` before serialization (verified by wire-body assertion!)!
- **A ChatGPT streaming turn enters a degenerate repetition loop (`"}\n}\n}\n..."`) because `max_output_tokens` isn't set server-side:** `SiwcStreamCutoffGuard` detects the repetition / token ceiling within seconds and aborts the SSE socket immediately, protecting the user's 5-hour allowance!
- **User completes login on a free/ineligible ChatGPT account whose returned OAuth scope omits `chatgpt.tokens.use.direct`:** Flow rejects cleanly BEFORE saving the connection, explaining clearly `"Your account didn't grant direct harness access (chatgpt.tokens.use.direct) — check plan eligibility or use an API key"`!
- **User clicks `Sign in with ChatGPT`, closes the browser tab without finishing, and clicks `Cancel`:** Ephemeral `127.0.0.1` loopback listener closes immediately (and auto-closes at 120 s TTL), leaving zero dangling open ports!
- **CSRF attacker hits `http://127.0.0.1:<port>/callback?code=evil&state=wrong`:** Strict `state` constant-time verification rejects immediately (`400 Invalid state`) and refuses code exchange!
- **Refresh token expires after 30 days of inactivity (`invalid_grant`):** `SiwcTokenRefresher` parks active builds cleanly, emits ONE `AccountCard` (`"ChatGPT sign-in expired — Sign in again"`), and NEVER silently falls back to a paid API key (`Task 141`)!

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Strict Wire-Constraint Invariant:** Every Sign in with ChatGPT direct request ALWAYS sends `store: false` and `stream: true` AND NEVER sends `max_output_tokens`, `temperature`, or `previous_response_id`.
- **Mandatory `chatgpt.tokens.use.direct` Scope Invariant:** Login strictly verifies `chatgpt.tokens.use.direct` in the granted scope before activating the connection.
- **Stable `ext_agent_host_id` Invariant:** Installation UUID `ext_agent_host_id` is persisted once in `global.db` and preserved across restarts and token refreshes.
- **Single-Flight Refresh Mutex Invariant:** Concurrent workers NEVER issue overlapping refresh-token exchanges on the same connection.
- **Bounded Client Stream-Cutoff Invariant:** Runaway or looping SSE streams are aborted client-side cleanly via `AbortController` to protect user allowance.
- **System-Browser-Only PKCE Invariant:** OAuth sign-in ALWAYS runs in the user's real OS browser with PKCE `S256` + `state` + OIDC `nonce` + ephemeral `127.0.0.1` callback (zero password-scraping WebViews!).

#### Multi-Agent Harmony And Branch Isolation

- **Worktree Setup:** Create branch `task/137-sign-in-with-chatgpt-oauth` via `node scripts/agent-worktree.mjs create 137 sign-in-with-chatgpt-oauth`.
- **Strict Subtree Boundary:** Touch ONLY `packages/providers/src/siwc/**`, `packages/providers/tests/siwc/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-137.md`.
- **Parallel Safe Execution:** Disjoint from `Tasks 135–136` and `Tasks 138–141`.
- **Handoff For `Task 140` (Allowance Pacing Header Feed), `Task 141` (Connections UI), `Task 144` (Codex Token Sharing/Separation), `Task 152` (M4 ChatGPT Plus Kitchen Build Exit Gate):** Export `SignInWithChatGptAuthFlow`, `SiwcTokenRefresher`, `SiwcDirectRequestAdapter`, and `SiwcStreamCutoffGuard` in `.agent-handoffs/task-137.md`.
- **Commit-Only Discipline:** Commit exclusively on `task/137-sign-in-with-chatgpt-oauth`; **NEVER merge** into `main` or `harness/integration`.
- **Mock Local OIDC/OAuth + SSE Server Tests:** Run a full local loopback mock OIDC/OAuth2 + SSE server in Vitest verifying PKCE `S256`, `state`/`nonce` rejection, `ext_agent_host_id` persistence, missing-scope rejection, 10-worker single-flight refresh mutex, wire-field stripping, and SSE stream-cutoff abort!

#### Verification, Testing And Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Verify `SiwcDirectRequestAdapter` wire payload ALWAYS contains `store: false`, `stream: true`, and NEVER contains `max_output_tokens`, `temperature`, or `previous_response_id`.

### Task 138: OpenRouter PKCE OAuth (`127.0.0.1` Loopback, Credit-Limited Key Minting) & Local Model Auto-Discovery (Ollama `/api/tags`, LM Studio, Tool/Context Checks & VRAM Slots)

- **Milestone & Track:** `M4 · OpenRouter OAuth & Local Offline Model Providers`
- **Depends On:** `Task 001`, `Task 014`, `Task 106`, `Task 117`, `Task 118`, `Task 120`, `Task 135`
- **Git Worktree & Branch:** `task/138-openrouter-oauth-local-models` in `../ef-wt/task-138-openrouter-oauth-local-models` (commit on own branch only; **NEVER merge**)
- **Owned Write Scope (Disjoint Subtree):** `packages/providers/src/openrouter-local/**`, `packages/providers/tests/openrouter-local/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-138.md`
- **Mandatory Reference Files:** [provider-connections.md](provider-connections.md#openrouter-and-local-models), [app-shell-and-governor.md](app-shell-and-governor.md), [onboarding-providers-and-runtimes.mmd](onboarding-providers-and-runtimes.mmd), [research/provider-subscriptions.md](research/provider-subscriptions.md)
- **Shared Contracts Consumed / Produced:** Consumes `GlobalDbRepo.connections` (`Task 014`), `VersionedModelRoster` (`Task 106`), `WindowsResourceTelemetryCollector` DXGI VRAM (`Task 117`), `GpuWhisperPriorityArbiter` (`Task 118`), `WindowsDpapiSecretsVault` (`Task 120`); produces `OpenRouterPkceOAuthFlow`, `LocalModelAutoDiscoverer`, `LocalModelCapabilityProber`, and `LocalVramSlotManager`

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Implement OpenRouter PKCE OAuth Loopback Flow (`OpenRouterPkceOAuthFlow`):** Implement OpenRouter's official browser OAuth PKCE (`S256`) flow via ephemeral `127.0.0.1` loopback listener (`shell.openExternal`, zero password WebViews!), allowing the developer to mint a dedicated, scoped, **credit-capped** OpenRouter API key straight from OpenRouter's consent screen in 2 clicks, storing the minted key strictly in DPAPI (`Task 120`), querying `GET /api/v1/auth/key` to display real remaining credit balance (`limit`, `usage`, `limit_remaining`), and automatically ingesting exact `usage.cost` returned by OpenRouter responses!
- [ ] **Implement Automatic Zero-Config Local Model Discovery (`LocalModelAutoDiscoverer`):** Probe local loopback endpoints strictly on `127.0.0.1` / `localhost` (`<= 1,500 ms` fast timeout, zero external traffic!):
  - **Ollama (`http://127.0.0.1:11434`):** Query `GET /api/tags` + `POST /api/show` to enumerate every installed local model, parameter size (`7B`/`14B`/`32B`), quantization (`Q4_K_M`/`Q8_0`), configured context window (`num_ctx`), and `POST /api/ps` for currently VRAM-loaded models!
  - **LM Studio (`http://127.0.0.1:1234`):** Query `GET /v1/models` (and LM Studio native `/api/v0/models` metadata when available!) to discover loaded local models and context sizes!
  - Support custom local port override in Settings (strictly loopback-verified by default unless user explicitly opts into LAN host)!
- [ ] **Implement Honest Local Model Capability Prober (`LocalModelCapabilityProber`):** Prevent painful silent failures caused by tiny local models that hallucinate broken JSON or lack function calling! Before marking a discovered local model eligible for coding/planning roles, deterministically check & run an optional fast 1-shot local probe (`<= 15 s`, cached by model digest!):
  1. **Context Window Floor:** Check effective context (`>= 16,384` tokens required for Junior worker briefs; `>= 32,768` recommended for Senior/Planner — clearly warning `"4k context too small for coding tasks"` instead of failing mysteriously mid-build!)
  2. **Structured JSON & Tool-Calling Probe:** Verify the model reliably emits valid schema-conforming JSON AND invokes a dummy tool call cleanly (`supportsTools`, `supportsStructuredJson`) — automatically marking non-tool models `chat_or_summary_only` rather than assigning them as tool-calling workers!
  3. **Live Speed Benchmark (`tokens/sec`):** Record real observed local `tok/s` so `Task 107` HEFT makespan estimates reflect actual laptop GPU speed honestly!
- [ ] **Implement VRAM-Aware Local Model Slot Manager (`LocalVramSlotManager`):** Integrate directly with `Task 117` DXGI VRAM headroom + `Task 118` `GpuWhisperPriorityArbiter` so local models run cleanly on real developer laptops:
  - Estimate required VRAM from model file size + KV-cache at target `num_ctx` (`modelBytes * 1.25 + kvCacheBytes`)
  - Default local concurrency to **`1` active VRAM slot** on `<= 16 GB` VRAM GPUs (preventing Ollama from thrashing model swaps or spilling to slow system RAM across 2 different models simultaneously!), allowing `2` parallel slots on identical already-loaded weights ONLY when `OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL` & VRAM headroom permit!
  - Yield immediately to `GpuWhisperPriorityArbiter` whenever the user presses the local Whisper dictation hotkey (`Task 157`)!
- [ ] **Implement Exact `$0.00` Local Cost Accounting With Energy/Time Transparency:** Tag all local Ollama/LM Studio turns strictly as `currency: 'local_slots', costMicroUsd: 0` (recording real tokens & wall-clock seconds honestly without inflating API spend totals)!
- [ ] **Implement Local-Only Offline Mode Support:** Confirm that a developer with ONLY Ollama/LM Studio connected can discover, plan, build, verify, and run a local project completely offline (`0` cloud calls!) whenever their local model meets capability floors!
- [ ] **Implement OpenRouter Credit-Balance Guard & Low-Credit Warning:** Poll OpenRouter `/api/v1/auth/key` balance cleanly on build start and every `10` turns (or after `402`), syncing remaining credit limit into `Task 128` wind-down so builds wind down gracefully before hitting OpenRouter's hard credit cap!
- [ ] **Implement Graceful Ollama/LM Studio Server-Stopped Diagnosis:** If a previously configured local connection stops responding (`ECONNREFUSED`), pause cleanly with `"Ollama isn't running — Start Ollama and click Retry"` instead of burning retries!

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **User runs Ollama with `llama3.2:3b` (`num_ctx = 4096`, weak tool-calling) alongside `qwen2.5-coder:14b` (`num_ctx = 32768`, strong tools):** `LocalModelCapabilityProber` marks `qwen2.5-coder:14b` eligible for worker/coder roles and clearly flags `llama3.2:3b` as `"Context 4k too small for coding tasks (needs >= 16k)"` so builds don't mysteriously fail!
- **Two parallel workers on a 12 GB RTX 4070 laptop try to call `qwen2.5-coder:14b` AND `deepseek-r1:14b` simultaneously (which would force constant 9 GB VRAM thrashing!):** `LocalVramSlotManager` caps distinct loaded local models to `1` slot and batches same-model turns cleanly!
- **OpenRouter PKCE callback returns a credit-capped key with `$5.00` remaining limit:** `OpenRouterPkceOAuthFlow` verifies `/api/v1/auth/key`, displays `"$5.00 remaining on OpenRouter key"`, and binds it directly to `Task 128` wind-down!
- **User presses Dictation hotkey (`Task 157`) while `qwen2.5-coder:14b` is queued for its next local turn:** `LocalVramSlotManager` pauses the next local LLM dispatch cleanly so Whisper runs smoothly on the GPU!
- **Neither Ollama nor LM Studio is installed on the user's laptop:** `LocalModelAutoDiscoverer` completes both loopback probes in `< 300 ms` with zero console error spam and shows a clean optional `"No local servers detected (Ollama / LM Studio)"` state!
- **Ollama `num_ctx` defaults to `2048` unless explicitly passed in `options.num_ctx`:** Adapter explicitly passes appropriate `num_ctx` (`16384`/`32768`) per VRAM budget so Ollama doesn't silently truncate worker briefs at 2k tokens!
- **User cancels OpenRouter browser OAuth consent:** Loopback listener closes cleanly and cancels without leaving stale half-created connections in `global.db`!

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Strict Loopback Discovery Invariant:** Automatic local model discovery probes ONLY `127.0.0.1` / `localhost` with `<= 1,500 ms` timeouts.
- **Capability-Gated Local Role Invariant:** Local models failing the `>= 16k` context floor or tool/JSON probe are never blindly assigned as coding workers.
- **Explicit `num_ctx` Invariant:** Ollama requests always pass explicit `num_ctx` sized to brief + VRAM headroom so Ollama's 2k/4k default never silently truncates prompts.
- **VRAM Anti-Thrash Invariant:** `LocalVramSlotManager` prevents concurrent distinct local models from exceeding DXGI VRAM budget and yields to interactive Whisper dictation.
- **OpenRouter PKCE & Exact-Cost Invariant:** OpenRouter OAuth runs strictly in the system browser via PKCE `S256`, stores minted keys in DPAPI, and ingests provider-reported `usage.cost`.
- **Zero-False-Dollar Local Ledger Invariant:** Local model turns record `costMicroUsd = 0` and `currency = 'local_slots'` alongside real token and latency receipts.

### Task 139: GitHub Copilot OAuth Device Flow (`gitHubToken`, CLI Reuse, `account.getQuota`) & Cursor Browser Auth (`Cursor.auth.login()`, 90-Day Key & 7-Day Expiry Reminder)

- **Milestone & Track:** `M4 · GitHub Copilot & Cursor Subscription Auth`
- **Depends On:** `Task 001`, `Task 014`, `Task 120`, `Task 135`
- **Git Worktree & Branch:** `task/139-copilot-cursor-subscription-auth` in `../ef-wt/task-139-copilot-cursor-subscription-auth` (commit on own branch only; **NEVER merge**)
- **Owned Write Scope (Disjoint Subtree):** `packages/providers/src/copilot-cursor-auth/**`, `packages/providers/tests/copilot-cursor-auth/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-139.md`
- **Mandatory Reference Files:** [provider-connections.md](provider-connections.md#github-copilot-and-cursor), [agent-runtime-adapters.md](agent-runtime-adapters.md), [open-design-questions.md](open-design-questions.md), [schema/global.sql](schema/global.sql), [onboarding-providers-and-runtimes.mmd](onboarding-providers-and-runtimes.mmd), [research/provider-subscriptions.md](research/provider-subscriptions.md)
- **Shared Contracts Consumed / Produced:** Consumes `GlobalDbRepo.connections` (`Task 014`), `WindowsDpapiSecretsVault` (`Task 120`), `SignedProviderPolicyEngine` (`Task 135`); produces `GitHubCopilotDeviceAuthFlow`, `CopilotQuotaReader`, `CursorBrowserAuthFlow`, and `CursorKeyExpiryReminderScheduler`

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Implement GitHub Copilot OAuth Device Flow & Existing CLI Reuse (`GitHubCopilotDeviceAuthFlow`):** Support BOTH frictionless paths documented in [provider-connections.md](provider-connections.md):
  1. **Existing Copilot/GitHub CLI Auth Reuse (Zero Re-Login When Already Signed In!):** Detect active authenticated `copilot` / `gh` CLI status cleanly via official read-only CLI status probe (`--version` + auth check — NEVER scraping arbitrary private internal config files without official API!), offering `"Use your signed-in GitHub account (@username)"` in 1 click!
  2. **Official GitHub OAuth Device Flow (`gitHubToken`):** Initiate RFC 8628 Device Authorization Grant (`POST /login/device/code`), display the crisp 8-character user code + 1-click `"Copy code & Open github.com/login/device"` button, poll strictly respecting server `interval` and `slow_down` backoff (`+5 s`), store the resulting `gitHubToken` exclusively in Windows DPAPI (`Task 120`), and verify active Copilot seat eligibility!
- [ ] **Implement Official Copilot Quota Reader (`CopilotQuotaReader` via `account.getQuota`):** Query Copilot SDK's `account.getQuota()` cleanly on connection verify, build start, and periodic intervals to retrieve exact remaining **premium request allowance** (`entitlement`, `remaining`, `percentRemaining`, `resetDateUtc`, `overageEnabled`), surfacing exact honest quota bars in Settings/Top Bar AND feeding `Task 140` Allowance Pacing directly so Copilot users never burn through a whole month's premium requests on trivial Junior tasks!
- [ ] **Implement Copilot Plan-Aware Cost Weighting Hook:** Map Copilot premium request multipliers (`0x` included models vs `1x` standard vs `3x` premium reasoning models from `Task 135` policy!) into `Task 106`/`140` so `Balanced` and `Cheapest` presets use `0x`/`1x` models for routine tasks and save premium requests for complex Senior work!
- [ ] **Implement Cursor Browser Auth (`CursorBrowserAuthFlow` via `Cursor.auth.login()`):** Invoke the official Cursor SDK `Cursor.auth.login()` browser login flow cleanly (opening the user's real OS browser — zero password WebViews!), receive the official **90-day Cursor user API key**, persist it strictly in Windows DPAPI (`Task 120`) alongside exact `issuedAt` and `expiresAt = issuedAt + 90 days` metadata in `global.db.connections`, and validate via `Agent.getUsage()` / model probe!
- [ ] **Implement Proactive 7-Day Cursor Key Expiry Reminder (`CursorKeyExpiryReminderScheduler`):** Continuously check `expiresAt - now` on cold open (`Task 130`) and daily tick:
  - At **`<= 7 days` remaining:** Emit ONE calm non-blocking FYI/Account reminder card (`"Your Cursor key expires in 6 days — Refresh in 1 click"`), never nagging repeatedly once acknowledged until `<= 48 hours`!
  - At **`<= 0` (expired) or `401`:** Immediately park active Cursor dispatches cleanly, emit an `AccountCard` (`Task 127`) with 1-click `"Re-sign in with Cursor"`, and NEVER silently fall back to a paid API key (`Task 141`)!
- [ ] **Implement Multi-Account & Organization-Policy Transparency:** Handle GitHub Enterprise / Organization Copilot policies cleanly (e.g., if org disables certain models or blocks third-party OAuth apps, display the exact org-policy message cleanly rather than generic `403`!)!
- [ ] **Implement Copilot BYOK Compatibility Metadata:** Support Copilot SDK BYOK mode (when a developer brings their own OpenAI/Anthropic Console API key through Copilot runtime) clearly tagged as `billingMode: 'byok_api_key'` vs `billingMode: 'copilot_subscription'` so usage analytics (`Task 141`) never conflate subscription quota with API dollars!
- [ ] **Implement Clean Disconnect & Token Wipe:** Deleting or disconnecting Copilot or Cursor wipes DPAPI entries immediately and cancels any pending device-flow pollers cleanly!

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **GitHub Device Flow polling receives `slow_down` or `expired_token` (15 min elapsed before user completes browser confirmation):** Poller immediately increments poll interval by `+5 s` on `slow_down`, stops cleanly on `expired_token` with a 1-click `"Generate new code"` button, and never hammers GitHub's auth endpoint!
- **Copilot `account.getQuota()` reports `remaining: 0, overageEnabled: false`:** Immediately notifies `Task 140` Pacing + `Task 128` Checkpoint Stop Card (`"Copilot premium requests exhausted — resets on <date> · Switch to 0x included model / Switch Connection / Keep Parked"`)!
- **Copilot `account.getQuota()` reports `remaining: 0, overageEnabled: true` (pay-per-request overage billed to user's card!):** Treated strictly as a **paid transition** (`Task 141`!) — pauses cleanly and asks explicit user confirmation BEFORE incurring paid Copilot overage charges!
- **Cursor 90-day key reaches Day 84 (`6 days` left):** `CursorKeyExpiryReminderScheduler` emits exactly ONE calm reminder card; clicking `"Refresh now"` runs `Cursor.auth.login()` cleanly in-place, updating DPAPI + resetting `expiresAt` to `+90 days`!
- **User tries to log in with a GitHub account that has NO active Copilot subscription:** Seat verification catches `no_copilot_entitlement` immediately during onboarding and explains clearly rather than failing during Wave 1!
- **User clicks `Cancel` midway through GitHub Device Flow or Cursor Browser Auth:** Active poller / loopback handle aborts immediately with zero leaked timers or half-saved connections!
- **GitHub Enterprise org restricts `claude-sonnet` inside Copilot:** Connection stores exact allowed model subset from seat capabilities so `Task 106` roster never dispatches a disallowed model!

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Strict Device/Browser Official Auth Invariant:** Copilot uses official GitHub Device Flow / CLI reuse (`gitHubToken`) and Cursor uses official `Cursor.auth.login()` — zero credential scraping or password WebViews.
- **No-Silent-Copilot-Overage Invariant:** Transitioning from included Copilot quota (`remaining > 0`) into paid overage (`remaining === 0 && overageEnabled === true`) ALWAYS pauses for explicit user approval (`Task 141`).
- **Exact 7-Day Cursor Expiry Reminder Invariant:** Every 90-day Cursor key tracks `expiresAt` in `global.db` and surfaces a calm renewal reminder at `<= 7 days` remaining.
- **RFC 8628 Backoff Compliance Invariant:** Device flow strictly obeys `interval` and `+5 s` `slow_down` responses and stops cleanly on `expired_token` or cancel.
- **DPAPI-Only Token Persistence Invariant:** `gitHubToken` and Cursor 90-day keys reside strictly in Windows DPAPI (`Task 120`).
- **Honest Quota-vs-BYOK Tagging Invariant:** Copilot subscription quota vs BYOK API-key usage are strictly separated in connection metadata and analytics.

- **Strict Subtree Boundary:** Touch ONLY `packages/providers/src/copilot-cursor-auth/**`, `packages/providers/tests/copilot-cursor-auth/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-139.md`.

### Task 140: Global Broker Allowance Pacing Controller (Per-Connection AIMD Concurrency Start `2`/`+1`/`÷2`, Burn-Rate Target, Learned `k[model]`, `429` vs Usage-Limit Split & Optional Auto-Resume)

- **Milestone & Track:** `M4 · Intelligent Subscription & Rate-Limit Pacing`
- **Depends On:** `Task 001`, `Task 014`, `Task 023`, `Task 106`, `Task 128`, `Task 137`, `Task 139`
- **Git Worktree & Branch:** `task/140-broker-allowance-pacing-aimd` in `../ef-wt/task-140-broker-allowance-pacing-aimd` (commit on own branch only; **NEVER merge**)
- **Owned Write Scope (Disjoint Subtree):** `packages/providers/src/pacing/**`, `packages/providers/tests/pacing/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-140.md`
- **Mandatory Reference Files:** [provider-connections.md](provider-connections.md#allowance-pacing-and-rate-limits), [planning-and-crew.md](planning-and-crew.md), [schema/global.sql](schema/global.sql), [onboarding-providers-and-runtimes.mmd](onboarding-providers-and-runtimes.mmd), [research/provider-subscriptions.md](research/provider-subscriptions.md)
- **Shared Contracts Consumed / Produced:** Consumes `GlobalDbRepo.connection_windows` (`Task 014`), `BudgetLedger` (`Task 023`), `BudgetWindDownController` (`Task 128`), `SiwcDirectRequestAdapter` headers (`Task 137`), `CopilotQuotaReader` (`Task 139`); produces `AllowancePacingController`, `AimdConcurrencyRegulator`, `BurnRateWindowTracker`, `ModelAllowanceWeightLearner`, and `RateLimitVsUsageLimitClassifier`

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Implement Per-Connection AIMD Concurrency Regulator (`AimdConcurrencyRegulator`):** Manage active in-flight concurrency independently for EVERY connected account (`global.db.connection_windows`) using proven TCP-style Additive-Increase / Multiplicative-Decrease (AIMD) from [provider-connections.md](provider-connections.md):
  - **Start conservatively at `cwnd = 2`** (preventing sudden cold-start bursts from tripping provider anti-burst `429` limits on minute 1!)
  - **Additive Increase (`+1`):** Increment `cwnd` by `+1` ONLY after a clean sustained window of successful turns with zero `429`s (`>= 6` clean completions or `>= 60 s` clean window, strictly capped at `min(connectionMaxCap, hardwareCap)`!)
  - **Multiplicative Decrease (`÷ 2`):** On ANY transient HTTP `429` / RPM / TPM rate limit, immediately halve `cwnd = max(1, floor(cwnd / 2))`, honor `Retry-After` + jittered backoff cleanly, and enter a cool-down hold (`60 s`) before allowing additive increases again!
- [ ] **Implement Strict `429` (Transient Rate Limit) vs `Usage-Limit` (Allowance Window Exhausted) Classifier (`RateLimitVsUsageLimitClassifier`):** NEVER confuse a temporary 20-second RPM burst limit with a 5-hour/weekly plan-window exhaustion!
  - **Transient `429` (`RPM`/`TPM`/`concurrency`):** Halve AIMD `cwnd`, wait `Retry-After` (capped/jittered), show calm Board countdown (`Task 125`: `"Rate-limited · retrying in 0:28"`), and resume automatically without stopping the build!
  - **Hard `Usage-Limit` (`5-hour window exhausted`, `weekly cap reached`, `Copilot remaining === 0`, `OpenRouter credit === 0`):** Immediately set `cwnd = 0`, persist exact `reset_at` timestamp in `global.db.connection_windows`, trigger `Task 128` Checkpoint Stop Card (`Wait for Reset` / `Switch Connection` / `Keep Parked`) with **ZERO useless `429` retry storms**!
- [ ] **Implement Smooth Rolling Burn-Rate Target Controller (`BurnRateWindowTracker`):** Prevent a fast parallel wave on ChatGPT Plus / Copilot / Cursor from burning 100% of a 5-hour or weekly allowance in 22 minutes and stranding the developer locked out of their own chat UI for 4.5 hours!
  - Track actual rolling allowance consumption in integer **`ppm`** (`0..1_000_000`) across both **short window** (e.g., 5h ChatGPT rolling window) AND **long window** (e.g., 7-day weekly / monthly Copilot cap) stored in `global.db.connection_windows`!
  - Support user-configurable **Harness Allowance Reserve** (e.g., `"Keep 20% of my ChatGPT allowance free for my own chats"` → effective harness ceiling = `800_000 ppm`, wind-down triggers cleanly at `90%` of that ceiling = `720_000 ppm`!)
  - Smoothly throttle dispatch pacing whenever observed burn rate significantly outpaces the remaining window duration (`paced_concurrency` gently steps down before hitting a brick wall!)!
- [ ] **Implement Empirical Model Allowance Weight Learner (`ModelAllowanceWeightLearner` — `k[model]`):** Because subscription providers rarely publish exact dollar-to-window conversion formulas for every model tier (`gpt-5.x-mini` vs `gpt-5.x-pro`), maintain a learned relative weight `k[model]` (in `ppm` per `1k` effective tokens) per `(connectionId, modelId)` in `global.db`:
  - Seed conservatively from `Task 135` signed policy priors
  - Calibrate smoothly via bounded recursive least-squares / EMA whenever real provider quota endpoints (`account/rateLimits/read` `Task 144`, `account.getQuota` `Task 139`, or header remaining-percent deltas!) report observed window delta `Δppm`!
  - Feed calibrated `k[model]` directly back into `Task 106` (`ExpectedCostLevelSelector`) and `Task 108` (`PlanPreviewBuilder`) so `"~12% of 5h window"` predictions become razor-accurate over time!
- [ ] **Implement Optional Opt-In Auto-Resume At Reset (`AutoResumeScheduler`):** When a build pauses on `Wait for Reset` and the developer explicitly checks **`Auto-resume when allowance resets`** (OFF by default — never surprising the user while away unless opted in!), schedule a clean daemon wakeup timer at `reset_at + 15 s` jitter, verify connection health & zero pending conflicts/holds first, and smoothly restart at conservative `cwnd = 2`!
- [ ] **Implement Interactive Reservation Slot For User Steering & Discovery:** Always reserve capacity headroom (`1` lightweight priority slot) so user interactive Discovery, Canvas Q&A (`ask-owner-responder@1`), and steering router calls NEVER wait behind 8 background coding workers on a paced connection!
- [ ] **Implement Cross-Project Shared Window Accounting:** Persist ALL connection window state in `global.db.connection_windows` (not per-project `state.db`!) so two open EF Harness projects sharing the SAME ChatGPT Plus account coordinate cleanly against ONE shared 5-hour window (`Task 188` Global Broker)!
- [ ] **Implement Honest Pacing Status Telemetry:** Emit crisp live pacing metrics (`{ connectionId, cwnd, maxCwnd, windowUsedPpm, reserveCeilingPpm, resetAt, pacingState: 'normal' | 'burn_paced' | 'backoff_429' | 'window_exhausted' }`) for Top Bar, Board Health (`Task 125`), and Diagnostics (`Task 133`)!

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **ChatGPT Plus starts a 12-task parallel wave with `Reserve = 20%` (`ceiling = 800,000 ppm`):** Starts smoothly at `cwnd = 2`, ramps `2 → 3 → 4` cleanly while burn rate stays inside target, slows down cleanly as usage nears `720,000 ppm` (`90%` of allowed `80%`), finishes active tasks cleanly, and parks BEFORE touching the user's reserved `20%` (zero premature 5-hour lockout!)!
- **Provider returns `429` with body `"rate_limit_exceeded: try again in 15s"`:** Classifier marks `transient_429` → halves `cwnd` (`4 → 2`), waits `15 s + jitter`, resumes cleanly without stopping the build!
- **Provider returns `429` with body `"usage_limit_reached: 5-hour limit resets at 19:30 UTC"`:** Classifier marks `usage_limit_exhausted` → immediately sets `cwnd = 0`, saves `reset_at = 19:30 UTC`, stops retrying immediately, and opens `Task 128` Checkpoint Stop Card!
- **User opens Project A and Project B simultaneously, both using the same ChatGPT Plus account:** Both read/write the exact same `global.db.connection_windows` row via atomic transactions (`Task 024`), preventing 2× window overshoot!
- **Provider does not expose exact remaining-percent headers (opaque window):** `ModelAllowanceWeightLearner` conservatively uses policy `k[model]` priors + timestamps of observed `usage_limit_reached` resets to estimate burn accurately without dividing by zero or pretending false precision!
- **Opt-in `Auto-resume at reset` fires at `19:30:15 UTC`, but laptop disk dropped below `5 GB` in the meantime:** Pre-resume check catches `DiskHeadroomGuard` block cleanly and keeps build parked with Disk Card instead of blindly launching!
- **User sends a quick read-only question `"What's left?"` while 4 workers occupy all normal `cwnd` slots:** Interactive priority slot lets the tiny query run cleanly without waiting 3 minutes!

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Conservative AIMD Start & Halving Invariant:** Every connection starts at `cwnd = 2`, increments by at most `+1` per clean sustained interval, and immediately halves (`max(1, floor(cwnd / 2))`) on any `429`.
- **Zero-Retry-Storm On Usage-Limit Invariant:** Hard allowance/quota exhaustion sets `cwnd = 0` immediately and NEVER hammers the provider with repeated doomed requests.
- **User-Reserve Protection Invariant:** Configured personal allowance reserve (e.g., `20%`) is strictly protected by triggering `90%` wind-down before encroaching on the user's personal margin.
- **Global Shared-Window Invariant:** Allowance tracking lives exclusively in `global.db.connection_windows`, shared atomically across all open projects using that account.
- **Opt-In-Only Auto-Resume Invariant:** Auto-resume at reset defaults strictly OFF and runs pre-flight safety checks before restarting at `cwnd = 2`.
- **Interactive Priority Reservation Invariant:** User steering/discovery queries never starve behind background worker concurrency.

#### Multi-Agent Harmony And Branch Isolation

- **Worktree Setup:** Create branch `task/140-broker-allowance-pacing-aimd` via `node scripts/agent-worktree.mjs create 140 broker-allowance-pacing-aimd`.
- **Strict Subtree Boundary:** Touch ONLY `packages/providers/src/pacing/**`, `packages/providers/tests/pacing/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-140.md`.
- **Parallel Safe Execution:** Disjoint from `Tasks 135–139`, `Task 141`, and `Task 188`.
- **Handoff For `Task 107` (Scheduler Pacing Cap), `Task 125` (Throttled/Reset Health Signals), `Task 128` (90%/100% Wind-Down), `Task 152` (M4 ChatGPT Plus Kitchen Exit Gate), `Task 188` (Multi-Project Broker):** Export `AllowancePacingController`, `AimdConcurrencyRegulator`, `BurnRateWindowTracker`, `ModelAllowanceWeightLearner`, and `RateLimitVsUsageLimitClassifier` in `.agent-handoffs/task-140.md`.
- **Commit-Only Discipline:** Commit exclusively on `task/140-broker-allowance-pacing-aimd`; **NEVER merge** into `main` or `harness/integration`.
- **Discrete-Event Pacing Simulator:** Simulate a full 5-hour ChatGPT Plus window across 30 parallel tasks with realistic token spikes, transient `429`s, `k[model]` calibration convergence, and personal reserve protection!

#### Verification, Testing And Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Run `pnpm --filter @ef-harness/providers test -- pacing` verifying exact AIMD dynamics (`start 2`, `+1` after clean interval, `÷ 2` on `429`, cool-down guard) and interactive priority reservation.
- [ ] Verify `RateLimitVsUsageLimitClassifier` backs off smoothly on transient RPM/TPM `429` while setting `cwnd = 0` immediately with zero retry storms on hard 5h/weekly/Copilot usage limits.
- [ ] Verify `BurnRateWindowTracker` protects a configured `20%` user reserve (`800,000 ppm` ceiling), triggers `90%` wind-down smoothly, and shares one atomic `global.db.connection_windows` row across 2 simulated concurrent projects.
- [ ] Verify `ModelAllowanceWeightLearner` converges `k[model]` accurately against simulated quota telemetry and opt-in `AutoResumeScheduler` respects pre-flight safety checks and starts at `cwnd = 2`.
- [ ] Run `pnpm --filter @ef-harness/providers typecheck`, `lint`, and `node scripts/verify-harmony.mjs --task 140`.
- **Acceptance:** Global broker allowance pacing controller (AIMD, burn-rate smoothing, learned `k[model]`, `429` vs usage-limit split, and opt-in auto-resume) passes all tests on `task/140-broker-allowance-pacing-aimd`.

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **User's ChatGPT Plus hits 100% 5-hour window while user ALSO has an Anthropic Console API key connected (`default policy = No Silent Fallback`):** `NoSilentPaidFallbackGuard` BLOCKS routing onto Anthropic API completely (`FallbackBlockedNeedsConsentError`), parks cleanly, and displays `CheckpointStopCard` asking explicit approval!
- **User explicitly configured `"Allow fallback ChatGPT Plus → OpenRouter up to $2.00 cap"`:** Guard verifies explicit opt-in exists AND cumulative fallback spend `< $2.00`, permits bounded fallback cleanly, and HARD-STOPS at `$2.00`!
- **Local Ollama crashes while a paid OpenAI key is also connected:** Guard refuses silent fallback from free local Ollama to paid OpenAI (`FallbackBlockedNeedsConsentError`) and alerts `"Ollama stopped — Restart Ollama or explicitly switch to OpenAI"`!
- **A project name starts with `=CMD|' /C calc'!A0` and user clicks `Export CSV`:** `UsageReceiptsCsvExporter` neutralizes CSV formula injection cleanly (`"'=CMD|..."`) so opening the CSV in Excel is 100% safe!
- **Analytics view has 10,000 per-task receipts across 6 months:** Server-side paginated SQL queries against `telemetry.db` + virtualized receipt table load in `< 50 ms`!
- **User disconnects the ONLY active connection while a build is paused:** UI warns cleanly `"No active connections left — connect a provider before resuming"` without crashing or leaving orphan pointers!
- **User tries to assign both `Coding` and `Oracle Author` to the same single provider family when 2 families are connected:** UI displays a crisp helpful note `"Using a different model family for Oracles improves bug detection"` while still respecting user choice!

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Absolute No-Silent-Paid-Fallback Invariant:** Without an explicit user-configured capped fallback rule, NO free/local or subscription connection can EVER silently fail over to a paid API key or paid overage.
- **Separated-Currency Honesty Invariant:** API `micro-USD`, subscription `ppm` / Copilot premium requests, and local `$0` turns are NEVER merged into a misleading blended dollar figure.
- **Estimated-vs-Reported Transparency Invariant:** Every estimated API dollar figure is visually labeled `Estimated` with price-table version.
- **Compliance-Visible Onboarding Invariant:** Claude Code strictly asks for Console API key only, Gemini CLI defaults OFF behind explicit policy notice, and Antigravity is completely absent.
- **CSV Formula-Injection-Safe Invariant:** All exported CSV strings neutralize leading `=`, `+`, `-`, `@` spreadsheet triggers.
- **Zero-Raw-Secret UI Invariant:** Once saved to DPAPI, raw keys/tokens are never returned to or rendered by the renderer process.

### Task 142: Agent Runtime Adapter Core Interface, Normalized Event Bus & Deterministic Supervision Policy Engine

- **Milestone & Track:** `M4 · Foreign Agent Runtime Adapter Architecture`
- **Depends On:** `Task 001`, `Task 008`, `Task 041`, `Task 045`, `Task 049`, `Task 119`, `Task 135`
- **Git Worktree & Branch:** `task/142-runtime-adapter-core-supervision` in `../ef-wt/task-142-runtime-adapter-core-supervision` (commit on own branch only; **NEVER merge**)
- **Owned Write Scope (Disjoint Subtree):** `packages/runtime-adapters/src/core/**`, `packages/runtime-adapters/tests/core/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-142.md`
- **Mandatory Reference Files:** [agent-runtime-adapters.md](agent-runtime-adapters.md), [sandbox-and-security.md](sandbox-and-security.md), [provider-connections.md](provider-connections.md), [onboarding-providers-and-runtimes.mmd](onboarding-providers-and-runtimes.mmd), [onboarding-providers-and-runtimes.svg](onboarding-providers-and-runtimes.svg), [research/agent-control-protocols.md](research/agent-control-protocols.md)
- **Shared Contracts Consumed / Produced:** Consumes `WorkerEventSchema` (`Task 008`), `WindowsJobSupervisor` (`Task 041`), `SandboxTierSelector` (`Task 045`), `LeasedMcpServer` (`Task 049`), `SessionProcessCapGuard` (`Task 119`), `SignedProviderPolicyEngine` (`Task 135`); produces `AgentRuntimeAdapter` interface, `NormalizedRuntimeEventBus`, `DeterministicSupervisionPolicyEngine`, and `WrappedVsStrippedModeSelector`

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Define & Enforce The Exact 10-Method `AgentRuntimeAdapter` Contract (`packages/runtime-adapters/src/core/interface.ts`):** Every external coding-agent runtime (`ACP`, `Codex`, `Copilot`, `Cursor`, `Claude Code`, `Gemini CLI`, `OpenCode`) implements strictly one clean uniform contract from [agent-runtime-adapters.md](agent-runtime-adapters.md):
  1. `probe()` — binary/SDK detection, semver version, compliance/min-version check (`Task 135`), supported modes (`wrapped` | `stripped`)
  2. `authStatus()` — non-destructive credential/quota/expiry status (never scraping forbidden home directories!)
  3. `startSession(spec)` — launch inside assigned Windows Job Object (`Task 041`) + sandbox tier (`Task 045`) + worktree cwd + leased MCP (`Task 049`)
  4. `sendTurn(sessionId, briefOrPrompt)` — send compiled brief (`Task 088`) or follow-up turn
  5. `steer(sessionId, deltaNote)` — inject additive steering note mid-session cleanly
  6. `interrupt(sessionId)` — abort in-flight turn cleanly (`< 500 ms` graceful cancel → Job Object kill fallback)
  7. `resume(sessionId, checkpointRef)` — resume an existing native session ID or signal `unsupported_resume` for `Task 150` fresh-session fallback
  8. `events(sessionId)` — typed async stream emitting strictly `NormalizedRuntimeEvent` items!
  9. `respondPermission(sessionId, requestId, decision)` — synchronous deterministic allow/deny callback for tool/file/shell requests!
  10. `usage(sessionId)` — normalized token, cost (`micro-USD` / `ppm`), and quota metrics!
- [ ] **Implement Normalized Runtime Event Bus (`NormalizedRuntimeEventBus`):** Translate heterogeneous adapter streams (ACP JSON-RPC notifications, Codex app-server events, Claude `stream-json`, Copilot/Cursor SDK callbacks) into ONE canonical event taxonomy (`turn_started`, `assistant_delta`, `tool_call_requested`, `tool_call_started`, `tool_call_finished`, `file_edited`, `permission_requested`, `permission_decided`, `usage_reported`, `rate_limited`, `turn_completed`, `session_error`, `session_exited`) so Board Cockpit (`Task 124`), Health Signals (`Task 125`), Inspector (`Task 126`), Office View (`Task 163`), and Pacing (`Task 140`) behave identically whether a task runs on the native worker loop OR any foreign CLI!
- [ ] **Implement Deterministic Supervision Policy Engine (`DeterministicSupervisionPolicyEngine`):** Handle EVERY `permission_requested` callback from ANY foreign runtime purely in deterministic kernel code (`< 2 ms`, ZERO LLM arbitration!):
  - **Write / Edit / Delete File:** Allow ONLY if resolved canonical path (after symlink resolution + Windows case folding!) lies strictly inside the task's `write_scope[]` within the assigned worktree (and NOT in `.git/`, `.harness/`, `package-lock.json`/`pnpm-lock.yaml`, or sealed test/oracle paths!); DENY everything else with crisp reason!
  - **Read File:** Allow inside assigned worktree + permitted read-only repo files; UNCONDITIONALLY DENY `~/.ssh`, `~/.aws`, `~/.gnupg`, `~/.claude`, `~/.codex`, `~/.gemini`, `%APPDATA%`, host `state.db`/`global.db`, or symlink escapes outside worktree!
  - **Shell / Terminal Execution:** In `wrapped` mode, allow ONLY safe read/test/build commands inside the sandbox OR redirect through `harness.run` (`Task 048` / Pool 2 `Task 119`); UNCONDITIONALLY DENY network exfil (`curl`, `wget`, `Invoke-WebRequest`), privilege escalation (`runas`, `sudo`), destructive global git (`git push`, `git reset --hard`, `git checkout main`), `npm install`/`pnpm add` (must use `Task 048`/`110` intent!), or interactive TTY hang traps!
  - **Web / MCP Tool Call:** Allow ONLY leased EF Harness MCP tools (`kb.*`, `harness.run`, `harness.read_result`, `Task 049`); DENY built-in unproxied web fetch/search tools that bypass `Task 046` allowlist proxy!
- [ ] **Implement `Wrapped` (Default) vs `Stripped` Mode Selector (`WrappedVsStrippedModeSelector`):** Support BOTH execution postures documented in [agent-runtime-adapters.md](agent-runtime-adapters.md):
  - **`wrapped` (Default):** Let the foreign runtime keep its strong native file-editing/planning loop INSIDE our OS sandbox (`Task 042`–`045`) + loopback proxy (`Task 046`) + deterministic permission hook (`DeterministicSupervisionPolicyEngine`)!
  - **`stripped` (Fallback):** Disable the foreign CLI's built-in shell/FS/web tools completely and expose ONLY our kernel MCP tools (`harness.run`, scoped `fs`, `kb.*`), used automatically when a runtime's native hooks fail conformance (`Task 151`) or when tighter isolation is requested!
- [ ] **Implement Mandatory OS Sandbox Wrapping (Defense-In-Depth):** NEVER rely solely on a foreign CLI's polite `permission_requested` callback! Every foreign adapter process MUST STILL execute inside the selected OS Sandbox Tier (`Task 042`–`045`) + Windows Job Object (`Task 041`) + Loopback Allowlist Proxy (`Task 046`) so even a rogue or buggy CLI that ignores a `DENY` response is physically blocked by Windows ACLs/Job/Proxy!
- [ ] **Implement Adapter Registry & Trust-Level Enforcement:** Maintain live runtime trust states (`conformance_verified` | `observe_only` | `disabled`) driven by `Task 151` Conformance Suite + `Task 135` Signed Policy — refusing to assign coding tasks to `observe_only` or `disabled` adapters!
- [ ] **Implement Strict Environment Scrubbing Before Spawn:** Strip ALL unrelated host env vars (`OPENAI_API_KEY`, `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, `GITHUB_TOKEN`, `AWS_*`, `STRIPE_*`, etc.) from foreign CLI child environments, injecting ONLY the exact credential/proxy env explicitly authorized for THAT adapter session!
- [ ] **Implement Structured Redaction On All Foreign Adapter Streams:** Pass every raw stdout/stderr/event payload from foreign CLIs through `Task 011` `PacketSecurityRedactor` before emitting to IPC or `turn_log`!

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **Foreign CLI asks permission to edit `../../.git/hooks/pre-commit` or a symlink inside worktree pointing to `C:\Users\Ayush\.ssh\id_rsa`:** `DeterministicSupervisionPolicyEngine` resolves `fs.realpathSync` + canonical normalized path, detects worktree escape immediately, and responds `DENY` (and OS sandbox Tier B ACLs also block it physically!)!
- **Foreign CLI requests permission to run `pnpm add axios` directly in shell:** Policy engine responds `DENY: "Direct package installs are disabled; emit a DependencyIntent via harness MCP instead"`!
- **Foreign CLI crashes silently with exit code `137` / `0xC0000005` mid-turn:** Job Object monitor immediately emits normalized `session_exited(abnormal)`, terminates any orphaned grandchildren, and hands off cleanly to `Task 150` resume/recovery!
- **Foreign CLI hangs waiting for `respondPermission` while user clicks `STOP` (`Task 114`):** `interrupt()` immediately replies `DENY (user_stopped)` to all pending permission requests and tears down the Job Object cleanly within `< 500 ms`!
- **Foreign CLI passes mixed Windows casing (`SRC\Api\Orders.ts` vs `write_scope: ['src/api/orders.ts']`):** Policy engine applies canonical Windows case-insensitive path matching so valid edits aren't falsely denied while out-of-scope edits remain strictly blocked!
- **A buggy foreign CLI ignores a `DENY` permission response and still attempts `curl https://evil.com`:** Loopback Allowlist Proxy (`Task 046`) + Sandbox firewall physically blocks the connection and triggers automatic conformance downgrade (`Task 151`)!
- **Multiple foreign CLI adapters emit incompatible token-usage JSON shapes:** Normalized `usage()` maps all variants cleanly into exact `{ inputTokens, cachedInputTokens, outputTokens, reasoningTokens, costMicroUsd?, quotaUnits? }`!

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Defense-In-Depth Sandbox Invariant:** Permission callbacks are NEVER the sole security boundary; every foreign CLI runs inside an OS sandbox + Windows Job Object + loopback proxy.
- **Deterministic Zero-LLM Permission Invariant:** Every `respondPermission` decision runs deterministically in `< 2 ms` with symlink/realpath traversal checks.
- **Strict Env-Scrub Invariant:** Foreign CLI processes inherit zero unrelated host credentials or env secrets.
- **Uniform 10-Method Contract Invariant:** All foreign runtime adapters expose identical lifecycle, steering, permission, event, and usage semantics to the kernel.
- **Conformance-Gated Dispatch Invariant:** Only `conformance_verified` adapters can receive live coding tasks; failed adapters downgrade immediately to `observe_only`/`disabled`.
- **Zero-Orphan-Grandchild Invariant:** Every adapter session terminates inside its Windows Job Object leaving `0` stray subprocesses.

#### Multi-Agent Harmony And Branch Isolation

- **Worktree Setup:** Create branch `task/142-runtime-adapter-core-supervision` via `node scripts/agent-worktree.mjs create 142 runtime-adapter-core-supervision`.
- **Strict Subtree Boundary:** Touch ONLY `packages/runtime-adapters/src/core/**`, `packages/runtime-adapters/tests/core/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-142.md`.
- **Parallel Safe Execution:** Disjoint from `Tasks 143–151` (`packages/runtime-adapters/src/{acp,codex,copilot,cursor,claude-code,gemini-cli,opencode,resume,conformance}/**`).
- **Handoff For `Tasks 143–151` (All Specific Runtime Adapters, Resume Coordinator & Conformance Suite):** Export `AgentRuntimeAdapter`, `NormalizedRuntimeEventBus`, `DeterministicSupervisionPolicyEngine`, `WrappedVsStrippedModeSelector`, and `AdapterRegistry` in `.agent-handoffs/task-142.md`.
- **Commit-Only Discipline:** Commit exclusively on `task/142-runtime-adapter-core-supervision`; **NEVER merge** into `main` or `harness/integration`.
- **Path-Escape & Env-Scrub Adversarial Tests:** Test symlink escapes, `../` traversals, Windows case-folding, `.git/hooks` write blocks, `~/.ssh` read blocks, `pnpm add` blocks, env scrubbing, and clean `STOP` interrupt teardown!

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Implement Full JSON-RPC 2.0 Stdio ACP Transport (`AcpJsonRpcTransport`):** Implement clean newline-delimited JSON-RPC 2.0 over stdin/stdout (strictly segregating stderr into diagnostic logs so stderr warnings NEVER corrupt JSON-RPC framing!), enforcing message-size caps (`<= 8 MB`), monotonic request IDs, strict timeout guards, and clean `session/cancel` propagation!
- [ ] **Implement Complete ACP Lifecycle Handshake & Session Protocol (`GenericAcpAdapter`):**
  1. `initialize` — advertise EF Harness client capabilities (`fs: { readTextFile: true, writeTextFile: true }`, `terminal: true`, MCP support), negotiate protocol version, and verify server capability compatibility!
  2. `session/new` — create isolated session pinned to the assigned worktree `cwd`, attaching `Task 049`'s per-attempt leased MCP server endpoint (`mcpServers[]` carrying scoped bearer token!)
  3. `session/prompt` — submit compiled brief (`Task 088`) or follow-up prompt blocks and stream progress cleanly
  4. `session/update` — normalize incoming ACP notifications (`agent_message_chunk`, `agent_thought_chunk`, `tool_call`, `tool_call_update`, `plan`, `usage_update`) into `Task 142` `NormalizedRuntimeEventBus`!
  5. `session/request_permission` — route EVERY ACP permission request synchronously through `Task 142` `DeterministicSupervisionPolicyEngine` (`< 2 ms`) returning exact ACP `allow_once` / `reject_once` outcomes!
  6. `session/cancel` & `session/load` — implement clean cooperative turn cancellation (with Job Object timeout fallback) and native ACP session resume when advertised by the agent!
- [ ] **Implement Host-Served Sandboxed `fs/*` & `terminal/*` Bridge (`AcpHostFsAndTerminalBridge`):** When the ACP agent delegates filesystem or terminal capabilities to the client host:
  - `fs/read_text_file` & `fs/write_text_file`: Validate EVERY path strictly through `DeterministicSupervisionPolicyEngine` (`realpath` inside worktree + `write_scope[]`, UTF-8 atomic write, line-range slicing, byte cap `<= 4 MB`)!

- [ ] **Implement Per-Attempt Leased MCP Registration & Worktree-Local Skill Mounting (`AcpMcpAndSkillBinder`):**
  - Register `Task 049`'s ephemeral loopback MCP server (exposing `kb.*`, `harness.run`, `harness.read_result`) cleanly in `session/new` `mcpServers[]`
  - Stage the task's vetted `<= 2` skills (`Task 078`) strictly into the worktree's temporary hidden skill directory excluded via `.git/info/exclude` (NEVER touching `~/.config`, `~/.claude`, `~/.codex`, or `~/.gemini`!) and clean up mounted temp skill files before final candidate diff capture so skills NEVER accidentally appear in git diffs!
- [ ] **Implement Shared Reusable ACP Base For `Codex-ACP`, `Copilot-ACP`, `Cursor-ACP`, `Gemini-ACP`, and `OpenCode-ACP`:** Structure `GenericAcpAdapter` cleanly as a configurable base engine with per-runtime spawn hooks, capability quirks adapters, and env allowlists so `Tasks 144–149` share rock-solid battle-tested JSON-RPC / `fs/*` / `terminal/*` security without duplicating framing logic!
- [ ] **Implement Protocol Error & Desync Circuit Breaker:** Detect malformed JSON-RPC frames, unknown method floods, or unresponsive `initialize` (`> 15 s`), terminating the child Job Object cleanly and returning structured `AcpProtocolError`!
- [ ] **Implement Clean Cleanup Of Mounted Temp Files Before Candidate Commit:** Guarantee an explicit `cleanupEphemeralMounts()` hook strips worktree-staged skill/MCP helper files before `Task 054` `STATIC_AUDIT` and `Task 060` commit!
- [ ] **Implement Byte-Bounded Stdout/Stderr Ring Capture For Raw Stream Inspector (`Task 126`):** Forward redacted raw ACP wire summaries safely to `turn_log` (`Task 029`) for debugging without leaking credentials!

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **ACP agent prints a startup banner (`"Welcome to Agent v1.2!"`) onto stdout instead of stderr before JSON-RPC starts:** Framed parser detects non-JSON prefix safely on startup or logs `AcpFramingCorruptionError` cleanly instead of hanging silently forever!
- **ACP agent sends `fs/read_text_file` for `C:\Users\Ayush\.ssh\id_ed25519`:** `AcpHostFsAndTerminalBridge` validates against `DeterministicSupervisionPolicyEngine`, rejects with JSON-RPC `-32003 Permission Denied`, and logs a security event!
- **ACP agent calls `terminal/create` with `git push --force origin main`:** Bridge rejects immediately through `DeterministicSupervisionPolicyEngine` + `harness.run` policy before spawning any process!
- **ACP agent calls `terminal/create` with `vitest run` while Pool 2 (`Task 119`) is full (`2/2` slots busy):** Bridge queues cleanly on Pool 2 (emitting `waiting_run_slot` to Board!), runs inside sandboxed Job Object once leased, streams redacted output, and releases cleanly!
- **ACP agent leaves a mounted `.ef-skills/skill.md` file in worktree:** `.git/info/exclude` hides it from Git AND `cleanupEphemeralMounts()` removes it cleanly on session close so zero skill artifacts ever pollute diffs!
- **ACP agent sends `session/request_permission` while `interrupt()` is invoked concurrently:** Pending permission promise resolves immediately to `reject_once` (`cancelled`) while `session/cancel` fires cleanly!
- **ACP agent advertises `loadSession: false`:** `GenericAcpAdapter.resume()` returns `{ supported: false }` cleanly so `Task 150` switches seamlessly to fresh-session + labeled WIP resume!

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Host-Served Security Parity Invariant:** Every ACP `fs/*` and `terminal/*` request enforces the EXACT same write-scope, path-escape, Pool-2, Job-Object, and secret-redaction rules as native workers.

- **Scoped-MCP-Per-Attempt Invariant:** Attached MCP servers carry ephemeral per-attempt tokens revoked the instant the session exits.
- **Clean Cancel-Unblocks-Permissions Invariant:** `interrupt()` immediately rejects pending `session/request_permission` waits so sessions never deadlock on cancel.
- **Reusable Base Fidelity Invariant:** All ACP-backed runtimes (`Tasks 144–149`) inherit identical framing, permission, and terminal security guarantees.

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Implement Primary `codex app-server` JSON-RPC Client (`CodexAppServerClient`):** Launch official unmodified `codex app-server` over stdio inside Windows Job Object supervision (`Task 041`) implementing the native JSON-RPC protocol (`initialize`, `thread/start`, `turn/start`, `turn/interrupt`, `thread/resume`, item/delta streaming notifications, and deterministic command/file approval callbacks routed through `Task 142` `DeterministicSupervisionPolicyEngine`)!
- [ ] **Implement Automatic `codex-acp` Fallback Transport (`CodexAcpFallbackTransport`):** If `codex app-server` protocol fails version probe or is explicitly overridden in policy (`Task 135`), fall back cleanly onto `GenericAcpAdapter` (`Task 143`) driving `codex-acp` with identical normalized events and security invariants!
- [ ] **Implement Real `account/rateLimits/read` Quota & Pacing Bridge (`CodexRateLimitBridge`):** Call Codex `app-server`'s `account/rateLimits/read` method at session start and after every completed turn to obtain authoritative ChatGPT/Codex 5-hour primary window and 7-day secondary window percentages + exact reset timestamps — feeding real observed deltas straight into `Task 140`'s `BurnRateWindowTracker` and `ModelAllowanceWeightLearner` (`k[model]`)!
- [ ] **Implement Clean `ACCESS_TOKEN` Refresh Restart Strategy:** Because long-running `codex app-server` processes receive OAuth access tokens via process startup/auth injection (`OPENAI_API_KEY` or Sign in with ChatGPT access token from `Task 137` DPAPI vault — NEVER reading/mutating the user's personal `~/.codex/auth.json` without isolation via ephemeral `CODEX_HOME`!), monitor token expiry (`exp - now < 180 s`): gracefully wait for the current turn boundary, checkpoint `threadId`, cleanly restart `codex app-server` with the freshly refreshed token from `SiwcTokenRefresher` (`Task 137`), and immediately invoke **`thread/resume`** so long multi-hour builds NEVER crash on 1-hour OAuth access-token expiration!
- [ ] **Implement Ephemeral Isolated `CODEX_HOME` & Native Windows MXC Sandbox Alignment:** Launch every Codex attempt with an isolated per-attempt `CODEX_HOME` directory (staging ONLY approved config.toml + leased harness MCP server `Task 049` + vetted skills, zero leakage into user `~/.codex`!), configuring Codex's native Windows **Mixed-Mode / Restricted-Token (MXC) sandbox policy** (`workspace-write` scoped strictly to the attempt worktree + network disabled except loopback proxy `Task 046`) aligned cleanly with `Task 042` Tier A!
- [ ] **Implement Full `thread/resume` & Steering Support:** Persist Codex's canonical `threadId` in `attempt_checkpoints` (`Task 053`/`150`) so additive steering notes (`Task 115`) and post-refresh/post-pause resumes invoke native `thread/resume` seamlessly (falling back cleanly to fresh session + labeled WIP via `Task 150` on contradiction or resume failure)!
- [ ] **Implement Deterministic Approval Routing For File Patch & Shell Exec Proposals:** Intercept every Codex `item/fileChange/requestApproval` and `item/commandExecution/requestApproval`, verify target paths against `write_scope[]` and commands against `DeterministicSupervisionPolicyEngine`, approving safe in-scope steps in `< 2 ms` and denying escapes/pushes/installs deterministically!
- [ ] **Implement Strict `CliMinVersionGate` Check & Both Auth Modes:** Verify installed `codex --version` meets `Task 135` minimum safe version before starting, cleanly supporting BOTH **Sign in with ChatGPT** (`Task 137`) and **OpenAI API Key** (`Task 136`) connections with exact currency tagging (`ppm` vs `micro-USD`)!

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **An active Codex build runs past 60 minutes and its Sign in with ChatGPT `ACCESS_TOKEN` approaches expiry:** At `exp - 180 s`, adapter finishes the active turn cleanly, refreshes via `SiwcTokenRefresher`, spawns a fresh `codex app-server` with the new token, and calls `thread/resume(threadId)` — continuing seamlessly with zero lost context and zero `401` crash!
- **`account/rateLimits/read` reports primary 5h window reached `92%` (`>= 90%` wind-down ceiling):** `CodexRateLimitBridge` immediately feeds exact `920_000 ppm` to `Task 140`, triggering clean wind-down (`Task 128`) before hitting a hard `usage_limit_reached` error!
- **User already uses Codex CLI personally with custom `~/.codex/config.toml` and custom MCP servers:** Isolated per-attempt `CODEX_HOME` keeps the user's personal `~/.codex` 100% untouched AND prevents personal unvetted MCP servers from leaking into harness builds!
- **Codex proposes editing a file outside `write_scope[]` or running `git push`:** Approval callback responds `decline` in `< 2 ms`, and native MXC sandbox ACLs physically block writes outside the worktree as defense-in-depth!
- **User's machine has an outdated `codex` binary below `Task 135` `minVersion`:** `probe()` reports `status: 'version_too_old'` with exact required version cleanly before any task launches!
- **`codex app-server` exits unexpectedly mid-turn (exit code `1`):** Job Object reaps any stray child processes, preserves worktree WIP diff, and hands off cleanly to `Task 150` (`thread/resume` or fresh-session fallback)!
- **Codex elevates/requests full host network (`danger-full-access`):** Policy strictly FORBIDS elevated/unrestricted sandbox flags (`danger-full-access`, `--yolo`, `approval-policy: never` outside controlled deterministic approval handler)!

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Zero-Personal-`~/.codex`-Mutation Invariant:** Every Codex run executes under an isolated ephemeral `CODEX_HOME` leaving the developer's `~/.codex` completely untouched.
- **Zero-Unrestricted-Sandbox Invariant:** Codex NEVER launches with `danger-full-access` or unapproved bypass flags; MXC `workspace-write` + deterministic approval callbacks are mandatory.
- **Seamless Token-Refresh-Plus-`thread/resume` Invariant:** Expiring OAuth access tokens rotate cleanly at turn boundaries via restart + `thread/resume` without crashing multi-hour tasks.
- **Authoritative Quota Feed Invariant:** `account/rateLimits/read` feeds exact window percentages and reset timestamps into `Task 140` after every turn.
- **No-Silent-Paid-Switch Invariant:** ChatGPT-backed Codex sessions never silently switch to an OpenAI API key when quota runs out (`Task 141`).
- **Dual-Transport Resilience Invariant:** Both `codex app-server` primary and `codex-acp` fallback satisfy the exact same `AgentRuntimeAdapter` contract and conformance tests (`Task 151`).

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Support `Wrapped` (Default) + `Stripped` Fallback & Copilot ACP Mode (`CopilotAcpFallbackAdapter`):**
  - **`wrapped` (Default):** Keep Copilot's built-in editing/coding tools enabled strictly under our SDK `onPermissionRequest` deterministic handler (`Task 142`) + OS sandbox + leased EF Harness MCP server (`kb.*`, `harness.run`, `harness.read_result`)!
  - **`stripped` (Fallback):** Disable Copilot's built-in shell/web tools (`excludedTools` / strict deny in `onPermissionRequest`) forcing tool calls strictly through EF Harness's sandboxed MCP tools whenever conformance or policy selects stripped posture!

  - Read exact turn-level token & request metrics via **`session.usage.getMetrics()`** after every completed turn and normalize into `Task 142` `usage()`!
  - Poll **`account.getQuota()`** (`Task 139`) on session start and post-turn intervals to update remaining Copilot premium request allowance (`remaining`, `resetDateUtc`, `overageEnabled`) in `global.db.connection_windows` (`Task 140`)!
  - **Enforce Hard Paid-Overage Stop Guard (`Task 139`/`141`):** If `remaining` hits `0` and `overageEnabled === true`, immediately pause cleanly BEFORE sending another request that would trigger paid per-request billing on the user's card!
- [ ] **Implement First-Class BYOK (Bring Your Own Key) Support:** Support Copilot SDK's official BYOK configuration (routing a Copilot SDK session through the user's connected Anthropic Console / OpenAI / custom endpoint key from `Task 136` DPAPI vault!), tagging all usage receipts cleanly as `billingMode: 'byok_api_key'` (`micro-USD` estimated via `Task 136` price table) instead of Copilot subscription quota!
- [ ] **Implement Isolated Per-Attempt Copilot Config & Skill Mounting:** Mount vetted task skills (`Task 078`) strictly inside the worktree's `.git/info/exclude`-protected directory and clean up before diff verification — zero writes into user home `~/.copilot` or `~/.config/github-copilot`!
- [ ] **Implement Clean Session Persistence & Resume:** Store Copilot's session ID in `attempt_checkpoints` so additive steering & pauses resume natively when supported (falling back cleanly to `Task 150` fresh session on contradiction or unsupported resume)!
- [ ] **Implement Organization-Restricted Model Discovery:** Query available Copilot models for the user's actual GitHub seat/org during `probe()` / `authStatus()` so disabled org models are excluded cleanly from `Task 106` roster selection!

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **Copilot `account.getQuota()` drops from `1` remaining premium request to `0` (`overageEnabled: true`) right after Turn 4:** `CopilotMetricsAndQuotaTracker` intercepts `remaining === 0` BEFORE Turn 5 dispatches, sets `cwnd = 0`, and opens `CheckpointStopCard` asking explicit approval before incurring overage charges!
- **Copilot proposes running `gh pr create` or `git push` via its built-in shell tool during a build task:** `onPermissionRequest` responds `deny` deterministically in `< 2 ms` (all pushes/PRs belong strictly to `Task 178` Ship phase with Approval Cards!)!
- **Copilot SDK returns a partial `session.usage.getMetrics()` payload on an interrupted turn:** Adapter safely defaults missing optional fields to `0`, tags `partial_interrupted: true`, and never throws `TypeError` on shutdown!
- **User runs Copilot in BYOK mode using their Anthropic Console API key:** Usage analytics record `micro-USD` against the Anthropic connection (zero deduction from Copilot premium quota!) and obey Anthropic Console compliance locks (`Task 135`)!
- **Copilot CLI/SDK updates and breaks `excludedTools` flag in stripped mode:** `Task 151` Conformance Suite detects the version bump, tests stripped enforcement, and safely downgrades if broken!
- **GitHub token expires or is revoked on github.com (`401 Bad credentials`):** Adapter parks active builds cleanly, surfaces ONE `AccountCard` (`"Re-authenticate GitHub Copilot"`), and NEVER silently switches to another paid connection (`Task 141`)!
- **Copilot session spawns a hung `vitest --watch` child process:** `interrupt()` terminates the entire Windows Job Object (`Task 041`) cleanly with `0` lingering node processes!

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Zero-Silent-Overage Invariant:** Copilot sessions NEVER silently cross from `remaining > 0` included quota into paid overage without explicit user consent.
- **Deterministic `onPermissionRequest` Invariant:** Every Copilot file/shell/tool request passes through `DeterministicSupervisionPolicyEngine` plus OS sandbox defense-in-depth.
- **Authoritative Metrics & Quota Invariant:** Turn receipts pull from `session.usage.getMetrics()` and quota pacing pulls from `account.getQuota()`.
- **Clean BYOK-vs-Subscription Separation Invariant:** BYOK turns bill to their underlying API connection's `micro-USD` ledger and never corrupt Copilot subscription quota accounting.
- **Zero-Home-Config-Pollution Invariant:** Personal `~/.copilot` / `~/.config/github-copilot` directories are never modified by harness runs.
- **Zero-Git-Push-During-Build Invariant:** Copilot coding workers are strictly blocked from pushing branches or opening PRs directly.

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Enforce Immutable Anthropic Console API Key ONLY Compliance (`ClaudeConsoleKeyComplianceEnforcer`):** Enforce the strict owner compliance rule from [open-design-questions.md](open-design-questions.md) and `Task 135`:
  - **REQUIRE** a validated Anthropic Console API key (`sk-ant-api...`) fetched from Windows DPAPI (`Task 120`/`136`), injected strictly via `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` inside the scrubbed child env (or via loopback proxy auth injection so even the child process never sees the raw key when proxy-routed!)
  - **UNCONDITIONALLY REFUSE** Claude consumer subscription OAuth tokens (`sk-ant-oat*`), `claude setup-token`, `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN`, or reading/inheriting `~/.claude/.credentials.json`!
  - Isolate EVERY Claude Code launch with an ephemeral per-attempt **`CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`** (and `--setting-sources project` / isolated empty settings!) so the child `claude` binary **CANNOT accidentally fall back to a developer's personal Claude Pro/Max OAuth login sitting in `~/.claude`**!
- [ ] **Implement Structured Bidirectional Headless Streaming (`ClaudeStreamJsonTransport`):** Launch official unmodified `claude -p --output-format stream-json --input-format stream-json --verbose` inside Windows Job Object (`Task 041`) + OS sandbox (`Task 045`), parsing every newline-delimited JSON event (`system/init`, `assistant`, `tool_use`, `tool_result`, `result` with authoritative `total_cost_usd` & `usage`, `session_id`) into `Task 142` `NormalizedRuntimeEventBus` and sending steering/follow-up turns cleanly via structured `stream-json` stdin!
- [ ] **Implement Deterministic Stdio Permission Prompt Tool (`ClaudeStdioPermissionController` via `--permission-prompt-tool stdio`):** Wire `--permission-prompt-tool stdio` directly to `Task 142` `DeterministicSupervisionPolicyEngine`:
  - Receive structured tool permission prompts over the stdio control channel (`Edit`, `Write`, `Bash`, `Read`, `Glob`, `Grep`, `WebFetch`, `MCP`)
  - Validate strictly in `< 2 ms` pure code (`write_scope[]`, symlink realpath containment, blocked `~/.ssh`/`~/.claude`, blocked `git push`/`pnpm add`/`curl`, blocked unproxied `WebFetch`), returning deterministic `{ behavior: 'allow', updatedInput? }` or `{ behavior: 'deny', message }` responses!
  - **NEVER pass `--dangerously-skip-permissions`** under any circumstance!
- [ ] **Enforce Hard Per-Attempt Dollar Ceiling Via `--max-budget-usd`:** Pass exact calculated per-attempt dollar ceiling directly on CLI (`--max-budget-usd <allocated_task_budget>`) derived from `Task 023` `BudgetLedger` reservation as a secondary defense-in-depth cap preventing runaway tool loops from overspending the user's Anthropic Console API balance!
- [ ] **Support `Wrapped` (Default) & `Stripped` Modes + Leased Harness MCP (`--mcp-config`):**
  - **`wrapped` (Default):** Keep Claude Code's native `Read`/`Edit`/`Write`/`Bash` guarded by `--permission-prompt-tool stdio` + OS sandbox + `--strict-mcp-config --mcp-config <ephemeral_harness_mcp.json>` (strictly preventing unapproved personal MCP servers from loading!)
  - **`stripped` (Fallback):** Pass `--disallowedTools Bash,WebFetch,WebSearch,Edit,Write` forcing ALL actions exclusively through EF Harness's leased MCP tools (`harness.run`, scoped file tools, `kb.*`)!
- [ ] **Implement Native Session Resume (`--resume <session_id>`) & Exact Cost Ingestion:** Persist `session_id` returned by `system/init` / `result` in `attempt_checkpoints` (`Task 150`) for clean additive steering resumes; ingest Claude's reported `usage` (`input_tokens`, `cache_read_input_tokens`, `cache_creation_input_tokens`, `output_tokens`) and cross-check against `Task 136`'s integer `micro-USD` price table (`BudgetLedger`)!
- [ ] **Implement Worktree-Local Skill Injection Without Touching `~/.claude`:** Mount vetted `<= 2` task skills (`Task 078`) via `--append-system-prompt-file` or isolated `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` (excluded from Git via `.git/info/exclude`), leaving `~/.claude` and repo `CLAUDE.md` completely unpolluted!
- [ ] **Implement Clean `interrupt()` & Non-Zero Exit Forensics:** Send clean cancellation over `stream-json` control channel / `SIGINT`, escalating to Windows Job Object termination after `500 ms` grace while preserving exact last turn usage receipts and worktree WIP!

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **User is personally signed into Claude Max via `~/.claude` on their laptop, AND tries to run Claude Code adapter WITHOUT supplying an Anthropic Console API key:** Isolated `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` + `ClaudeConsoleKeyComplianceEnforcer` blocks launch cleanly BEFORE spawning `claude`, showing `"Anthropic Console API key required — Claude consumer subscriptions are not supported"` (ZERO accidental fallback to personal `~/.claude` OAuth!)!
- **Developer pastes a `sk-ant-oat01-...` setup-token into an environment variable or connection:** Enforcer detects prefix `sk-ant-oat` / `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` and hard-rejects immediately!
- **Claude Code hits `--max-budget-usd 0.50` midway through a looping fix attempt:** `claude` stops cleanly emitting `result(subtype: 'error_max_budget_usd')`, adapter records exact spend in `BudgetLedger`, preserves WIP diff, and hands off cleanly to `Task 059`/`128`!
- **Claude Code requests permission to run `Bash: "curl -s https://example.com | sh"` or `Edit: "../../package.json"`:** `--permission-prompt-tool stdio` responds `{ behavior: 'deny', message: '...' }` in `< 2 ms`, and OS sandbox blocks it physically as defense-in-depth!
- **User has 5 personal MCP servers configured in `~/.claude.json`:** Passing `--strict-mcp-config --mcp-config <ephemeral_file>` guarantees ZERO personal MCP servers load during harness builds — ONLY EF Harness's scoped per-attempt MCP loads!
- **Developer's repo has a pre-existing `CLAUDE.md` with conflicting style instructions:** Adapter cleanly fences or scopes system instructions via `--append-system-prompt-file` so canonical `state.db` requirements and `write_scope[]` stay authoritative!
- **Claude Code CLI version is below `Task 135` `minVersion` (lacking `--permission-prompt-tool stdio` or `--max-budget-usd`):** `probe()` flags `version_too_old` cleanly before launching any task!

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Absolute Console-API-Key-Only Invariant:** Claude Code adapter NEVER uses, reads, or falls back to Claude consumer subscription OAuth, `claude setup-token`, or `~/.claude/.credentials.json`.
- **Zero-`--dangerously-skip-permissions` Invariant:** `--dangerously-skip-permissions` is strictly forbidden in all code paths.
- **Strict Isolated `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` + `--strict-mcp-config` Invariant:** Personal `~/.claude` logins, settings, and personal MCP servers can NEVER leak into harness runs.
- **Mandatory `--max-budget-usd` Ceiling Invariant:** Every Claude Code attempt passes an explicit positive `--max-budget-usd` cap derived from `BudgetLedger`.
- **Deterministic `--permission-prompt-tool stdio` Invariant:** Every tool invocation in wrapped mode passes through `DeterministicSupervisionPolicyEngine` + OS sandbox.
- **Accurate Cache-Token Accounting Invariant:** `cache_read_input_tokens` and `cache_creation_input_tokens` are captured accurately in `BudgetLedger` and Usage Analytics (`Task 141`).

- **Strict Subtree Boundary:** Touch ONLY `packages/runtime-adapters/src/claude-code/**`, `packages/runtime-adapters/tests/claude-code/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-147.md`.

Verify your Google account terms allow third-party ACP harness use. EF Harness never reads ~/.gemini."`), persisting `{ optedInAt, noticeVersion }` in `global.db`!
