- **Shared Contracts Consumed / Produced:** Consumes `TiledFloorPlanLoader` walkable grid (`Task 162`), `OfficeCastProjector` (`Task 163`); produces `TruthfulAnimationDirector`, `AStarTilePathfinder`, `BurstCollapseEventQueue`, and `OfficeFrameBudgetMonitor`

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Implement Strict Truthful Animation Director (`TruthfulAnimationDirector`):** Enforce EVERY single truthfulness law from [office-view.md](office-view.md) so cute animations NEVER lag behind reality, lie about task status, or waste CPU:
  1. **Per-Character Bounded Action Queue:** Each active agent owns an isolated lightweight motion queue (`maxQueueLen = 2`) independent of all other characters so one character walking to QA Lab NEVER delays another character!
  2. **Burst Collapse (`BurstCollapseEventQueue`):** If a fast task transitions `Queued → Working → Verifying → Integrating → Done` within `400 ms`, collapse intermediate redundant waypoints immediately — keeping ONLY the **latest authoritative target destination** (NEVER making a character walk through 4 obsolete rooms 15 seconds after the task already merged!)!
  3. **State-Beats-Motion Law:** Live semantic status (overhead icons, health signals `Stuck`/`Loop`/`Held`/`Waiting on You`, desk pin, tag badge, hover status line) updates **INSTANTANEOUSLY ON FRAME 0 (`0 ms` lag!)** — NEVER waiting for a walk animation to finish before showing that a worker failed, paused, or needs your answer!
  4. **`<= 2 s` Lag Teleport / Fast-Snap Guarantee:** Track exact wall-clock lag `now - latestStateTimestamp` per character; if any walk path would take `> 2.0 seconds` behind live state (or after tab-restore / wake from sleep / burst jump!), immediately **fast-snap / cozy poof-teleport** the character straight to its exact truthful room desk so Office View is NEVER more than `2 seconds` behind real `state.db` truth!
  5. **`1 s` Minimum Dwell Smoothing:** When a character legitimately arrives at a station (`QA Lab` Test Rig, `Merge Bay`, `Break Room`) and isn't superseded by an urgent state change, hold a calm `1.0 s` minimum dwell before starting a minor cosmetic stroll (preventing jittery back-and-forth pacing on rapid step oscillations while STILL updating overhead status icons instantaneously!)!
  6. **Instant Status Icons Always Independent Of Walk State:** Error/Hold/Question/Checkmark icons swap immediately on the character's head even mid-walk!
- [ ] **Implement Fast Tile-Grid A* Pathfinding (`AStarTilePathfinder`):** Run deterministic 4-way/8-way corner-safe A* pathfinding over the `TiledFloorPlanLoader` walkable grid (`Task 162`, `~60 × 40` tiles, pre-baked room-doorway waypoint cache!) completing any room-to-room path query in **`< 0.3 ms`** with simple local character separation (gentle tile offset so two agents walking down a hallway don't stack invisibly onto identical pixels!)!
- [ ] **Implement Strict `60 fps` Active / `< 5%` Idle CPU / `0%` Hidden Performance Budget (`OfficeFrameBudgetMonitor`):**
  - While Office View is actively visible with moving characters: target crisp `60 fps` (`<= 8 ms` JS frame time per tick) using object-pooled sprites and dirty-flag transforms (only updating sprites that actually moved or changed frame!)
  - When characters are seated/idle (minimal subtle typing/lamp ambient ticks): drop to throttled `12–15 fps` ambient cadence holding CPU usage strictly **`< 5%` on a standard laptop**!
  - When Office View tab is inactive, window minimized, or reduced-motion active: `0` animation ticks (`0%` CPU)!
- [ ] **Implement Smooth Paper-Delivery & Parcel Courier Micro-Animations (v2 Polish):** When an agent submits a question to the CEO Desk or hands verified code to the QA Lab / Merge Bay, animate a tiny crisp paper/box transfer along the A* corridor (strictly subject to the exact same `Burst Collapse` + `<= 2 s` lag snap + `State-Beats-Motion` rules — the Inbox card itself appears in the Left Rail at `t = 0 ms` unconditionally!)!

- [ ] **Implement Deterministic Virtual-Clock Simulation Support:** Drive all Director updates strictly from an injected `dtMs` / `nowMs` clock parameter so unit tests prove exact `<= 2.0 s` teleport, `1.0 s` dwell, burst collapse, and `0 ms` icon updates deterministically in `< 50 ms`!
- [ ] **Implement Path-Blocked Graceful Teleport Fallback:** If an unexpected floorplan prop or dynamic desk blocks A*, return `no_path` cleanly in `< 0.5 ms` and snap directly to target desk (never infinite-looping A*!)!
- [ ] **Implement Live FPS & Lag Telemetry Export:** Expose `{ currentFps, avgTickMs, maxVisualLagMs, activeWalkersCount }` to `Task 133` Diagnostics and `Task 175` M5 Office Truthfulness Gate!

### Task 165: Office View Accessibility & Auto-Fallback (Reduced-Motion Seated Icons-Only, Orange-Pressure Auto-Board Switch, Logical Tab Order, Screen-Reader Mirror, 30+ Hot-Desk Counter & Optional Chimes)

- **Milestone & Track:** `M5 · Inclusive Accessible Office View & Hardware Auto-Fallback`
- **Depends On:** `Task 001`, `Task 118`, `Task 123`, `Task 124`, `Task 162`, `Task 163`, `Task 164`
- **Git Worktree & Branch:** `task/165-office-a11y-auto-fallback` in `../ef-wt/task-165-office-a11y-auto-fallback` (commit on own branch only; **NEVER merge**)
- **Owned Write Scope (Disjoint Subtree):** `apps/renderer/src/office/a11y/**`, `apps/renderer/tests/office-a11y/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-165.md`
- **Mandatory Reference Files:** [office-view.md](office-view.md#accessibility-and-fallback), [app-shell-and-governor.md](app-shell-and-governor.md), [open-design-questions.md](open-design-questions.md), [cockpit-and-office.mmd](cockpit-and-office.mmd), [research/office-view-prior-art.md](research/office-view-prior-art.md)
- **Shared Contracts Consumed / Produced:** Consumes `PressureHysteresisStateMachine` (`Task 118`), `PhaseLayoutPresetManager` (`Task 123`), `BoardCockpitView` (`Task 124`), `TruthfulAnimationDirector` (`Task 164`); produces `OfficeReducedMotionAdapter`, `OrangePressureAutoBoardFallback`, `OfficeSemanticMirrorTree`, `HotDeskOverflowAggregator`, and `OptionalSoftChimesController`

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Implement `prefers-reduced-motion` Seated Icons-Only Mode (`OfficeReducedMotionAdapter`):** Respect BOTH Windows OS `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` media query AND an explicit in-app `"Reduced motion / Static Office"` toggle:
  - Disable ALL character walking, bouncing, pulsing, and floating parcel animations immediately (`0` continuous motion!)
  - Render characters calmly **seated directly at their exact truthful room desks** with crisp static status icons, `AgentID · short title` tags, and connection pins — OR default cleanly to **Board View** (`Task 124`) on first build per `Task 123` preset while still allowing the user to view Static Office anytime!
- [ ] **Implement Hardware Governor `Orange`/`Red` Automatic Board Fallback (`OrangePressureAutoBoardFallback`):** Subscribe directly to `Task 118`'s `PressureHysteresisStateMachine`:
  - The instant pressure transitions to **`ORANGE` or `RED`** while Office View is active, smoothly switch the center tab to lightweight **`Board View`** (`Task 124`), stop the PixiJS ticker completely (`0%` GPU/CPU!), and display a calm non-blocking banner: `"Switched to Board view to keep your laptop responsive (RAM pressure) · Switch back to Office when ready"`!
  - Because `Task 118` already enforces `10 s` enter / `30 s` recover hysteresis, this auto-fallback NEVER flickers back and forth rapidly!
  - When pressure recovers cleanly back to `GREEN`, offer a gentle `"Switch back to Office"` button (never forcibly yanking the user back off Board if they started using Board!)!
- [ ] **Implement Parallel Logical Keyboard Tab Order & Screen-Reader Semantic Mirror (`OfficeSemanticMirrorTree`):** Because an HTML `<canvas>` is opaque to screen readers and keyboard `Tab` focus, maintain a lightweight synchronized **semantic DOM mirror** (`role="region" aria-label="Office View"`) strictly mirroring visible rooms and active agents in **logical operational order**:
  - `CEO Office (N inbox items)` → `Waiting on You / Flagged Workers` → `Engineering Bullpen (grouped by Feature)` → `QA Lab (Pool 2 Test Rigs)` → `Merge Bay` → `Shipping Dock` → `Break Room`!
  - Pressing `Tab` / arrow keys moves a crisp visible high-contrast focus ring directly onto the matching character on the PixiJS canvas AND scrolls/pans the camera gently to keep the focused character in view!
  - Pressing `Enter` / `Space` opens `WorkerInspectorPanel` (`Task 126`) or Inbox identically to mouse click!
  - Announce critical transitions cleanly via debounced `aria-live="polite"` (e.g., `"Feature Orders moved to Merge Bay"`, `"1 decision needs your input"` — strictly debounced so 20 workers never flood a screen reader!)!
- [ ] **Implement `30+` Worker Hot-Desk Overflow Counter (`HotDeskOverflowAggregator`):** When a massive wave or multi-project view exceeds the 24–30 fixed desks in `Engineering Bullpen`, keep the top priority active/flagged/critical-path workers visibly seated at desks (`<= 28` visible characters) and aggregate overflow queued/background workers cleanly onto the **Hot-Desk Overflow Counter** (`"+12 more agents working in background — View all on Board"`) so sprites NEVER overlap off-map or break frame budgets!
- [ ] **Implement Strictly Opt-In Soft Audio Chimes (`OptionalSoftChimesController` — OFF By Default!):** Provide a strictly **OFF-by-default** Settings toggle (`"Play gentle soft chimes for completed features & needs-you cards"`) with subtle volume slider, Focus Mode auto-mute (`Task 127`), and short cozy non-jarring Web Audio synthesis/OGG cues (`feature_done`, `needs_you`, `build_complete`) — ZERO audio ever plays unless explicitly enabled by the user!
- [ ] **Implement High-Contrast Windows Accessibility Mode Compatibility:** Detect Windows `forced-colors: active` / High Contrast mode and automatically boost pixel tag borders, status icon contrast, and focus rings (or recommend Board View cleanly)!
- [ ] **Implement Instant One-Key `Office ↔ Board` Toggle (`V` Shortcut):** Allow effortless instant switching between `Office` and `Board` preserving exact selected worker / Inspector focus seamlessly across both views!
- [ ] **Implement Zero-Visual-Trap Focus Management:** Ensure keyboard users can effortlessly tab INTO the Office semantic mirror, traverse rooms/workers, and tab cleanly OUT to the Right Inspector or Composer without ever getting trapped!

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **Windows user has `Settings → Accessibility → Animation effects: OFF` (`prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`):** Office immediately disables all walking/bouncing animations (static seated desks + crisp icons only!) and defaults Build Phase smoothly to Board View without requiring manual setup!
- **Laptop RAM hits `ORANGE` for 10 seconds during a big Playwright run while user is watching Office View:** `OrangePressureAutoBoardFallback` stops PixiJS immediately (`0%` GPU), switches cleanly to Board View, and shows the calm explanation banner (and stays stably on Board thanks to `Task 118` 30s hysteresis!)!
- **50 tasks run in a giant synthetic stress wave (`> 30` active/queued workers):** `HotDeskOverflowAggregator` seats the 28 highest-priority/flagged workers cleanly at Bullpen desks and shows `"+22 more agents — Open Board"` with zero off-map sprites or frame drops!
- **Screen-reader user (`NVDA` / `Narrator`) opens Office View:** Semantic DOM mirror exposes exact rooms, `A0014 · print page — Running vitest`, and `Enter` opens Worker Inspector seamlessly while `aria-live` never spams rapid frame ticks!
- **User enabled Soft Chimes, then turned on `Focus Mode` (`Ctrl+.`):** `OptionalSoftChimesController` immediately mutes all chimes while Focus Mode is active!
- **User presses `V` while `A0014 · print page` is selected in Office View:** Switches cleanly to `Board View` with `A0014 · print page` highlighted and `WorkerInspectorPanel` uninterrupted!
- **User manually switches back to Office while Governor is STILL in `ORANGE`:** Allows explicit user override (`userOverrodeOrangeFallback = true`) with a tiny subtle `"High RAM pressure"` tooltip while capping Office to static reduced-motion mode to keep laptop responsive!

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Strict Reduced-Motion Respect Invariant:** When `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` or user toggle is enabled, `0` continuous character/parcel animations execute.
- **Automatic `Orange`/`Red` Board Fallback Invariant:** Sustained Governor `Orange`/`Red` automatically stops PixiJS and switches cleanly to Board View (unless user explicitly overrides).
- **100% Keyboard & Screen-Reader Parity Invariant:** Every interactive room, desk, worker, and CEO Inbox tray in Office View is reachable via logical Tab order + `Enter` and mirrored cleanly in semantic DOM with debounced `aria-live`.
- **Bounded-Sprite `30+` Hot-Desk Cap Invariant:** Visible Office sprites never exceed physical floorplan desk capacity (`<= 28–30`), overflowing cleanly into the clickable Hot-Desk Counter.
- **Strictly Opt-In Audio Invariant:** Soft chimes default strictly OFF and auto-mute unconditionally in Focus Mode.
- **Zero-Selection-Loss `Office ↔ Board` Switch Invariant:** Toggling between Office and Board preserves the inspected worker and open panels seamlessly.

- **Shared Contracts Consumed / Produced:** Consumes `KnowledgeGraphRepo` (`Task 017`), `MinGitRepoInspector` (`Task 035`), `SafetyScanner` (`Task 036`); produces `BrownfieldL0RepoScanner`, `StackAndFrameworkDetector`, `GitChurnHotspotAnalyzer`, `MonorepoWorkspacePicker`, and `ObservedRepoFactsPersister`

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Implement Fast Zero-LLM Gitignore-Respecting Tree Scanner (`BrownfieldL0RepoScanner`):** Scan ANY existing repository in `< 2 s` (targeting `< 1 s` on repos like `resume-changer` and `< 3 s` on 10,000-file monorepos!) strictly respecting `.gitignore` + `.git/info/exclude` via `git ls-files` + untracked non-ignored listing — **UNCONDITIONALLY skipping `node_modules/`, `.git/`, `dist/`, `build/`, `.next/`, `vendor/`, `__pycache__/`, `target/`, and binary blobs**!
- [ ] **Implement Exact Multi-Ecosystem Manifest, Framework & Script Detector (`StackAndFrameworkDetector`):** Deterministically parse manifests & config files across real-world repos to extract ground-truth `basis = 'observed'` facts:
  - **Languages & File Counts:** Exact byte & file breakdown (TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Go, Rust, SQL, CSS, Markdown, etc.)
  - **Package Managers & Lockfiles:** `pnpm` (`pnpm-lock.yaml`, `pnpm-workspace.yaml`), `npm` (`package-lock.json`), `yarn` (`yarn.lock`), `bun` (`bun.lockb`), `uv`/`poetry`/`pip` (`pyproject.toml`), `cargo` (`Cargo.toml`), `go` (`go.mod`)
  - **Frameworks & UI Kits:** Next.js (App vs Pages router!), React/Vite, Angular, Express/Fastify/Hono, NestJS, Prisma/Drizzle/TypeORM/Knex/SQLAlchemy, Tailwind CSS + existing `shadcn/ui` / MUI / Chakra (`Task 094` brownfield adoption!), Vitest/Jest/Pytest/Playwright/Cypress!
  - **Runnable Scripts & CI Workflows:** Exact scripts from `package.json` (`dev`, `build`, `test`, `lint`, `typecheck`, `db:migrate`), `.github/workflows/*.yml` CI jobs/Node versions/env checks, `Dockerfile` / `docker-compose.yml` services!
  - **Database Schemas & Migrations:** Auto-locate `prisma/schema.prisma`, `drizzle/`, `migrations/*.sql`, `schema/*.sql`, OpenAPI specs!
  - **Environment Variable Contracts (`.env.example` ONLY!):** Parse variable *names* (NEVER reading real secret values from `.env` or `.env.local`!) from `.env.example` / `.env.sample` + static `process.env.FOO` references!
- [ ] **Implement Git Churn & Coupling Hotspot Analyzer (`GitChurnHotspotAnalyzer`):** Query bounded recent Git history (`git log --numstat -n 300 --no-merges`, `< 500 ms`!) to identify: (a) top **high-churn hotspot files** (files modified most frequently over the last 90 days / 300 commits — high regression risk!), (b) **temporal co-change pairs** (files that almost always change together in the same commit, revealing hidden implicit seams!), and (c) recent commit style & branch naming conventions!
- [ ] **Implement Monorepo Workspace & Package Picker (`MonorepoWorkspacePicker`):** Automatically detect `pnpm-workspace.yaml`, `package.json.workspaces`, `turbo.json`, `nx.json`, `Cargo.toml [workspace]`, and inter-package internal dependency graphs; when scanning a monorepo with `> 1` package, present a crisp **Scope Picker** letting the developer select which target app/packages their change touches (while automatically including direct internal workspace dependencies read-only!) so L1/L2 stays razor-focused and cheap!
- [ ] **Implement Strict Zero-Secret-File-Read Boundary:** NEVER open or index `.env`, `.env.local`, `.env.production`, `*.pem`, `*.key`, `id_rsa`, `credentials.json`, or `secrets.*` during L0 scanning (record ONLY `{ path, ignoredByGit, skippedAsSensitive: true }` metadata)!
- [ ] **Implement Existing Docs & Plan File Inventory:** Catalog existing `README.md`, `docs/**/*.md`, `ARCHITECTURE.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md` (with file sizes, line counts, and last-modified Git commit timestamps — directly powering `Task 168`'s Stale-Docs Detector and `resume-changer` 73-doc benchmark verification in `Task 175`!)!
- [ ] **Implement Incremental L0 Rescan Hash Cache:** Persist `l0_snapshot_hash` (`HEAD SHA` + dirty file mtimes) in `state.db` so reopening a brownfield repo with zero file changes loads L0 facts instantaneously in `< 5 ms`!
- [ ] **Persist All L0 Facts As `basis = 'observed'` Canonical Nodes:** Write detected stack, scripts, frameworks, schemas, CI jobs, docs inventory, hotspots, and workspace packages cleanly into `state.db` (`Task 017`)!

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **Repository contains a live `.env` with `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY=sk_live_...` and `private.pem`:** Zero-secret-file-read boundary skips reading their contents completely (ONLY records `skippedAsSensitive: true`), proving 0 secret bytes ever enter `state.db`!
- **Monorepo has 40 packages (`apps/*`, `packages/*`) and 25,000 files including `node_modules`:** `git ls-files` skips `node_modules` completely, scans real source files in `< 2 s`, detects all 40 packages + workspace DAG, and presents clean `MonorepoWorkspacePicker`!
- **Existing repo (`resume-changer@497831ec`) has 73 Markdown files under `docs/` (17 plan/task files totaling 4,906 lines):** L0 accurately inventories all 73 docs with exact git last-touch dates, line counts, and Next.js + Tailwind + Vitest stack in `< 1 s`!
- **Repo has zero commits yet (fresh `git init` with untracked existing files) OR is not even a Git repo yet (`Task 035`):** `GitChurnHotspotAnalyzer` gracefully yields `churnAvailable: false` while filesystem gitignore-aware walker STILL completes full stack/manifest/script detection cleanly!
- **Repo contains a symlink loop (`a/link → ..`) or deep Windows `MAX_PATH` (`> 260` chars) directory:** Symlink visited-inode guard prevents infinite recursion and Windows `\\?\` / safe path handling prevents crashes!
- **Next.js repo mixes Pages Router (`pages/`) AND App Router (`app/`):** Detector accurately reports `nextjsRouter: 'hybrid_app_and_pages'` instead of misclassifying as single-router!
- **`.github/workflows/ci.yml` runs on `ubuntu-latest` (case-sensitive Linux FS!) while developer works on Windows:** L0 explicitly flags `ciLinuxCaseSensitive: true` so `Task 054`/`178` warn early about case-mismatched imports!

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Zero-LLM / Zero-Network L0 Invariant:** Complete L0 repo scanning runs 100% deterministically locally at `$0.00` cost in `< 3 s`.
- **Zero-Sensitive-File-Read Invariant:** `.env`, `.env.local`, `*.pem`, `*.key`, and credential files are NEVER opened or indexed by L0.
- **Gitignore-Clean Invariant:** `node_modules/`, build outputs, and ignored caches are never walked or counted as repo source code.
- **Observed-Basis-Only Invariant:** All L0 facts persist strictly with `basis = 'observed'`, never conflated with user `explicit` intent.
- **Symlink-Loop-Safe Invariant:** Directory traversal detects cyclic symlinks cleanly without hanging.
- **Monorepo-Aware Invariant:** Multi-package workspaces always detect internal workspace edges and support focused package scoping.

  - Every cross-file import & symbol reference edge (`from_file → to_file / target_symbol`, resolving TypeScript `tsconfig.json` `paths` aliases like `@/components/*` and barrel `index.ts` re-exports!)
  - Incremental content-hash re-indexing: skip any file whose `(mtime, size, sha256)` matches `indexed_files` so updating 3 files after a commit re-indexes in **`< 50 ms`**!

  - Compute global baseline `file_rank` stored in `code-index.db.file_rank` identifying the architectural hubs (shared types, DB client, auth middleware, core domain models, layout shells)
  - Support **query-personalized PageRank** seeded on the files/symbols mentioned in a developer's change request (`"Update the resume export PDF margins"` → personalizes PageRank strongly around `pdf/*`, `export/*`, and their direct callers/callees!) to render a compact **1,000–2,000 token Aider-style Repo Map** giving planners & workers razor-sharp whole-codebase structural orientation at tiny token cost!

  - Skip generated client/schema outputs (`prisma/client/**`, `*.generated.ts`, `*.g.dart`, `*_pb.ts`, files starting with `// @generated` or `/* DO NOT EDIT */`), vendored libs (`vendor/**`, `third_party/**`), and lockfiles (`pnpm-lock.yaml`, `package-lock.json`)

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **TypeScript repo uses `@/*` path aliases (`tsconfig.json` `paths: { "@/*": ["./src/*"] }`) and `src/components/index.ts` barrel exports:** Resolver expands `@/` aliases and traces through barrel re-exports so `file_rank` and `findCallers()` resolve real target modules accurately!
- **Repo contains a `3.5 MB` auto-generated `graphql-types.generated.ts` file referenced by 80 components:** `GeneratedAndVendoredFilter` detects `// @generated` + size limit, keeping it out of hub distortion while preserving basic type lookup cleanly!
- **File contains a syntax error (developer is halfway through editing a line in VS Code!):** Tree-Sitter's error-tolerant incremental parser STILL extracts all valid sibling symbols and imports cleanly without aborting the file index!
- **User edits 2 files in VS Code:** Incremental mtime+SHA-256 index updates ONLY those 2 files and refreshes `file_rank` in `< 50 ms`!
- **`code-index.db` gets corrupted by power loss:** Auto-rebuild detects corruption via `PRAGMA quick_check`, recreates `code-index.db` from `schema/code-index.sql`, and re-indexes silently!
- **Repo has `2,500` source files:** Batched async WASM parsing + PageRank completes cleanly in `< 5 s` without freezing UI input (`< 50 ms` latency maintained)!
- **Circular imports exist (`a.ts ↔ b.ts`):** PageRank power iteration (`d = 0.85`, damping prevents trap divergence!) converges smoothly within `<= 30` iterations!

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Zero-LLM / Zero-Native-Compile Invariant:** L1 code indexing runs 100% offline via portable `web-tree-sitter` WASM with zero LLM calls and zero C++ toolchain needed on user machines.
- **Disposable-Rebuildable DB Invariant:** Deleting or corrupting `code-index.db` auto-rebuilds cleanly with zero canonical state loss.
- **Generated-Noise Exclusion Invariant:** Minified, vendored, lockfile, and `// @generated` files never pollute PageRank hubs or compact repo maps.
- **Exact Alias-Aware Resolution Invariant:** TypeScript/JS `tsconfig.json` `paths` and relative imports resolve accurately across Windows `\`/`/` paths.
- **Bounded-Token Map Rendering Invariant:** `CompactCodeMapQueryService` strictly respects caller token budgets (`<= maxTokens`).
- **Incremental Sub-50ms Delta Invariant:** Re-indexing `<= 5` edited files completes in `< 50 ms`.

- **Handoff For `Task 129` (Undo Cross-Feature Importer Scan), `Task 168` (L2 Focus Ranking), `Task 185` (Sweep Symbol Inventory), `Task 175` (`resume-changer` Indexing Proof):** Export `WasmTreeSitterIndexer`, `AiderPageRankCalculator`, `GeneratedAndVendoredFilter`, and `CompactCodeMapQueryService` in `.agent-handoffs/task-167.md`.

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Implement Request-Driven Focused Module Selection (`RequestDrivenFocusSelector`) — NEVER Whole-Repo Summarization!:** Given the developer's brownfield change request (`"Fix PDF page-break clipping on long achievement lists"`), combine `Task 167`'s query-personalized PageRank + L0 churn hotspots + symbol FTS to select ONLY the **`5–20` highest-relevance modules** directly touching or bordering the change (`maxFiles = 20` default!) — keeping L2 cheap, fast, and laser-focused instead of blindly feeding a 500-file repository to an LLM!
- [ ] **Implement Mandatory Pre-Spend Estimate & Confirmation Gate (`L2PreSpendEstimator`):** Before spending a single LLM token reading/summarizing brownfield code into `module-card-writer@1`, compute exact input token count of the selected uncached modules + exact estimated cost (`micro-USD` or `%` of plan window!) and show a crisp transparent pre-spend summary (`"Reading 9 uncached files (~18k tokens, est. ~$0.06 / 0.2% window) — 6 other relevant files already cached"`) requiring confirmation whenever the batch exceeds a small threshold (`> 25k` input tokens or `> $0.15`, OR first time sending code from a new repo to a cloud provider!)!
- [ ] **Implement Strict Pre-Egress Secret-Masking Guard (`CodeEgressSecretMasker`):** Scan EVERY single brownfield source file excerpt through `Task 011` `PacketSecurityRedactor` + high-entropy detector BEFORE sending it to ANY cloud LLM (`module-card-writer@1`): mask any accidentally hardcoded API keys, tokens, DB URLs, or private keys in legacy brownfield code (`[REDACTED_LEGACY_SECRET]`), emit a crisp Security Notice card (`"Found a possible hardcoded credential in src/legacy/mailer.ts:14 — masked before sending to model"`), and keep the raw file untouched on disk!
- [ ] **Implement File-Hash Cached `module-card-writer@1` Engine (`ModuleCardCacheEngine`):** Persist structured `module_cards` in `code-index.db` keyed strictly by `(file_path, file_content_sha256, prompt_version)` capturing `{ purpose, publicApiSummary, sideEffectsAndIo, invariantsAndGotchas[], externalDependencies[], testCoverageNotes, observedSymbolHashes }`:
  - Cache hits cost **`0` tokens and `< 2 ms`** across subsequent changes on the same repository!
  - Whenever a file is modified (hash mismatch!), invalidate & refresh ONLY that exact changed file's card!
  - Verify every symbol/export mentioned in the generated card actually exists in `Task 167`'s `code-index.db.symbols` table (rejecting hallucinated function names!)!
- [ ] **Implement Deterministic + Lightweight Stale-Docs Detector (`StaleDocsDetector`):** Solve the #1 brownfield trap (believing outdated `docs/*.md` or `README.md` over actual running code — critical for the 73-doc `resume-changer` benchmark in `Task 175`!):
  1. **Zero-LLM Structural Drift Checks FIRST:** Compare every file path, CLI script, endpoint route, env var, and symbol identifier referenced inside `README.md` and `docs/**/*.md` against live L0/L1 ground truth (`Task 166`–`167`) + compare each doc's Git last-modified commit timestamp against the last-modified timestamps of the code modules it describes!
  2. Flag docs referencing deleted files, renamed exports, removed npm scripts, or untouched for `> 180 days` while their target code changed `> 20` times as **`likely_stale`** with exact concrete drift evidence (`"docs/old-api.md references src/api/v1.ts (deleted 8 months ago) and POST /api/legacy (not found in code)"`)!
  3. Enforce the Golden Brownfield Precedence Rule: **`Live Code (L0/L1) > Verified Recent Docs > Stale Docs`** — tagging stale docs explicitly so planners NEVER follow obsolete architecture docs blindly!
- [ ] **Implement Persistent `observed` Module Nodes In `state.db`:** Project active focused `module_cards` cleanly into `state.db` as `node(type = 'brownfield_module', basis = 'observed')` so they immediately appear on the Architecture Canvas (`Task 153` `Today` layer!) and in `Task 154` Node #14 popovers!
- [ ] **Implement Graceful Offline / Zero-Cloud-Egress Mode:** When using local Ollama (`Task 138`) or when user declines cloud code egress, support running L2 locally via Ollama OR skipping L2 cleanly and relying solely on L0 + L1 compact code maps!
- [ ] **Implement Bounded Concurrency & Batch Efficiency:** Summarize uncached focus modules in bounded parallel batches (`<= 4` concurrent calls honoring `Task 140` pacing) so 12 focused files finish in `< 8 s`!

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **Legacy brownfield file `src/config/stripe.ts` has a hardcoded old key `sk_live_old12345`:** `CodeEgressSecretMasker` scrubs it to `[REDACTED_LEGACY_SECRET]` BEFORE `module-card-writer@1` ever sees it, alerts the user cleanly, and verifies `0` raw secret bytes in outbound requests!
- **A 73-doc repository (`resume-changer`) has 12 obsolete archive docs referencing removed components alongside 5 fresh docs:** `StaleDocsDetector` pinpoints the exact 12 stale docs deterministically at `0` LLM tokens using symbol/path non-existence + git age skew, preventing planners from resurrecting dead legacy designs!
- **User asks a second change request 2 hours later touching 8 of the same 10 files:** `ModuleCardCacheEngine` serves 8 instant SHA-256 cache hits (`0` tokens!) and runs `module-card-writer@1` on ONLY the 2 new files!
- **`module-card-writer@1` hallucinates that `src/pdf.ts` exports `generateDocx()` when `code-index.db.symbols` shows ONLY `renderResumePdf()`:** Symbol-parity check catches the fabricated export immediately and strips/repairs it!
- **User asks a massive vague request (`"Refactor the whole 400-file repo"`):** `RequestDrivenFocusSelector` refuses to blindly dump 400 files, caps focus batch at 20 top hubs, shows honest `L2PreSpendEstimator` cost, and prompts the user to narrow to specific packages/features (`Task 166` `MonorepoWorkspacePicker`)!
- **User clicks `"Decline cloud code read"` on first-repo pre-spend consent:** Gracefully proceeds with `L0 + L1` deterministic code map (zero cloud code egress!) or offers switching to local Ollama!
- **A doc in `docs/adr-01.md` is 1 year old, YET every single file path and symbol it cites STILL exists unchanged in live code:** `StaleDocsDetector` does NOT falsely mark stable accurate ADRs as stale just because they are old — it flags `stale` only on broken refs OR high target-code churn skew!

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Request-Driven-Focus Invariant:** L2 NEVER summarizes an entire repo eagerly; it summarizes ONLY `<= 20` request-focused uncached files per pass.
- **Pre-Spend Transparency Invariant:** First-time cloud code reads and batches above threshold ALWAYS show exact token & cost estimate before sending code.
- **Zero-Legacy-Secret-Egress Invariant:** Every source snippet passes `CodeEgressSecretMasker` before leaving the machine; raw hardcoded legacy secrets NEVER reach external LLM APIs.
- **Content-Hash Cache Invariant:** Unmodified files (`file_content_sha256` match) ALWAYS hit `code-index.db.module_cards` at `0` LLM tokens.
- **Live-Code-Outranks-Stale-Docs Invariant:** `StaleDocsDetector` verifies doc path/symbol citations against L0/L1 and strictly prevents stale docs from overriding live code reality.
- **Symbol-Grounded Card Invariant:** Module cards cannot assert nonexistent exported symbols absent from `code-index.db.symbols`.

Show a crisp summary of observed L0 stack/health PLUS **5 one-click prefilled change-type starters** ([brownfield-discovery.md](brownfield-discovery.md)):
  1. **`Add a new feature`** (fits cleanly into existing architecture & conventions)
  2. **`Change or extend an existing flow`** (modifies an existing screen/API safely)
  3. **`Fix a bug or mystery issue`** (routes cleanly into Bug Scrubber `Task 100` / Investigation `Task 182`)
  4. **`Make something faster (Performance fix)`** (activates mandatory measurable baseline interview!)
  5. **`Clean up or refactor across files (Sweep)`** (routes cleanly into Safe Sweep `Task 184`–`185`)
- [ ] **Implement Mixed-Request Work-Item Splitter (`MixedRequestWorkItemSplitter`):** Real developers often say `"Fix the login redirect bug, make the orders table faster, and add CSV export"` in ONE opening prompt! Deterministically/structuredly split mixed requests into distinct typed `work_items` in `state.db` (`#1 Bug Fix`, `#2 Perf Fix`, `#3 New Feature`), letting the user confirm execution order (e.g., `"Fix bug first, then perf, then CSV export"`) instead of mashing 3 unrelated changes into one chaotic mega-branch!
- [ ] **Implement Mandatory Measurable Performance-Fix Interview (`MeasurablePerfInterviewFlow`):** Prevent hand-wavy `"make it faster"` tasks that cannot be verified! Whenever a work item is classified as `performance_fix`, require settling 3 concrete measurable criteria BEFORE planning:
  1. **Exact target surface & dataset size** (e.g., `GET /api/orders` with `10,000` seeded rows, OR client render of `500` items)
  2. **Measured current baseline** (automatically captured in local test env via real timing benchmark AND **`EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS)`** for SQL/Postgres/SQLite queries!)
  3. **Concrete target threshold** (e.g., `"p95 < 120 ms and zero sequential table scan on orders(user_id)"`) — turning vague perf wishes into a deterministic, machine-verifiable acceptance oracle!
- [ ] **Implement Observed-Reality Confirmation Card + `Today` vs `Change` Canvas Layer Projection (`TodayVsChangeConfirmationBuilder`):** Before generating a single task on a brownfield repo, present ONE crisp **Confirmation Card** summarizing:
  - What EF Harness observed (`Stack`, `Affected existing modules`, `Stale docs ignored`, `Untouched subsystems preserved`)
  - Exact proposed `Today` (existing `observed` architecture dimmed/slate) vs `Change` (highlighted additive/modified delta nodes) projection directly onto `Task 153` Architecture Canvas so the developer can visually verify `"Yes, you understood my repo accurately — ONLY touch those 4 modules!"` before any code is edited!
- [ ] **Implement Deterministic Existing Conventions Extractor (`ExistingConventionsExtractor`):** Extract the existing repository's REAL working conventions purely from L0/L1 code + config files (ZERO rewriting existing style!):
  - Formatting & Lint configs (`.prettierrc*`, `eslint.config.*`, `tsconfig.json` strictness, path aliases `@/*`)
  - Folder & naming patterns (`kebab-case` vs `PascalCase` components, colocated `*.test.ts` vs `__tests__/`, API handler pattern, error-envelope shape, existing UI primitives `src/components/ui/*`, existing DB query builder/ORM idioms)
  - Commit message convention (`conventional commits` detected from recent `git log`)
  - Persist extracted conventions as a compact **`<= 600`-token `observed` Conventions Card** automatically injected into every brownfield worker's `MUST` band (`Task 088`) so generated PR diffs look native to the repo!
- [ ] **Enforce Zero-Re-Asking Of Observed Stack Facts:** Automatically pre-settle applicable M2 discovery criteria (`language`, `framework`, `db_engine`, `auth_library`, `css_system`, `test_runner`) with **`basis = 'observed'`** straight from L0/L1 so Discovery asks ONLY about the requested change (typically `1–4` focused questions instead of 25 greenfield questions!)!
- [ ] **Implement Anti-Rewrite Scope Fence:** Explicitly mark every existing module OUTSIDE the confirmed change blast radius as **read-only / out-of-scope** in `state.db`, preventing workers from "helpfully" reformatting or refactoring unrelated legacy files!
- [ ] **Implement Existing `AGENTS.md` / `CONTRIBUTING.md` Safe Ingestion:** Read repository contributor guides cleanly (sanitized against prompt injection & validated against live code by `StaleDocsDetector` `Task 168`) as supplementary style hints while keeping canonical user instructions authoritative!

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **Shared Contracts Consumed / Produced:** Consumes `WorktreeSlotPool` (`Task 038`), `HarnessRunEngine` (`Task 048`), `TestEnvOrchestrator` (`Task 050`), `BrownfieldL0RepoScanner` (`Task 166`); produces `BaselineTestHealthRunner`, `KnownFailingQuarantineStore`, `ThreeRunFlakeDetector`, `CharacterizationSafetyNetPlanner`, and `BrokenBuildEntryGate`

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Implement Isolated Clean-Worktree Baseline Runner (`BaselineTestHealthRunner`):** BEFORE editing a single line of an existing brownfield repository, check out the repo's exact baseline commit into an isolated worktree slot (`Task 038`) and run its detected `typecheck`, `lint`, `build`, and `test` commands (`Task 166`) inside the sandboxed test environment (`Task 048`/`050`) — capturing exact baseline pass/fail/skip/duration receipts (`state.db.baseline_test_health`) WITHOUT touching the user's working checkout!
- [ ] **Implement Strict `Broken-Build Entry Gate` (`BrokenBuildEntryGate`):** If the repository's existing baseline **fails to compile / `build` / `typecheck` BEFORE EF Harness even starts**, STOP clearly before planning feature edits and present 3 honest options:
  1. **`Fix the broken baseline build first`** (opens a focused repair task on the exact baseline compiler errors)
  2. **`Inspect environment / missing tool`** (e.g., wrong Node version or missing local DB routed to `Task 121` Human-Step Probe!)
  3. **`Proceed scoped anyway`** (explicitly acknowledging baseline build is broken so workers aren't unfairly blamed for pre-existing errors!)
- [ ] **Implement Pre-Existing Known-Failing Test Quarantine (`KnownFailingQuarantineStore`):** Real legacy repositories often have 3 pre-existing broken tests unrelated to the user's new feature! Record every failing test ID from the clean baseline run in `state.db.baseline_quarantined_tests(test_id, file_path, error_fingerprint, baseline_commit_sha)` so:
  - Later verification gates (`Task 055`/`111`) strictly enforce **ZERO NEW regressions** (every test that passed on baseline MUST STILL pass, plus all newly added tests MUST pass!)
  - Pre-existing quarantined failures do NOT cause workers to loop endlessly trying to fix unrelated broken legacy suites (while clearly reporting `"3 pre-existing failing tests excluded from regression gate"` in every receipt and offering `"Fix them too?"`!)!
  - If a quarantined test lives INSIDE a file the user's change explicitly modifies, clearly warn and require deciding whether to fix or explicitly preserve quarantine!
- [ ] **Implement Targeted 3× Flake Detector (`ThreeRunFlakeDetector`):** Whenever a baseline test fails on Run 1 (or any test fails intermittently during verification!), automatically re-run ONLY the failing subset up to **3 times (`3×`)** in clean isolated invocations (`< 30 s` budget):
  - `0/3` pass → deterministic **`known_failing`** (quarantined cleanly!)
  - `1/3` or `2/3` pass → tagged explicitly **`baseline_flaky`** with exact stack/timing variance, preventing flaky legacy tests from randomly failing unrelated worker candidates while surfacing them transparently in the Health Card!
  - `3/3` pass → healthy passing baseline test!
- [ ] **Implement Zero-Test Characterization Safety-Net Phase (`CharacterizationSafetyNetPlanner`):** When a brownfield repository has **ZERO tests** (or `0` tests covering the specific existing modules targeted by the user's change!), automatically insert a tiny, cheap, high-leverage **Characterization Safety-Net Pre-Phase (`P0.B-Char`)** BEFORE modifying legacy code:
  - Generates `3–8` crisp characterization tests pinning the **CURRENT observed behavior** of the exact modules about to be modified (run against the untouched baseline commit FIRST to prove `100%` green on current behavior!)
  - Guarantees that refactoring or extending untested legacy code has a real regression safety net before the first edit lands!
  - Allows experienced developers a clean 1-click `"Skip safety-net tests (I'll verify manually)"` opt-out clearly recorded in receipts!
- [ ] **Implement Normalized Test-Reporter Parsing Across Ecosystems:** Parse structured JSON/JUnit test IDs cleanly from Vitest, Jest, Playwright, Node `node:test`, Pytest, Go `go test -json`, and Cargo test so individual test-ID quarantine works identically across languages!
- [ ] **Implement Baseline Cache Keyed By `HEAD SHA` + Lockfile Hash:** Cache clean baseline health receipts keyed by `(baselineCommitSha, lockfileSha256)` so subsequent changes on the same commit skip redundant baseline test runs cleanly!
- [ ] **Implement Zero-Dirty-Baseline Cleanliness Check:** Confirm the baseline worktree remains 100% clean after baseline tests run (detecting leaky legacy tests that mutate tracked files on disk and flagging them immediately!)!

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **Legacy repo has 120 passing tests, 2 consistently failing old tests (`0/3`), and 1 flaky timeout test (`2/3`):** `BaselineTestHealthRunner` marks 120 as mandatory regression floor, quarantines the 2 deterministic failures as `known_failing`, flags the 1 flaky test as `baseline_flaky`, and unlocks smooth feature work with exact transparency!
- **Worker's PR breaks 1 of the 120 baseline passing tests while the 2 quarantined tests still fail:** Regression gate catches the exact 1 NEW regression immediately and rejects the candidate!
- **Repo's `pnpm build` fails on untouched baseline because Node 22 is needed or a stray syntax error sits on `main`:** `BrokenBuildEntryGate` catches it BEFORE spending tokens on feature workers and presents the exact compiler error + 3 clean choices!
- **Untested legacy module `src/billing/calculateTax.ts` has `0` existing tests and user wants to add VAT support:** `CharacterizationSafetyNetPlanner` creates 5 characterization tests capturing current US tax behavior, verifies all 5 PASS on untouched baseline FIRST, and then locks them into the regression suite for the VAT change!
- **A characterization test generated in `P0.B-Char` FAILS on untouched baseline code (meaning the agent guessed wrong about current behavior!):** Baseline-green proof immediately catches the inaccurate characterization test and repairs it until it matches real observed baseline behavior!
- **A leaky legacy test writes `debug.log` into the tracked repo root during baseline run:** Post-run dirty check detects `?? debug.log` immediately and flags the leaky test before workers inherit a dirty tree!
- **Baseline suite has 2,000 slow tests taking 12 minutes:** Scoped baseline runner supports running fast affected-module tests + smoke first while offering optional full-suite background verification within time budgets!

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Strict Zero-New-Regression Invariant:** Every test passing on clean baseline MUST pass on every brownfield worker candidate and merge-queue commit.
- **Quarantined-Failure Transparency Invariant:** Pre-existing `known_failing` and `baseline_flaky` tests are explicitly listed in receipts — never silently hidden or deleted.
- **Baseline-Green Characterization Invariant:** Every generated safety-net characterization test MUST pass on the untouched baseline commit BEFORE any production code edit begins.
- **Broken-Build-Before-Coding Gate Invariant:** A broken baseline compiler/build NEVER silently launches coding workers to fail mysteriously; it stops clearly at `BrokenBuildEntryGate`.
- **3× Re-Run Flake Classification Invariant:** Failing baseline tests run strictly 3× in isolated runs to separate deterministic failures (`0/3`) from flakes (`1/3`, `2/3`).
- **Isolated-Worktree-Only Invariant:** Baseline test runs NEVER run inside or dirty the developer's own working checkout.

#### Multi-Agent Harmony And Branch Isolation

- **Worktree Setup:** Create branch `task/170-brownfield-baseline-test-health` via `node scripts/agent-worktree.mjs create 170 brownfield-baseline-test-health`.
- **Strict Subtree Boundary:** Touch ONLY `packages/brownfield/src/test-health/**`, `packages/brownfield/tests/test-health/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-170.md`.
- **Parallel Safe Execution:** Disjoint from `Tasks 166–169` and `Task 171`.
- **Handoff For `Task 055` (Verifier Quarantine Filter), `Task 093` (Brownfield Gate 0), `Task 175` (`resume-changer` Baseline Run):** Export `BaselineTestHealthRunner`, `KnownFailingQuarantineStore`, `ThreeRunFlakeDetector`, `CharacterizationSafetyNetPlanner`, and `BrokenBuildEntryGate` in `.agent-handoffs/task-170.md`.
- **Commit-Only Discipline:** Commit exclusively on `task/170-brownfield-baseline-test-health`; **NEVER merge** into `main` or `harness/integration`.
- **Real Vitest Fixture Repo Tests:** Run real isolated baseline checks against 4 fixture repos: healthy repo, 2-failing + 1-flaky repo, broken-TypeScript repo, and 0-test repo proving characterization safety-net generation and baseline-green verification!

#### Verification, Testing And Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Run `pnpm --filter @ef-harness/brownfield test -- test-health` verifying isolated baseline execution classifies passing, `0/3` `known_failing`, and `1/3`–`2/3` `baseline_flaky` tests accurately across Vitest/JSON reporters.
- [ ] Verify regression gate catches any NEW regression on a baseline-passing test while permitting quarantined pre-existing failures with explicit transparency.
- [ ] Verify `BrokenBuildEntryGate` stops cleanly on a baseline compile error and `CharacterizationSafetyNetPlanner` generates baseline-passing tests on a 0-test repo (rejecting inaccurate tests that fail on untouched baseline!).
- [ ] Verify dirty-tree leak detection catches baseline tests that write untracked repo files and cache skips redundant reruns on identical `(HEAD, lockfileSha256)`.
- [ ] Run `pnpm --filter @ef-harness/brownfield typecheck`, `lint`, and `node scripts/verify-harmony.mjs --task 170`.

- **Mandatory Reference Files:** [editor-coexistence.md](editor-coexistence.md), [workspace-and-git.md](workspace-and-git.md), [editor-coexistence.mmd](editor-coexistence.mmd), [editor-coexistence.svg](editor-coexistence.svg), [research/coexistence-undo-and-reentry.md](research/coexistence-undo-and-reentry.md)
- **Shared Contracts Consumed / Produced:** Consumes `TaskHoldsManager` (`Task 021`), `MinGitRepoInspector` (`Task 035`), `RefLeaseAndCasManager` (`Task 039`), `SmartBranchFreshnessSync` (`Task 110`), `ProjectMergeQueue` (`Task 111`); produces `EditorCoexistenceWatcher`, `ActiveScopeOverlapDetector`, `ManualLockfileIncludeHandler`, and `BaseSyncIntegrationMerger`

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Implement Lightweight Developer-Checkout File & Git Watcher (`EditorCoexistenceWatcher` via `@parcel/watcher`):** Watch the developer's primary working checkout cleanly (`300 ms` debounce, strictly ignoring `.git/objects`, `node_modules/`, build outputs, and `.harness/views/` handled by `Task 085`!) PLUS watch `.git/HEAD` and `.git/refs/heads/<devBranch>` to detect in real time while a build runs in parallel:
  1. Uncommitted edits the developer makes in VS Code / Cursor / Neovim
  2. New manual commits the developer makes on their branch
  3. Manual branch switches, `git pull`, or `git rebase` / force-push updates
  4. Manual edits to `package.json` / `pnpm-lock.yaml` (e.g., developer runs `pnpm add framer-motion` in their own terminal!)
  - **Golden Coexistence Law:** EF Harness NEVER runs `git stash`, NEVER writes into the developer's dirty files, and NEVER runs `git checkout` in the developer's working directory!
- [ ] **Implement Real-Time Active-Scope Overlap Detector & 3-Choice Overlap Card (`ActiveScopeOverlapDetector`):** Cross-check every developer-edited file path (normalized case-insensitively on Windows!) against the active `write_scope[]` of all currently `WORKING` / `VERIFYING` / `INTEGRATING` tasks in `state.db`:
  - **Zero Overlap (Developer edits `README.md` or unrelated `src/marketing/Hero.tsx` while workers build `src/api/orders.ts`):** Stay **100% quiet & zero interruption**! Workers keep running at full speed!
  - **Overlap Detected (Developer edits `src/api/orders.ts` while Worker `A0014` is actively editing `src/api/orders.ts`!):** Immediately place a surgical `editor_overlap` hold (`Task 021`) ONLY on `A0014` (never pausing unrelated workers!) and surface ONE calm **Overlap Card** with the exact 3 choices from [editor-coexistence.md](editor-coexistence.md):
    1. **`Take Over` ("I'll handle this file / task myself"):** Transitions `A0014` cleanly into `Task 173` **`HUMAN_OWNED`** (`"I Fixed It Myself"` flow) and parks the agent off that file!
    2. **`Keep Both` (Finish & merge cleanly):** Lets the developer keep their edit in their checkout while `A0014` finishes in its isolated worktree, flagging `src/api/orders.ts` for clean 3-way review at Landing (`Task 172`)!
    3. **`Ignore my draft` (Temporary scratch edit):** Releases the hold on `A0014` cleanly without touching the developer's disk file!
- [ ] **Implement Manual Lockfile `Commit and include` Card (`ManualLockfileIncludeHandler`):** When the watcher detects the developer manually modified `package.json` or `pnpm-lock.yaml` / `package-lock.json` in their checkout (e.g., ran `pnpm add` in terminal!) while a build is active, surface a clear non-alarmist card:
  - **`Commit & include in harness base`** (cleanly guides/absorbs the committed lockfile update into `harness/integration` via `Task 110` serialized dependency path so workers immediately see the new package!)
  - **`Keep separate until landing`** (leaves `harness/integration` untouched until `Task 172` Safe Landing!)
  - NEVER silently runs `git add` or `git commit` inside the developer's checkout without explicit consent!
- [ ] **Implement Base-Sync Integration Merger (`BaseSyncIntegrationMerger`):** When the developer makes a clean new commit or runs `git pull` on their base branch (`main` / `feature/xyz`) while EF Harness is building on `harness/integration`, offer/run clean **base sync** merging the developer's new commits into `harness/integration` through `Task 111`'s serialized merge-queue gate (using fresh ephemeral worktree + `CombinedRegressionGate` + atomic CAS `update-ref` — NEVER touching the developer's working tree!), then letting `Task 110` `SmartBranchFreshnessSync` update only affected feature branches!
- [ ] **Implement Deleted-File & Force-Push Safe Detection:**
  - If the developer deletes a file in their branch that an active task depends on (`git diff --diff-filter=D`), detect it cleanly during base-sync pre-flight and alert affected tasks rather than letting workers silently recreate deleted files!
  - If the developer amends or force-pushes/rebases their local branch (non-fast-forward `oldHead` no longer ancestor of `newHead`), detect the rewritten ancestry cleanly (`git merge-base --is-ancestor`), pause base-sync safely, and offer clean re-anchor preview instead of creating a duplicate-commit merge mess!
- [ ] **Implement Anti-Noise Debouncing For Editor Autosave & Build Tools:** Coalesce rapid VS Code autosaves (`300 ms`), ignore editor swap/temp files (`*.swp`, `*~`, `.#*', `*.tmp`, `.DS_Store`), and suppress re-triggering the same Overlap Card once the user already chose `Keep Both` or `Ignore` for that `(file, taskId)`!
- [ ] **Implement Clean Watcher Teardown & Handle Hygiene:** Unconditionally unsubscribe `@parcel/watcher` handles on project close/switch so Windows folder handles are NEVER left locked (allowing users to rename/delete project folders cleanly after closing the project!)!
- [ ] **Implement Coexistence Event Audit Log:** Record every overlap decision, base-sync merge SHA, and lockfile inclusion in `state.db.coexistence_events` for clean landing context (`Task 172`)!

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **Developer edits `src/pages/About.tsx` in VS Code while 4 workers are coding `src/api/orders.ts` and `src/db/menu.ts`:** Zero overlap with active `write_scope[]` → `0` holds, `0` cards, `0` interruptions — both developer and harness code smoothly side by side!
- **Developer saves `src/api/orders.ts` in VS Code while Worker `A0014` owns `src/api/orders.ts`:** Within `300 ms`, `A0014` receives surgical `editor_overlap` hold (the other 3 workers stay untouched!) and ONE Overlap Card (`Take Over / Keep Both / Ignore`) appears!
- **Developer saves `src/api/orders.ts` 15 more times over the next 10 minutes after clicking `Keep Both`:** Suppression cache remembers `(src/api/orders.ts, A0014, Keep Both)` so the user is NOT nagged 15 times!
- **Developer runs `git commit --amend` on `main` while EF Harness had branched `harness/integration` off the pre-amend SHA:** `BaseSyncIntegrationMerger` detects non-ancestor ancestry drift via `git merge-base --is-ancestor`, halts automatic base-sync cleanly, and presents a clean `"Base branch history was rewritten — Re-anchor cleanly?"` card!
- **Developer runs `pnpm add dayjs` in their VS Code terminal:** `ManualLockfileIncludeHandler` detects `package.json` + `pnpm-lock.yaml` edits and surfaces the calm `"Commit and include in harness base / Keep separate"` card without ever touching their git index!
- **Developer switches `main` → `hotfix/prod` in VS Code while EF Harness is building:** `.git/HEAD` watcher catches the branch switch cleanly without touching checkout, notes `"Your checkout switched to hotfix/prod — Harness continues safely on harness/integration"`!
- **User closes project in EF Harness and immediately tries to rename `D:\code\kitchen` in Windows Explorer:** Clean watcher unsubscribe ensures `0` open directory handles so Windows Explorer renames smoothly with zero `Folder In Use` error!

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Zero-Touch-Developer-Checkout Invariant:** `EditorCoexistenceWatcher` NEVER executes `git stash`, `git add`, `git commit`, `git checkout`, or file writes inside the developer's working directory without explicit consented action.
- **Zero-Noise Non-Overlapping Edit Invariant:** Manual edits outside active worker `write_scope[]` trigger `0` holds and `0` Inbox cards.
- **Surgical Single-Task Overlap Hold Invariant:** Overlapping manual edits hold ONLY the exact colliding task(s), never pausing unrelated parallel workers.
- **Exact 3-Choice Overlap Resolution Invariant:** Every overlap card cleanly offers `Take Over` (`HUMAN_OWNED`), `Keep Both`, and `Ignore`, suppressing repeat alerts once decided.
- **Rewrite/Force-Push Safe Base-Sync Invariant:** Non-ancestor branch rewrites are detected before merge and never cause duplicate-commit merge pollution.
- **Zero-Locked-Folder-Handle Invariant:** Closing a project unconditionally disposes all `@parcel/watcher` native handles on Windows.

#### Multi-Agent Harmony And Branch Isolation

- **Worktree Setup:** Create branch `task/171-editor-coexistence-watcher-sync` via `node scripts/agent-worktree.mjs create 171 editor-coexistence-watcher-sync`.
- **Strict Subtree Boundary:** Touch ONLY `packages/integrator/src/coexistence-watcher/**`, `packages/integrator/tests/coexistence-watcher/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-171.md`.

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Implement Pre-Landing Full-State Analyzer (`SafeLandingPreFlightAnalyzer`):** Before moving a single ref on the developer's active branch (`main` / `feature/xyz`), inspect the EXACT live state of the developer's working checkout (`git status --porcelain=v2`, staged vs unstaged vs untracked files, current `HEAD` vs `harness/integration` merge-base, and `git merge-tree --write-tree`!) classifying cleanly into 4 deterministic landing paths ([editor-coexistence.md](editor-coexistence.md)):
  1. **Path A — Clean Fast-Forward / Clean Merge:** Developer's working tree is clean (`0` dirty files) AND merge-tree has `0` conflicts → fast-forward (or clean `--no-ff` merge / squash per user preference) onto developer's branch with exact `EF-*` summary!
  2. **Path B — Untouched-Dirty Safe Apply (Zero Overlap!):** Developer has uncommitted edits in `README.md` or `src/scratch.ts` that have **ZERO intersection** with ANY file changed in `base..harness/integration` (and zero untracked-file filename collision!) → land cleanly via safe Git index/ref update that preserves 100% of the developer's untouched dirty files byte-for-byte **WITHOUT EVER running `git stash`!**
  3. **Path C — Dirty-Overlap 4-Option Card (`DirtyOverlapFourOptionDialog`):** Developer has uncommitted edits in `>= 1` file that ALSO changed on `harness/integration` → **HARD-STOP automatic landing** (ZERO silent stash, ZERO clobber!) and present the exact **4 clear choices**:
     - **Option 1 (`Commit your edits first, then land`):** Guides clean commit of developer's work, runs `BaseSyncIntegrationMerger` + conflict check, then lands cleanly!
     - **Option 2 (`Land onto a separate new branch`):** Creates clean branch `ef/<feature-slug>` pointing at verified `harness/integration` HEAD, leaving the developer's dirty working directory 100% untouched so they can review/merge in VS Code at their own pace!
     - **Option 3 (`Open side-by-side diff for overlapping files`):** Inspect exact overlapping hunks (`Your local edit` vs `Harness build`) and pick per-file/per-hunk before landing!
     - **Option 4 (`Cancel landing — keep on harness/integration`):** Zero changes made anywhere!
  4. **Path D — Diverged / Force-Pushed / Deleted-File Base:** If developer's branch diverged (`commits ahead`) or was force-pushed/rebased since `harness/integration` branched, run `BaseSyncIntegrationMerger` (`Task 171`) in an isolated ephemeral worktree + `CombinedRegressionGate` (`Task 111`) FIRST so the combined result is proven green BEFORE touching the developer's branch!
- [ ] **Enforce Absolute Zero-Silent-Stash & Zero-Silent-Overwrite Law (`ZeroStashLandingExecutor`):** Hard-forbid calling `git stash push`, `git stash pop`, `git checkout --force`, `git reset --hard`, or `git clean -fd` inside the developer's working checkout under ANY circumstance!
- [ ] **Implement Pre-Landing Safety Recovery Ref (`LandingRollbackSafetyPoint`):** Immediately BEFORE advancing the developer's branch ref, record a clean immutable local safety snapshot (`refs/ef-safety/pre-land-<timestamp>` + temp-index dirty snapshot via `Task 037` if dirty files exist!) and display a crisp `"Landed cleanly onto main (abc123) · Undo landing"` safety button so even an accidental landing click is 1-click reversible!
- [ ] **Implement Untracked-File Overwrite Collision Guard:** Explicitly verify that NO file newly added by `harness/integration` shares a path (case-insensitively on Windows!) with an **untracked** file currently sitting in the developer's checkout — treating untracked filename collisions strictly as Path C (`DirtyOverlapFourOptionDialog`) so untracked developer notes/prototypes are NEVER silently overwritten!
- [ ] **Implement Clean Commit-Style Choice (`Keep feature commits` / `Squash into 1 clean commit` / `Create new branch`):** Let the developer choose their preferred Git history shape on the Landing Preview card (showing exact commit count, changed file count, `+add/-del`, and verification receipt summary from `Task 101`)!
- [ ] **Implement Detached-HEAD & Submodule Safe Handling:** Detect detached `HEAD` or dirty nested submodules (`Task 035`) cleanly before landing and default safely to `"Land onto a new named branch ef/<slug>"` instead of failing mid-merge!
- [ ] **Implement Post-Landing `harness/integration` & Ref Cleanup:** After verified landing succeeds onto the developer's branch, sync `harness/integration` cleanly to the landed SHA, prune retired `harness/f/*` refs (`Task 110`), and preserve `.harness/views/` cleanly excluded!
- [ ] **Implement Landing Receipt Persistence In `state.db`:** Persist `{ landingId, targetBranch, preLandSha, landedSha, safetyRef, strategy, overlappingFilesHandled, landedAt }` so Re-Entry (`Task 130`) and Ship (`Task 178`) know the exact landed commit!

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **Developer has uncommitted edits in `docs/notes.md` (untouched by harness) while `harness/integration` modifies `src/api/orders.ts` and `src/ui/Menu.tsx`:** Path B applies `harness/integration` cleanly onto `main` WITHOUT calling `git stash` — `docs/notes.md` stays byte-for-byte identical in the working tree (verified by SHA-256 pre/post check!) while `src/api/orders.ts` and `src/ui/Menu.tsx` land cleanly!

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Absolute Zero-Silent-Stash Invariant:** EF Harness NEVER invokes `git stash`, `git reset --hard`, `git checkout -f`, or `git clean` in the developer's working checkout.
- **Byte-Exact Untouched-Dirty Preservation Invariant:** Path B landing verifies every untouched dirty & untracked developer file maintains identical SHA-256 bytes before and after landing.
- **Windows Case-Insensitive Untracked-Collision Invariant:** Any case-insensitive path collision with a dirty OR untracked developer file routes strictly to Path C's 4-option dialog.
- **Pre-Land Safety Snapshot Invariant:** Every landing writes an immutable `refs/ef-safety/pre-land-*` recovery pointer before updating the target branch ref.
- **Green-Before-Branch-Move Invariant:** Diverged or force-pushed bases ALWAYS pass isolated `CombinedRegressionGate` in an ephemeral worktree before touching the developer's branch.
- **Zero-Data-Loss Cancel Invariant:** Choosing Option 4 (`Cancel`) or Option 2 (`Separate branch`) leaves the developer's working tree and branch 100% unchanged.

  - Run the EXACT same clean-copy verification suite (`Task 055`: `typecheck`, `lint`, `STATIC_AUDIT`, leaf tests, and feature sealed checks!) so human fixes enjoy the same regression protection as AI code!
  - Preserve **TRUE DEVELOPER GIT AUTHORSHIP** (`user.name <user.email>` from developer's real Git config — NEVER overwriting human code with an AI/bot author!) stamped with clean `EF-Author-Mode: human-fixed` + `EF-Task: <id>` trailers!
- [ ] **Implement Out-Of-Scope & Contract-Change Reconciliation (`HumanScopeAndContractReconciler`):** Developers fixing a real bug often cleanly touch 1 extra helper file OR adjust an API contract field slightly beyond the original planned `write_scope[]`! Instead of rigidly rejecting a good human fix like a runaway AI worker:
  - Inspect `git diff --name-only` + AST/contract diff against `state.db`!
  - If the human touched an extra non-conflicting file: confirm cleanly (`"Your fix also updated src/lib/dates.ts — Include in task and update graph ownership?"`) and check for collisions with active sibling workers!
  - If the human modified a locked API/DB contract (`Task 083`/`112`): automatically detect the contract delta (`DeterministicSchemaDiffClassifier`!), sync `state.db` contract nodes cleanly to match the developer's actual code (`basis = 'explicit'`), and run `ReverseImpactWalker` (`Task 087`) so downstream AI tasks immediately build against the developer's REAL updated contract instead of clobbering it!
- [ ] **Implement Explicit `This test is wrong` & `Accept anyway` Human Authority Escape Hatches (`HumanVerificationOverridePolicy`):** The human developer is ALWAYS the ultimate authority! If Clean Verification fails on the developer's fix, present exact failing test details PLUS 3 honest paths:
  1. **`Fix code & re-check`** (keep editing in VS Code!)
  2. **`This test is wrong`** (routes straight into updating/superseding the stale spec/visible/sealed check via `Task 059`/`087` with developer rationale, re-verifies the updated test PASSES on the fix, and keeps the suite permanently honest!)
  3. **`Accept anyway (Human Override)`** (explicitly records `verification_status = 'human_override_accepted'`, exact failing check IDs, and developer reason in `state.db` + Landing Summary `Task 101` — NEVER pretending failed tests passed, while NEVER trapping a senior developer behind a buggy test!)
- [ ] **Implement Seamless Handoff Back To Parallel Build Pipeline:** Once verified (or human-override accepted), land the developer's commit through `FeatureIntegratorEngine` (`Task 096`) / `ProjectMergeQueue` (`Task 111`) seamlessly, immediately unblocking all waiting downstream AI tasks and waking the wave!
- [ ] **Implement `"Hand back to AI"` Reversibility:** If the developer opens the worktree, inspects the code, and decides `"Actually, let AI finish this with my partial changes + this hint"`, support 1-click **`"Hand back to AI (keep my edits)"`** that snapshots their edits as a clean starting WIP + explicit human guidance note and resumes AI execution smoothly!
- [ ] **Implement Zero-AI-Overwrite Protection For Human Commits:** Tag human-authored lines/commits in `state.db` so later AI rework prompts receive explicit `"Preserve developer's human-fixed implementation in <file> unless contradicting a newer decision"` framing!

### Task 174: Complete UI Consistency Verification Pipeline (ESLint/Stylelint Token Rules, Duplicate-Component Detector, Playwright 3-Width Boxes + 24px Tap Targets, `axe-core` Gate, Cross-Screen Rhythm & `toHaveScreenshot`)

- **Milestone & Track:** `M5 · Automated UI Consistency & Visual Regression Gate`
- **Depends On:** `Task 001`, `Task 054`, `Task 057`, `Task 094`, `Task 099`, `Task 161`
- **Git Worktree & Branch:** `task/174-ui-consistency-verification-pipeline` in `../ef-wt/task-174-ui-consistency-verification-pipeline` (commit on own branch only; **NEVER merge**)

- **Mandatory Reference Files:** [ui-design-system.md](ui-design-system.md#verifying-ui-consistency), [verification-for-real-apps.md](verification-for-real-apps.md), [ui-design-system.mmd](ui-design-system.mmd), [ui-design-system.svg](ui-design-system.svg), [research/ui-consistency-and-preview.md](research/ui-consistency-and-preview.md)
- **Shared Contracts Consumed / Produced:** Consumes `StaticAuditGate` (`Task 054`), `UiPlaywrightContractVerifier` (`Task 057`), `DesignTokenLintRuleset` (`Task 094`), `BrandAssetRegistry` (`Task 099`), `BeforeAfterBaselineApprover` (`Task 161`); produces `UiConsistencyPipeline`, `DuplicateComponentDetector`, `ThreeWidthLayoutAndTapTargetChecker`, `CrossScreenRhythmAuditor`, and `ApprovedScreenshotRegressionRunner`

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Implement Unified 6-Stage UI Consistency Verification Pipeline (`UiConsistencyPipeline`):** Enforce crisp, uniform, accessible product craft across parallel frontend workers automatically on every UI leaf, feature integration, and Completion Wave ([ui-design-system.md](ui-design-system.md)):
  1. **Stage 1 — ESLint & Stylelint Token Discipline (`Task 094`):** Enforce 0 raw hex/RGB colors, 0 arbitrary Tailwind color values, 0 broken dark-mode hardcoded `bg-white`/`text-black`, 0 raw `<button>`/`<input>` bypassing `src/components/ui/*`, and 0 unapproved external image hotlinks (`Task 099`)!
  2. **Stage 2 — Static Duplicate-Component Detector (`DuplicateComponentDetector`):** Parse AST of newly added UI components across feature folders (`src/features/*/components/**`) and detect when a parallel worker quietly creates a redundant clone of an existing Phase 0 primitive or sibling component (e.g., `OrderModal.tsx` re-implementing `Dialog`, `KitchenButton.tsx` cloning `Button`, or 2 nearly identical `Badge`/`Card` implementations via normalized JSX structure + prop-signature similarity `>= 0.80`!) — flagging `"Duplicate of shared src/components/ui/dialog.tsx — reuse shared primitive"`!
  3. **Stage 3 — Playwright 3-Width Bounding-Box & `24 px` Tap-Target Audit (`ThreeWidthLayoutAndTapTargetChecker`):** Render every changed/active route in headless Playwright at **all 3 canonical breakpoints** (`375×812` mobile, `768×1024` tablet, `1440×900` desktop) across BOTH light and dark themes (when dark mode enabled!) asserting:
     - **Zero horizontal overflow** (`scrollWidth <= clientWidth + 1 px`)
     - **Zero clipped/overlapping interactive controls** (bounding-box intersection check across sibling buttons/inputs/labels!)
     - **Minimum `24×24 px` WCAG 2.2 AA tap-target floor** on EVERY interactive `<button>`, `<a>`, `<input>`, `[role="button"]` (with `>= 44 px` recommended warning on primary mobile touch controls!)
     - **Zero broken images** (`complete && naturalWidth > 0`) and **zero invisible/zero-height primary content containers**!
  4. **Stage 4 — Hard `axe-core` Accessibility Gate:** Run `axe-core` WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA audit on every rendered route/state — **HARD-FAIL** on ANY `serious` or `critical` violation (missing button/input accessible names, color contrast `< 4.5:1`, broken ARIA attributes, missing form labels, keyboard focus traps!), while surfacing `moderate`/`minor` notices clearly!
  5. **Stage 5 — Cross-Screen Visual Rhythm Auditor (`CrossScreenRhythmAuditor`):** Compare measured computed metrics across ALL screens in the app (header height, sidebar width, page-title `font-size`/`font-family`/`line-height`, primary card padding/border-radius, primary button height, body font family) — flagging jarring cross-screen inconsistency when Worker B's new `/print` or `/settings` page suddenly uses `18 px` body text, `24 px` rounded cards, or a `76 px` header while every other screen uses `14 px` / `8 px` / `56 px`!
  6. **Stage 6 — Approved `toHaveScreenshot` Visual Regression Runner (`ApprovedScreenshotRegressionRunner`):** Run deterministic Playwright `toHaveScreenshot` comparisons ONLY against **explicitly user-approved baselines** (created in Gate 0 `/__styleguide` `Task 094` or approved via Point-to-Fix `Task 161`!), injecting fixed deterministic fonts, frozen virtual clock, disabled CSS animations (`animations: 'disabled'`), and masked dynamic timestamps/IDs so pixel diffs catch REAL layout regressions with **near-zero flakiness**!
- [ ] **Implement Deterministic Visual Diff Artifact Packaging:** On any Stage 3–6 failure, store clean `expected.png`, `actual.png`, `diff.png`, and exact failing DOM selector + `data-ef-source` file/line (`Task 161`) in CAS (`Task 028`) so `WorkerInspectorPanel` (`Task 126`) and `VerificationHintLadder` (`Task 059`) give the worker (and user!) surgical pinpoint diagnostics!
- [ ] **Implement Optional Advisory `taste-reviewer@1` Handoff:** After Stages 1–6 pass deterministically, optionally pass the captured screenshots to `Task 102` `taste-reviewer@1` (strictly advisory, budget-respecting)!
- [ ] **Implement Clean Headless/CLI Skip:** Automatically skip all 6 UI stages cleanly (`0 ms`, `status: 'not_applicable_no_ui'`) for headless API / CLI projects!
- [ ] **Implement Windows Sub-Pixel Font Anti-Aliasing Tolerance Calibration:** Calibrate `maxDiffPixelRatio` (`<= 0.005`) and `threshold` (`0.15`) cleanly for Windows ClearType/DirectWrite rendering so identical layouts never flake on 1-pixel subpixel anti-aliasing differences while genuinely broken shifts/colors fail decisively!

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **Parallel Worker B builds `/settings` using a `68 px` header and `rounded-3xl` cards while Worker A's `/orders` and `/menu` use `56 px` header and `rounded-lg` (`8 px`):** `CrossScreenRhythmAuditor` detects the exact outlier (`headerHeight: 68px vs median 56px`, `cardRadius: 24px vs 8px`) deterministically at `0` LLM tokens and returns a surgical fix hint!
- **Worker C builds a custom `src/features/menu/CustomModal.tsx` cloning `src/components/ui/dialog.tsx`:** `DuplicateComponentDetector` flags `similarity = 0.88` with `src/components/ui/dialog.tsx` before merge!
- **An icon-only close button renders at `16×16 px` on `375px` mobile:** `ThreeWidthLayoutAndTapTargetChecker` hard-fails Stage 3 (`WCAG 2.2 tap target 16×16 < 24×24 px`) citing exact `data-ef-source` file/line!
- **Dark mode card uses low-contrast `#475569` text on `#1E293B` background (`2.7:1 < 4.5:1`):** Stage 4 `axe-core` catches `color-contrast (serious)` in dark mode and blocks merge immediately!
- **A screen has a live `"Updated 2 seconds ago"` clock or random order UUID causing false pixel diffs:** `ApprovedScreenshotRegressionRunner` masks `[data-ef-dynamic]` regions + injects deterministic test clock (`Task 052`) so `toHaveScreenshot` passes 100/100 times with zero flake!

- **Two buttons in a narrow `375px` action bar overlap by 14 px:** Bounding-box intersection detector catches the exact 14 px overlap between `Save` and `Cancel` buttons immediately!

- **3-Width × Dual-Theme Coverage Invariant:** Every UI screen is verified at `375px`, `768px`, and `1440px` across enabled themes (light + dark) with `0` horizontal overflow and `0` interactive overlaps.
- **Hard `24 px` Tap-Target & `axe-core` Serious Floor Invariant:** Zero interactive elements `< 24×24 px` and zero `serious`/`critical` `axe-core` violations can pass UI verification.
