### Task 176: External Effect Ledger & Approval Engine (`effects` Table, Payload Hash, Idempotency Key, Env Approval Policies, Lease-Epoch Fencing & Unknown-Outcome Reconciler)

- **Milestone & Track:** `M6 · Safe External Side-Effect Ledger & Approval Governance`
- **Depends On:** `Task 001`, `Task 007`, `Task 013`, `Task 025`, `Task 127`
- **Git Worktree & Branch:** `task/176-external-effect-ledger-approvals` in `../ef-wt/task-176-external-effect-ledger-approvals` (commit on own branch only; **NEVER merge**)
- **Owned Write Scope (Disjoint Subtree):** `packages/ship-deploy/src/effects/**`, `packages/ship-deploy/tests/effects/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-176.md`
- **Mandatory Reference Files:** [ship-and-deploy.md](ship-and-deploy.md#the-external-effect-ledger), [database-design.md](database-design.md), [schema/state.sql](schema/state.sql), [ship-and-deploy.mmd](ship-and-deploy.mmd), [ship-and-deploy.svg](ship-and-deploy.svg), [research/ci-and-deployment.md](research/ci-and-deployment.md)
- **Shared Contracts Consumed / Produced:** Consumes `CanonicalHash` (`Task 007`), `StateDb` `effects` table (`Task 013`), `IdempotencyOpsManager` (`Task 025`), `ApprovalCard` (`Task 127`); produces `ExternalEffectLedger`, `EnvApprovalPolicyEngine`, `LeaseEpochFencingGuard`, and `UnknownOutcomeReconciler`

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Implement Mandatory Outbound Effect Ledger (`ExternalEffectLedger`):** Route EVERY external side effect outside the local machine (`git push`, create/update/merge GitHub PR, sync env secrets to host, run remote DB backup/migration, deploy Preview/Staging/Production, trigger rollback, register webhook/DNS!) through `state.db.effects` **BEFORE executing a single network call**:
  - Persist `{ effectId, effectType, targetEnv: 'preview' | 'staging' | 'production' | 'git_remote', canonicalPayloadHash (RFC 8785!), idempotencyKey, writerEpoch, approvalStatus: 'pending_approval' | 'approved' | 'denied' | 'auto_allowed', execStatus: 'planned' | 'dispatched' | 'succeeded' | 'failed' | 'unknown_outcome', remoteReceiptJson?, createdAt, dispatchedAt?, finishedAt? }`!
  - **Idempotent Replay Guarantee:** Submitting the exact same `(effectType, idempotencyKey)` with matching `canonicalPayloadHash` when `execStatus === 'succeeded'` returns the recorded `remoteReceiptJson` immediately (NEVER double-creating PRs, double-deploying, or double-running production migrations!) — and HARD-REJECTS reusing an `idempotencyKey` with a DIFFERENT `canonicalPayloadHash` (`PayloadHashMismatchError`)!
- [ ] **Implement Environment-Tiered Approval Policy Engine (`EnvApprovalPolicyEngine`):** Enforce strict non-bypassable approval rules per target environment ([ship-and-deploy.md](ship-and-deploy.md)):
  - **`git_remote` (Push / Open PR):** Explicit user `ApprovalCard` (`Task 127`) required for initial push/PR; bounded CI repair pushes (`<= 3` fixes on the SAME PR branch, `Task 178`) may run under the user's explicit `"Approve PR & up to 3 CI repair pushes"` grant (strictly NEVER force-pushing protected branches or auto-merging PRs to `main` without approval!)
  - **`preview`:** Optional auto-deploy ONLY when explicitly opted in per project (default asks first time!)
  - **`staging`:** Explicit `ApprovalCard` showing exact commit SHA, migration diff, and name-only env diff!
  - **`production` (Deploy, Production Migration Expand/Backfill/Contract, Production Secret Sync, Production Rollback):** **ALWAYS requires explicit fresh human `ApprovalCard` click** bound strictly to exact `canonicalPayloadHash` — NEVER auto-approved, NEVER covered by `Task 108` auto-start, and invalidating approval immediately if the target commit SHA or payload changes by 1 byte before dispatch!
- [ ] **Implement Lease-Epoch Fencing Guard (`LeaseEpochFencingGuard`):** Every effect dispatch verifies the daemon still holds the active single-writer `writer_epoch` (`Task 187`) AND `project_runtime.state !== 'STOPPED'` inside an atomic `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` transition `planned → dispatched` right before invoking the external API — preventing split-brain dual-laptop pushes or post-Stop deploys!
- [ ] **Implement Crash-Safe `unknown_outcome` Reconciler (`UnknownOutcomeReconciler`):** Solve the #1 distributed-systems bug in deployment tools (network timeout or laptop crash AFTER sending `POST /v13/deployments` or `git push` BEFORE receiving HTTP `200`!):
  - Because `execStatus = 'dispatched'` is committed to `state.db` BEFORE the network call starts, a crash/timeout leaves the effect cleanly in **`unknown_outcome`**!
  - **UNCONDITIONALLY FORBID blind automatic retries of `unknown_outcome` effects!**
  - Instead, run each effect type's registered deterministic read-only **`reconcile(idempotencyKey, payloadHash)`** probe first (e.g., `git ls-remote` checking if commit SHA already landed, GitHub PR search by head branch + idempotency trailer, Vercel deployment lookup by commit SHA + metadata key, Postgres migration table check!) to prove whether the remote side succeeded (`→ succeeded` w/ real receipt!) or never took effect (`→ safe_to_retry`) — escalating to the developer ONLY if remote state remains genuinely ambiguous!
- [ ] **Implement Strict Payload-Hash Binding On Approval:** When the user clicks `Approve` on an `ApprovalCard` for `Deploy commit abc123 to Production`, bind approval strictly to `payloadHash(abc123)`; if a newer commit `def456` lands before dispatch, approval AUTOMATICALLY invalidates (`approval_stale_payload_changed`) and demands fresh review!
- [ ] **Implement Complete External Effect Audit History:** Expose an immutable chronological ledger of every approved, denied, succeeded, failed, and reconciled external action visible in the `Ship` phase view (`Task 123`) and `Diagnostics` (`Task 133`)!
- [ ] **Implement Zero-Secret Storage In `effects` Payload:** Store ONLY secret *names* and salted HMAC hashes in `effects.payload_json` (NEVER raw env values or tokens!), verified by `PacketSecurityRedactor` before SQLite insert!
- [ ] **Implement Dry-Run Preview Mode For Every Effect:** Support `planEffect()` producing the exact human-readable diff + `canonicalPayloadHash` + approval requirement without ever hitting external write APIs!

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **Laptop Wi-Fi drops 1 second after sending `Create GitHub PR` (`POST /repos/.../pulls`), so the client sees `ETIMEDOUT` even though GitHub DID create PR #42:** Effect enters `unknown_outcome`; `UnknownOutcomeReconciler` queries `GET /repos/.../pulls?head=...` BEFORE retrying, discovers PR #42 already exists, records `succeeded (PR #42)`, and avoids creating duplicate PRs or crashing!
- **User approves Production Deploy for commit `abc123`, then quickly pushes an extra tweak `def456` before deploy starts:** `canonicalPayloadHash` mismatch immediately invalidates the `abc123` approval and asks fresh approval for `def456`!
- **A bug attempts to dispatch `production` deploy with `autoApprove: true`:** `EnvApprovalPolicyEngine` hard-rejects (`ProductionAlwaysRequiresExplicitApprovalError`) unconditionally!
- **Two laptops open the same synced project (`Task 187`) and stale Laptop A (`writer_epoch = 4`) tries to push while Laptop B took over (`writer_epoch = 5`):** `LeaseEpochFencingGuard` catches `4 < 5` before network dispatch and blocks the stale push cleanly!
- **Caller replays identical `(effectType: 'deploy_preview', idempotencyKey: 'dep-abc123')` after it already succeeded:** Ledger returns cached `remoteReceiptJson` cleanly with `0` duplicate external API calls!
- **Caller reuses `idempotencyKey: 'dep-abc123'` with a DIFFERENT commit payload:** Ledger throws `PayloadHashMismatchError` immediately (preventing silent mis-execution)!
- **User clicks `STOP` (`Task 114`) 20 ms before a queued deploy transitions `planned → dispatched`:** Atomic epoch check sees `STOPPED`, aborts transition cleanly, and makes `0` external network calls!

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Write-Ahead Effect Ledger Invariant:** Every external write transitions `planned → dispatched` atomically in `state.db.effects` BEFORE initiating any network request.
- **Zero-Blind-Retry-On-Unknown-Outcome Invariant:** Timed-out or crashed `dispatched` effects enter `unknown_outcome` and MUST run read-only remote reconciliation before any retry is permitted.
- **Unconditional Production Approval Invariant:** Every `production` write/deploy/migration/secret-sync/rollback ALWAYS requires explicit human approval bound strictly to `canonicalPayloadHash`.
- **Payload-Bound Approval Invariant:** Changing a single byte of commit SHA, migration SQL, or env diff invalidates prior approval immediately.
- **Fenced Writer-Epoch Invariant:** Stale `writer_epoch` or `STOPPED` runtime state blocks all external dispatches before the socket opens.
- **Zero-Secret-In-Ledger Invariant:** `effects` rows never store raw API keys, passwords, or env secret values.

#### Multi-Agent Harmony And Branch Isolation

- **Worktree Setup:** Create branch `task/176-external-effect-ledger-approvals` via `node scripts/agent-worktree.mjs create 176 external-effect-ledger-approvals`.
- **Strict Subtree Boundary:** Touch ONLY `packages/ship-deploy/src/effects/**`, `packages/ship-deploy/tests/effects/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-176.md`.
- **Parallel Safe Execution:** Disjoint from `Tasks 177–181` (`packages/ship-deploy/src/{github,ci-loop,deploy-adapters,live-migrations,post-deploy}/**`).
- **Handoff For `Tasks 177–181` (All GitHub, CI, Deploy, Live Migration & Post-Deploy Engines):** Export `ExternalEffectLedger`, `EnvApprovalPolicyEngine`, `LeaseEpochFencingGuard`, and `UnknownOutcomeReconciler` in `.agent-handoffs/task-176.md`.
- **Commit-Only Discipline:** Commit exclusively on `task/176-external-effect-ledger-approvals`; **NEVER merge** into `main` or `harness/integration`.
- **Crash-Injection & Idempotency Tests:** Simulate network timeout after remote write, mid-dispatch crash, payload-hash tampering, stale `writer_epoch` rejection, production auto-approve refusal, and idempotent replay cleanly offline!

### Task 177: Remote GitHub Connector & Rate-Aware Queue (Device OAuth / `gh` Reuse, Branch Protection Reader, PR vs Direct Mode, `< 80/min` & `< 500/hr` Queue & Conditional `304` Polling)

- **Milestone & Track:** `M6 · Remote GitHub Integration & Rate-Limit Stewardship`
- **Depends On:** `Task 001`, `Task 035`, `Task 120`, `Task 176`
- **Git Worktree & Branch:** `task/177-github-connector-rate-queue` in `../ef-wt/task-177-github-connector-rate-queue` (commit on own branch only; **NEVER merge**)
- **Owned Write Scope (Disjoint Subtree):** `packages/ship-deploy/src/github/**`, `packages/ship-deploy/tests/github/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-177.md`
- **Mandatory Reference Files:** [ship-and-deploy.md](ship-and-deploy.md#github-connector-and-rate-limits), [sandbox-and-security.md](sandbox-and-security.md), [ship-and-deploy.mmd](ship-and-deploy.mmd), [research/ci-and-deployment.md](research/ci-and-deployment.md)
- **Shared Contracts Consumed / Produced:** Consumes `MinGitRepoInspector` (`Task 035`), `WindowsDpapiSecretsVault` (`Task 120`), `ExternalEffectLedger` (`Task 176`); produces `GitHubAuthConnector`, `BranchProtectionPolicyReader`, `GitHubRateAwareQueue`, and `ConditionalEtagPoller`

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Implement Seamless GitHub Auth (`GitHubAuthConnector` — Existing `gh` CLI Reuse + Official Device OAuth):**
  1. Auto-detect already-authenticated official `gh` CLI (`gh auth status`) and offer 1-click reuse (zero duplicate sign-in!)
  2. Support official GitHub OAuth Device Flow (`Task 139` RFC 8628 pattern, minimal repo/workflow scopes ONLY — requesting `workflow` scope explicitly ONLY if `.github/workflows/**` edits are needed!) storing tokens exclusively in Windows DPAPI (`Task 120`)
  3. Support GitHub remote parsing across HTTPS (`https://github.com/owner/repo.git`), SSH (`git@github.com:owner/repo.git`), and GitHub Enterprise Server hostnames!
- [ ] **Implement Live Branch Protection & Ruleset Reader (`BranchProtectionPolicyReader`):** Query GitHub branch protection / repository rulesets (`GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/branches/{branch}/protection` + `/rules/branches/{branch}`, handling `403`/`404` cleanly for personal/unprotected repos!) BEFORE planning push/ship strategy:
  - Detect required Pull Requests, required approving review count, required status checks (`ci/test`, `ci/build`), linear-history requirement, signed-commit requirement, and force-push bans!
  - Automatically select **PR Mode** (`push feature branch → open PR`) whenever default branch is protected (or multi-contributor repo — default safe mode!), offering **Direct Push Mode** ONLY on unprotected personal/solo repos when the user explicitly selects Direct Mode!
- [ ] **Implement Strict Serialized Secondary-Rate-Limit-Safe Request Queue (`GitHubRateAwareQueue`):** Respect GitHub's strict REST/GraphQL secondary rate limits ([ship-and-deploy.md](ship-and-deploy.md)) so EF Harness NEVER gets the user's GitHub account temporarily suspended or `403`-throttled:
  - **Serialize mutating writes (`POST`/`PATCH`/`PUT`/`DELETE`) strictly one at a time** with minimum `1,000 ms` spacing (`<= 60` mutations/min, hard ceiling **`< 80` content-creating requests/min** AND **`< 500` content-creating requests/hour**!)
  - Enforce primary rate-limit headroom (`x-ratelimit-remaining` + `x-ratelimit-reset`) AND obey `Retry-After` headers verbatim on any `403`/`429` secondary rate-limit response with exponential jittered backoff!
  - NEVER issue parallel write bursts across multiple projects sharing the same GitHub account (shared token bucket per GitHub user ID in `global.db`)!
- [ ] **Implement Zero-Quota Conditional `ETag` / `304 Not Modified` CI Poller (`ConditionalEtagPoller`):** Poll PR checks and GitHub Actions workflow runs (`GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/commits/{sha}/check-runs`, `/actions/runs`) strictly with `If-None-Match: <etag>` headers:
  - GitHub `304 Not Modified` responses consume **`0` primary API rate-limit quota**!
  - Use smart adaptive polling intervals (`10 s` during first 2 min → `20 s` → `45 s` cap, pausing completely when all runs reach `completed` or user pauses!)!
- [ ] **Implement Pre-Push `git ls-remote` & Repo Visibility Guard:** Before every push, check target repo visibility (`public` vs `private` via `GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}`) so `Task 186` orphan-branch sync and `Task 178` push approvals display a prominent **`PUBLIC REPOSITORY`** badge whenever pushing to a public repo!
- [ ] **Implement Non-Interactive Scoped Git Credential Helper (`GIT_ASKPASS` / Ephemeral Helper):** Pass GitHub HTTPS push credentials strictly via an ephemeral in-memory loopback credential helper / one-shot pipe scoped to that exact push subprocess (NEVER embedding `https://<token>@github.com/...` inside `.git/config`, remote URLs, or process argv!)!
- [ ] **Implement Safe Non-Force-Push Enforcement:** Hard-forbid `git push --force` to protected or default branches (`main`, `master`, `develop`, `production`) in code; permit `--force-with-lease` ONLY on harness-owned PR branches if explicitly approved by the user!
- [ ] **Implement Full Reconciler Hooks For `Task 176` `UnknownOutcomeReconciler`:** Register deterministic read-only reconcilers for `git_push` (`git ls-remote` ref SHA match), `create_pr` (query open PR by `head` branch + `EF-Effect-Id` footer), and `update_pr` so network drops never create duplicate PRs!

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **GitHub returns `403` with `retry-after: 60` (secondary rate limit):** `GitHubRateAwareQueue` pauses ALL queued mutations for that GitHub user for `60 s + jitter`, displays `"GitHub rate limit — resuming in 0:58"`, and never hammers the endpoint!
- **CI workflow runs for 18 minutes (`60` polls):** `ConditionalEtagPoller` sends `If-None-Match` on every poll — `54` of `60` return `304 Not Modified` consuming **`0`** rate-limit quota!
- **Target repo's `main` branch has branch protection requiring PR + 1 review + passing `ci-test`:** `BranchProtectionPolicyReader` detects protection automatically and locks Ship flow to **PR Mode** (`Direct Push` disabled with explanation `"Branch 'main' is protected — shipping via Pull Request"`)!
- **User's repo remote is a `PUBLIC` GitHub repo:** Pre-push guard displays a clear amber **`Public repository (owner/repo)`** badge on the Approval Card and reminds about secret-scan verification (`gitleaks`)!
- **Token lacks `workflow` scope while a PR edits `.github/workflows/ci.yml`:** Connector detects workflow file in diff BEFORE push, warns cleanly `"Push touches .github/workflows/ — requires GitHub 'workflow' scope"`, and guides scope grant cleanly instead of opaque `refusing to allow an OAuth App to create or update workflow` errors!
- **A bug attempts to run `git push https://ghp_secret@github.com/owner/repo.git`:** Credential guard forbids embedded URL tokens completely, using ephemeral `GIT_ASKPASS` pipe only so zero tokens ever appear in `.git/config`, argv, or logs!
- **Two concurrent projects push to two different repos under the same GitHub account:** Shared per-account token bucket serializes mutations `< 80/min` & `< 500/hr` cleanly across both projects!

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Strict `< 80/min` & `< 500/hr` Serialized Mutation Invariant:** Mutating GitHub API writes serialize cleanly with `>= 1,000 ms` spacing and strict rate ceilings honoring `Retry-After` and `x-ratelimit-reset`.
- **Zero-Quota `304` Conditional Polling Invariant:** All repeated CI/PR status polls send `If-None-Match` ETags to leverage zero-cost `304 Not Modified`.
- **Zero-Embedded-Token-URL Invariant:** GitHub tokens are NEVER written into `.git/config`, remote URLs, or CLI argv; push auth uses ephemeral non-persistent credential helpers only.
- **Branch-Protection-Respect Invariant:** Protected default branches ALWAYS use PR Mode and hard-forbid `--force` pushes.
- **Public-Repo Visibility Warning Invariant:** Pushing to any public GitHub repository always displays an explicit `PUBLIC REPOSITORY` warning + clean `gitleaks` check.
- **Zero-Duplicate-PR Reconciler Invariant:** Every GitHub write effect registers a read-only `Task 176` reconciler preventing duplicate PR creation on network drop.

- **Strict Subtree Boundary:** Touch ONLY `packages/ship-deploy/src/github/**`, `packages/ship-deploy/tests/github/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-177.md`.
- **Parallel Safe Execution:** Disjoint from `Task 176` (`src/effects/**`), `Task 178` (`src/ci-loop/**`), and `Tasks 179–181`.
- **Handoff For `Task 178` (Push, PR & CI Loop), `Task 186` (Public-Repo `harness-state` Guard):** Export `GitHubAuthConnector`, `BranchProtectionPolicyReader`, `GitHubRateAwareQueue`, and `ConditionalEtagPoller` in `.agent-handoffs/task-177.md`.
- **Commit-Only Discipline:** Commit exclusively on `task/177-github-connector-rate-queue`; **NEVER merge** into `main` or `harness/integration`.
- **Local Mock GitHub API & Rate-Limit Stress Tests:** Spin up a local loopback mock GitHub REST API verifying `< 80/min` serialization, `Retry-After` / `x-ratelimit-reset` backoff, `If-None-Match` → `304` zero-quota polling, branch protection PR enforcement, `workflow` scope detection, and zero token leaks in `.git/config`!

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Implement Durable `ship_runs` Lifecycle Controller (`ShipRunStateMachine`):** Persist every Ship session cleanly in `state.db.ship_runs` (`PREFLIGHT → PUSH_APPROVAL → PUSHING → PR_OPEN → CI_WATCHING → CI_TRIAGING → CI_FIXING → CI_GREEN | CI_ESCALATED → DEPLOYING → SHIPPED`) so closing the app while a 10-minute GitHub Actions run executes resumes seamlessly at `CI_WATCHING` on reopen (`Task 130`)!
- [ ] **Implement Pre-Push Mandatory Safety & Secret Gate:** Before creating any `git_push` effect in `Task 176`, unconditionally run `Task 036` `gitleaks` secret scan over the exact commit range `origin/<base>..HEAD` + verify zero `.harness/views/` or `.env.local` files are tracked + verify local tests passed — blocking push immediately if a single secret appears!
- [ ] **Implement Canonical Graph-Generated Pull Request Builder (`GraphGeneratedPrBuilder`):** Generate a clean, reviewer-ready PR title & Markdown body directly from canonical `state.db` nodes and `Task 101` Landing Summary (ZERO generic `"Auto PR"` slop!):
  - Plain-English **Summary** of features built / bug fixed + linked requirements
  - Exact **Verification Receipts** table (unit, Playwright, sealed hidden checks, `STATIC_AUDIT`, UI consistency, `gitleaks`)
  - Explicit **Migrations & Env Vars Needed** section (strictly var NAMES only — zero secret values!)
  - Explicit **Human-Fixed / Delegated Decisions / Deferred Notes** transparency section + hidden `EF-Effect-Id` trailer for `Task 176` idempotent PR reconciliation!
  - Always show the full generated PR title & body inside the `ApprovalCard` (editable by the developer before clicking `Create PR`!)!
- [ ] **Implement Failed CI Log Fetcher & Redactor (`gh run view --log-failed` / REST Logs API):** When `ConditionalEtagPoller` (`Task 177`) reports a failed check run or Actions job, fetch strictly the **failed step logs only** (bounding to last `400` lines around first error + stripping ANSI escape codes + running `Task 011` secret redaction!) so CI triage stays concise, fast, and secret-safe!
- [ ] **Implement Deterministic + `ci-triage@1` 5-Class Failure Classifier (`FiveClassCiTriager`):** Classify EVERY CI failure strictly into one of the exact **5 operational classes** from [ship-and-deploy.md](ship-and-deploy.md):
  1. **`Class 1 — Real Code / Test / Type / Lint Regression`:** Genuine bug or missing file/export in our branch → eligible for bounded automated CI repair!
  2. **`Class 2 — Cross-OS / Environment Portability Mismatch` (Especially Windows → Linux Case-Sensitivity!):** e.g., `Cannot find module './OrderCard'` on Linux `ubuntu-latest` when file on disk is `./orderCard.tsx`, CRLF vs LF bash script line endings (`^M: bad interpreter`), or hardcoded `\` path separator! → **Handled by `LinuxCaseSensitivityAutoRepair`!**
  3. **`Class 3 — Transient CI Infra / Network Flake`:** GitHub runner outage, npm registry `503`, Playwright CDN timeout, Docker Hub `429` → do **NOT** edit code! Trigger at most `1` bounded `Re-run failed jobs` (with approval/policy) and escalate cleanly if runner stays down!
  4. **`Class 4 — Missing CI Secret / Org Permission / Workflow Config`:** e.g., `Error: secret STRIPE_TEST_KEY not set in GitHub Actions` → do **NOT** edit code! Emit ONE crisp `SecretCard`/`ToolCard` telling the developer the exact missing GitHub Actions secret or permission!
  5. **`Class 5 — Unrelated Pre-Existing Main Branch CI Failure`:** Same failing check already red on `origin/<base>` → report honestly with link to base failure instead of thrashing our PR!
- [ ] **Implement Dedicated Deterministic Windows → Linux Case-Sensitivity Auto-Repair (`LinuxCaseSensitivityAutoRepair`):** Directly satisfy the M6 roadmap certification check (`Task 200`!):
  - Parse Linux CI module-not-found / TS2307 / Rollup / Vite / Next.js / Python / Go case-mismatch errors (`Cannot find module './Components/Header'`, `Could not resolve "../utils/DateFormat"`)
  - Compare import specifier casing against exact real Git-tracked filenames (`git ls-files` — exact tree case!)
  - Deterministically rewrite the mismatched import path casing (or `git mv` via two-step temp rename on case-insensitive Windows NTFS: `git mv Foo.ts Foo.ts.__tmp && git mv Foo.ts.__tmp foo.ts` so Git ACTUALLY records the case change on Windows!!), verify cleanly in a local case-sensitivity linter (`Task 054`), commit, and push!
- [ ] **Implement Strict Bounded CI Repair Loop (`BoundedCiRepairLoop` — Max `3` Pushes Per Failure Fingerprint!):**
  - Hash every CI failure into a canonical `error_fingerprint` (`normalized error type + file + message`)
  - Allow at most **`3` repair pushes for the same `error_fingerprint`** (AND hard total cap `<= 5` auto-repair pushes per PR run!) — EVERY push verified locally first (`Task 055`), checked against `gitleaks`, and logged via `Task 176` `ExternalEffectLedger`!
  - If the same fingerprint still fails after Push #3 (or total cap hits), **STOP automatically** and surface a clear `"CI repair paused after 3 attempts on the same error — Inspect logs / Fix by hand"` card — NEVER entering an infinite push-fail-push loop burning Actions minutes!
- [ ] **Implement Zero-Auto-Merge-Without-Approval Policy:** When ALL CI checks turn green (`CI_GREEN`), celebrate cleanly in Ship View (`"All 4 CI checks passed — Ready to merge PR #42 or deploy!"`) and wait for explicit developer click before merging the PR or triggering Staging/Prod deploy (`Task 179`)!

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **Code built & passed 100% on Windows NTFS (`import { Header } from './Header'`), yet Git tracks `header.tsx` and GitHub Actions `ubuntu-latest` fails with `TS2307: Cannot find module './Header'`:** `FiveClassCiTriager` classifies `Class 2 (Linux case-sensitivity)`, `LinuxCaseSensitivityAutoRepair` resolves exact tracked `header.tsx` via `git ls-files`, fixes import casing (or two-step Windows `git mv`), verifies locally, pushes ONE surgical commit, and CI turns green!
- **A CI failure is caused by `Error: Missing repository secret DATABASE_URL` (`Class 4`):** Triage refuses to spawn a coding worker or edit code; it surfaces one crisp `SecretCard` (`"Add DATABASE_URL in GitHub Repo Settings → Secrets → Actions, then re-run CI"`)!
- **GitHub Actions fails due to `npm ERR! 503 Service Unavailable` (`Class 3` transient flake):** Triage triggers 1 clean `Re-run failed jobs` without making a bogus dummy commit!
- **CI repair pushes Fix #1, Fix #2, and Fix #3 for the exact same `playwright login timeout` fingerprint and it STILL fails:** `BoundedCiRepairLoop` hits `pushesForFingerprint === 3`, halts immediately (NEVER pushing Fix #4!), and escalates cleanly with full redacted logs!
- **Local commit before push accidentally includes a test `.env` with `AKIA...`:** Pre-push `gitleaks` gate hard-blocks the `git_push` effect BEFORE touching GitHub!
- **A shell script `.github/scripts/migrate.sh` committed on Windows has CRLF (`\r\n`) and fails on Linux with `/bin/bash^M: bad interpreter`:** `Class 2` auto-repair normalizes LF line endings + sets `git update-index --chmod=+x` cleanly!
- **Developer closes EF Harness while CI is running and reopens 20 minutes later:** `ship_runs` resumes in `CI_WATCHING`, polls `304`/latest check state cleanly, and presents `"PR #42 CI passed while you were away!"`!

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Strict Max-3-Pushes-Per-Fingerprint Invariant:** CI repair NEVER pushes more than 3 commits for the same failure fingerprint (or > 5 total pushes per ship run) before halting for human review.
- **Zero-Code-Edit-On-Infra/Secret-Failure Invariant:** `Class 3` (transient runner outage), `Class 4` (missing secret/perm), and `Class 5` (pre-existing base failure) NEVER spawn code-editing repair workers.
- **Two-Step Windows NTFS Case-Rename Invariant:** File-case fixes on Windows ALWAYS use two-step `git mv` (`A → A.__tmp → a`) verified via `git ls-files` so Linux Git receives the real case change.
- **Mandatory Local-Verify + `gitleaks` Before Every Push Invariant:** No initial push or CI-fix push can execute without passing local secret scan and local check suite first.
- **Zero-Unapproved-PR-Merge Invariant:** Green CI NEVER auto-merges a PR into a protected branch without explicit user approval.
- **Crash-Resumable `ship_runs` Invariant:** Closing or restarting EF Harness mid-CI never loses PR tracking or duplicates the PR.

#### Multi-Agent Harmony And Branch Isolation

- **Strict Subtree Boundary:** Touch ONLY `packages/ship-deploy/src/ci-loop/**`, `packages/ship-deploy/tests/ci-loop/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-178.md`.
- **Parallel Safe Execution:** Disjoint from `Tasks 176–177` and `Tasks 179–181`.
- **Handoff For `Task 179` (Post-CI Deploy Trigger), `Task 200` (M6 Linux Case-Sensitivity CI Auto-Repair Certification):** Export `ShipRunStateMachine`, `GraphGeneratedPrBuilder`, `BoundedCiRepairLoop`, `FiveClassCiTriager`, and `LinuxCaseSensitivityAutoRepair` in `.agent-handoffs/task-178.md`.
- **Commit-Only Discipline:** Commit exclusively on `task/178-push-pr-bounded-ci-repair`; **NEVER merge** into `main` or `harness/integration`.
- **5-Class Triage & Windows-to-Linux Case-Repair Tests:** Test all 5 CI classes, real two-step Windows `git mv` case-sensitivity auto-repair + CRLF repair, max-3-push cap termination, pre-push `gitleaks` block, and crash-resume at `CI_WATCHING`!

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Define Clean Pluggable `DeployAdapter` Contract (`packages/ship-deploy/src/deploy-adapters/interface.ts`):** Every host adapter implements one uniform, effect-ledger-backed contract:
  - `probeAuth()` (verify Vercel token / SSH key + remote Docker daemon reachability read-only)
  - `planDeploy(env, commitSha)` (dry-run summary: target URL/host, image/build diff, **name-only** env diff, estimated downtime/swap strategy)
  - `syncEnv(env, diffPlan)` (push ONLY changed env vars from DPAPI vault directly to host over encrypted channel — strictly **name-only diff** in Approval Cards & logs!)
  - `deploy(env, commitSha, effectId)` (idempotent deployment tagged with `EF-Effect-Id` + build ID returning `{ deploymentId, liveUrl, buildId, previousDeploymentId }`)
  - `reconcile(effectId, commitSha)` (read-only lookup for `Task 176` `UnknownOutcomeReconciler`!)
  - `rollback(env, targetDeploymentId, effectId)` (instant atomic promotion/container swap back to exact previous known-good release!)
- [ ] **Implement v1 Adapter #1 — Official `VercelDeployAdapter` (Owner v1 Decision in [open-design-questions.md](open-design-questions.md)):**
  - Authenticate via Vercel Personal/Team token stored strictly in DPAPI (`Task 120`) or verified existing `vercel` CLI session
  - Support **`preview`** (branch preview URL), **`staging`** (custom staging target/branch), and **`production`** (`vercel deploy --prod` / Vercel REST Deployments API with immutable build ID metadata!)
  - Sync environment variables via Vercel Env Vars API scoped strictly by target (`preview` / `development` / `production`), showing **ONLY variable names** (`+ RESEND_API_KEY (added)`, `~ STRIPE_KEY (updated)`, `- OLD_FLAG (removed)`) in the Approval Card and NEVER logging plaintext values!
  - Implement instant zero-rebuild **`rollback()`** via Vercel's Instant Rollback API (`POST /v9/projects/{id}/rollback/{deploymentId}`) back to `previousDeploymentId`!
- [ ] **Implement v1 Adapter #2 — Production-Hardened `DockerOverSshDeployAdapter` (Owner v1 Decision in [open-design-questions.md](open-design-questions.md)):**
  - Connect strictly with verified host key pinning (**`StrictHostKeyChecking=yes`** with explicit user-confirmed `known_hosts` fingerprint on first connect — NEVER blind `StrictHostKeyChecking=no` MITM-vulnerable SSH!) and DPAPI/ssh-agent key auth!
  - Build tagged immutable Docker image (`<app>:<commitSha>` + healthcheck + non-root container lint check!), transfer cleanly (registry push or `docker save | zstd | ssh docker load`!), write runtime env strictly via `0600` ephemeral remote env-file piped over SSH stdin (NEVER passing secret values on remote `docker run -e SECRET=...` command line where `ps aux` leaks them!!), and perform **health-gated blue/green or rolling container swap** (keeping `<app>:<previousSha>` image cached locally on the remote host so `rollback()` swaps back in `< 5 s`!)!
  - Support Compose (`docker compose up -d --wait`) cleanly when `compose.yaml` is present, verifying container `healthy` status before cutting traffic!
- [ ] **Implement Strict Name-Only Diff `syncEnv` Vault Push (`NameOnlySyncEnvController`):** Compare local DPAPI vault env names + salted HMAC digests (`Task 120`) against remote host env names (and previously synced digests) to display an exact clean diff (`2 added, 1 changed, 0 deleted — [names only]`) inside `Task 176` `ApprovalCard`, blocking any `sk_live_` secret from syncing to `preview` (`Task 120`!) and blocking any `sk_test_` secret from silently syncing to `production` without explicit warning!
- [ ] **Enforce Strict Preview / Staging / Production Approval Tiers (`Task 176`):**
  - `preview`: asks once or honors explicit user preview-auto setting
  - `staging`: ALWAYS requires explicit `ApprovalCard`
  - `production`: ALWAYS requires explicit payload-bound `ApprovalCard` showing exact commit SHA, target domain/host, name-only env diff, and migration status (`Task 180`)!
- [ ] **Implement Pre-Deploy Health-Endpoint & Build-ID Verification Contract:** Require/verify the deployed app exposes a lightweight build-ID / health metadata endpoint (or Docker `HEALTHCHECK`) so `Task 181` Post-Deploy Verification can prove the NEW release `commitSha` is actually serving live traffic (not a cached stale version!)!
- [ ] **Keep Post-v1 Managed Container Hosts Cleanly Deferred Behind `DeployAdapter`:** Keep Fly.io / Railway / Render / Cloud Run cleanly out of v1 scope (`Out Of Scope`), validating the pluggable `DeployAdapter` interface cleanly so they slot in post-v1 with zero core refactor!
- [ ] **Implement Strict SSH Command Injection & Path Hygiene:** Pass every remote Docker image tag, container name, and compose path strictly validated against strict regex allowlists (`^[a-zA-Z0-9._:/-]+$`) with zero unescaped shell interpolation!

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **First time deploying via `DockerOverSshDeployAdapter` to `deploy@198.51.100.12`:** Adapter fetches server's ED25519 SSH host fingerprint, shows it clearly inside a `ToolCard`/`ApprovalCard` (`"Trust SSH host 198.51.100.12? Fingerprint: SHA256:..."`), pins it into harness `known_hosts`, and refuses connection if the fingerprint ever unexpectedly changes later (MITM protection!)!
- **`DockerOverSshDeployAdapter` injects 6 production secrets into the container:** Piped strictly over encrypted SSH stdin into a `chmod 0600` container env file (or Docker secret) — verified `0` secret values appear in remote `ps aux`, shell history, or local `effects` logs!
- **Developer accidentally puts `sk_test_123` into `production` env scope OR `sk_live_456` into `preview` env scope:** `NameOnlySyncEnvController` catches BOTH mismatches BEFORE `syncEnv` Approval (`"Warning: Stripe TEST key detected for Production"` / `"Refused: Stripe LIVE key blocked from Preview"`)!
- **New Docker container crashes (`CrashLoopBackOff` / unhealthy) during swap on remote VPS:** Health-gated swap aborts BEFORE stopping the previous healthy container, keeping live traffic up and reporting exact redacted container startup logs!
- **Network drops right after triggering Vercel `POST /v13/deployments`:** `Task 176` `UnknownOutcomeReconciler` invokes `VercelDeployAdapter.reconcile(effectId, commitSha)` to find the exact in-progress Vercel deployment URL instead of launching a duplicate deploy!
- **Image tag or project name contains shell metacharacters (`app; rm -rf /`):** Strict regex validation rejects the invalid tag BEFORE invoking SSH or Docker!
- **Developer clicks `Rollback Production` on Vercel or Docker/SSH:** Routes through `Task 176` explicit Production Approval Card and restores `previousDeploymentId` / `<app>:<previousSha>` cleanly in seconds!

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Exact v1 Host Scope Invariant:** v1 ships production-grade `VercelDeployAdapter` and `DockerOverSshDeployAdapter` behind the clean `DeployAdapter` contract.
- **Name-Only Env Diff Invariant:** `syncEnv` Approval Cards, logs, and `effects` rows NEVER display or log plaintext environment secret values (names + change types only).
- **Zero-CLI-Argv-Secret On Remote Host Invariant:** Docker-over-SSH NEVER passes secrets via `docker run -e KEY=VALUE` argv; secrets pass exclusively via `0600` stdin-piped env files/secrets.
- **Strict SSH Host-Key Pinning Invariant:** SSH connections ALWAYS enforce `StrictHostKeyChecking=yes` with explicit user-confirmed host fingerprints.
- **Health-Gated Atomic Swap Invariant:** Remote containers/deployments must pass health probes before replacing live traffic, keeping previous releases cached for fast rollback.
- **Production-Test-Key & Preview-Live-Key Cross-Guard Invariant:** Live keys are blocked from `preview`, and test keys raise explicit warning blocks on `production`.

### Task 180: Live Expand-Then-Contract Production Migration Engine (All 6 Phases: Rehearse → Snapshot Backup → Additive Expand → App Deploy → Pausable Batched Backfill → Approved Contract w/ Export)

- **Milestone & Track:** `M6 · Zero-Downtime Expand-Then-Contract Production Database Migrations`
- **Depends On:** `Task 001`, `Task 052`, `Task 110`, `Task 120`, `Task 176`, `Task 179`
- **Git Worktree & Branch:** `task/180-live-expand-contract-migrations` in `../ef-wt/task-180-live-expand-contract-migrations` (commit on own branch only; **NEVER merge**)
- **Owned Write Scope (Disjoint Subtree):** `packages/ship-deploy/src/live-migrations/**`, `packages/ship-deploy/tests/live-migrations/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-180.md`
- **Mandatory Reference Files:** [ship-and-deploy.md](ship-and-deploy.md#live-database-migrations-expand-then-contract), [database-design.md](database-design.md), [schema/state.sql](schema/state.sql), [ship-and-deploy.mmd](ship-and-deploy.mmd), [research/ci-and-deployment.md](research/ci-and-deployment.md)
- **Shared Contracts Consumed / Produced:** Consumes `TemplateDbSeeder` (`Task 052`), `MigrationIntentAndConflictLinter` (`Task 110`), `WindowsDpapiSecretsVault` (`Task 120`), `ExternalEffectLedger` & `EnvApprovalPolicyEngine` (`Task 176`), `DeployAdapter` (`Task 179`); produces `ExpandContractMigrationOrchestrator`, `DdlSafetyClassifier`, `PausableBatchedBackfillRunner`, and `ContractPhaseExportGuard`

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Implement Strict DDL Safety Classifier (`DdlSafetyClassifier`):** Parse EVERY outgoing production SQL migration AST BEFORE execution to classify exact safety hazards deterministically:
  - **`SAFE_ADDITIVE` (Expand-eligible):** `CREATE TABLE`, `ADD COLUMN ... NULL` (or fast metadata-only default), `CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY`, adding new enum values, new views/triggers
  - **`LOCK_HAZARD` (Requires online rewrite!):** `CREATE INDEX` without `CONCURRENTLY` on Postgres, `ADD COLUMN ... NOT NULL` without default on large tables, `ALTER COLUMN TYPE` rewriting table with `ACCESS EXCLUSIVE` lock! → Automatically flags & rewrites/guides safe `lock_timeout = '2s'` + `statement_timeout` + `NOT VALID` constraint validation!
  - **`DESTRUCTIVE_CONTRACT` (`DROP COLUMN`, `DROP TABLE`, `RENAME COLUMN`, `DELETE`/`TRUNCATE`):** **UNCONDITIONALLY FORBIDDEN** during Phase 3 (`Expand`) — strictly quarantined into Phase 6 (`Contract`) AFTER dual-read/dual-write deploy + backfill + explicit user confirmation + data export!
- [ ] **Implement The Exact 6-Phase Expand-Then-Contract Production State Machine (`ExpandContractMigrationOrchestrator` — Persisted Durably In `state.db`!):**
  - **Phase 1 — Rehearse Locally (`REHEARSE`):** Apply the exact migration SQL against a realistic local clone of schema + synthetic production-scale rows (`Task 052`), verifying `0` SQL errors, clean lock profile, AND verifying BOTH the **OLD app version (`N-1`)** AND the **NEW app version (`N`)** pass smoke tests against the expanded schema (zero-downtime backward-compatibility proof!)!
  - **Phase 2 — Verified Snapshot Backup (`BACKUP`):** Before executing a single DDL statement against Staging/Production, trigger a verified database backup/snapshot (via provider snapshot API or `pg_dump --format=custom` / SQLite online backup API to a verified checksummed backup artifact!) and **HARD-BLOCK Phase 3 if backup fails or is unverified** (requiring explicit written risk override only if user's DB host manages external continuous PITR snapshots attested cleanly!)!
  - **Phase 3 — Additive Expand (`EXPAND`):** Under explicit `Task 176` `ApprovalCard` + strict `SET lock_timeout = '3s'` + retry backoff on transient lock contention, execute ONLY verified `SAFE_ADDITIVE` expand DDL (leaving old columns/tables 100% intact so currently-running `N-1` production pods keep serving with zero errors!)!
  - **Phase 4 — Deploy Dual-Compatible App (`APP_DEPLOY`):** Trigger `Task 179` `DeployAdapter.deploy()` rolling out the new app release `N` (which writes to both/new schema safely and reads seamlessly across expanded columns!), verified by `Task 181` Post-Deploy Health Check!
  - **Phase 5 — Pausable, Idempotent, Batched Backfill (`BACKFILL` via `PausableBatchedBackfillRunner`):** For any data migration/backfill across existing rows:
    - Execute in small **keyset-paginated batches** (`batchSize = 500–1,000` rows strictly by primary key cursor, NEVER `OFFSET` or single million-row `UPDATE` locking the whole table!) with adaptive inter-batch sleep (`100–500 ms`) throttling cleanly if DB latency spikes!
    - Persist exact `{ lastProcessedPk, rowsProcessed, rowsRemainingEst, batchErrors }` in `state.db` after EVERY batch so clicking **`Pause`**, **`STOP`**, or losing Wi-Fi resumes strictly from `lastProcessedPk + 1` with **zero duplicate work** (idempotent `WHERE new_col IS NULL` guard!)!
  - **Phase 6 — Explicitly Approved Contract With Pre-Drop Data Export (`CONTRACT` via `ContractPhaseExportGuard`):** Strictly separated from initial deploy (typically after Phase 4+5 are proven healthy in live traffic!):
    - Verify zero active queries/errors reference the deprecated column/table AND Phase 5 backfill reached `100%` (`remaining === 0`)!
    - Export a timestamped CSV/JSONL/SQL archive of any about-to-be-dropped column/table data to a verified local/backup location FIRST!
    - Require a dedicated, loud, payload-bound **`Production Destructive Contract ApprovalCard`** (`Task 176`) explicitly listing the exact `DROP` statements and exported archive path before executing!
- [ ] **Implement Automatic `lock_timeout` Protection On Production Postgres:** Wrap every live DDL execution in `SET LOCAL lock_timeout = '3000ms'` with up to `3` jittered retries so a DDL statement can NEVER sit queued behind a slow report query and pile up an `ACCESS EXCLUSIVE` lock queue that takes down the entire live website!
- [ ] **Implement Idempotent Rollback Safety Between Phases:** Because Phase 3 (`Expand`) is strictly additive and preserves old columns intact, rolling back Phase 4 (`App Deploy`) back to `N-1` (`Task 179`/`181`) works instantaneously with **ZERO database corruption and ZERO data loss**!
- [ ] **Implement Transparent Live Backfill Progress Strip:** Stream exact live progress (`"Backfilling orders.total_cents: 42,500 / 50,000 rows (85%) · 12 ms/batch · Pause"`) to Ship View without noisy logs!
- [ ] **Implement Zero-Backfill / Zero-Contract Fast Path:** When a deploy contains ONLY simple additive migrations (e.g., adding a brand-new `dietary_tags` table with no backfill and no drop), cleanly execute Phases `1 → 2 → 3 → 4` and automatically mark Phases `5` and `6` `not_applicable`!

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **Developer's migration contains `ALTER TABLE orders DROP COLUMN legacy_price;` mixed into the same SQL file as `ADD COLUMN price_cents INTEGER;`:** `DdlSafetyClassifier` hard-rejects mixing `DESTRUCTIVE_CONTRACT` into Phase 3 (`Expand`), guiding clean split into Phase 3 Expand (`ADD COLUMN`) + Phase 5 Backfill + Phase 6 Contract (`DROP COLUMN`)!
- **Phase 2 Snapshot Backup fails (`pg_dump: connection refused` or disk full):** Phase 3 (`Expand`) is **HARD-BLOCKED** (`BackupRequiredBeforeLiveMigrationError`) — zero production DDL ever runs without verified backup protection!
- **Phase 5 Backfill is at `63%` (`31,500 / 50,000` rows) when user clicks `Pause` or laptop sleeps:** Exact keyset cursor `lastProcessedPk = 31500` commits cleanly to `state.db`; on Resume, backfill picks up cleanly at `id > 31500` with idempotent `WHERE target IS NULL`!
- **Phase 4 App Deploy fails Post-Deploy Health Check (`Task 181`) and rolls back to App `N-1`:** Because Phase 3 was strictly additive and Phase 6 (`DROP`) has NOT run yet, App `N-1` resumes serving live traffic cleanly with **0 schema errors and 0 lost rows**!
- **A live production table has an active long-running analytics query holding a read lock when Phase 3 `ALTER TABLE` runs:** `SET LOCAL lock_timeout = '3000ms'` cleanly aborts the DDL attempt after 3 s (preventing site-wide connection pileup!), waits jittered backoff, and succeeds cleanly once the analytics query finishes!
- **Phase 1 Rehearsal proves App `N-1` crashes on the expanded schema because a new `NOT NULL` column omitted a `DEFAULT`:** Caught 100% locally in Phase 1 BEFORE touching production!
- **User tries to run Phase 6 `DROP COLUMN` while Phase 5 Backfill still has `420` `NULL` rows remaining:** `ContractPhaseExportGuard` hard-blocks Phase 6 (`BackfillIncompleteError: 420 rows still unmigrated`)!

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Zero-Destructive-DDL-In-Expand Invariant:** `DROP`, `RENAME`, and narrowing `ALTER` statements are unconditionally forbidden in Phase 3 (`Expand`).
- **Backup-Before-Mutate Invariant:** No Staging/Production DDL runs without a verified Phase 2 snapshot backup (or explicitly attested external PITR).
- **Backward-Compatible Rehearsal Invariant:** Phase 1 proves BOTH App `N-1` and App `N` pass against the expanded schema before live rollout.
- **Lock-Timeout Site-Safety Invariant:** Live DDL ALWAYS enforces bounded `lock_timeout` so migrations cannot stall live production traffic.
- **Keyset-Pausable-Idempotent Backfill Invariant:** Phase 5 backfills use strictly primary-key keyset pagination, durable cursor checkpoints, adaptive throttling, and idempotent predicates.
- **Export-Before-Contract Invariant:** Phase 6 `DROP` migrations require `100%` complete backfill, verified data export archive, and fresh explicit payload-bound Production Approval.

#### Multi-Agent Harmony And Branch Isolation

- **Worktree Setup:** Create branch `task/180-live-expand-contract-migrations` via `node scripts/agent-worktree.mjs create 180 live-expand-contract-migrations`.
- **Strict Subtree Boundary:** Touch ONLY `packages/ship-deploy/src/live-migrations/**`, `packages/ship-deploy/tests/live-migrations/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-180.md`.
- **Parallel Safe Execution:** Disjoint from `Tasks 176–179` and `Task 181`.
- **Handoff For `Task 181` (Post-Deploy Phase 4 Verification Gate & Safe Rollback):** Export `ExpandContractMigrationOrchestrator`, `DdlSafetyClassifier`, `PausableBatchedBackfillRunner`, and `ContractPhaseExportGuard` in `.agent-handoffs/task-180.md`.
- **Commit-Only Discipline:** Commit exclusively on `task/180-live-expand-contract-migrations`; **NEVER merge** into `main` or `harness/integration`.
- **Real Local SQLite/Postgres 6-Phase Tests:** Execute all 6 phases end-to-end against a real local database with 5,000 synthetic rows, simulating mixed-DDL rejection, Phase-2 backup failure block, Phase-5 mid-backfill pause/resume at row 2,500, Phase-4 rollback compatibility with App `N-1`, and Phase-6 pre-drop export + approval!

### Task 181: Post-Deploy Verification, External Registrations & Auto-Rollback (Health/Build-ID Check, Deployed Playwright Smoke, 10-Min Error Watch, Auto-Rollback Preview/Staging + Offered Prod Rollback & Webhook/DNS Receipts)

- **Milestone & Track:** `M6 · Post-Deploy Verification, Error Watch & Safe Rollback`
- **Depends On:** `Task 001`, `Task 057`, `Task 121`, `Task 176`, `Task 179`, `Task 180`
- **Git Worktree & Branch:** `task/181-post-deploy-verify-rollback` in `../ef-wt/task-181-post-deploy-verify-rollback` (commit on own branch only; **NEVER merge**)
- **Owned Write Scope (Disjoint Subtree):** `packages/ship-deploy/src/post-deploy/**`, `packages/ship-deploy/tests/post-deploy/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-181.md`
- **Mandatory Reference Files:** [ship-and-deploy.md](ship-and-deploy.md#post-deploy-verification-and-rollback), [verification-for-real-apps.md](verification-for-real-apps.md), [ship-and-deploy.mmd](ship-and-deploy.mmd), [ship-and-deploy.svg](ship-and-deploy.svg), [research/ci-and-deployment.md](research/ci-and-deployment.md)
- **Shared Contracts Consumed / Produced:** Consumes `UiPlaywrightContractVerifier` (`Task 057`), `HumanStepProbeRegistry` (`Task 121`), `ExternalEffectLedger` & `EnvApprovalPolicyEngine` (`Task 176`), `DeployAdapter` (`Task 179`); produces `PostDeployVerifier`, `TenMinuteErrorWatchMonitor`, `EnvironmentRollbackPolicyController`, and `ExternalRegistrationReceiptManager`

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Implement Live Health & Exact Build-ID Verification (`PostDeployVerifier.verifyHealthAndBuildId`):** Immediately after `DeployAdapter.deploy()` reports live URL ready, poll the deployed target (`<= 60 s` bounded warmup retries) verifying:
  1. Valid TLS certificate + HTTP `200` on declared health endpoint (`/api/health` or `/`)
  2. Exact **deployed Build-ID / Commit SHA match** (`response.buildId === expectedCommitSha` or expected deploy header/meta tag) — proving the NEW version is genuinely live and not masked behind a stale CDN/proxy cache!
  3. Safe non-leaking headers (zero stack traces, `/__styleguide` confirmed `404` in production, zero `data-ef-source` attributes in production HTML!)!
- [ ] **Implement Strictly Non-Destructive Read-Only Deployed Playwright Smoke Suite (`PostDeployVerifier.runDeployedSmoke`):** Execute a compact, strictly **read-only / non-destructive** Playwright smoke check against the live deployed URL (loading key public/health routes at `375px` + `1440px`, asserting HTTP `< 400`, `0` uncaught JS console errors, `0` failed static asset/CSS/font `404`s, `0` broken images, and valid title/shell mount) — **UNCONDITIONALLY FORBIDDING mutating production customer data, sending live emails, or hitting live Stripe endpoints** during post-deploy smoke!
- [ ] **Implement 10-Minute Post-Deploy Error Watch (`TenMinuteErrorWatchMonitor`):** After initial health & smoke checks pass on Staging/Production, run a calm, low-overhead **10-minute post-deploy observation window** (polling host logs/metrics API on Vercel or `docker logs --since` over SSH every `30 s` — zero spam!) tracking HTTP `5xx` error rates, unhandled runtime exceptions, and container restart counts; if a sudden spike breaches error thresholds (`>= 3` consecutive health fails, container crash loop, or `5xx` rate spike > threshold), immediately trigger `EnvironmentRollbackPolicyController`!
- [ ] **Implement Strict Environment-Aware Rollback Policy (`EnvironmentRollbackPolicyController`):** Enforce the exact rollback governance from [ship-and-deploy.md](ship-and-deploy.md):
  - **`preview` & `staging`:** On failed health/Build-ID check, failed deployed smoke, or 10-minute error watch crash spike → execute **AUTOMATIC safe rollback** (`DeployAdapter.rollback(env, previousDeploymentId)`) logged via `Task 176`, verify `previousDeploymentId` returns healthy, and emit a crisp failure report with exact failing smoke screenshot & redacted runtime logs!
  - **`production`:** NEVER silently auto-rollback production behind the user's back (because production rollback can interact with live customer writes or active Phase 4 migrations!) — instead, immediately raise a **`P0` Interrupt-Now Production Alert Card** (`Task 127`) showing the exact failing health/smoke/5xx evidence AND a prominent 1-click **`Approve Rollback to <previousSha> Now`** button (plus **`Investigate / Keep Live`**), executing atomic `DeployAdapter.rollback()` through `Task 176` the instant the developer confirms!
- [ ] **Implement External Registration & Webhook/DNS Receipt Manager (`ExternalRegistrationReceiptManager`):** Track every external post-deploy wiring step cleanly (`custom domain DNS CNAME/A/TXT`, `Stripe live webhook endpoint registration`, `OAuth redirect URI registration`, `Resend/SMTP domain DKIM/SPF verification`):
  - Provide crisp copyable values (`Webhook URL: https://app.example.com/api/webhooks/stripe`, `Signing events: checkout.session.completed, ...`)
  - Run automated read-only verification probes (`Task 121`: DNS `resolveTxt`/`resolveCname`, TLS HTTPS reachability, signed test-ping where safe!)
  - Persist verifiable **External Registration Receipts** (`{ registrationType, targetUrlOrDomain, probeStatus: 'verified' | 'attested', verifiedAt, evidence }`) in `state.db`!
- [ ] **Implement Non-Blocking Early-Completion Option On 10-Min Watch:** Allow the developer to minimize/continue working smoothly during the 10-minute error watch (or dismiss the watch early once satisfied), completing `ship_runs.state = 'SHIPPED'` cleanly with full deploy & verification receipt!
- [ ] **Implement Secret-Redacted Runtime Log Capture:** Run EVERY fetched Vercel/Docker runtime log line through `Task 011` `PacketSecurityRedactor` BEFORE storing in CAS or displaying in Ship View!
- [ ] **Implement Final `Shipped` Release Receipt:** Persist `{ shipRunId, env, commitSha, liveUrl, deploymentId, healthPassedAt, smokeReceiptSha, tenMinWatchVerdict, registrations[], rollbackTargetId }` cleanly in `state.db`!

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **Vercel deploys successfully (`200 OK`), yet `/api/health` still returns OLD `buildId: old_sha` due to misconfigured alias/cache:** Build-ID verifier detects `old_sha !== new_sha` cleanly and flags `StaleDeploymentBuildIdMismatch` instead of falsely declaring success!
- **Staging deploy boots healthy at `t = 0`, yet starts crashing with `500` DB-connection errors at `t = 4 min`:** `TenMinuteErrorWatchMonitor` catches the spike at minute 4, triggers **automatic Staging rollback** back to `previousDeploymentId`, confirms previous release is `200 OK`, and notifies the user with exact redacted logs!
- **Production deploy fails Playwright smoke (`ReferenceError: window is not defined` on `/orders`):** `EnvironmentRollbackPolicyController` does NOT silently roll back production — it immediately raises a `P0` Interrupt-Now Card with the exact console error + 1-click **`Approve Production Rollback to <prevSha>`**!
- **Production HTML response accidentally contains `/__styleguide` (`200 OK`) or `data-ef-source="..."`:** `PostDeployVerifier` catches the dev-artifact leak in production immediately and raises a high-priority warning!
- **User configures custom domain `kitchen.example.com` and clicks `"Verify DNS"`:** `ExternalRegistrationReceiptManager` queries DNS `CNAME`/`TXT` + checks live TLS cert expiry and stamps `verified` receipt (or exact `"CNAME still points to old.host — DNS propagation may take a few minutes"` diagnostic)!
- **10-minute watch loses local laptop Wi-Fi at minute 6:** Watch logs `"Local internet offline — watch paused, live app unaffected"` cleanly without falsely claiming the remote server crashed or triggering a bogus rollback!
- **Deployed Playwright smoke encounters a route requiring login on Production:** Read-only smoke checks ONLY public routes + unauthenticated redirect hygiene (`302`/`401` confirming protected routes stay locked!) without mutating live production accounts!

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Build-ID Proof Invariant:** Post-deploy health verification proves exact `expectedCommitSha` is live before declaring deploy green.
- **Strictly Read-Only Live Smoke Invariant:** Deployed Playwright smoke checks NEVER mutate production customer data, submit live payments, or trigger live customer emails.
- **Auto-Rollback Preview/Staging vs Explicit-Approve Production Invariant:** Failed `preview`/`staging` deploys auto-rollback safely; failed `production` deploys raise an immediate `P0` alert offering 1-click approved rollback (never silent unapproved prod rollback!).
- **Local-Offline-Not-Remote-Crash Invariant:** Local laptop internet drops during the 10-minute watch NEVER trigger false remote rollbacks.
- **Zero-Dev-Artifact-In-Prod Invariant:** Post-deploy check confirms `/__styleguide` is `404` and zero `data-ef-source` attributes exist in production HTML.
- **Honest External Registration Receipt Invariant:** DNS/webhook/OAuth registrations record exact `verified` (probe-passed) vs `attested` receipts cleanly.

- **Strict Subtree Boundary:** Touch ONLY `packages/ship-deploy/src/post-deploy/**`, `packages/ship-deploy/tests/post-deploy/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-181.md`.

- **Commit-Only Discipline:** Commit exclusively on `task/181-post-deploy-verify-rollback`; **NEVER merge** into `main` or `harness/integration`.

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Implement Strict 6-Stage Scientific Investigation State Machine (`MysteryBugInvestigationPipeline`):** Enforce hard deterministic stage gates persisted in `state.db.investigations` so AI agents NEVER jump straight to guessing random band-aid patches on mysterious bugs ([investigations-and-sweeps.md](investigations-and-sweeps.md)):
  - **Stage 1 — `INTAKE`:** Ingest scrubbed `SymptomCard` (`Task 100`: HAR, mapped stack frames, failing inputs, browser/OS notes, expected vs observed behavior) + L1 code map around suspected routes/symbols (`Task 167`), asking the developer ONLY targeted missing repro facts if essential!
  - **Stage 2 — `CLEAN_REPRO` (Hard Gate — Zero Production Code Edits Permitted!):** Inside an isolated read-only-app worktree, author a standalone automated reproduction test (unit, API, or Playwright script) and **PROVE it reproduces the exact failure fingerprint cleanly** (`fails on baseline` with matching error class/symptom — and for intermittent bugs, proves reliable trigger rate under deterministic seed/concurrency!). Cannot advance to Stage 3 without a verified failing repro OR explicit developer approval of an instrumentation-only fallback!
  - **Stage 3 — `QUARANTINED_LOCALIZE`:** Run temporary diagnostic logging, `git bisect`, browser diffing, and delta-debugging (`Task 183`) strictly inside a **quarantined scratch worktree** (guaranteeing zero temporary `console.log` / debug probes ever leak into the final fix commit!), maintaining an explicit structured **Hypothesis Ledger** (`{ hypothesisId, prediction, experiment, result: 'confirmed' | 'falsified' }`)!
  - **Stage 4 — `PROVEN_MINIMAL_FLIP_ROOT_CAUSE` (`MinimalFlipRootCauseProver`):** Before authorizing any production fix, require `investigator@1` to articulate the EXACT root cause (file, symbol, causal mechanism) AND **PROVE IT via a Minimal-Flip Experiment** — toggling/instrumenting ONLY that minimal causal condition makes the Stage 2 repro flip deterministically `RED → GREEN` (and reverting flips it right back `GREEN → RED`!), proving causation rather than coincidence!
  - **Stage 5 — `SCOPED_FIX`:** Discard the quarantined Stage 3 scratch instrumentation cleanly, open a fresh clean fix worktree on `harness/integration`, apply ONLY the minimal surgical production fix addressing the proven mechanism (guarded by `Task 183`'s Symptom-Patch Detector against `try/catch {}` / `setTimeout` / `null`-swallowing band-aids!), and pass `CleanVerifierHarness` (`Task 055`) + full regression suite!
  - **Stage 6 — `PERMANENT_REPRO_AND_MECHANISM_TESTS`:** Commit TWO durable tests alongside the fix: (1) the cleaned-up **end-to-end Repro Test** (proving the user's exact reported symptom fails on pre-fix commit and passes post-fix!) AND (2) a focused **Mechanism Unit Test** pinning the underlying invariant/edge case so the same bug class can never regress via a different UI path!

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **Agent tries to skip Stage 2 (`CLEAN_REPRO`) and immediately edit `src/orders/cutoff.ts`:** `StageGateEnforcer` hard-blocks writes to `src/` during Stage 2 (`ProductionEditsForbiddenBeforeReproError`) until a failing repro script is proven!
- **Stage 3 scratch worktree has 14 `console.log('[DEBUG-99]', ...)` lines scattered across 6 files:** Stage 5 discards the Stage 3 scratch worktree completely and starts a brand-new clean worktree from `harness/integration` HEAD so **0 debug logs ever enter the fix commit**!
- **Agent claims root cause is `"stale React state"`, yet toggling that state in Stage 4 leaves the Stage 2 repro STILL FAILING:** `MinimalFlipRootCauseProver` rejects the falsified hypothesis immediately and forces continued Stage 3 localization!
- **Stage 2 repro test passes on the pre-fix base commit (meaning it didn't actually reproduce the bug!):** Stage 2 gate detects `exitCode === 0` on baseline and rejects (`ReproMustFailOnBaseError`)!
- **Bug cannot be reproduced after 4 clean attempts (prod-only Safari/timezone quirk without enough HAR data):** Pipeline pauses honestly with exact tried environments + `"Need Safari version / sample payload — or add targeted telemetry?"` (ZERO blind guesswork patches!)!
- **Fix passes the Stage 2 Repro Test but skips writing a Mechanism Unit Test:** Stage 6 gate checks BOTH repro + mechanism test presence and red-before-green failure on base before accepting!
- **Production fix resolves the reported bug but breaks 1 existing baseline test:** Stage 5 `CleanVerifierHarness` catches the regression immediately before landing!

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Repro-Before-Fix Invariant:** Zero production code edits are permitted before a verified baseline-failing reproduction exists (unless user explicitly opts into instrumentation-only escalation).
- **Zero-Leaked-Instrumentation Invariant:** Stage 3 diagnostic logging runs in an isolated scratch worktree that is unconditionally discarded before Stage 5 fix authoring.
- **Minimal-Flip Causal Proof Invariant:** Every root-cause claim MUST pass a verified bidirectional flip test (`RED → GREEN → RED`) before Stage 5 opens.
- **Dual Permanent Test Invariant:** Every finished investigation ships BOTH a permanent Repro Test and a Mechanism Test verified red-before-green against pre-fix base.
- **Hypothesis-Ledger Honesty Invariant:** Every tested and falsified hypothesis is recorded durably in `state.db`, preventing agents from re-testing already-falsified guesses.
- **Zero-Blind-Speculative-Fix Invariant:** Unreproducible bugs escalate honestly for missing repro data rather than shipping unverified patches.

### Task 183: Investigation Localization Toolkit (Flake-Safe `git bisect run` 5/5 Stability + Fingerprint + Exit 125 + Revert Verify, WebKit/Chromium Diff Runner, Delta-Debugging Shrinker, Hypothesis Loop Guard & Symptom-Patch Detector)

- **Depends On:** `Task 001`, `Task 035`, `Task 038`, `Task 057`, `Task 182`

- **Owned Write Scope (Disjoint Subtree):** `packages/investigations/src/localization/**`, `packages/investigations/tests/localization/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-183.md`
- **Mandatory Reference Files:** [investigations-and-sweeps.md](investigations-and-sweeps.md#localization-tools-and-symptom-patch-detection), [verification-for-real-apps.md](verification-for-real-apps.md), [investigations-and-sweeps.mmd](investigations-and-sweeps.mmd), [research/debugging-and-codemods.md](research/debugging-and-codemods.md)

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Implement Flake-Safe `git bisect run` Engine (`FlakeSafeGitBisector`):** Execute automated Git regression bisection inside a quarantined scratch worktree with 4 battle-tested anti-misattribution safeguards from [investigations-and-sweeps.md](investigations-and-sweeps.md):
  1. **5/5 Endpoint Stability Pre-Check:** Before bisecting, run the repro script **`5` times** on known-bad `HEAD` (must fail `5/5` with the EXACT same failure fingerprint!) and **`5` times** on candidate known-good ancestor (must pass `5/5`!) — refusing noisy bisect on flaky repros until stabilized!
  2. **Exact Failure Fingerprint Matching:** Every bisect step checks NOT just `exitCode !== 0`, but whether the failure matches the **exact target error fingerprint** — returning **exit code `125` (`git bisect skip`)** whenever an intermediate historical commit fails to compile, fails `pnpm install`, or hits an UNRELATED crash so broken intermediate commits NEVER corrupt the bisect search!
  3. **Automated Revert Verification Proof:** Once `git bisect` identifies suspect commit `C_bad`, deterministically verify by testing `git revert --no-commit C_bad` (or `C_bad~1` vs `C_bad` direct diff): confirm `C_bad~1` passes `3/3` and `C_bad` fails `3/3` with the exact fingerprint — proving `C_bad` truly introduced the regression!
  4. **Clean `git bisect reset` Guarantee:** Unconditionally clean up bisect state in `finally`!
- [ ] **Implement Cross-Browser WebKit vs Chromium Differential Runner (`CrossBrowserDiffRunner`):** For browser-specific UI/CSS/date/clipboard bugs (`"Works in Chrome, breaks in Safari/WebKit!"`), run the exact Stage 2 Playwright repro script side-by-side in **Chromium AND WebKit** (and Firefox when installed!), capturing differential console errors, network status, computed styles, DOM bounding boxes, and screenshots — immediately isolating exact engine divergence!
- [ ] **Implement Automated Delta-Debugging (`ddmin`) Input & Reproduction Shrinker (`DeltaDebuggingInputShrinker`):** When a bug triggers only on a huge 500-line JSON payload, 20-step UI sequence, or large CSV/Markdown document, run classic Zeller **`ddmin`** binary-partition minimization (bounded `<= 40` repro evaluations!) to shrink the failing input down to a **1-minimal failing fixture** (e.g., a 3-line JSON or 2-step sequence that still triggers the exact failure fingerprint!) — making root-cause diagnosis & Stage 6 permanent tests crystal clear!
- [ ] **Implement Hypothesis Loop & Tunnel-Vision Guard (`HypothesisLoopGuard`):** Monitor the Stage 3 Hypothesis Ledger (`Task 182`) deterministically:
  - Hard-block proposing a duplicate or semantically identical hypothesis already marked `falsified`!
  - Detect **3 consecutive falsified hypotheses inside the same narrow subsystem/file** (`tunnel_vision_trigger`) and automatically force a step-back diagnostic pivot (broadening search to callers, DB/serialization boundary, middleware, or `git bisect`!) before burning more turns!
- [ ] **Implement Deterministic AST/Diff Symptom-Patch Detector (`SymptomPatchDetector`):** Intercept Stage 5 candidate fixes BEFORE acceptance and flag classic AI band-aid / symptom-masking anti-patterns that hide bugs instead of fixing root causes:
  1. **Empty or Swallowing `catch` Blocks (`catch (e) {}` / `catch { return null; }`)** newly added around the failing call site!
  2. **Arbitrary `setTimeout` / `sleep` Delays (`await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 500))`)** added to mask a race condition or missing `await`!
  3. **Blind Optional-Chaining / Default-Zero Paper-Over (`foo?.bar?.baz ?? []` or `if (!x) return;`)** added at the symptom crash line WITHOUT fixing why `x` became unexpectedly `undefined`/`null` upstream!
  4. **Test-Weakening / Retry-Wrapping** (`test.retries(5)`, loosening assertion tolerances, deleting edge-case checks)!
  - Flagged candidates require EITHER a genuine upstream mechanism fix OR explicit reasoned justification verified by `reviewer@1` (`Task 102`) / human developer!
- [ ] **Implement Bounded Bisect Window & Shallow-Clone Guard:** Handle shallow Git clones (`git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository`) gracefully (`"Repo is a shallow clone — bisect limited to available commits"`), and bound bisect depth cleanly (`<= 256` commits / `<= 8` steps)!
- [ ] **Implement Deterministic Failure-Fingerprint Normalizer:** Strip volatile timestamps, random UUIDs, temp paths, and memory addresses from stack traces before hashing the failure fingerprint so identical bugs hash identically across bisect commits!
- [ ] **Implement Clean Structured Localization Artifacts:** Store bisect suspect commit, WebKit-vs-Chromium diff JSON, minimal `ddmin` input, and symptom-patch audit results in CAS (`Task 028`) for the Investigation Receipt (`Task 182`)!

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **Commit #4 of an 8-commit Git history has a broken `tsc` syntax error completely unrelated to our runtime bug:** `FlakeSafeGitBisector` sees compile failure (`fingerprint !== targetFingerprint`), returns exit code **`125` (`skip`)**, and STILL pinpoints exact guilty commit #6 cleanly!
- **Stage 2 repro is flaky (`fails 3/5` on `HEAD`):** 5/5 stability pre-check catches the flake immediately and refuses bisect (`FlakyReproBlocksBisectError`), guiding deterministic clock/seed stabilization first instead of pointing at a random innocent commit!
- **A bug reproduces on a 256-item JSON array:** `DeltaDebuggingInputShrinker` runs `ddmin` in `~18` fast evaluations and shrinks it down to the exact 2 conflicting items `[item_42, item_189]` that trigger the duplicate-key crash!
- **Date parsing `new Date("2026-11-19 10:30")` works in Chromium yet produces `Invalid Date` in Safari/WebKit:** `CrossBrowserDiffRunner` captures Chromium `PASS` vs WebKit `FAIL (Invalid Date)` side-by-side immediately!
- **Agent tries to "fix" a `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'cutoff')` by adding `try { ... } catch { return true; }` OR `await sleep(300)`:** `SymptomPatchDetector` catches BOTH anti-patterns in AST diff inspection and hard-rejects the band-aid patch before Stage 5 passes!
- **Agent proposes 3 slightly reworded variations of `"maybe the CSS z-index is wrong"` when all 3 failed:** `HypothesisLoopGuard` catches tunnel vision on hypothesis #3 and forces broadening to DOM/event/API layers!
- **Repro fails ONLY in WebKit, and WebKit browser binary is not installed yet:** `CrossBrowserDiffRunner` degrades cleanly and surfaces a crisp `ToolCard` (`Task 121`: `"Install Playwright WebKit?"`) instead of crashing!

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **5/5-Stability-Before-Bisect Invariant:** `git bisect` NEVER runs on a noisy/flaky repro that fails `< 5/5` on bad or passes `< 5/5` on good.
- **Exact-Fingerprint + Exit-125 Skip Invariant:** Broken intermediate commits return exit `125` (`git bisect skip`) rather than falsely marking unrelated errors as `bad`.
- **Verified-Suspect-Revert Invariant:** Every bisected commit `C_bad` is cross-verified (`C_bad~1` passes `3/3`, `C_bad` fails `3/3`) before claiming it as the culprit.
- **Bounded `ddmin` Minimization Invariant:** Input shrinking caps strictly at `<= 40` evaluations and guarantees the shrunk output reproduces the EXACT same failure fingerprint.
- **Zero-Silent-Symptom-Patch Invariant:** Empty `catch` blocks, arbitrary `setTimeout`/`sleep` race masks, blind crash-site guard paper-overs, and test weakening are flagged deterministically in Stage 5.
- **Zero-Tunnel-Vision Loop Invariant:** Repeated or narrow-subsystem consecutive falsified hypotheses trigger automatic diagnostic pivot.

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Implement Deadlock-Free Two-Phase `path_leases` Manager (`SweepLeaseCoordinator` — `intent → granted`):** Leverage `state.db.path_leases` (`Task 020`) so a repo-wide refactor/rename sweep NEVER collides catastrophically with parallel feature workers AND NEVER deadlocks with another sweep ([investigations-and-sweeps.md](investigations-and-sweeps.md)):
  - **Phase 1 (`intent`):** Register all target paths/globs (or `repo_wide` lease) in `path_leases(status = 'intent')` atomically — immediately blocking any NEW feature tasks overlapping those paths from claiming work (stopping starvation of the sweep!) while letting already-active in-flight feature tasks finish cleanly!
  - **Phase 2 (`granted`):** Transition `intent → granted` atomically inside `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` the instant `0` active overlapping feature tasks or merge-queue items remain!

  - **`ast-grep` (`sg`):** Fast multi-language structural AST pattern transforms (TS/JS/Python/Go/Rust/CSS/HTML!)
  - **`jscodeshift`:** Standardized JS/JSX/React codemods!
  - Run all codemods strictly inside `Task 045`/`048` sandboxed execution with dry-run diff preview (`N` files changed, `+X/-Y` lines) BEFORE applying!

PLUS (b) **Bounded `sweep-worker@1` Tail Shards** (strictly `<= 8` files per shard for nuanced edge cases/prose/tests that AST rules cannot mechanically transform!)!

- [ ] **Implement Clean Atomic Abort & Lease Release On `STOP`:** Clicking `STOP` during `intent` draining OR mid-sweep immediately aborts safely, deletes/parks `harness/s/<sweep-slug>` without touching `harness/integration`, and releases all `path_leases` so paused feature tasks resume immediately!

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes
