### Task 185: Sweep Safety Guards (Variant-Expanded Reference Inventory w/ Persisted-Name Gate, Characterization Tests, Risky-AST Detector, Leftover Scan, Re-Sync Recompute & Queued-Brief Symbol-Map Updater)

- **Milestone & Track:** `M6 · Repo-Wide Sweep Safety, Persisted-Name & Post-Sweep Re-Sync Guards`
- **Depends On:** `Task 001`, `Task 017`, `Task 087`, `Task 088`, `Task 167`, `Task 170`, `Task 184`
- **Git Worktree & Branch:** `task/185-sweep-safety-guards-resync` in `../ef-wt/task-185-sweep-safety-guards-resync` (commit on own branch only; **NEVER merge**)
- **Owned Write Scope (Disjoint Subtree):** `packages/investigations/src/sweep-guards/**`, `packages/investigations/tests/sweep-guards/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-185.md`
- **Mandatory Reference Files:** [investigations-and-sweeps.md](investigations-and-sweeps.md#sweep-safety-guards), [knowledge-slicing.md](knowledge-slicing.md), [investigations-and-sweeps.mmd](investigations-and-sweeps.mmd), [research/debugging-and-codemods.md](research/debugging-and-codemods.md)
- **Shared Contracts Consumed / Produced:** Consumes `KnowledgeGraphRepo` (`Task 017`), `KnowledgePacketSlicer` (`Task 088`), `CompactCodeMapQueryService` (`Task 167`), `CharacterizationSafetyNetPlanner` (`Task 170`), `SweepOrchestrator` (`Task 184`); produces `VariantExpandedReferenceInventory`, `PersistedNameBoundaryGate`, `RiskyAstTransformDetector`, `SweepLeftoverScanner`, and `PostSweepBriefSymbolUpdater`

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Implement Variant-Expanded Reference Inventory With Hard Persisted-Name Gate (`VariantExpandedReferenceInventory` + `PersistedNameBoundaryGate`):** Before ANY rename/refactor sweep runs, deterministically expand the target symbol across ALL naming conventions (`camelCase`, `PascalCase`, `snake_case`, `SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE`, `kebab-case`, plural/singular forms, e.g. `MealOrder`, `mealOrder`, `meal_order`, `MEAL_ORDER`, `meal-order`, `meal_orders`) and scan the entire repo via `code-index.db` + ripgrep, classifying EVERY occurrence into 2 strict safety zones ([investigations-and-sweeps.md](investigations-and-sweeps.md)):
  - **`Zone 1 — Internal Code Symbols`** (TS/JS/Python identifiers, filenames, internal React components, internal helper imports → safe for codemod rename!)
  - **`Zone 2 — Persisted / External Wire Names`** (SQL table/column names, JSON API request/response keys, env var names `MEAL_ORDER_*`, `localStorage`/cookie keys, URL route slugs, webhook event types, CSS custom property tokens, i18n keys, CLI flag names!) — **HARD-GATED (`PersistedNameBoundaryGate`):** default strictly to **`KEEP EXTERNAL/PERSISTED NAMES UNCHANGED`** (inserting clean mapping boundary if needed!), requiring an explicit user decision (`"Also rename persisted DB table / API JSON key via Expand-Then-Contract migration?"`) BEFORE touching ANY Zone 2 name so a routine TypeScript rename can NEVER silently corrupt live user databases, break API clients, or wipe browser `localStorage`!
- [ ] **Implement Pre-Sweep Behavior-Preserving Characterization Guard:** When a refactor sweep touches modules lacking test coverage, invoke `Task 170` `CharacterizationSafetyNetPlanner` BEFORE transforming code — proving behavior-preserving equivalence (`baseline tests + characterization tests` pass identically BEFORE and AFTER the sweep with zero semantic drift)!
- [ ] **Implement Deterministic Risky-AST Transform Detector (`RiskyAstTransformDetector`):** Inspect the full post-codemod AST diff on `harness/s/<sweep>` BEFORE landing and flag dangerous accidental semantic mutations that syntactic codemods can trigger:
  1. **Dynamic Property / Reflection Access (`obj[key]`, `Object.keys`, `eval`, `JSON.parse` cast, template-string SQL/route keys)** referencing the renamed identifier that a static rename might have missed or broken!
  2. **Shadowed Variable / Scope Capture Collisions** (renaming `item → order` inside a function that ALREADY declares local variable `const order = ...`, silently capturing the wrong binding!)
  3. **Serialization / ORM Column-Name Coupling** (e.g., Drizzle/Prisma/TypeORM field renamed without `@map("old_col")` accidentally triggering a destructive DB column drop!)
  4. **Control-Flow / Boolean-Negation Inversion or Side-Effect Reordering** in structural `ast-grep` transforms!
- [ ] **Implement Post-Sweep Leftover & Broken-Reference Scanner (`SweepLeftoverScanner`):** After the codemod + tail shards complete on `harness/s/<sweep>`, re-run the exact `VariantExpandedReferenceInventory` scan across ALL Zone 1 code files, test files, config files, and docs — verifying **`0` accidental unrenamed Zone 1 leftovers** (every remaining hit MUST be explicitly accounted for in Zone 2 persisted-name exclusions or historical changelog/migration files!)!
- [ ] **Implement Post-Sweep Re-Sync Checklist Recompute & `code-index.db` Refresh:** Immediately after `harness/s/<sweep>` lands onto `harness/integration`, refresh `code-index.db` (`Task 167`) + `name_registry` (`Task 019`) + `state.db` entity/file references and deterministically recompute affected task checklists & write-scope globs (`old_path → new_path`)!
- [ ] **Implement Queued-Brief Symbol-Map Updater (`PostSweepBriefSymbolUpdater`):** Solve the classic multi-wave stale-plan hazard! Whenever a repo-wide sweep lands while `Queued` / paused tasks from earlier planning STILL reference old filenames or old symbol names (`OrderCard.tsx` → `MealOrderCard.tsx`, `getUser()` → `getAccount()`):
  - Persist an immutable **`sweep_symbol_map`** (`{ sweepId, oldPath → newPath, oldSymbol → newSymbol, persistedExclusions[] }`) in `state.db`
  - Deterministically rewrite `write_scope[]` paths on queued tasks AND inject a crisp compact **`[RECENT SWEEP SYMBOL MAP]`** header (`<= 300` tokens) into the compiled `MUST` brief (`Task 088`) of every pending task planned before the sweep (plus mark affected active/re-entering branches for smart freshness sync `Task 110`!) so NO queued worker tries to recreate deleted old filenames or import old deleted symbol names!
- [ ] **Implement Historical Migration Immutability Guard:** Unconditionally exclude already-applied historical SQL migration files (`migrations/*.sql`, `prisma/migrations/**`) from codemod rewrites so sweeps NEVER mutate checksummed migration history!
- [ ] **Implement Complete Sweep Audit Scorecard:** Record `{ filesChanged, codemodCount, tailShardCount, zone2ExcludedCount, riskyAstFlagsCleared, leftoverCount, queuedBriefsUpdatedCount }` in `state.db.sweep_runs`!

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **Developer requests `"Rename OrderItem to MealOrderItem across the codebase"`:** `VariantExpandedReferenceInventory` finds 42 TypeScript references (`Zone 1`), 1 Prisma model `@map("order_items")` (`Zone 2`), 1 REST JSON field `order_item_id` (`Zone 2`), and 2 historical `.sql` migration files (immutable!). `PersistedNameBoundaryGate` defaults all Zone 2 names to **PRESERVED** (keeping DB + API wire compatibility 100% intact while renaming all 42 TS symbols cleanly!)!
- **Renaming `user → account` inside `checkout.ts` collides with an existing local parameter `account` in `processRefund(user, account)`:** `RiskyAstTransformDetector` catches the exact variable-shadowing binding clash BEFORE commit and routes that 1 function to safe scoped rename (`userAccount` or manual disambiguation)!
- **Codemod misses 2 dynamic string keys `router.push('/order-item/' + id)` and 1 test file comment:** `SweepLeftoverScanner` surfaces those exact 3 residual occurrences with line numbers before the sweep can pass!
- **A Prisma model field `orderItem` is renamed to `mealOrderItem` without `@map("order_item")`:** `RiskyAstTransformDetector` catches ORM column-name drift immediately (preventing accidental production column drop!) and adds `@map("order_item")` cleanly!
- **12 Wave-2 tasks were already queued referencing `src/components/OrderCard.tsx` before the sweep renamed it to `src/components/MealOrderCard.tsx`:** `PostSweepBriefSymbolUpdater` deterministically updates all 12 queued tasks' `write_scope[]` AND injects the compact symbol map into their briefs so Wave 2 compiles cleanly with `0` phantom old-file recreations!
- **Sweep attempts to edit `migrations/20261110_create_orders.sql`:** Historical migration immutability guard hard-blocks any write to historical migrations!
- **Leftover scan finds `0` Zone 1 leftovers and `0` risky AST flags:** Sweep passes safety gate cleanly and lands atomically!

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Persisted-Name-Safe-Default Invariant:** DB tables/columns, API JSON keys, env vars, `localStorage`/cookie keys, routes, and historical migrations are NEVER silently renamed by a code sweep without explicit user approval.
- **Zero-Binding-Shadowing Invariant:** `RiskyAstTransformDetector` verifies renamed identifiers never collide with existing in-scope local variables or ORM column bindings.
- **Zero-Unaccounted-Leftover Invariant:** Every variant (`camelCase`, `PascalCase`, `snake_case`, `kebab-case`, `SCREAMING_SNAKE`) remaining after a sweep must be explicitly accounted for in Zone 2 exclusions or immutable migrations.
- **Zero-Historical-Migration-Mutation Invariant:** Already-applied migration files are unconditionally read-only to all sweeps.
- **Zero-Stale-Queued-Brief Invariant:** Every queued task planned pre-sweep automatically receives updated `write_scope[]` paths and the compact `sweep_symbol_map`.
- **Behavior-Equivalence Proof Invariant:** Pre-existing + characterization tests MUST pass identically before and after any refactoring sweep.

#### Multi-Agent Harmony And Branch Isolation

- **Worktree Setup:** Create branch `task/185-sweep-safety-guards-resync` via `node scripts/agent-worktree.mjs create 185 sweep-safety-guards-resync`.
- **Strict Subtree Boundary:** Touch ONLY `packages/investigations/src/sweep-guards/**`, `packages/investigations/tests/sweep-guards/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-185.md`.
- **Parallel Safe Execution:** Disjoint from `Tasks 182–184` and `Tasks 186–188` (`packages/portability/**`).
- **Handoff For `Task 088` (Slicer Symbol-Map Injection Hook), `Task 184` (Pre/Post Sweep Safety Gates), `Task 189`/`200` (Sweep Benchmark Set):** Export `VariantExpandedReferenceInventory`, `PersistedNameBoundaryGate`, `RiskyAstTransformDetector`, `SweepLeftoverScanner`, and `PostSweepBriefSymbolUpdater` in `.agent-handoffs/task-185.md`.
- **Commit-Only Discipline:** Commit exclusively on `task/185-sweep-safety-guards-resync`; **NEVER merge** into `main` or `harness/integration`.
- **Adversarial Sweep-Hazard Tests:** Test full 6-variant expansion, Zone 1 vs Zone 2 persisted-name separation (SQL/JSON/env/`localStorage`/migrations), variable-shadowing detection, Prisma `@map` ORM hazard detection, leftover detection, and queued-brief `write_scope[]` + symbol-map rewriting!

### Task 186: Incremental Orphan-Branch Portability Exporter (`harness-state`, Sorted Per-Entity YAML, Append-Only `history/*.jsonl`, `age`-Encrypted `checks-sealed/*.age`, `git fast-import` & Public-Repo Guard)

- **Milestone & Track:** `M6 · Git-Native Project Portability & Encrypted Sync Export`
- **Depends On:** `Task 001`, `Task 007`, `Task 017`, `Task 035`, `Task 091`, `Task 177`
- **Git Worktree & Branch:** `task/186-orphan-branch-portability-exporter` in `../ef-wt/task-186-orphan-branch-portability-exporter` (commit on own branch only; **NEVER merge**)
- **Owned Write Scope (Disjoint Subtree):** `packages/portability/src/exporter/**`, `packages/portability/tests/exporter/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-186.md`
- **Mandatory Reference Files:** [projects-portability-and-sync.md](projects-portability-and-sync.md), [open-design-questions.md](open-design-questions.md), [database-design.md](database-design.md), [projects-portability-and-sync.mmd](projects-portability-and-sync.mmd), [projects-portability-and-sync.svg](projects-portability-and-sync.svg), [research/portability-and-sync.md](research/portability-and-sync.md)
- **Shared Contracts Consumed / Produced:** Consumes `CanonicalHash` (`Task 007`), `KnowledgeGraphRepo` (`Task 017`), `MinGitRepoInspector` (`Task 035`), `HiddenCheckPoolStore` (`Task 091`), `GitHubAuthConnector` visibility check (`Task 177`); produces `OrphanBranchPortabilityExporter`, `SortedPerEntityYamlSerializer`, `AgeSealedChecksEncryptor`, `GitFastImportWriter`, and `PublicRemotePushGuard`

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Implement Zero-Checkout Incremental Orphan-Branch Exporter (`OrphanBranchPortabilityExporter` → `refs/heads/harness-state`):** Export canonical project knowledge, specs, decisions, features, history, and sealed checks onto a dedicated **orphan Git branch `harness-state`** (`0` shared history with `main`, NEVER polluting the developer's source tree or working directory!) strictly via **`git fast-import`** piped over stdin after a **`10-second` quiet debounce** (NEVER checking out `harness-state` into any working folder, completing incremental updates of changed entities in `< 150 ms`!)!
- [ ] **Implement Deterministic Per-Entity Sorted YAML Layout (`SortedPerEntityYamlSerializer`):** Serialize canonical `state.db` entities into crisp, Git-diff-friendly, merge-friendly files with strictly sorted keys and LF newlines so two computers or diffs produce minimal clean patches:
  - `manifest.yaml` (`schemaVersion`, `projectId`, `exportedAt`, `canonicalGraphSha256`, `deviceId`, `writerEpoch`)
  - `lease.yaml` (single-writer lease metadata consumed by `Task 187`!)
  - `decisions/<id>.yaml`, `requirements/<id>.yaml`, `entities/<id>.yaml`, `contracts/<id>.yaml`, `features/<id>.yaml`, `screens/<id>.yaml`, `rules/<id>.yaml`, `tasks/<id>.yaml`, `edges/<source_id>.yaml`
  - **Append-Only Sharded History (`history/YYYY-MM-<device_short>.jsonl`):** Write immutable append-only history/audit records into per-month/per-device `.jsonl` segments so history logs NEVER produce merge conflicts!
  - **UNCONDITIONALLY EXCLUDE** all DPAPI secrets, API keys, OAuth tokens, `.env` values, raw HARs, ephemeral `telemetry.db` samples, `code-index.db`, and local absolute OS paths (`C:\Users\Ayush\...`)!
- [ ] **Implement `age`-Encrypted Sealed Hidden Checks (`AgeSealedChecksEncryptor` → `checks-sealed/*.age`):** Encrypt EVERY sealed hidden acceptance check from `Task 091` (`oracle-author@1`) using standard **`age` (`age-encryption` X25519)** BEFORE writing into `checks-sealed/<feature_id>.age` on `harness-state` (with the project's `age` private key stored strictly in Windows DPAPI `Task 120` + optional user-exportable recovery passphrase/key!) — ensuring sealed checks sync safely across the developer's laptops without exposing unencrypted hidden checks in Git history!
- [ ] **Implement Strict Public-Repo Off-By-Default Push Guard (`PublicRemotePushGuard` — Owner Decision in [open-design-questions.md](open-design-questions.md)):**
  - Local `harness-state` orphan branch updates stay 100% local by default!
  - **Public GitHub / Git Remotes:** Pushing `harness-state` to a **public** remote is **STRICTLY OFF BY DEFAULT**! Enabling push to a public remote requires explicit opt-in AFTER a loud plain-English warning (`"This repository is PUBLIC. Pushing 'harness-state' makes your specs, decisions, and design history publicly readable on GitHub (secrets remain excluded and sealed checks are encrypted). Are you sure?"`)!
  - **Private Remotes:** Ask **once** on first push (`"Sync harness-state branch to private remote 'origin' for backup & cross-device sync?"`) and remember preference cleanly per project!
- [ ] **Implement Pre-Export Secret & PII Verification Gate:** Scan EVERY serialized YAML / JSONL buffer through `Task 011` `PacketSecurityRedactor` + `gitleaks` pattern check BEFORE feeding bytes into `git fast-import` — hard-aborting export if ANY residual secret pattern is ever detected (`SecretDetectedInPortabilityExportError`)!
- [ ] **Implement True Incremental Delta Fast-Import (`GitFastImportWriter`):** Track `lastExportedRevisionByEntity` in `state.db` so modifying 2 decisions emits ONLY 2 `M 100644 inline ...` operations (and `D <path>` for deleted entities) on top of `from refs/heads/harness-state` in `git fast-import` — keeping 300-entity incremental exports under **`< 100 ms`**!
- [ ] **Implement Canonical Round-Trip Determinism Proof:** Exporting identical `state.db` state twice produces zero new commit (no-op when `canonicalGraphSha256` unchanged!) and identical sorted YAML tree hashes!
- [ ] **Implement Clean `harness-state` GC & History Compaction Option:** Prevent runaway orphan branch growth over years by keeping `checks-sealed/*.age` deduplicated by hash and bounding `history/*.jsonl` segment sizes cleanly (`<= 2 MB` per segment)!

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **Developer's repository is `PUBLIC` on GitHub (`github.com/user/open-tool`), and developer clicks Ship / Sync:** `PublicRemotePushGuard` keeps `harness-state` push strictly **OFF** by default (NEVER silently pushing internal design transcripts/decisions to a public GitHub branch!); only explicit post-warning opt-in enables it!
- **Developer's repository is `PRIVATE`:** On first sync/push, asks ONCE cleanly (`"Sync harness-state to private origin?"`), remembers user's Yes/No choice cleanly!
- **A decision note accidentally contains a pasted `sk_live_...` string that bypassed earlier checks:** Pre-export secret gate catches the secret pattern BEFORE `git fast-import` runs, aborts cleanly with exact node ID, and offers `Task 030` 8-step secret purge!
- **Developer edits 5 nodes within 4 seconds:** `10-second` quiet debounce coalesces all 5 edits into ONE clean `harness-state` commit via `git fast-import` instead of spamming 5 micro-commits!
- **300-entity project modifies 1 requirement:** Incremental `git fast-import` updates ONLY `requirements/REQ-42.yaml`, `manifest.yaml`, and appends 1 line to `history/2026-11-<dev>.jsonl` in `< 100 ms` with **ZERO working-directory checkout or file-watcher noise**!
- **Sealed hidden check `CHK-07` exists in `state.db`:** Exporter writes `checks-sealed/F-Orders.age` strictly encrypted (`-----BEGIN AGE ENCRYPTED FILE-----`) — raw plaintext check assertions appear **0 times** anywhere on `harness-state`!
- **Project has NO changes since last `harness-state` commit:** Exporter checks `canonicalGraphSha256`, skips creating an empty redundant commit cleanly!

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Zero-Working-Tree-Checkout Invariant:** `harness-state` writes exclusively via `git fast-import` directly into Git's object DB — never checking out or touching the user's workspace files.
- **Public-Remote-Off-By-Default Invariant:** Pushing `harness-state` to any public remote is disabled by default and requires explicit post-warning opt-in.
- **Zero-Plaintext-Sealed-Check Invariant:** 100% of `checks-sealed/*.age` files on `harness-state` are `age`-encrypted; zero plaintext sealed oracle code enters Git.
- **Zero-Secret-In-Export Invariant:** Pre-export secret scan blocks any credential, API key, token, or absolute host user path from entering `harness-state`.
- **Append-Only History Segment Invariant:** `history/YYYY-MM-<device>.jsonl` files are append-only and device-sharded to prevent merge conflicts.
- **No-Op On Unchanged Graph Invariant:** Exporting identical canonical state creates 0 redundant commits.

#### Multi-Agent Harmony And Branch Isolation

- **Worktree Setup:** Create branch `task/186-orphan-branch-portability-exporter` via `node scripts/agent-worktree.mjs create 186 orphan-branch-portability-exporter`.
- **Strict Subtree Boundary:** Touch ONLY `packages/portability/src/exporter/**`, `packages/portability/tests/exporter/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-186.md`.
- **Parallel Safe Execution:** Disjoint from `Task 187` (`src/rehydration/**`) and `Task 188` (`src/broker/**`).
- **Handoff For `Task 187` (Rehydration, Zip & Lease Takeover), `Task 198` (300-Entity Export Scale Test), `Task 199` (Zero-Secret Export Audit):** Export `OrphanBranchPortabilityExporter`, `SortedPerEntityYamlSerializer`, `AgeSealedChecksEncryptor`, `GitFastImportWriter`, and `PublicRemotePushGuard` in `.agent-handoffs/task-186.md`.
- **Commit-Only Discipline:** Commit exclusively on `task/186-orphan-branch-portability-exporter`; **NEVER merge** into `main` or `harness/integration`.
- **Real `git fast-import` & `age` Encryption Tests:** Run real `git fast-import` against a local temp Git repo with 300 synthetic entities, verifying `< 100 ms` incremental export, real `age` encrypt/decrypt (asserting 0 plaintext oracle bytes in `git cat-file`), 10s quiet debounce, public-repo off-by-default block, and pre-export secret abort!

  - Persist `lease.yaml` on `harness-state`: `{ activeDeviceId, activeDeviceLabel, writerEpoch: integer, leasedAtUtc, heartbeatAtUtc, buildActive: boolean }`
  - On open/fetch from remote, compare remote `lease.yaml` against local `(deviceId, writerEpoch)`:
    - **Case 1 — Same `deviceId` & matching `writerEpoch`:** Active single writer — full read/write access!
    - **Case 2 — Different `deviceId` holds active lease (`remote.activeDeviceId !== local.deviceId`):** Open cleanly in **`Read-Only Viewer Mode`** by default (`"Currently active on 'Desktop-PC' (last seen 4m ago) — Viewing read-only · Take over editing"`), disabling worker dispatch, graph edits, and external effects (`Task 176`) cleanly!
    - **Case 3 — Explicit Fenced Non-FF Takeover (`Take Over Lease`):** User explicitly clicks `"Take over on this machine"`: increments `newEpoch = remote.writerEpoch + 1`, writes `lease.yaml` with `(localDeviceId, newEpoch)`, and pushes **STRICTLY NON-FORCE (`git push --force-with-lease=refs/heads/harness-state:<expectedRemoteSha>` — NEVER blind `--force`!)**! If Laptop A pushed concurrently in the exact same second, non-FF push fails cleanly, re-fetches, and prevents silent data loss!
    - **Fencing Stale Laptop A:** The instant Laptop A tries its next `harness-state` push or external effect check and sees `remote.writerEpoch (5) > local.writerEpoch (4)`, Laptop A **IMMEDIATELY transitions to Read-Only Fenced Mode** and pauses any active build cleanly (`"Control was taken over by 'Laptop-B' — paused safely to prevent conflicts"`)!
- [ ] **Implement Hard Force-Push Guard On `harness-state`:** Unconditionally forbid raw `git push --force` on `harness-state`; all lease takeovers and syncs strictly verify remote ref ancestry / expected SHA so another device's committed history is NEVER overwritten!
- [ ] **Implement Graceful Lost-Key Sealed-Oracle Regeneration (`LostKeyOracleRegenerator`):** What if a developer opens their synced project on a new laptop and LOST their `age` recovery key for `checks-sealed/*.age`?
  - Rehydrate 100% of decisions, specs, requirements, architecture, features, tasks, and history cleanly (`0` project knowledge lost!)
  - Detect `checks-sealed/*.age` cannot be decrypted cleanly (NEVER crashing rehydration!)
  - Show ONE crisp card: `"Sealed acceptance checks are encrypted with a key from your other device — Enter recovery key, OR regenerate fresh sealed checks from your specs (~$0.12)"`, cleanly invoking `Task 091` `IndependentOracleAuthorSealer` strictly from canonical specs to re-seal new hidden checks under the new device's `age` key!
- [ ] **Implement Rehydration Schema Version Forward-Compatibility & Upcaster Hook:** Apply `Task 015`/`132` upcasters automatically when importing an older `manifest.yaml` `schemaVersion` onto a newer EF Harness release, and cleanly refuse newer unsupported `schemaVersion`s!
- [ ] **Implement Clean Local-Device Identity (`device_id` + Friendly Hostname Label):** Generate one stable non-PII UUID `device_id` per installation in `global.db` alongside an editable friendly label (`"Work Laptop"`, `"Home Desktop"`).
- [ ] **Implement Full Round-Trip Parity Proof (`Export → Rehydrate → Re-Export`):** Verify `state.db → harness-state → fresh state.db` preserves 100% of nodes, edges, history, statuses, bases, rollups, and FTS5 search parity with identical `canonicalGraphSha256`!

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **Laptop A (`writerEpoch = 4`) is offline on a plane while Laptop B takes over (`writerEpoch = 5`) and finishes Wave 2; Laptop A lands and reconnects:** Laptop A attempts non-FF sync, sees `remote.writerEpoch (5) > local (4)`, immediately fences itself into Read-Only Mode, and preserves any offline Laptop A edits safely as a conflict-inspectable local branch instead of force-overwriting Laptop B's Wave 2!
- **Laptop B opens a project while Laptop A is actively building:** Laptop B opens cleanly in **Read-Only Viewer Mode** (`"Active on Laptop-A · Read-only"`), letting the user browse Canvas, Specs, and Board safely with zero accidental concurrent writes!
- **User opens synced project on Laptop B and forgot their `age` key for `checks-sealed/*.age`:** `OrphanBranchRehydrator` restores 100% of specs/decisions/features cleanly and `LostKeyOracleRegenerator` offers 1-click regeneration of sealed checks from specs!
- **Malicious `.ef-project.zip` contains a zip-slip path `../../../../Windows/System32/evil.dll`:** `PortableZipArchiveManager` rejects any entry escaping target staging root or containing `..` / absolute paths BEFORE extracting a single byte!
- **Two laptops click `"Take Over Lease"` at the exact same millisecond (`both trying epoch 4 → 5`):** Git `--force-with-lease=<expectedOldSha>` guarantees strictly ONE wins atomically at the remote; the loser gets clean non-FF rejection, re-fetches `epoch 5`, and enters Read-Only cleanly!
- **Imported YAML file on `harness-state` was manually corrupted by a broken third-party edit:** Strict Zod validation + `canonicalGraphSha256` check catches the exact corrupt file/line before committing and rolls back the SQLite rebuild transaction cleanly!
- **User exports `.ef-project.zip` and imports it on an air-gapped computer with zero Git remote:** Full project rehydrates cleanly with `0` network calls and zero missing metadata!

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Lossless Round-Trip Hash Invariant:** `Export (`Task 186`) → Rehydrate (`Task 187`)` produces an identical `canonicalGraphSha256` across 100% of canonical graph entities, edges, and history.
- **Single-Writer Fenced Epoch Invariant:** At most ONE device holds the active `writer_epoch` lease; stale devices fence immediately into Read-Only Mode upon seeing a higher `writer_epoch`.
- **Zero-Blind-Force-Push Invariant:** `harness-state` NEVER runs blind `git push --force`; all remote pushes verify expected remote SHA (`--force-with-lease`).
- **Default-Read-Only On Foreign Active Lease Invariant:** Opening a project currently leased by another device ALWAYS defaults safely to Read-Only Viewer Mode until explicit user takeover.
- **Zero-Data-Loss Lost-Key Recovery Invariant:** Missing an `age` decryption key NEVER blocks rehydration of specs/decisions/code history and cleanly supports regenerating sealed checks from canonical specs.
- **Zip-Slip Immunity Invariant:** `.ef-project.zip` import strictly rejects path-traversal (`..`), symlink entries, and oversize zip-bombs before extraction.

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Implement Machine-Wide Multi-Project Resource Broker (`GlobalMultiProjectBroker` Backed By `global.db`):** Coordinate concurrency, provider allowance windows, API spend caps, Pool-2 Warm Execution Slots, and Heavy-Lane permits cleanly across **multiple simultaneously open EF Harness projects** (e.g., Project A running a big Wave 2 build in background while the developer opens Project B for interactive Discovery & a quick bug fix!) — strictly zero cross-DB `ATTACH` (communicating solely via `Task 024`'s atomic `global.db.grants` protocol!)!
- [ ] **Implement Exact 4-Class Weighted Fair Queuing (`WeightedFairQueueArbiter`):** Schedule provider & execution requests across competing projects strictly by canonical operational class ([projects-portability-and-sync.md](projects-portability-and-sync.md)):
  1. **`interactive` (Highest Priority — Weight `8`):** Live user Discovery turns, Canvas Q&A (`ask-owner-responder@1`), Steering `router@1`, Point-to-Fix `visual-steer@1`!
  2. **`foreground` (Weight `4`):** Active focused window's build workers & verifiers!
  3. **`background` (Weight `2`):** Other open / tray-minimized project builds!
  4. **`batch` (Weight `1`):** Optional background brownfield L2 refreshes, Meta-Lab eval sweeps, low-priority refactors!
  - Weighted fair queuing guarantees BOTH crisp responsiveness for the foreground/interactive project AND guaranteed zero-starvation forward progress for background builds!
- [ ] **Enforce Mandatory Reserved Interactive Slot Per Connection:** Reserve strictly `1` lightweight interactive fast-lane slot per active connection whenever `cwnd >= 2` (or strict immediate preemption on next turn boundary when `cwnd === 1`) so chatting/discovering in Project B **NEVER waits behind 10 background coding workers in Project A**!
- [ ] **Implement 10-Minute Renewable Cross-Project Budget & Quota Grants (`CrossProjectGrantLeaseManager`):** Use `Task 024`'s two-phase `global.db.grants` table (`grantId`, `projectId`, `connectionId`, `currency: 'micro_usd' | 'ppm'`, `grantedAmount`, `consumedAmount`, `expiresAt = now + 10 min`) so:
  - Project A and Project B sharing ONE ChatGPT Plus 5-hour window OR ONE `$20` OpenRouter credit balance atomically lease bounded **10-minute slices** (e.g., `50,000 ppm` or `$1.00`) without stepping on each other's allowance!
  - Unspent remainder returns cleanly to the shared `global.db` pool immediately upon grant close or 10-minute expiry (`reclaimExpiredGrants()`) — preventing a crashed/idle Project A from stranding allowance needed by Project B!
- [ ] **Implement Machine-Wide Execution-Slot & Heavy-Lane Sharing (`MachineWideSlotCoordinator`):** Share the machine's physical **Pool 2 Warm Execution Slots (`2–4`)**, **Session-Process Cap (`4–8`)**, and **Single Heavy-Lane Semaphore (`Task 118`–`119`)** globally across ALL open projects (one shared `global.db` / `harnessd` broker!), enforcing **Verifier > Foreground Worker > Background Worker > Batch** so opening 3 projects simultaneously on a 16 GB laptop STILL caps total simultaneous Playwright/tsc runs strictly at `2` (ZERO laptop freeze!)!
- [ ] **Implement Shared Dynamic Port Lease Table (`41000–48999`) Across All Projects:** Coordinate all Live Preview, Postgres, Redis, Mailpit, and S3 ports globally via `global.db.port_leases` (`Task 014`) so Project A's preview and Project B's test environment can NEVER collide on port numbers!
- [ ] **Implement Dynamic Foreground Focus Boost:** Automatically update `foregroundProjectId` in the broker whenever the user switches the active project tab/window so the project currently in front of the user's eyes immediately receives `foreground` weight (`4`) while the previously active project gracefully shifts to `background` (`2`) without losing a single in-flight step!
- [ ] **Implement Transparent Multi-Project Resource Popover Data:** Expose live broker breakdown (`"Shared ChatGPT Plus: Project A 3 slots · Project B 1 interactive slot · Machine run slots: 2/2 (Project B Verifier, Project A Worker)"`) cleanly for Top Bar & Diagnostics (`Task 133`)!

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **Project A runs an 8-worker Wave 2 build on ChatGPT Plus (`cwnd = 4`) while the developer switches to Project B and sends a Discovery message:** Reserved interactive slot + `interactive` weight (`8`) dispatches Project B's Discovery turn IMMEDIATELY (`< 100 ms` queue wait!) without pausing Project A!
- **Project A and Project B BOTH request a `$2.00` grant when only `$2.50` remains on the shared OpenRouter key:** Atomic `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` in `global.db.grants` grants `$2.00` to A and `$0.50` (partial bounded grant!) to B — total granted NEVER exceeds `$2.50`!
- **Project A crashes unexpectedly while holding a `10-minute` grant of `100,000 ppm` (`20,000 ppm` actually used):** Dead-lease / 10-min TTL expiry reclaims the unused `80,000 ppm` cleanly back into the global pool so Project B is never starved!
- **3 open projects simultaneously trigger `pnpm build` + Playwright on a 16 GB laptop (`machine Pool 2 = 2`, `heavyLane = 1`):** `MachineWideSlotCoordinator` strictly enforces global ceiling (`2` run slots total, `1` heavy lane total across ALL 3 projects!), keeping laptop UI latency `< 50 ms`!
- **Foreground Project B runs continuously for 45 minutes while Background Project A sits in `background` (`weight = 2`):** Weighted Fair Queuing guarantees Project A STILL receives steady proportional share (`~33%` of non-interactive capacity) — zero starvation!
- **Two projects share a GitHub account (`Task 177`) and push PRs simultaneously:** Broker shares ONE `GitHubRateAwareQueue` (`< 80/min`, `< 500/hr`) across both projects cleanly!
- **Hardware Governor enters `ORANGE` (`1` machine execution slot total):** Broker cleanly allocates the single slot strictly by `Verifier > Foreground > Background` across all projects!

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Strict Machine-Wide Capacity Ceiling Invariant:** Total active Pool-2 execution slots, heavy-lane jobs, and resident foreign CLI processes across ALL open projects combined NEVER exceed the single laptop's Governor caps.
- **Zero-Starvation Weighted Fair Queuing Invariant:** Every active class (`interactive:8`, `foreground:4`, `background:2`, `batch:1`) receives deterministic proportional service with zero starvation.
- **Reserved-Interactive-Responsiveness Invariant:** User interactive prompts in any project ALWAYS bypass background worker queues via the reserved interactive slot.
- **Atomic 10-Min Reclaimable Grant Invariant:** Shared connection `micro-USD` and `ppm` grants never over-allocate across concurrent projects and automatically reclaim unspent amounts after 10 minutes or release.
- **Zero-Cross-DB-`ATTACH` Invariant:** All multi-project coordination flows strictly through `global.db` + `Task 024` grants — zero `ATTACH` queries across project DBs.

### Task 190: Meta-Lab Simulated Developer Harnesses (Scripted Regression Driver, Hidden-Spec Persona Model Driver, Anonymized Recorded Session Replayer & Exact-Input Response Cache)

- **Milestone & Track:** `M6 · Meta-Lab Automated User Simulation & Replay`
- **Depends On:** `Task 001`, `Task 007`, `Task 011`, `Task 069`, `Task 189`
- **Git Worktree & Branch:** `task/190-meta-lab-sim-dev-harnesses` in `../ef-wt/task-190-meta-lab-sim-dev-harnesses` (commit on own branch only; **NEVER merge**)

- **Shared Contracts Consumed / Produced:** Consumes `CanonicalHash` (`Task 007`), `PacketSecurityRedactor` (`Task 011`), `DiscoverySessionCoordinator` (`Task 069`), `MetaLabBenchmarkRegistry` (`Task 189`); produces `ScriptedRegressionSimDev`, `HiddenSpecPersonaSimDev`, `AnonymizedSessionReplayer`, and `ExactInputModelResponseCache`

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Implement Mode 1 — Deterministic Scripted Regression Driver (`ScriptedRegressionSimDev`):** Drive EF Harness Discovery, Plan Preview, Steering, Inbox Cards, and Approvals cleanly via structured deterministic rulesets (`matchQuestionId`, `matchTopicPattern`, `replyText`, `injectMidBuildSteeringAtTask`, `clickAction`) — achieving **`100%` reproducible zero-variance user behavior** for fast CI regression checks and paired A/B prompt testing (`Task 191`)!
- [ ] **Implement Mode 2 — Hidden-Spec Persona Model Driver (`HiddenSpecPersonaSimDev`):** Evaluate how well EF Harness discovers requirements from realistic messy humans! Feed a separate **Persona Model** a private hidden product specification PLUS realistic human communication traits (`busy_founder_terse`, `rambling_dictation_with_retractions`, `non_technical_small_business_owner`, `opinionated_senior_engineer`, `mid_build_scope_changer`):
  - The Persona Model answers ONLY what EF Harness actually asks (NEVER volunteering hidden spec details unprompted unless naturally triggered by its persona!)
  - Tests whether EF Harness's adaptive question selector (`Task 072`), `infer-or-ask` honesty (`Task 070`–`071`), and spec expansion (`Task 079`–`081`) truly uncover critical hidden requirements without nagging the user!
  - Enforces a strict turn ceiling (`<= 25` user turns) and budget ceiling so Persona tests stay fast and affordable!
- [ ] **Implement Mode 3 — Anonymized Real Recorded Session Replayer (`AnonymizedSessionReplayer`):** Support exporting opt-in anonymized recorded developer interaction sequences (`userMessage` + `uiActions` scrubbed completely of secrets, emails, usernames, company names, and proprietary code via `Task 011` + `AnonymizationScrubber`!) and replaying them deterministically against candidate harness versions to prevent regressions on real-world messy phrasing (spoken dictation quirks, mid-build interruptions, overlapping edits!)!
- [ ] **Implement Content-Addressed Exact-Input Response Cache (`ExactInputModelResponseCache`):** Slash Meta-Lab eval cost & wall-clock time by **`60–85%`** cleanly WITHOUT biasing A/B comparisons!
  - Key cache entries strictly by **exact RFC 8785 canonical hash** of `(modelId, systemPrompt, messagesJson, toolsSchemaJson, temperature/seed, responseFormatSchema)` stored in local Meta-Lab SQLite/CAS cache!
  - If an eval experiment changes ONLY `feature-planner@1` (leaving Discovery `batch-resolve@1` and `system-architect@1` inputs byte-identical!), Discovery & System Arch steps hit the exact-input cache instantaneously at **`$0.00` and `< 5 ms`** while the modified `feature-planner@1` step executes fresh live calls!
  - Include explicit `--no-cache` and `--cache-mode read-only | read-write | bypass` controls PLUS cache-hit ratio reporting on every eval run!
- [ ] **Implement Realistic Mid-Build Interaction Injection Schedule:** Allow all 3 Sim-Dev modes to inject timed mid-build events deterministically at exact lifecycle milestones (`onFeatureMerged`, `onTaskStarted`, `onInboxCardArrived`): e.g., `"Inject ambiguous message when F-Orders reaches 50%"`, `"Trigger STOP during Wave 1"`, `"Modify unrelated VS Code file while building"`!
- [ ] **Implement Strict Persona Non-Leakage Guard:** Verify programmatically that the hidden spec prompt given to `HiddenSpecPersonaSimDev` is strictly isolated from EF Harness's `state.db`, worktree, and worker prompts (zero side-channel leakage!)!
- [ ] **Implement Anonymization Verification Gate On Recorded Sessions:** Run double-pass secret + PII + Windows-path redaction BEFORE saving any recorded session fixture, failing closed if any raw secret/email/username survives!
- [ ] **Implement Uniform `SimDevDriver` Interface & Transcript Recorder:** All 3 modes implement one clean `SimDevDriver` contract recording exact `{ turnSeq, triggerEvent, responseText, actionTaken, elapsedMs, personaTokens }` for post-eval inspection in `Task 191`!

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **A prompt candidate changes a single comma in `batch-resolve@1`'s system prompt:** Exact RFC 8785 input hash immediately misses cache cleanly on `batch-resolve@1` (forcing a real live evaluation!) while unchanged upstream prompts still hit cache accurately!
- **A Persona Model gets stuck repeating `"Sounds good"` when EF Harness asks an unclear question:** Turn ceiling (`<= 25` turns) + repetition detector halts cleanly and scores the harness poorly on Discovery clarity (catching bad UX!) rather than looping infinitely!
- **A recorded session contains `C:\Users\Ayush\my-company\secret.env` and `ayush@acme.com`:** `AnonymizationScrubber` replaces paths/emails/company names deterministically (`<USER>`, `<EMAIL_1>`, `<PROJECT>`) and fails closed if any secret survives!
- **`ScriptedRegressionSimDev` encounters an unexpected new Inbox question added by a harness refactor (`no matching rule`):** Driver records `unmatched_question_encountered` cleanly and either uses declared safe fallback (`"Use recommended default"`) or fails strictly in regression-strict mode so unexpected extra user interruptions are immediately caught!
- **Two parallel eval runs write to `ExactInputModelResponseCache` simultaneously:** SQLite `WAL` + `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` upsert handles concurrent cache reads/writes cleanly with zero corruption!
- **User runs paired statistical eval (`Task 191`) with `--no-cache` to measure live non-deterministic model variance across `k = 5` seeds:** `--cache-mode bypass` guarantees 100% fresh provider calls with exact seed/run tagging!
- **`HiddenSpecPersonaSimDev` encounters a `SecretCard` (`Task 127`) during an E2E test:** Supplies ONLY synthetic test-env credentials (`sk_test_SIM_MOCK_123`) cleanly without exposing real vault keys!

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Strict Exact-Input Cache Key Invariant:** Cache keys hash 100% of `(modelId, systemPrompt, messages, tools, params, schema)` via RFC 8785 — a 1-character prompt change NEVER receives a stale cached response.
- **Zero-Hidden-Spec-Leakage Invariant:** `HiddenSpecPersonaSimDev`'s private spec is completely inaccessible to EF Harness processes, worktrees, and databases.
- **Zero-PII/Secret Recorded-Session Invariant:** Anonymized recorded session exports pass double-pass secret/PII/path scrubbing before touching disk.
- **Bounded-Turn Persona Invariant:** Simulated developer loops enforce hard turn and repetition ceilings so evals never hang.
- **Strict Unmatched-Question Visibility Invariant:** Extra unexpected questions surfaced to a scripted regression driver are explicitly counted as interruption regressions!
- **Uniform `SimDevDriver` Interface Invariant:** Scripted, Persona, and Replayer modes plug interchangeably into `Task 191` Evaluation Runner.

#### Multi-Agent Harmony And Branch Isolation

### Task 191: Meta-Lab 3-Level Evaluation Runner (Unit / Component / E2E) & Paired Statistical Promotion Engine (McNemar's Test, Bootstrap 95% CI, ≥15% Efficiency Tie Rule & Lifecycle States)

- **Milestone & Track:** `M6 · Meta-Lab Rigorous Statistical Prompt & Skill Promotion`
- **Depends On:** `Task 001`, `Task 009`, `Task 078`, `Task 189`, `Task 190`
- **Git Worktree & Branch:** `task/191-meta-lab-evals-statistical-promotion` in `../ef-wt/task-191-meta-lab-evals-statistical-promotion` (commit on own branch only; **NEVER merge**)
- **Owned Write Scope (Disjoint Subtree):** `packages/meta-lab/src/evals/**`, `packages/meta-lab/tests/evals/**`, and `.agent-handoffs/task-191.md`
- **Mandatory Reference Files:** [meta-lab.md](meta-lab.md#three-level-evals-and-statistical-promotion), [task-and-skill-architecture.md](task-and-skill-architecture.md), [meta-lab.mmd](meta-lab.mmd), [meta-lab.svg](meta-lab.svg), [research/evaluating-prompts-and-skills.md](research/evaluating-prompts-and-skills.md)
- **Shared Contracts Consumed / Produced:** Consumes `PromptContractRegistry` (`Task 009`), `SkillManifestRegistry` (`Task 078`), `MetaLabBenchmarkRegistry` & `PromptContaminationScanner` (`Task 189`), `SimDevDriver` & `ExactInputModelResponseCache` (`Task 190`); produces `ThreeLevelEvalRunner`, `PairedStatisticalPromotionEngine`, `McNemarAndBootstrapCalculator`, and `ArtifactLifecycleManager`

#### Scope And Implementation Requirements

- [ ] **Implement Complete 3-Level Evaluation Runner (`ThreeLevelEvalRunner`):** Evaluate EVERY candidate prompt (`prompt-contracts.md`), skill (`corpus/skills/**`), corpus pack, or scheduler tweak across 3 escalating cost/fidelity tiers ([meta-lab.md](meta-lab.md)):
  - **Level 1 — Fast Unit Evals (`< 30 s`, pennies!):** Single-prompt contract precision/recall suites over curated golden + adversarial cases (e.g., `batch-resolve@1` against 5-pos/2-neg examples from `Tasks 075–076`, `entailment-checker@1` against `"link on phones"`, `router@1` multi-clause routing, `ci-triage@1` 5-class accuracy, `contradiction-check@1` false-positive rate!) — hard gate before spending dollars on Level 2/3!
  - **Level 2 — Component Pipeline Evals (`2–5 min`):** Multi-step subsystem evals (Discovery → Readiness → Spec Expansion → 5-Layer Contradictions; Slicer → Native Worker → Verifier; Bug Intake → 6-Stage Investigation; Sweep Planner → Codemod → Safety Guards) using `ExactInputModelResponseCache` (`Task 190`)!
  - **Level 3 — Full End-To-End Held-Out Evals (`15–45 min`):** Complete greenfield & brownfield benchmark runs (`Kitchen`, `resume-changer`, `Expense CLI`, `Booking API`, `10-Bug Set`, `Sweep Set`, `Red-Team Set`) scored strictly by independent external graders (`Task 189`) on the **Held-Out Frozen Eval Split**!
- [ ] **Implement Paired Statistical Promotion Engine (`PairedStatisticalPromotionEngine` + `McNemarAndBootstrapCalculator`):** Eliminate "vibes-based" prompt engineering and noisy 1-run regressions! Always run **Baseline (`active`) vs Candidate (`draft`) PAIRED on the EXACT SAME frozen case set, seeds, and model version**, then apply exact statistical decision rules:
  1. **Exact McNemar's Test (Two-Sided Exact Binomial on Discordant Pairs `b` [Base Fail → Cand Pass] vs `c` [Base Pass → Cand Fail]):** Compute exact p-value for binary pass/fail outcomes — requiring statistically significant improvement (`b > c`, `p < 0.05` on paired cases, OR strict non-inferiority `c === 0` / upper degradation bound cleanly within margin for efficiency-only wins!)
  2. **Paired Non-Parametric Bootstrap 95% Confidence Interval (`B = 10,000` Resamples, Deterministic PRNG Seed!):** Compute exact `95% CI` for mean paired delta on continuous metrics (`hiddenPassRateDelta`, `tokenCostRatio`, `wallClockRatio`, `humanInterruptionsDelta`, `paperworkPctDelta`)!
  3. **Exact `>= 15%` Efficiency Tie Rule:** If Candidate ties Baseline on pass quality (paired quality 95% CI strictly non-inferior, zero new critical/security failures!) AND achieves **`>= 15%` reduction** in cost/tokens OR wall-clock time (entire 95% CI showing `>= 15%` savings!), approve promotion cleanly as an **Efficiency Win**!
  4. **Hard Zero-Regression Security & Contract Floor:** Unconditionally **REJECT** promotion if Candidate introduces even **1** Red-Team security failure (`Task 193`), **1** schema violation (`Task 009`), **1** prompt-contamination flag (`Task 189`), OR breaks the `<= 20%` paperwork budget!
- [ ] **Implement Formal Artifact Lifecycle State Machine (`ArtifactLifecycleManager` — `draft → evaluated → active → deprecated`):** Manage every versioned prompt contract, vetted skill, and corpus pack cleanly in `meta-lab/registry.json` + Git:
  - **`draft`:** Newly edited candidate; CANNOT be selected by production builds!
  - **`evaluated`:** Has passed `PromptContaminationScanner` + Level 1/2/3 paired evals with immutable signed `EvalReport` attached (showing exact McNemar `p`, Bootstrap 95% CI, and cost/speed deltas)!
  - **`active`:** Explicitly promoted after passing statistical promotion criteria (superseding prior `active → deprecated` cleanly while preserving exact rollback pointer!)
  - **`deprecated`:** Archived cleanly for reproducible replay of historical runs, never selected for new builds!
- [ ] **Implement Cost-Capped Early Stopping (Futility Pruning):** If a Level 1 Unit Eval drops `> 5%` below baseline or fails schema validation, abort immediately BEFORE launching expensive Level 2/3 E2E runs, saving 95% of wasted eval budget!
- [ ] **Implement Crisp Markdown & JSON Promotion Scorecard Generator:** Emit clear paired comparison tables (`Baseline v1 vs Candidate v2`, discordant pairs `b/c`, McNemar exact `p`, Bootstrap 95% CI, token/time savings %, security verdict, and crisp `PROMOTE | REJECT | NEED_MORE_SAMPLES` recommendation)!
- [ ] **Implement Deterministic PRNG For Reproducible Bootstrap CIs:** Seed bootstrap resampling deterministically from `sha256(evalRunId)` so re-analyzing the exact same paired dataset ALWAYS computes identical 95% CI bounds to 4 decimal places!
- [ ] **Implement CLI Entrypoint (`pnpm meta-lab:eval --candidate <id> --level 1|2|3`):** Provide clean developer/CI CLI tooling outputting structured JSON + human summary and exiting with semantic codes (`0` promote-eligible, `1` rejected, `2` insufficient power / need more samples)!
- [ ] **Implement Instant One-Command Rollback (`active → deprecated`, previous `deprecated → active`):** Allow instant atomic rollback of any promoted prompt or skill if a real-world edge case appears post-release!

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **Candidate improves pass rate on 2 cases and regresses on 2 cases (`b = 2, c = 2`):** McNemar exact `p = 1.0`, quality ties, cost is identical (`0%` savings `< 15%`) → engine cleanly returns **`REJECT (no significant improvement)`** instead of churning prompts on noise!
- **Candidate matches baseline pass rate identically (`b = 0, c = 0`, 0 regressions!) AND reduces average build cost by `22%` (`95% CI: [17.4%, 26.8%]`, lower bound `>= 15%`!):** Efficiency Tie Rule approves **`PROMOTE (Efficiency Win: -22% cost, 0 quality loss)`**!
- **Candidate reduces cost by `16%` on average, YET its 95% CI is `[-2%, +31%]` (noisy outlier!) OR it breaks 1 Red-Team security test:** Engine hard-rejects (`95% CI crosses below 15%` / `RedTeamRegressionBlock`)!
- **Candidate achieves `b = 7, c = 0` (`McNemar exact p = 0.0156 < 0.05`) on paired held-out cases with 0 security regressions:** Engine approves **`PROMOTE (Quality Win: p = 0.0156)`**!
- **Engineer tries to force-promote a `draft` prompt straight to `active` skipping `evaluated` (`draft → active`):** `ArtifactLifecycleManager` hard-throws `InvalidLifecycleTransitionError('draft → active forbidden; must pass evaluated')`!
- **Candidate fails Level 1 `batch-resolve@1` unit eval (`78%` vs baseline `96%`):** Futility gate aborts immediately in `< 20 s`, never launching costly Level 3 E2E runs!
- **Discordant counts are tiny (`b = 3, c = 0`, exact McNemar `p = 0.25 > 0.05`):** Exact binomial McNemar accurately detects insufficient statistical power (`NEED_MORE_SAMPLES` instead of using broken asymptotic chi-square approximation on tiny `n`!)!

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Strict Paired-Evaluation Invariant:** Baseline and Candidate ALWAYS evaluate paired on the exact same frozen suite version, split (`held_out`), and model roster.
- **Exact-Binomial McNemar Invariant:** Binary paired tests ALWAYS use exact two-sided binomial McNemar (never inaccurate asymptotic chi-square on small discordant counts `b + c < 25`).
- **Exact `>= 15%` CI-Backed Efficiency Tie Invariant:** Efficiency promotions require non-inferior quality AND full 95% CI confirming `>= 15%` cost/latency improvement.
- **Zero-Security/Contamination-Regression Invariant:** Any Red-Team failure, schema error, or contamination match unconditionally vetoes promotion regardless of pass rate or cost savings.
- **Strict Lifecycle State-Machine Invariant:** Only `draft → evaluated → active → deprecated` (and explicit audited rollback) transitions are permitted.
- **Deterministic Reproducible Statistics Invariant:** Seeded bootstrap resampling (`B = 10,000`) yields bit-identical CI bounds on repeated analysis.

#### Multi-Agent Harmony And Branch Isolation

- **Worktree Setup:** Create branch `task/191-meta-lab-evals-statistical-promotion` via `node scripts/agent-worktree.mjs create 191 meta-lab-evals-statistical-promotion`.

- **Commit-Only Discipline:** Commit exclusively on `task/191-meta-lab-evals-statistical-promotion`; **NEVER merge** into `main` or `harness/integration`.

- **Unicode & Space-In-Path Safe Invariant:** All bundled launchers pass tests inside paths containing spaces and non-ASCII characters.

#### Edge Cases And Failure Modes

- **All 6 milestones pass EXCEPT `Task 197` finds 1 stale diagram or `Task 198` reports Board update `11.4 ms > 10 ms`:** `V1ReleaseCertificationRunner` outputs **`NO-GO`** cleanly pinpointing the exact failing gate and exits non-zero!
- **A Linux case-sensitivity fix on Windows uses naive single-step `git mv Header.tsx header.tsx` which NTFS silently ignores (`git ls-files` still shows `Header.tsx`!):** `cert-linux-ci-case-repair.test.ts` inspects exact `git ls-files` tree casing and catches the broken single-step rename immediately!
- **All 7 benchmark suites pass EXCEPT `suite:red-team-security` has 1 canary byte leak in a diagnostics log:** Hard `NO-GO` veto blocks release immediately!
- **One of the 200 task handoffs (`task-147`) wasn't wired into the adapter registry on `harness/integration`:** Integration closure verifier catches the unwired adapter before release!
- **Release runner tries to tag `v1.0.0` with `--unsigned-dev` installer:** Full release profile strictly requires Authenticode signed installer + valid `latest.yml` SHA-512 blockmap + CycloneDX SBOM!
- **Re-running `V1ReleaseCertificationRunner` in `ci-replay` mode twice in a row:** Produces bit-consistent `GO` scorecard cleanly offline with zero flakes!
- **Any single sub-suite leaves behind a stray background process or temp file:** Final release hygiene check asserts `0` leaked PIDs and clean workspace before emitting `GO`!

#### Bug Prevention And Invariants

- **Zero-Waiver v1 Release Gate Invariant:** Release status `GO` requires 100% PASS across all 7 frozen benchmark suites, all 7 pre-release audit/scale/packaging/parity gates, and all M0–M6 milestone exit gates.
- **Verified Linux Case-Sensitivity Repair Invariant:** Windows → Linux case-mismatch CI auto-repair is verified end-to-end against real Git index tree casing (`git ls-files`).
- **Complete 200-Task Integration Closure Invariant:** All contracts and handoffs across `Task 001`–`Task 200` are verified wired on `harness/integration` before tagging `v1.0.0`.

- **Signed & Verifiable Release Artifact Invariant:** Production v1 release ships signed Windows NSIS installer, verified `integrity-manifest.json`, `latest.yml`, CycloneDX SBOM, and `V1_RELEASE_SCORECARD.md`.
- **Clean-Machine Zero-Leak Final Invariant:** Final certification completes with `0` leaked child processes, `0` plaintext secrets, and clean Git state.

## Out Of Scope And Deferred Post-v1 Capabilities

The following items are explicitly **out of scope for v1** per [roadmap.md](roadmap.md), [open-design-questions.md](open-design-questions.md), [execution-capacity.md](execution-capacity.md), [provider-connections.md](provider-connections.md), and [ship-and-deploy.md](ship-and-deploy.md). Implementing agents MUST NOT invent partial hacks, fake UI stubs, or undocumented workarounds for any of these items during `Task 001`–`Task 200`:

1. **Strictly Prohibited Provider Routes (Never Offered):**
   - **Claude consumer subscription OAuth / `claude setup-token` / `~/.claude/.credentials.json` scraping:** Explicitly withdrawn per owner compliance decision; Claude Code uses Anthropic Console API keys ONLY (`Task 135`, `Task 147`).
   - **Google Antigravity:** Never offered as a provider, runtime adapter, or UI option (`Task 135`, `Task 141`, `Task 148`, `Task 199`).
   - **Reading or scraping `~/.gemini`:** Strictly forbidden; Gemini CLI runs unmodified via `gemini --acp`, off by default behind explicit policy notice (`Task 148`).
2. **Deferred Post-v1 Platforms & Sandboxes:**
   - **macOS & Linux native desktop packaging / OS sandboxes (`Seatbelt`, `bubblewrap`/`landlock`):** v1 targets Windows 10/11 first; clean interface seams exist (`Task 045`, `Task 117`), while full macOS/Linux installers ship post-v1.
   - **Tier E Remote Cloud Sandboxes (e.g., E2B / Modal / remote Docker VMs):** Clean pluggable `TierERemoteExecutionInterface` contract is defined and tested against an in-memory mock (`Task 045`, `Task 119`); live hosted cloud sandbox execution ships post-v1.
3. **Deferred Post-v1 Deploy Hosts:**
   - **Managed container & PaaS hosts beyond Vercel and Docker over SSH** (Fly.io, Railway, Render, Google Cloud Run, AWS ECS/Amplify, Cloudflare Workers): v1 ships production-grade **Vercel** and **Docker over SSH** behind the clean `DeployAdapter` interface (`Task 179`).
4. **Deferred Post-v1 Collaboration & Cloud Sync:**
   - **Multi-user real-time collaborative editing / hosted team SaaS server / cloud telemetry:** EF Harness v1 is strictly a local-first open-source single-developer desktop application with Git-native orphan-branch (`harness-state`) single-writer cross-device sync (`Task 186`–`187`) and zero phone-home telemetry (`Task 133`, `Task 199`).
5. **Deferred Post-v1 Office Art & Theme Packs:**
   - **Custom user-imported Tiled maps, 3D/isometric engines, or multiplayer offices:** v1 ships the cozy 16-px 2D PixiJS 11-room Office View (`Tasks 162–165`) with full truthfulness, A* movement, accessibility mirror, and automatic `Orange → Board` fallback.

## Multi-Agent Branch Integration & Merge-Queue Runbook

Because **every worker agent commits strictly on its own dedicated worktree branch `task/NNN-<slug>` and NEVER merges into `main` or `harness/integration`**, the Integration Coordinator integrates completed task branches cleanly in topological wave order using the following deterministic protocol:

1. **Pre-Merge Branch Audit (Per Task Branch `task/NNN-<slug>`):**
   - Run `node scripts/verify-harmony.mjs --task NNN` confirming modified files stay strictly inside the task's **Owned Write Scope (Disjoint Subtree)** and `.agent-handoffs/task-NNN.md` exists with exact exported types, pending root-wiring notes, and verification results.
   - Verify clean working tree, `typecheck`, `lint`, and task unit/integration test suites pass cleanly on the branch.
2. **Strict Topological Wave Integration Order:**
   - **Wave 0 (Foundation):** Merge `task/001-foundation-opencode-monorepo-worktrees` onto `harness/integration` FIRST, verify `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm build`, and fast-forward `main` so every downstream agent branches from verified foundation.
   - **Wave 1 (Spikes & Shared Contracts):** Merge `task/002`–`task/011` cleanly in order (0 overlapping files across `spikes/**` and `packages/contracts/src/*`), wire barrel exports in `packages/contracts/src/index.ts` in one clean coordinator wiring commit, and tag `milestone/contracts-ready`.
   - **Wave 2 (M0 Kernel):** Merge `task/012`–`task/033` (disjoint subtrees under `packages/kernel/src/*`), wire `packages/kernel/src/index.ts` from `.agent-handoffs/task-012..033.md`, then merge & run **`task/034`** M0 10,000-run simulation exit gate.
   - **Wave 3 (M1 One Task End-To-End):** Merge `task/035`–`task/067` (disjoint subtrees across `git`, `sandbox`, `test-env`, `worker`, `verifier`, `daemon`, `desktop`), perform one clean coordinator barrel-wiring commit per package, then merge & run **`task/068`** M1 20-task Kitchen exit gate.
   - **Wave 4 (M2 Discovery, Corpus, Spec, Arch, Plan & Intake):** Merge `task/069`–`task/104` (disjoint subtrees across `discovery`, `corpus`, `spec-expansion`, `research-engine`, `planner`, `integrator`, `intake`), wire package exports from handoffs, then merge & run **`task/105`** M2 Kitchen sequential exit gate (`>= 90%`).
   - **Wave 5 (M3 Parallel, Cockpit, Governor, Steering & Desktop Lifecycle):** Merge `task/106`–`task/133`, wire shell tabs & IPC routes from handoffs, then merge & run **`task/134`** M3 parallel exit gate (`>= 2.0×` speedup, `0` drop, `p99 < 50 ms`, Board `< 10 ms`).
   - **Wave 6 (M4 Providers & Foreign Runtime Adapters):** Merge `task/135`–`task/151`, wire provider/adapter registries from handoffs, then merge & run **`task/152`** M4 ChatGPT Plus allowance-paced & 7-adapter conformance exit gate.
   - **Wave 7 (M5 Canvas, Dictation, Preview, Office, Brownfield & Coexistence):** Merge `task/153`–`task/174`, wire Center Tabs & coexistence hooks from handoffs, then merge & run **`task/175`** M5 `resume-changer@497831ec` & Office truthfulness exit gate.
   - **Wave 8 (M6 Ship/Deploy, Investigations/Sweeps, Portability/Broker, Meta-Lab & Final Certification):** Merge `task/176`–`task/199`, run final wiring commit, then merge & execute **`task/200`** to produce the final signed **`V1_RELEASE_SCORECARD.md` (`GO`)** before promoting `harness/integration → main` and tagging `v1.0.0`!
3. **Post-Integration Worktree Cleanup:** After each wave's branches are merged and verified green on `harness/integration`, clean up merged worktrees safely via `node scripts/agent-worktree.mjs remove <NNN>` so disk space stays lean.
